book.title: Tanakh
book.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)
book.license: Hebrew: Miqra according to the Masorah via Sefaria, CC BY-SA. English: JPS 1917, public domain.
book.notes: Torah, Nevi’im and Ketuvim in the Hebrew order. Hebrew verse numbering is retained; a few books (e.g. Joel) differ from Christian numbering.

verses.original: שְׁמַ֣ע יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל אַתָּ֨ה עֹבֵ֤ר הַיּוֹם֙ אֶת־הַיַּרְדֵּ֔ן לָבֹא֙ לָרֶ֣שֶׁת גּוֹיִ֔ם גְּדֹלִ֥ים וַעֲצֻמִ֖ים מִמֶּ֑ךָּ עָרִ֛ים גְּדֹלֹ֥ת וּבְצֻרֹ֖ת בַּשָּׁמָֽיִם׃
verses.translit: shm' yshr'l 'th 'br hyvm 'thyrdn lb' lrsht gvym gdlym v'tsmym mmkh 'rym gdlt vbtsrt bshmym
verses.translation: Hear, O Israel: thou art to pass over the Jordan this day, to go in to dispossess nations greater and mightier than thyself, cities great and fortified up to heaven,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַֽם־גָּד֥וֹל וָרָ֖ם בְּנֵ֣י עֲנָקִ֑ים אֲשֶׁ֨ר אַתָּ֤ה יָדַ֙עְתָּ֙ וְאַתָּ֣ה שָׁמַ֔עְתָּ מִ֣י יִתְיַצֵּ֔ב לִפְנֵ֖י בְּנֵ֥י עֲנָֽק׃
verses.translit: 'mgdvl vrm bny 'nqym 'shr 'th yd't v'th shm't my ytytsb lpny bny 'nq
verses.translation: a people great and tall, the sons of the Anakim, whom thou knowest, and of whom thou hast heard say: ‘Who can stand before the sons of Anak?’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְיָדַעְתָּ֣ הַיּ֗וֹם כִּי֩ יְהֹוָ֨ה אֱלֹהֶ֜יךָ הֽוּא־הָעֹבֵ֤ר לְפָנֶ֙יךָ֙ אֵ֣שׁ אֹֽכְלָ֔ה ה֧וּא יַשְׁמִידֵ֛ם וְה֥וּא יַכְנִיעֵ֖ם לְפָנֶ֑יךָ וְהֽוֹרַשְׁתָּ֤ם וְהַֽאֲבַדְתָּם֙ מַהֵ֔ר כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר דִּבֶּ֥ר יְהֹוָ֖ה לָֽךְ׃
verses.translit: vyd't hyvm khy yhvh 'lhykh hv'h'br lpnykh 'sh 'khlh hv' yshmydm vhv' ykhny'm lpnykh vhvrshtm vh'bdtm mhr kh'shr dbr yhvh lkh
verses.translation: Know therefore this day, that the LORD thy God is He who goeth over before thee as a devouring fire; He will destroy them, and He will bring them down before thee; so shalt thou drive them out, and make them to perish quickly, as the LORD hath spoken unto thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַל־תֹּאמַ֣ר בִּלְבָבְךָ֗ בַּהֲדֹ֣ף יְהֹוָה֩ אֱלֹהֶ֨יךָ אֹתָ֥ם ׀ מִלְּפָנֶ֘יךָ֮ לֵאמֹר֒ בְּצִדְקָתִי֙ הֱבִיאַ֣נִי יְהֹוָ֔ה לָרֶ֖שֶׁת אֶת־הָאָ֣רֶץ הַזֹּ֑את וּבְרִשְׁעַת֙ הַגּוֹיִ֣ם הָאֵ֔לֶּה יְהֹוָ֖ה מוֹרִישָׁ֥ם מִפָּנֶֽיךָ׃
verses.translit: 'lt'mr blbbkh bhdf yhvh 'lhykh 'tm  mlpnykh l'mr btsdqty hby'ny yhvh lrsht 'th'rts hz't vbrsh't hgvym h'lh yhvh mvryshm mpnykh
verses.translation: Speak not thou in thy heart, after that the LORD thy God hath thrust them out from before thee, saying: ‘For my righteousness the LORD hath brought me in to possess this land’; whereas for the wickedness of these nations the LORD doth drive them out from before thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֹ֣א בְצִדְקָתְךָ֗ וּבְיֹ֙שֶׁר֙ לְבָ֣בְךָ֔ אַתָּ֥ה בָ֖א לָרֶ֣שֶׁת אֶת־אַרְצָ֑ם כִּ֞י בְּרִשְׁעַ֣ת  הַגּוֹיִ֣ם הָאֵ֗לֶּה יְהֹוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֶ֙יךָ֙ מוֹרִישָׁ֣ם מִפָּנֶ֔יךָ וּלְמַ֜עַן הָקִ֣ים אֶת־הַדָּבָ֗ר אֲשֶׁ֨ר נִשְׁבַּ֤ע יְהֹוָה֙ לַאֲבֹתֶ֔יךָ לְאַבְרָהָ֥ם לְיִצְחָ֖ק וּֽלְיַעֲקֹֽב׃
verses.translit: l' btsdqtkh vbyshr lbbkh 'th b' lrsht 't'rtsm khy brsh't  hgvym h'lh yhvh 'lhykh mvryshm mpnykh vlm'n hqym 'thdbr 'shr nshb' yhvh l'btykh l'brhm lytschq vly'qb
verses.translation: Not for thy righteousness, or for the uprightness of thy heart, dost thou go in to possess their land; but for the wickedness of these nations the LORD thy God doth drive them out from before thee, and that He may establish the word which the LORD swore unto thy fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְיָדַעְתָּ֗ כִּ֠י לֹ֤א בְצִדְקָֽתְךָ֙ יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱ֠לֹהֶ֠יךָ נֹתֵ֨ן לְךָ֜ אֶת־הָאָ֧רֶץ הַטּוֹבָ֛ה הַזֹּ֖את לְרִשְׁתָּ֑הּ כִּ֥י עַם־קְשֵׁה־עֹ֖רֶף אָֽתָּה׃
verses.translit: vyd't khy l' btsdqtkh yhvh 'lhykh ntn lkh 'th'rts htvbh hz't lrshth khy 'mqshh'rf 'th
verses.translation: Know therefore that it is not for thy righteousness that the LORD thy God giveth thee this good land to possess it; for thou art a stiffnecked people.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: זְכֹר֙ אַל־תִּשְׁכַּ֔ח אֵ֧ת אֲשֶׁר־הִקְצַ֛פְתָּ אֶת־יְהֹוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ בַּמִּדְבָּ֑ר לְמִן־הַיּ֞וֹם אֲשֶׁר־יָצָ֣אתָ  מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֗יִם עַד־בֹּֽאֲכֶם֙ עַד־הַמָּק֣וֹם הַזֶּ֔ה מַמְרִ֥ים הֱיִיתֶ֖ם עִם־יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: zkhr 'ltshkhch 't 'shrhqtspt 'tyhvh 'lhykh bmdbr lmnhyvm 'shryts't  m'rts mtsrym 'db'khm 'dhmqvm hzh mmrym hyytm 'myhvh
verses.translation: Remember, forget thou not, how thou didst make the LORD thy God wroth in the wilderness; from the day that thou didst go forth out of the land of Egypt, until ye came unto this place, ye have been rebellious against the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבְחֹרֵ֥ב הִקְצַפְתֶּ֖ם אֶת־יְהֹוָ֑ה וַיִּתְאַנַּ֧ף יְהֹוָ֛ה בָּכֶ֖ם לְהַשְׁמִ֥יד אֶתְכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vbchrb hqtsptm 'tyhvh vyt'nf yhvh bkhm lhshmyd 'tkhm
verses.translation: Also in Horeb ye made the LORD wroth, and the LORD was angered with you to have destroyed you.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בַּעֲלֹתִ֣י הָהָ֗רָה לָקַ֜חַת לוּחֹ֤ת הָֽאֲבָנִים֙ לוּחֹ֣ת הַבְּרִ֔ית אֲשֶׁר־כָּרַ֥ת יְהֹוָ֖ה עִמָּכֶ֑ם וָאֵשֵׁ֣ב בָּהָ֗ר אַרְבָּעִ֥ים יוֹם֙ וְאַרְבָּעִ֣ים לַ֔יְלָה לֶ֚חֶם לֹ֣א אָכַ֔לְתִּי וּמַ֖יִם לֹ֥א שָׁתִֽיתִי׃
verses.translit: b'lty hhrh lqcht lvcht h'bnym lvcht hbryt 'shrkhrt yhvh 'mkhm v'shb bhr 'rb'ym yvm v'rb'ym lylh lchm l' 'khlty vmym l' shtyty
verses.translation: When I was gone up into the mount to receive the tables of stone, even the tables of the covenant which the LORD made with you, then I abode in the mount forty days and forty nights; I did neither eat bread nor drink water.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּתֵּ֨ן יְהֹוָ֜ה אֵלַ֗י אֶת־שְׁנֵי֙ לוּחֹ֣ת הָֽאֲבָנִ֔ים כְּתֻבִ֖ים בְּאֶצְבַּ֣ע אֱלֹהִ֑ים וַעֲלֵיהֶ֗ם כְּֽכׇל־הַדְּבָרִ֡ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר דִּבֶּר֩ יְהֹוָ֨ה עִמָּכֶ֥ם בָּהָ֛ר מִתּ֥וֹךְ הָאֵ֖שׁ בְּי֥וֹם הַקָּהָֽל׃
verses.translit: vytn yhvh 'ly 'tshny lvcht h'bnym khtbym b'tsb' 'lhym v'lyhm khkhlhdbrym 'shr dbr yhvh 'mkhm bhr mtvkh h'sh byvm hqhl
verses.translation: And the LORD delivered unto me the two tables of stone written with the finger of God; and on them was written according to all the words, which the LORD spoke with you in the mount out of the midst of the fire in the day of the assembly.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֗י מִקֵּץ֙ אַרְבָּעִ֣ים י֔וֹם וְאַרְבָּעִ֖ים לָ֑יְלָה נָתַ֨ן יְהֹוָ֜ה אֵלַ֗י אֶת־שְׁנֵ֛י לֻחֹ֥ת הָאֲבָנִ֖ים לֻח֥וֹת הַבְּרִֽית׃
verses.translit: vyhy mqts 'rb'ym yvm v'rb'ym lylh ntn yhvh 'ly 'tshny lcht h'bnym lchvt hbryt
verses.translation: And it came to pass at the end of forty days and forty nights, that the LORD gave me the two tables of stone, even the tables of the covenant.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהֹוָ֜ה אֵלַ֗י ק֣וּם רֵ֤ד מַהֵר֙ מִזֶּ֔ה כִּ֚י שִׁחֵ֣ת עַמְּךָ֔ אֲשֶׁ֥ר הוֹצֵ֖אתָ מִמִּצְרָ֑יִם סָ֣רוּ מַהֵ֗ר מִן־הַדֶּ֙רֶךְ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר צִוִּיתִ֔ם עָשׂ֥וּ לָהֶ֖ם מַסֵּכָֽה׃
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'ly qvm rd mhr mzh khy shcht 'mkh 'shr hvts't mmtsrym srv mhr mnhdrkh 'shr tsvytm 'shv lhm mskhh
verses.translation: And the LORD said unto me: ‘Arise, get thee down quickly from hence; for thy people that thou hast brought forth out of Egypt have dealt corruptly; they are quickly turned aside out of the way which I commanded them; they have made them a molten image.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר יְהֹוָ֖ה אֵלַ֣י לֵאמֹ֑ר רָאִ֙יתִי֙ אֶת־הָעָ֣ם הַזֶּ֔ה וְהִנֵּ֥ה עַם־קְשֵׁה־עֹ֖רֶף הֽוּא׃
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'ly l'mr r'yty 'th'm hzh vhnh 'mqshh'rf hv'
verses.translation: Furthermore the LORD spoke unto me, saying: ‘I have seen this people, and, behold, it is a stiffnecked people;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֶ֤רֶף מִמֶּ֙נִּי֙ וְאַשְׁמִידֵ֔ם וְאֶמְחֶ֣ה אֶת־שְׁמָ֔ם מִתַּ֖חַת הַשָּׁמָ֑יִם וְאֶֽעֱשֶׂה֙ אֽוֹתְךָ֔ לְגוֹי־עָצ֥וּם וָרָ֖ב מִמֶּֽנּוּ׃
verses.translit: hrf mmny v'shmydm v'mchh 'tshmm mtcht hshmym v''shh 'vtkh lgvy'tsvm vrb mmnv
verses.translation: let Me alone, that I may destroy them, and blot out their name from under heaven; and I will make of thee a nation mightier and greater than they.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וָאֵ֗פֶן וָֽאֵרֵד֙ מִן־הָהָ֔ר וְהָהָ֖ר בֹּעֵ֣ר בָּאֵ֑שׁ וּשְׁנֵי֙ לוּחֹ֣ת הַבְּרִ֔ית עַ֖ל שְׁתֵּ֥י יָדָֽי׃
verses.translit: v'pn v'rd mnhhr vhhr b'r b'sh vshny lvcht hbryt 'l shty ydy
verses.translation: So I turned and came down from the mount, and the mount burned with fire; and the two tables of the covenant were in my two hands.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וָאֵ֗רֶא וְהִנֵּ֤ה חֲטָאתֶם֙ לַיהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶ֔ם עֲשִׂיתֶ֣ם לָכֶ֔ם עֵ֖גֶל מַסֵּכָ֑ה סַרְתֶּ֣ם מַהֵ֔ר מִן־הַדֶּ֕רֶךְ אֲשֶׁר־צִוָּ֥ה יְהֹוָ֖ה אֶתְכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: v'r' vhnh cht'tm lyhvh 'lhykhm 'shytm lkhm 'gl mskhh srtm mhr mnhdrkh 'shrtsvh yhvh 'tkhm
verses.translation: And I looked, and, behold, ye had sinned against the LORD your God; ye had made you a molten calf; ye had turned aside quickly out of the way which the LORD had commanded you.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וָאֶתְפֹּשׂ֙ בִּשְׁנֵ֣י הַלֻּחֹ֔ת וָֽאַשְׁלִכֵ֔ם מֵעַ֖ל שְׁתֵּ֣י יָדָ֑י וָאֲשַׁבְּרֵ֖ם לְעֵינֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: v'tpsh bshny hlcht v'shlkhm m'l shty ydy v'shbrm l'ynykhm
verses.translation: And I took hold of the two tables, and cast them out of my two hands, and broke them before your eyes.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וָֽאֶתְנַפַּל֩ לִפְנֵ֨י יְהֹוָ֜ה כָּרִאשֹׁנָ֗ה אַרְבָּעִ֥ים יוֹם֙ וְאַרְבָּעִ֣ים לַ֔יְלָה לֶ֚חֶם לֹ֣א אָכַ֔לְתִּי וּמַ֖יִם לֹ֣א שָׁתִ֑יתִי עַ֤ל כׇּל־חַטַּאתְכֶם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר חֲטָאתֶ֔ם לַעֲשׂ֥וֹת הָרַ֛ע בְּעֵינֵ֥י יְהֹוָ֖ה לְהַכְעִיסֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: v'tnpl lpny yhvh khr'shnh 'rb'ym yvm v'rb'ym lylh lchm l' 'khlty vmym l' shtyty 'l khlcht'tkhm 'shr cht'tm l'shvt hr' b'yny yhvh lhkh'ysv
verses.translation: And I fell down before the LORD, as at the first, forty days and forty nights; I did neither eat bread nor drink water; because of all your sin which ye sinned, in doing that which was evil in the sight of the LORD, to provoke Him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֣י יָגֹ֗רְתִּי מִפְּנֵ֤י הָאַף֙ וְהַ֣חֵמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר קָצַ֧ף יְהֹוָ֛ה עֲלֵיכֶ֖ם לְהַשְׁמִ֣יד אֶתְכֶ֑ם וַיִּשְׁמַ֤ע יְהֹוָה֙ אֵלַ֔י גַּ֖ם בַּפַּ֥עַם הַהִֽוא׃
verses.translit: khy ygrty mpny h'f vhchmh 'shr qtsf yhvh 'lykhm lhshmyd 'tkhm vyshm' yhvh 'ly gm bp'm hhv'
verses.translation: For I was in dread of the anger and hot displeasure, wherewith the LORD was wroth against you to destroy you. But the LORD hearkened unto me that time also.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּֽבְאַהֲרֹ֗ן הִתְאַנַּ֧ף יְהֹוָ֛ה מְאֹ֖ד לְהַשְׁמִיד֑וֹ וָֽאֶתְפַּלֵּ֛ל גַּם־בְּעַ֥ד אַהֲרֹ֖ן בָּעֵ֥ת הַהִֽוא׃
verses.translit: vb'hrn ht'nf yhvh m'd lhshmydv v'tpll gmb'd 'hrn b't hhv'
verses.translation: Moreover the LORD was very angry with Aaron to have destroyed him; and I prayed for Aaron also the same time.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְֽאֶת־חַטַּאתְכֶ֞ם אֲשֶׁר־עֲשִׂיתֶ֣ם אֶת־הָעֵ֗גֶל לָקַ֘חְתִּי֮ וָאֶשְׂרֹ֣ף אֹת֣וֹ ׀ בָּאֵשׁ֒ וָאֶכֹּ֨ת אֹת֤וֹ טָחוֹן֙ הֵיטֵ֔ב עַ֥ד אֲשֶׁר־דַּ֖ק לְעָפָ֑ר וָֽאַשְׁלִךְ֙ אֶת־עֲפָר֔וֹ אֶל־הַנַּ֖חַל הַיֹּרֵ֥ד מִן־הָהָֽר׃
verses.translit: v'tcht'tkhm 'shr'shytm 'th'gl lqchty v'shrf 'tv  b'sh v'kht 'tv tchvn hytb 'd 'shrdq l'pr v'shlkh 't'prv 'lhnchl hyrd mnhhr
verses.translation: And I took your sin, the calf which ye had made, and burnt it with fire, and beat it in pieces, grinding it very small, until it was as fine as dust; and I cast the dust thereof into the brook that descended out of the mount.—
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבְתַבְעֵרָה֙ וּבְמַסָּ֔ה וּבְקִבְרֹ֖ת הַֽתַּאֲוָ֑ה מַקְצִפִ֥ים הֱיִיתֶ֖ם אֶת־יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: vbtb'rh vbmsh vbqbrt ht'vh mqtspym hyytm 'tyhvh
verses.translation: And at Taberah, and at Massah, and at Kibroth-hattaavah, ye made the LORD wroth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבִשְׁלֹ֨חַ יְהֹוָ֜ה אֶתְכֶ֗ם מִקָּדֵ֤שׁ בַּרְנֵ֙עַ֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר עֲלוּ֙ וּרְשׁ֣וּ אֶת־הָאָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָתַ֖תִּי לָכֶ֑ם וַתַּמְר֗וּ אֶת־פִּ֤י יְהֹוָה֙ אֱלֹ֣הֵיכֶ֔ם וְלֹ֤א הֶֽאֱמַנְתֶּם֙ ל֔וֹ וְלֹ֥א שְׁמַעְתֶּ֖ם בְּקֹלֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vbshlch yhvh 'tkhm mqdsh brn' l'mr 'lv vrshv 'th'rts 'shr ntty lkhm vtmrv 'tpy yhvh 'lhykhm vl' h'mntm lv vl' shm'tm bqlv
verses.translation: And when the LORD sent you from Kadesh-barnea, saying: ‘Go up and possess the land which I have given you’; then ye rebelled against the commandment of the LORD your God, and ye believed Him not, nor hearkened to His voice.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מַמְרִ֥ים הֱיִיתֶ֖ם עִם־יְהֹוָ֑ה מִיּ֖וֹם דַּעְתִּ֥י אֶתְכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: mmrym hyytm 'myhvh myvm d'ty 'tkhm
verses.translation: Ye have been rebellious against the LORD from the day that I knew you.—
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וָֽאֶתְנַפַּ֞ל לִפְנֵ֣י יְהֹוָ֗ה אֵ֣ת אַרְבָּעִ֥ים הַיּ֛וֹם וְאֶת־אַרְבָּעִ֥ים הַלַּ֖יְלָה אֲשֶׁ֣ר הִתְנַפָּ֑לְתִּי כִּֽי־אָמַ֥ר יְהֹוָ֖ה לְהַשְׁמִ֥יד אֶתְכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: v'tnpl lpny yhvh 't 'rb'ym hyvm v't'rb'ym hlylh 'shr htnplty khy'mr yhvh lhshmyd 'tkhm
verses.translation: So I fell down before the LORD the forty days and forty nights that I fell down; because the LORD had said He would destroy you.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וָאֶתְפַּלֵּ֣ל אֶל־יְהֹוָה֮ וָאֹמַר֒ אֲדֹנָ֣י יֱהֹוִ֗ה אַל־תַּשְׁחֵ֤ת עַמְּךָ֙ וְנַחֲלָ֣תְךָ֔ אֲשֶׁ֥ר פָּדִ֖יתָ בְּגׇדְלֶ֑ךָ אֲשֶׁר־הוֹצֵ֥אתָ מִמִּצְרַ֖יִם בְּיָ֥ד חֲזָקָֽה׃
verses.translit: v'tpll 'lyhvh v'mr 'dny yhvh 'ltshcht 'mkh vnchltkh 'shr pdyt bgdlkh 'shrhvts't mmtsrym byd chzqh
verses.translation: And I prayed unto the LORD, and said: ‘O Lord GOD, destroy not Thy people and Thine inheritance, that Thou hast redeemed through Thy greatness, that Thou hast brought forth out of Egypt with a mighty hand.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: זְכֹר֙ לַעֲבָדֶ֔יךָ לְאַבְרָהָ֥ם לְיִצְחָ֖ק וּֽלְיַעֲקֹ֑ב אַל־תֵּ֗פֶן אֶל־קְשִׁי֙ הָעָ֣ם הַזֶּ֔ה וְאֶל־רִשְׁע֖וֹ וְאֶל־חַטָּאתֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: zkhr l'bdykh l'brhm lytschq vly'qb 'ltpn 'lqshy h'm hzh v'lrsh'v v'lcht'tv
verses.translation: Remember Thy servants, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob; look not unto the stubbornness of this people, nor to their wickedness, nor to their sin;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: פֶּן־יֹאמְר֗וּ הָאָ֘רֶץ֮ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הוֹצֵאתָ֣נוּ מִשָּׁם֒ מִבְּלִי֙ יְכֹ֣לֶת יְהֹוָ֔ה לַהֲבִיאָ֕ם אֶל־הָאָ֖רֶץ אֲשֶׁר־דִּבֶּ֣ר לָהֶ֑ם וּמִשִּׂנְאָת֣וֹ אוֹתָ֔ם הוֹצִיאָ֖ם לַהֲמִתָ֥ם בַּמִּדְבָּֽר׃
verses.translit: pny'mrv h'rts 'shr hvts'tnv mshm mbly ykhlt yhvh lhby'm 'lh'rts 'shrdbr lhm vmshn'tv 'vtm hvtsy'm lhmtm bmdbr
verses.translation: lest the land whence Thou broughtest us out say: Because the LORD was not able to bring them into the land which He promised unto them, and because He hated them, He hath brought them out to slay them in the wilderness.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהֵ֥ם עַמְּךָ֖ וְנַחֲלָתֶ֑ךָ אֲשֶׁ֤ר הוֹצֵ֙אתָ֙ בְּכֹחֲךָ֣ הַגָּדֹ֔ל וּבִֽזְרֹעֲךָ֖ הַנְּטוּיָֽה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vhm 'mkh vnchltkh 'shr hvts't bkhchkh hgdl vbzr'kh hntvyh {p}
verses.translation: Yet they are Thy people and Thine inheritance, that Thou didst bring out by Thy great power and by Thy outstretched arm.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בָּעֵ֨ת הַהִ֜וא אָמַ֧ר יְהֹוָ֣ה אֵלַ֗י פְּסׇל־לְךָ֞ שְׁנֵֽי־לוּחֹ֤ת אֲבָנִים֙ כָּרִ֣אשֹׁנִ֔ים וַעֲלֵ֥ה אֵלַ֖י הָהָ֑רָה וְעָשִׂ֥יתָ לְּךָ֖ אֲר֥וֹן עֵֽץ׃
verses.translit: b't hhv' 'mr yhvh 'ly psllkh shnylvcht 'bnym khr'shnym v'lh 'ly hhrh v'shyt lkh 'rvn 'ts
verses.translation: At that time the LORD said unto me: ‘Hew thee two tables of stone like unto the first, and come up unto Me into the mount; and make thee an ark of wood.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֶכְתֹּב֙ עַל־הַלֻּחֹ֔ת אֶ֨ת־הַדְּבָרִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר הָי֛וּ עַל־הַלֻּחֹ֥ת הָרִאשֹׁנִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר שִׁבַּ֑רְתָּ וְשַׂמְתָּ֖ם בָּאָרֽוֹן׃
verses.translit: v'khtb 'lhlcht 'thdbrym 'shr hyv 'lhlcht hr'shnym 'shr shbrt vshmtm b'rvn
verses.translation: And I will write on the tables the words that were on the first tables which thou didst break, and thou shalt put them in the ark.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וָאַ֤עַשׂ אֲרוֹן֙ עֲצֵ֣י שִׁטִּ֔ים וָאֶפְסֹ֛ל שְׁנֵי־לֻחֹ֥ת אֲבָנִ֖ים כָּרִאשֹׁנִ֑ים וָאַ֣עַל הָהָ֔רָה וּשְׁנֵ֥י הַלֻּחֹ֖ת בְּיָדִֽי׃
verses.translit: v''sh 'rvn 'tsy shtym v'psl shnylcht 'bnym khr'shnym v''l hhrh vshny hlcht bydy
verses.translation: So I made an ark of acacia-wood, and hewed two tables of stone like unto the first, and went up into the mount, having the two tables in my hand.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּכְתֹּ֨ב עַֽל־הַלֻּחֹ֜ת כַּמִּכְתָּ֣ב הָרִאשׁ֗וֹן אֵ֚ת עֲשֶׂ֣רֶת הַדְּבָרִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר דִּבֶּר֩ יְהֹוָ֨ה אֲלֵיכֶ֥ם בָּהָ֛ר מִתּ֥וֹךְ הָאֵ֖שׁ בְּי֣וֹם הַקָּהָ֑ל וַיִּתְּנֵ֥ם יְהֹוָ֖ה אֵלָֽי׃
verses.translit: vykhtb 'lhlcht khmkhtb hr'shvn 't 'shrt hdbrym 'shr dbr yhvh 'lykhm bhr mtvkh h'sh byvm hqhl vytnm yhvh 'ly
verses.translation: And He wrote on the tables according to the first writing, the ten words, which the LORD spoke unto you in the mount out of the midst of the fire in the day of the assembly; and the LORD gave them unto me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וָאֵ֗פֶן וָֽאֵרֵד֙ מִן־הָהָ֔ר וָֽאָשִׂם֙ אֶת־הַלֻּחֹ֔ת בָּאָר֖וֹן אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשִׂ֑יתִי וַיִּ֣הְיוּ שָׁ֔ם כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוַּ֖נִי יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: v'pn v'rd mnhhr v'shm 'thlcht b'rvn 'shr 'shyty vyhyv shm kh'shr tsvny yhvh
verses.translation: And I turned and came down from the mount, and put the tables in the ark which I had made; and there they are, as the LORD commanded me.—
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל נָ֥סְע֛וּ מִבְּאֵרֹ֥ת בְּנֵי־יַעֲקָ֖ן מוֹסֵרָ֑ה שָׁ֣ם מֵ֤ת אַהֲרֹן֙ וַיִּקָּבֵ֣ר שָׁ֔ם וַיְכַהֵ֛ן אֶלְעָזָ֥ר בְּנ֖וֹ תַּחְתָּֽיו׃
verses.translit: vbny yshr'l ns'v mb'rt bnyy'qn mvsrh shm mt 'hrn vyqbr shm vykhhn 'l'zr bnv tchtyv
verses.translation: And the children of Israel journeyed from Beeroth-benejaakan to Moserah; there Aaron died, and there he was buried; and Eleazar his son ministered in the priest’s office in his stead.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִשָּׁ֥ם נָסְע֖וּ הַגֻּדְגֹּ֑דָה וּמִן־הַגֻּדְגֹּ֣דָה יׇטְבָ֔תָה אֶ֖רֶץ נַ֥חֲלֵי מָֽיִם׃
verses.translit: mshm ns'v hgdgdh vmnhgdgdh ytbth 'rts nchly mym
verses.translation: From thence they journeyed unto Gudgod; and from Gudgod to Jotbah, a land of brooks of water.—
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בָּעֵ֣ת הַהִ֗וא הִבְדִּ֤יל יְהֹוָה֙ אֶת־שֵׁ֣בֶט הַלֵּוִ֔י לָשֵׂ֖את אֶת־אֲר֣וֹן בְּרִית־יְהֹוָ֑ה לַעֲמֹד֩ לִפְנֵ֨י יְהֹוָ֤ה לְשָֽׁרְתוֹ֙ וּלְבָרֵ֣ךְ בִּשְׁמ֔וֹ עַ֖ד הַיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃
verses.translit: b't hhv' hbdyl yhvh 'tshbt hlvy lsh't 't'rvn brytyhvh l'md lpny yhvh lshrtv vlbrkh bshmv 'd hyvm hzh
verses.translation: At that time the LORD separated the tribe of Levi, to bear the ark of the covenant of the LORD, to stand before the LORD to minister unto Him, and to bless in His name, unto this day.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַל־כֵּ֞ן לֹֽא־הָיָ֧ה לְלֵוִ֛י חֵ֥לֶק וְנַחֲלָ֖ה עִם־אֶחָ֑יו יְהֹוָה֙ ה֣וּא נַחֲלָת֔וֹ כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבֶּ֛ר יְהֹוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ לֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: 'lkhn l'hyh llvy chlq vnchlh 'm'chyv yhvh hv' nchltv kh'shr dbr yhvh 'lhykh lv
verses.translation: Wherefore Levi hath no portion nor inheritance with his brethren; the LORD is his inheritance, according as the LORD thy God spoke unto him.—
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאָנֹכִ֞י עָמַ֣דְתִּי בָהָ֗ר כַּיָּמִים֙ הָרִ֣אשֹׁנִ֔ים אַרְבָּעִ֣ים י֔וֹם וְאַרְבָּעִ֖ים לָ֑יְלָה וַיִּשְׁמַ֨ע יְהֹוָ֜ה אֵלַ֗י גַּ֚ם בַּפַּ֣עַם הַהִ֔וא לֹא־אָבָ֥ה יְהֹוָ֖ה הַשְׁחִיתֶֽךָ׃
verses.translit: v'nkhy 'mdty bhr khymym hr'shnym 'rb'ym yvm v'rb'ym lylh vyshm' yhvh 'ly gm bp'm hhv' l''bh yhvh hshchytkh
verses.translation: Now I stayed in the mount, as at the first time, forty days and forty nights; and the LORD hearkened unto me that time also; the LORD would not destroy thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהֹוָה֙ אֵלַ֔י ק֛וּם לֵ֥ךְ לְמַסַּ֖ע לִפְנֵ֣י הָעָ֑ם וְיָבֹ֙אוּ֙ וְיִֽירְשׁ֣וּ אֶת־הָאָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁר־נִשְׁבַּ֥עְתִּי לַאֲבֹתָ֖ם לָתֵ֥ת לָהֶֽם׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'ly qvm lkh lms' lpny h'm vyb'v vyyrshv 'th'rts 'shrnshb'ty l'btm ltt lhm {p}
verses.translation: And the LORD said unto me: ‘Arise, go before the people, causing them to set forward, that they may go in and possess the land, which I swore unto their fathers to give unto them.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַתָּה֙ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל מָ֚ה יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ שֹׁאֵ֖ל מֵעִמָּ֑ךְ כִּ֣י אִם־לְ֠יִרְאָ֠ה אֶת־יְהֹוָ֨ה אֱלֹהֶ֜יךָ לָלֶ֤כֶת בְּכׇל־דְּרָכָיו֙ וּלְאַהֲבָ֣ה אֹת֔וֹ וְלַֽעֲבֹד֙ אֶת־יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ בְּכׇל־לְבָבְךָ֖ וּבְכׇל־נַפְשֶֽׁךָ׃
verses.translit: v'th yshr'l mh yhvh 'lhykh sh'l m'mkh khy 'mlyr'h 'tyhvh 'lhykh llkht bkhldrkhyv vl'hbh 'tv vl'bd 'tyhvh 'lhykh bkhllbbkh vbkhlnpshkh
verses.translation: And now, Israel, what doth the LORD thy God require of thee, but to fear the LORD thy God, to walk in all His ways, and to love Him, and to serve the LORD thy God with all thy heart and with all thy soul;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לִשְׁמֹ֞ר אֶת־מִצְוֺ֤ת יְהֹוָה֙ וְאֶת־חֻקֹּתָ֔יו אֲשֶׁ֛ר אָנֹכִ֥י מְצַוְּךָ֖ הַיּ֑וֹם לְט֖וֹב לָֽךְ׃
verses.translit: lshmr 'tmtsvt yhvh v'tchqtyv 'shr 'nkhy mtsvkh hyvm ltvb lkh
verses.translation: to keep for thy good the commandments of the LORD, and His statutes, which I command thee this day?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֵ֚ן לַיהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ הַשָּׁמַ֖יִם וּשְׁמֵ֣י הַשָּׁמָ֑יִם הָאָ֖רֶץ וְכׇל־אֲשֶׁר־בָּֽהּ׃
verses.translit: hn lyhvh 'lhykh hshmym vshmy hshmym h'rts vkhl'shrbh
verses.translation: Behold, unto the LORD thy God belongeth the heaven, and the heaven of heavens, the earth, with all that therein is.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: רַ֧ק בַּאֲבֹתֶ֛יךָ חָשַׁ֥ק יְהֹוָ֖ה לְאַהֲבָ֣ה אוֹתָ֑ם וַיִּבְחַ֞ר בְּזַרְעָ֣ם אַחֲרֵיהֶ֗ם בָּכֶ֛ם מִכׇּל־הָעַמִּ֖ים כַּיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃
verses.translit: rq b'btykh chshq yhvh l'hbh 'vtm vybchr bzr'm 'chryhm bkhm mkhlh'mym khyvm hzh
verses.translation: Only the LORD had a delight in thy fathers to love them, and He chose their seed after them, even you, above all peoples, as it is this day.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמַלְתֶּ֕ם אֵ֖ת עׇרְלַ֣ת לְבַבְכֶ֑ם וְעׇ֨רְפְּכֶ֔ם לֹ֥א תַקְשׁ֖וּ עֽוֹד׃
verses.translit: vmltm 't 'rlt lbbkhm v'rpkhm l' tqshv 'vd
verses.translation: Circumcise therefore the foreskin of your heart, and be no more stiffnecked.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֚י יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶ֔ם ה֚וּא אֱלֹהֵ֣י הָֽאֱלֹהִ֔ים וַאֲדֹנֵ֖י הָאֲדֹנִ֑ים הָאֵ֨ל הַגָּדֹ֤ל הַגִּבֹּר֙ וְהַנּוֹרָ֔א אֲשֶׁר֙ לֹא־יִשָּׂ֣א פָנִ֔ים וְלֹ֥א יִקַּ֖ח שֹֽׁחַד׃
verses.translit: khy yhvh 'lhykhm hv' 'lhy h'lhym v'dny h'dnym h'l hgdl hgbr vhnvr' 'shr l'ysh' pnym vl' yqch shchd
verses.translation: For the LORD your God, He is God of gods, and Lord of lords, the great God, the mighty, and the awful, who regardeth not persons, nor taketh reward.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עֹשֶׂ֛ה מִשְׁפַּ֥ט יָת֖וֹם וְאַלְמָנָ֑ה וְאֹהֵ֣ב גֵּ֔ר לָ֥תֶת ל֖וֹ לֶ֥חֶם וְשִׂמְלָֽה׃
verses.translit: 'shh mshpt ytvm v'lmnh v'hb gr ltt lv lchm vshmlh
verses.translation: He doth execute justice for the fatherless and widow, and loveth the stranger, in giving him food and raiment.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַאֲהַבְתֶּ֖ם אֶת־הַגֵּ֑ר כִּֽי־גֵרִ֥ים הֱיִיתֶ֖ם בְּאֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם׃
verses.translit: v'hbtm 'thgr khygrym hyytm b'rts mtsrym
verses.translation: Love ye therefore the stranger; for ye were strangers in the land of Egypt.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֶת־יְהֹוָ֧ה אֱלֹהֶ֛יךָ תִּירָ֖א אֹת֣וֹ תַעֲבֹ֑ד וּב֣וֹ תִדְבָּ֔ק וּבִשְׁמ֖וֹ תִּשָּׁבֵֽעַ׃
verses.translit: 'tyhvh 'lhykh tyr' 'tv t'bd vbv tdbq vbshmv tshb'
verses.translation: Thou shalt fear the LORD thy God; Him shalt thou serve; and to Him shalt thou cleave, and by His name shalt thou swear.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ה֥וּא תְהִלָּתְךָ֖ וְה֣וּא אֱלֹהֶ֑יךָ אֲשֶׁר־עָשָׂ֣ה אִתְּךָ֗ אֶת־הַגְּדֹלֹ֤ת וְאֶת־הַנּֽוֹרָאֹת֙ הָאֵ֔לֶּה אֲשֶׁ֥ר רָא֖וּ עֵינֶֽיךָ׃
verses.translit: hv' thltkh vhv' 'lhykh 'shr'shh 'tkh 'thgdlt v'thnvr't h'lh 'shr r'v 'ynykh
verses.translation: He is thy glory, and He is thy God, that hath done for thee these great and tremendous things, which thine eyes have seen.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּשִׁבְעִ֣ים נֶ֔פֶשׁ יָרְד֥וּ אֲבֹתֶ֖יךָ מִצְרָ֑יְמָה וְעַתָּ֗ה שָֽׂמְךָ֙ יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ כְּכוֹכְבֵ֥י הַשָּׁמַ֖יִם לָרֹֽב׃
verses.translit: bshb'ym npsh yrdv 'btykh mtsrymh v'th shmkh yhvh 'lhykh khkhvkhby hshmym lrb
verses.translation: Thy fathers went down into Egypt with threescore and ten persons; and now the LORD thy God hath made thee as the stars of heaven for multitude.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאָ֣הַבְתָּ֔ אֵ֖ת יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֑יךָ וְשָׁמַרְתָּ֣ מִשְׁמַרְתּ֗וֹ וְחֻקֹּתָ֧יו וּמִשְׁפָּטָ֛יו וּמִצְוֺתָ֖יו כׇּל־הַיָּמִֽים׃
verses.translit: v'hbt 't yhvh 'lhykh vshmrt mshmrtv vchqtyv vmshptyv vmtsvtyv khlhymym
verses.translation: Therefore thou shalt love the LORD thy God, and keep His charge, and His statutes, and His ordinances, and His commandments, alway.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וִֽידַעְתֶּם֮ הַיּוֹם֒ כִּ֣י  לֹ֣א אֶת־בְּנֵיכֶ֗ם אֲשֶׁ֤ר לֹֽא־יָדְעוּ֙ וַאֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹא־רָא֔וּ אֶת־מוּסַ֖ר יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֑ם אֶת־גׇּדְל֕וֹ אֶת־יָדוֹ֙ הַחֲזָקָ֔ה וּזְרֹע֖וֹ הַנְּטוּיָֽה׃
verses.translit: vyd'tm hyvm khy  l' 'tbnykhm 'shr l'yd'v v'shr l'r'v 'tmvsr yhvh 'lhykhm 'tgdlv 'tydv hchzqh vzr'v hntvyh
verses.translation: And know ye this day; for I speak not with your children that have not known, and that have not seen the chastisement of the LORD your God, His greatness, His mighty hand, and His outstretched arm,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֶת־אֹֽתֹתָיו֙ וְאֶֽת־מַעֲשָׂ֔יו אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשָׂ֖ה בְּת֣וֹךְ מִצְרָ֑יִם לְפַרְעֹ֥ה מֶֽלֶךְ־מִצְרַ֖יִם וּלְכׇל־אַרְצֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: v't'ttyv v'tm'shyv 'shr 'shh btvkh mtsrym lpr'h mlkhmtsrym vlkhl'rtsv
verses.translation: and His signs, and His works, which He did in the midst of Egypt unto Pharaoh the king of Egypt, and unto all his land;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַאֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂה֩ לְחֵ֨יל מִצְרַ֜יִם לְסוּסָ֣יו וּלְרִכְבּ֗וֹ אֲשֶׁ֨ר הֵצִ֜יף אֶת־מֵ֤י יַם־סוּף֙ עַל־פְּנֵיהֶ֔ם בְּרׇדְפָ֖ם אַחֲרֵיכֶ֑ם וַיְאַבְּדֵ֣ם יְהֹוָ֔ה עַ֖ד הַיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃
verses.translit: v'shr 'shh lchyl mtsrym lsvsyv vlrkhbv 'shr htsyf 'tmy ymsvf 'lpnyhm brdpm 'chrykhm vy'bdm yhvh 'd hyvm hzh
verses.translation: and what He did unto the army of Egypt, unto their horses, and to their chariots; how He made the water of the Red Sea to overflow them as they pursued after you, and how the LORD hath destroyed them unto this day;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַאֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשָׂ֛ה לָכֶ֖ם בַּמִּדְבָּ֑ר עַד־בֹּאֲכֶ֖ם עַד־הַמָּק֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃
verses.translit: v'shr 'shh lkhm bmdbr 'db'khm 'dhmqvm hzh
verses.translation: and what He did unto you in the wilderness, until ye came unto this place;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַאֲשֶׁ֨ר עָשָׂ֜ה לְדָתָ֣ן וְלַאֲבִירָ֗ם בְּנֵ֣י אֱלִיאָב֮ בֶּן־רְאוּבֵן֒ אֲשֶׁ֨ר פָּצְתָ֤ה הָאָ֙רֶץ֙ אֶת־פִּ֔יהָ וַתִּבְלָעֵ֥ם וְאֶת־בָּתֵּיהֶ֖ם וְאֶת־אׇהֳלֵיהֶ֑ם וְאֵ֤ת כׇּל־הַיְקוּם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּרַגְלֵיהֶ֔ם בְּקֶ֖רֶב כׇּל־יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: v'shr 'shh ldtn vl'byrm bny 'ly'b bnr'vbn 'shr ptsth h'rts 'tpyh vtbl'm v'tbtyhm v't'hlyhm v't khlhyqvm 'shr brglyhm bqrb khlyshr'l
verses.translation: and what He did unto Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab, the son of Reuben; how the earth opened her mouth, and swallowed them up, and their households, and their tents, and every living substance that followed them, in the midst of all Israel;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֤י עֵֽינֵיכֶם֙ הָֽרֹאֹ֔ת אֶת־כׇּל־מַעֲשֵׂ֥ה יְהֹוָ֖ה הַגָּדֹ֑ל אֲשֶׁ֖ר עָשָֽׂה׃
verses.translit: khy 'ynykhm hr't 'tkhlm'shh yhvh hgdl 'shr 'shh
verses.translation: but your eyes have seen all the great work of the LORD which He did.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּשְׁמַרְתֶּם֙ אֶת־כׇּל־הַמִּצְוָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֛ר אָנֹכִ֥י מְצַוְּךָ֖ הַיּ֑וֹם לְמַ֣עַן תֶּחֶזְק֗וּ וּבָאתֶם֙ וִֽירִשְׁתֶּ֣ם אֶת־הָאָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֥ר אַתֶּ֛ם עֹבְרִ֥ים שָׁ֖מָּה לְרִשְׁתָּֽהּ׃
verses.translit: vshmrtm 'tkhlhmtsvh 'shr 'nkhy mtsvkh hyvm lm'n tchzqv vb'tm vyrshtm 'th'rts 'shr 'tm 'brym shmh lrshth
verses.translation: Therefore shall ye keep all the commandment which I command thee this day, that ye may be strong, and go in and possess the land, whither ye go over to possess it;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּלְמַ֨עַן תַּאֲרִ֤יכוּ יָמִים֙ עַל־הָ֣אֲדָמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר֩ נִשְׁבַּ֨ע יְהֹוָ֧ה לַאֲבֹתֵיכֶ֛ם לָתֵ֥ת לָהֶ֖ם וּלְזַרְעָ֑ם אֶ֛רֶץ זָבַ֥ת חָלָ֖ב וּדְבָֽשׁ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vlm'n t'rykhv ymym 'lh'dmh 'shr nshb' yhvh l'btykhm ltt lhm vlzr'm 'rts zbt chlb vdbsh {s}
verses.translation: and that ye may prolong your days upon the land, which the LORD swore unto your fathers to give unto them and to their seed, a land flowing with milk and honey.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֣י הָאָ֗רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֨ר אַתָּ֤ה בָא־שָׁ֙מָּה֙ לְרִשְׁתָּ֔הּ לֹ֣א כְאֶ֤רֶץ מִצְרַ֙יִם֙ הִ֔וא אֲשֶׁ֥ר יְצָאתֶ֖ם מִשָּׁ֑ם אֲשֶׁ֤ר תִּזְרַע֙ אֶֽת־זַרְעֲךָ֔ וְהִשְׁקִ֥יתָ בְרַגְלְךָ֖ כְּגַ֥ן הַיָּרָֽק׃
verses.translit: khy h'rts 'shr 'th b'shmh lrshth l' kh'rts mtsrym hv' 'shr yts'tm mshm 'shr tzr' 'tzr'kh vhshqyt brglkh khgn hyrq
verses.translation: For the land, whither thou goest in to possess it, is not as the land of Egypt, from whence ye came out, where thou didst sow thy seed, and didst water it with thy foot, as a garden of herbs;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָאָ֗רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֨ר אַתֶּ֜ם עֹבְרִ֥ים שָׁ֙מָּה֙ לְרִשְׁתָּ֔הּ אֶ֥רֶץ הָרִ֖ים וּבְקָעֹ֑ת לִמְטַ֥ר הַשָּׁמַ֖יִם תִּשְׁתֶּה־מָּֽיִם׃
verses.translit: vh'rts 'shr 'tm 'brym shmh lrshth 'rts hrym vbq't lmtr hshmym tshthmym
verses.translation: but the land, whither ye go over to possess it, is a land of hills and valleys, and drinketh water as the rain of heaven cometh down;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֶ֕רֶץ אֲשֶׁר־יְהֹוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ דֹּרֵ֣שׁ אֹתָ֑הּ תָּמִ֗יד עֵינֵ֨י יְהֹוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֶ֙יךָ֙ בָּ֔הּ מֵֽרֵשִׁית֙ הַשָּׁנָ֔ה וְעַ֖ד אַחֲרִ֥ית שָׁנָֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: 'rts 'shryhvh 'lhykh drsh 'th tmyd 'yny yhvh 'lhykh bh mrshyt hshnh v'd 'chryt shnh {s}
verses.translation: a land which the LORD thy God careth for; the eyes of the LORD thy God are always upon it, from the beginning of the year even unto the end of the year. .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָיָ֗ה אִם־שָׁמֹ֤עַ תִּשְׁמְעוּ֙ אֶל־מִצְוֺתַ֔י אֲשֶׁ֧ר אָנֹכִ֛י מְצַוֶּ֥ה אֶתְכֶ֖ם הַיּ֑וֹם לְאַהֲבָ֞ה אֶת־יְהֹוָ֤ה אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶם֙ וּלְעׇבְד֔וֹ בְּכׇל־לְבַבְכֶ֖ם וּבְכׇל־נַפְשְׁכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vhyh 'mshm' tshm'v 'lmtsvty 'shr 'nkhy mtsvh 'tkhm hyvm l'hbh 'tyhvh 'lhykhm vl'bdv bkhllbbkhm vbkhlnpshkhm
verses.translation: And it shall come to pass, if ye shall hearken diligently unto My commandments which I command you this day, to love the LORD your God, and to serve Him with all your heart and with all your soul,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנָתַתִּ֧י מְטַֽר־אַרְצְכֶ֛ם בְּעִתּ֖וֹ יוֹרֶ֣ה וּמַלְק֑וֹשׁ וְאָסַפְתָּ֣ דְגָנֶ֔ךָ וְתִירֹֽשְׁךָ֖ וְיִצְהָרֶֽךָ׃
verses.translit: vntty mtr'rtskhm b'tv yvrh vmlqvsh v'spt dgnkh vtyrshkh vytshrkh
verses.translation: that I will give the rain of your land in its season, the former rain and the latter rain, that thou mayest gather in thy corn, and thy wine, and thine oil.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנָתַתִּ֛י עֵ֥שֶׂב בְּשָׂדְךָ֖ לִבְהֶמְתֶּ֑ךָ וְאָכַלְתָּ֖ וְשָׂבָֽעְתָּ׃
verses.translit: vntty 'shb bshdkh lbhmtkh v'khlt vshb't
verses.translation: And I will give grass in thy fields for thy cattle, and thou shalt eat and be satisfied.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִשָּֽׁמְר֣וּ לָכֶ֔ם פֶּ֥ן יִפְתֶּ֖ה לְבַבְכֶ֑ם וְסַרְתֶּ֗ם וַעֲבַדְתֶּם֙ אֱלֹהִ֣ים אֲחֵרִ֔ים וְהִשְׁתַּחֲוִיתֶ֖ם לָהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: hshmrv lkhm pn ypth lbbkhm vsrtm v'bdtm 'lhym 'chrym vhshtchvytm lhm
verses.translation: Take heed to yourselves, lest your heart be deceived, and ye turn aside, and serve other gods, and worship them;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְחָרָ֨ה אַף־יְהֹוָ֜ה בָּכֶ֗ם וְעָצַ֤ר אֶת־הַשָּׁמַ֙יִם֙ וְלֹֽא־יִהְיֶ֣ה מָטָ֔ר וְהָ֣אֲדָמָ֔ה לֹ֥א תִתֵּ֖ן אֶת־יְבוּלָ֑הּ וַאֲבַדְתֶּ֣ם מְהֵרָ֗ה מֵעַל֙ הָאָ֣רֶץ הַטֹּבָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר יְהֹוָ֖ה נֹתֵ֥ן לָכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vchrh 'fyhvh bkhm v'tsr 'thshmym vl'yhyh mtr vh'dmh l' ttn 'tybvlh v'bdtm mhrh m'l h'rts htbh 'shr yhvh ntn lkhm
verses.translation: and the anger of the LORD be kindled against you, and He shut up the heaven, so that there shall be no rain, and the ground shall not yield her fruit; and ye perish quickly from off the good land which the LORD giveth you.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְשַׂמְתֶּם֙ אֶת־דְּבָרַ֣י אֵ֔לֶּה עַל־לְבַבְכֶ֖ם וְעַֽל־נַפְשְׁכֶ֑ם וּקְשַׁרְתֶּ֨ם אֹתָ֤ם לְאוֹת֙ עַל־יֶדְכֶ֔ם וְהָי֥וּ לְטוֹטָפֹ֖ת בֵּ֥ין עֵינֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vshmtm 'tdbry 'lh 'llbbkhm v'lnpshkhm vqshrtm 'tm l'vt 'lydkhm vhyv ltvtpt byn 'ynykhm
verses.translation: Therefore shall ye lay up these My words in your heart and in your soul; and ye shall bind them for a sign upon your hand, and they shall be for frontlets between your eyes.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלִמַּדְתֶּ֥ם אֹתָ֛ם אֶת־בְּנֵיכֶ֖ם לְדַבֵּ֣ר בָּ֑ם בְּשִׁבְתְּךָ֤ בְּבֵיתֶ֙ךָ֙ וּבְלֶכְתְּךָ֣ בַדֶּ֔רֶךְ וּֽבְשׇׁכְבְּךָ֖ וּבְקוּמֶֽךָ׃
verses.translit: vlmdtm 'tm 'tbnykhm ldbr bm bshbtkh bbytkh vblkhtkh bdrkh vbshkhbkh vbqvmkh
verses.translation: And ye shall teach them your children, talking of them, when thou sittest in thy house, and when thou walkest by the way, and when thou liest down, and when thou risest up.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּכְתַבְתָּ֛ם עַל־מְזוּז֥וֹת בֵּיתֶ֖ךָ וּבִשְׁעָרֶֽיךָ׃
verses.translit: vkhtbtm 'lmzvzvt bytkh vbsh'rykh
verses.translation: And thou shalt write them upon the door-posts of thy house, and upon thy gates;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְמַ֨עַן יִרְבּ֤וּ יְמֵיכֶם֙ וִימֵ֣י בְנֵיכֶ֔ם עַ֚ל הָֽאֲדָמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר נִשְׁבַּ֧ע יְהֹוָ֛ה לַאֲבֹתֵיכֶ֖ם לָתֵ֣ת לָהֶ֑ם כִּימֵ֥י הַשָּׁמַ֖יִם עַל־הָאָֽרֶץ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: lm'n yrbv ymykhm vymy bnykhm 'l h'dmh 'shr nshb' yhvh l'btykhm ltt lhm khymy hshmym 'lh'rts {s}
verses.translation: that your days may be multiplied, and the days of your children, upon the land which the LORD swore unto your fathers to give them, as the days of the heavens above the earth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּי֩ אִם־שָׁמֹ֨ר תִּשְׁמְר֜וּן אֶת־כׇּל־הַמִּצְוָ֣ה הַזֹּ֗את אֲשֶׁ֧ר אָנֹכִ֛י מְצַוֶּ֥ה אֶתְכֶ֖ם לַעֲשֹׂתָ֑הּ לְאַהֲבָ֞ה אֶת־יְהֹוָ֧ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֛ם לָלֶ֥כֶת בְּכׇל־דְּרָכָ֖יו וּלְדׇבְקָה־בֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: khy 'mshmr tshmrvn 'tkhlhmtsvh hz't 'shr 'nkhy mtsvh 'tkhm l'shth l'hbh 'tyhvh 'lhykhm llkht bkhldrkhyv vldbqhbv
verses.translation: For if ye shall diligently keep all this commandment which I command you, to do it, to love the LORD your God, to walk in all His ways, and to cleave unto Him,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהוֹרִ֧ישׁ יְהֹוָ֛ה אֶת־כׇּל־הַגּוֹיִ֥ם הָאֵ֖לֶּה מִלִּפְנֵיכֶ֑ם וִֽירִשְׁתֶּ֣ם גּוֹיִ֔ם גְּדֹלִ֥ים וַעֲצֻמִ֖ים מִכֶּֽם׃
verses.translit: vhvrysh yhvh 'tkhlhgvym h'lh mlpnykhm vyrshtm gvym gdlym v'tsmym mkhm
verses.translation: then will the LORD drive out all these nations from before you, and ye shall dispossess nations greater and mightier than yourselves.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כׇּל־הַמָּק֗וֹם אֲשֶׁ֨ר תִּדְרֹ֧ךְ כַּֽף־רַגְלְכֶ֛ם בּ֖וֹ לָכֶ֣ם יִהְיֶ֑ה מִן־הַמִּדְבָּ֨ר וְהַלְּבָנ֜וֹן מִן־הַנָּהָ֣ר נְהַר־פְּרָ֗ת וְעַד֙ הַיָּ֣ם הָאַֽחֲר֔וֹן יִהְיֶ֖ה גְּבֻלְכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: khlhmqvm 'shr tdrkh khfrglkhm bv lkhm yhyh mnhmdbr vhlbnvn mnhnhr nhrprt v'd hym h'chrvn yhyh gblkhm
verses.translation: Every place whereon the sole of your foot shall tread shall be yours: from the wilderness, and Lebanon, from the river, the river Euphrates, even unto the hinder sea shall be your border.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֹא־יִתְיַצֵּ֥ב אִ֖ישׁ בִּפְנֵיכֶ֑ם פַּחְדְּכֶ֨ם וּמוֹרַֽאֲכֶ֜ם יִתֵּ֣ן  יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶ֗ם עַל־פְּנֵ֤י כׇל־הָאָ֙רֶץ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תִּדְרְכוּ־בָ֔הּ כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר דִּבֶּ֥ר לָכֶֽם׃ {ס}
verses.translit: l'ytytsb 'ysh bpnykhm pchdkhm vmvr'khm ytn  yhvh 'lhykhm 'lpny khlh'rts 'shr tdrkhvbh kh'shr dbr lkhm {s}
verses.translation: There shall no man be able to stand against you: the LORD your God shall lay the fear of you and the dread of you upon all the land that ye shall tread upon, as He hath spoken unto you.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: רְאֵ֗ה אָנֹכִ֛י נֹתֵ֥ן לִפְנֵיכֶ֖ם הַיּ֑וֹם בְּרָכָ֖ה וּקְלָלָֽה׃
verses.translit: r'h 'nkhy ntn lpnykhm hyvm brkhh vqllh
verses.translation: Behold, I set before you this day a blessing and a curse:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֶֽת־הַבְּרָכָ֑ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר תִּשְׁמְע֗וּ אֶל־מִצְוֺת֙ יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֧ר אָנֹכִ֛י מְצַוֶּ֥ה אֶתְכֶ֖ם הַיּֽוֹם׃
verses.translit: 'thbrkhh 'shr tshm'v 'lmtsvt yhvh 'lhykhm 'shr 'nkhy mtsvh 'tkhm hyvm
verses.translation: the blessing, if ye shall hearken unto the commandments of the LORD your God, which I command you this day;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהַקְּלָלָ֗ה אִם־לֹ֤א תִשְׁמְעוּ֙ אֶל־מִצְוֺת֙ יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶ֔ם וְסַרְתֶּ֣ם מִן־הַדֶּ֔רֶךְ אֲשֶׁ֧ר אָנֹכִ֛י מְצַוֶּ֥ה אֶתְכֶ֖ם הַיּ֑וֹם לָלֶ֗כֶת אַחֲרֵ֛י אֱלֹהִ֥ים אֲחֵרִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹֽא־יְדַעְתֶּֽם׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vhqllh 'ml' tshm'v 'lmtsvt yhvh 'lhykhm vsrtm mnhdrkh 'shr 'nkhy mtsvh 'tkhm hyvm llkht 'chry 'lhym 'chrym 'shr l'yd'tm {s}
verses.translation: and the curse, if ye shall not hearken unto the commandments of the LORD your God, but turn aside out of the way which I command you this day, to go after other gods, which ye have not known.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָיָ֗ה כִּ֤י יְבִֽיאֲךָ֙ יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ אֶל־הָאָ֕רֶץ אֲשֶׁר־אַתָּ֥ה בָא־שָׁ֖מָּה לְרִשְׁתָּ֑הּ וְנָתַתָּ֤ה אֶת־הַבְּרָכָה֙ עַל־הַ֣ר גְּרִזִ֔ים וְאֶת־הַקְּלָלָ֖ה עַל־הַ֥ר עֵיבָֽל׃
verses.translit: vhyh khy yby'kh yhvh 'lhykh 'lh'rts 'shr'th b'shmh lrshth vntth 'thbrkhh 'lhr grzym v'thqllh 'lhr 'ybl
verses.translation: And it shall come to pass, when the LORD thy God shall bring thee into the land whither thou goest to possess it, that thou shalt set the blessing upon mount Gerizim, and the curse upon mount Ebal.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֲלֹא־הֵ֜מָּה בְּעֵ֣בֶר הַיַּרְדֵּ֗ן אַֽחֲרֵי֙ דֶּ֚רֶךְ מְב֣וֹא הַשֶּׁ֔מֶשׁ בְּאֶ֙רֶץ֙ הַֽכְּנַעֲנִ֔י הַיֹּשֵׁ֖ב בָּעֲרָבָ֑ה מ֚וּל הַגִּלְגָּ֔ל אֵ֖צֶל אֵלוֹנֵ֥י מֹרֶֽה׃
verses.translit: hl'hmh b'br hyrdn 'chry drkh mbv' hshmsh b'rts hkhn'ny hyshb b'rbh mvl hglgl 'tsl 'lvny mrh
verses.translation: Are they not beyond the Jordan, behind the way of the going down of the sun, in the land of the Canaanites that dwell in the Arabah, over against Gilgal, beside the terebinths of Moreh?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֤י אַתֶּם֙ עֹבְרִ֣ים אֶת־הַיַּרְדֵּ֔ן לָבֹא֙ לָרֶ֣שֶׁת אֶת־הָאָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁר־יְהֹוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֖ם נֹתֵ֣ן לָכֶ֑ם וִֽירִשְׁתֶּ֥ם אֹתָ֖הּ וִֽישַׁבְתֶּם־בָּֽהּ׃
verses.translit: khy 'tm 'brym 'thyrdn lb' lrsht 'th'rts 'shryhvh 'lhykhm ntn lkhm vyrshtm 'th vyshbtmbh
verses.translation: For ye are to pass over the Jordan to go in to possess the land which the LORD your God giveth you, and ye shall possess it, and dwell therein.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּשְׁמַרְתֶּ֣ם לַעֲשׂ֔וֹת אֵ֥ת כׇּל־הַֽחֻקִּ֖ים וְאֶת־הַמִּשְׁפָּטִ֑ים אֲשֶׁ֧ר אָנֹכִ֛י נֹתֵ֥ן לִפְנֵיכֶ֖ם הַיּֽוֹם׃
verses.translit: vshmrtm l'shvt 't khlhchqym v'thmshptym 'shr 'nkhy ntn lpnykhm hyvm
verses.translation: And ye shall observe to do all the statutes and the ordinances which I set before you this day.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֵ֠לֶּה הַֽחֻקִּ֣ים וְהַמִּשְׁפָּטִים֮ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תִּשְׁמְר֣וּן לַעֲשׂוֹת֒ בָּאָ֕רֶץ אֲשֶׁר֩ נָתַ֨ן יְהֹוָ֜ה אֱלֹהֵ֧י אֲבֹתֶ֛יךָ לְךָ֖ לְרִשְׁתָּ֑הּ כׇּ֨ל־הַיָּמִ֔ים אֲשֶׁר־אַתֶּ֥ם חַיִּ֖ים עַל־הָאֲדָמָֽה׃
verses.translit: 'lh hchqym vhmshptym 'shr tshmrvn l'shvt b'rts 'shr ntn yhvh 'lhy 'btykh lkh lrshth khlhymym 'shr'tm chyym 'lh'dmh
verses.translation: These are the statutes and the ordinances, which ye shall observe to do in the land which the LORD, the God of thy fathers, hath given thee to possess it, all the days that ye live upon the earth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַבֵּ֣ד תְּ֠אַבְּד֠וּן אֶֽת־כׇּל־הַמְּקֹמ֞וֹת אֲשֶׁ֧ר עָֽבְדוּ־שָׁ֣ם הַגּוֹיִ֗ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר אַתֶּ֛ם יֹרְשִׁ֥ים אֹתָ֖ם אֶת־אֱלֹהֵיהֶ֑ם עַל־הֶהָרִ֤ים הָֽרָמִים֙ וְעַל־הַגְּבָע֔וֹת וְתַ֖חַת כׇּל־עֵ֥ץ רַעֲנָֽן׃
verses.translit: 'bd t'bdvn 'tkhlhmqmvt 'shr 'bdvshm hgvym 'shr 'tm yrshym 'tm 't'lhyhm 'lhhrym hrmym v'lhgb'vt vtcht khl'ts r'nn
verses.translation: Ye shall surely destroy all the places, wherein the nations that ye are to dispossess served their gods, upon the high mountains, and upon the hills, and under every leafy tree.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנִתַּצְתֶּ֣ם אֶת־מִזְבְּחֹתָ֗ם וְשִׁבַּרְתֶּם֙ אֶת־מַצֵּ֣בֹתָ֔ם וַאֲשֵֽׁרֵיהֶם֙ תִּשְׂרְפ֣וּן בָּאֵ֔שׁ וּפְסִילֵ֥י אֱלֹֽהֵיהֶ֖ם תְּגַדֵּע֑וּן וְאִבַּדְתֶּ֣ם אֶת־שְׁמָ֔ם מִן־הַמָּק֖וֹם הַהֽוּא׃
verses.translit: vnttstm 'tmzbchtm vshbrtm 'tmtsbtm v'shryhm tshrpvn b'sh vpsyly 'lhyhm tgd'vn v'bdtm 'tshmm mnhmqvm hhv'
verses.translation: And ye shall break down their altars, and dash in pieces their pillars, and burn their Asherim with fire; and ye shall hew down the graven images of their gods; and ye shall destroy their name out of that place.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֹֽא־תַעֲשׂ֣וּן כֵּ֔ן לַיהֹוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: l't'shvn khn lyhvh 'lhykhm
verses.translation: Ye shall not do so unto the LORD your God.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֠י אִֽם־אֶל־הַמָּק֞וֹם אֲשֶׁר־יִבְחַ֨ר יְהֹוָ֤ה אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶם֙ מִכׇּל־שִׁבְטֵיכֶ֔ם לָשׂ֥וּם אֶת־שְׁמ֖וֹ שָׁ֑ם לְשִׁכְנ֥וֹ תִדְרְשׁ֖וּ וּבָ֥אתָ שָּֽׁמָּה׃
verses.translit: khy 'm'lhmqvm 'shrybchr yhvh 'lhykhm mkhlshbtykhm lshvm 'tshmv shm lshkhnv tdrshv vb't shmh
verses.translation: But unto the place which the LORD your God shall choose out of all your tribes to put His name there, even unto His habitation shall ye seek, and thither thou shalt come;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַהֲבֵאתֶ֣ם שָׁ֗מָּה עֹלֹֽתֵיכֶם֙ וְזִבְחֵיכֶ֔ם וְאֵת֙ מַעְשְׂרֹ֣תֵיכֶ֔ם וְאֵ֖ת תְּרוּמַ֣ת יֶדְכֶ֑ם וְנִדְרֵיכֶם֙ וְנִדְבֹ֣תֵיכֶ֔ם וּבְכֹרֹ֥ת בְּקַרְכֶ֖ם וְצֹאנְכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vhb'tm shmh 'ltykhm vzbchykhm v't m'shrtykhm v't trvmt ydkhm vndrykhm vndbtykhm vbkhrt bqrkhm vts'nkhm
verses.translation: and thither ye shall bring your burnt-offerings, and your sacrifices, and your tithes, and the offering of your hand, and your vows, and your freewill-offerings, and the firstlings of your herd and of your flock;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַאֲכַלְתֶּם־שָׁ֗ם לִפְנֵי֙ יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶ֔ם וּשְׂמַחְתֶּ֗ם בְּכֹל֙ מִשְׁלַ֣ח יֶדְכֶ֔ם אַתֶּ֖ם וּבָתֵּיכֶ֑ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר בֵּֽרַכְךָ֖ יְהֹוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶֽיךָ׃
verses.translit: v'khltmshm lpny yhvh 'lhykhm vshmchtm bkhl mshlch ydkhm 'tm vbtykhm 'shr brkhkh yhvh 'lhykh
verses.translation: and there ye shall eat before the LORD your God, and ye shall rejoice in all that ye put your hand unto, ye and your households, wherein the LORD thy God hath blessed thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֹ֣א תַעֲשׂ֔וּן כְּ֠כֹ֠ל אֲשֶׁ֨ר אֲנַ֧חְנוּ עֹשִׂ֛ים פֹּ֖ה הַיּ֑וֹם אִ֖ישׁ כׇּל־הַיָּשָׁ֥ר בְּעֵינָֽיו׃
verses.translit: l' t'shvn khkhl 'shr 'nchnv 'shym ph hyvm 'ysh khlhyshr b'ynyv
verses.translation: Ye shall not do after all that we do here this day, every man whatsoever is right in his own eyes;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֥י לֹא־בָאתֶ֖ם עַד־עָ֑תָּה אֶל־הַמְּנוּחָה֙ וְאֶל־הַֽנַּחֲלָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־יְהֹוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ נֹתֵ֥ן לָֽךְ׃
verses.translit: khy l'b'tm 'd'th 'lhmnvchh v'lhnchlh 'shryhvh 'lhykh ntn lkh
verses.translation: for ye are not as yet come to the rest and to the inheritance, which the LORD your God giveth thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַעֲבַרְתֶּם֮ אֶת־הַיַּרְדֵּן֒ וִֽישַׁבְתֶּ֣ם בָּאָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁר־יְהֹוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֖ם מַנְחִ֣יל אֶתְכֶ֑ם וְהֵנִ֨יחַ לָכֶ֧ם מִכׇּל־אֹיְבֵיכֶ֛ם מִסָּבִ֖יב וִֽישַׁבְתֶּם־בֶּֽטַח׃
verses.translit: v'brtm 'thyrdn vyshbtm b'rts 'shryhvh 'lhykhm mnchyl 'tkhm vhnych lkhm mkhl'ybykhm msbyb vyshbtmbtch
verses.translation: But when ye go over the Jordan, and dwell in the land which the LORD your God causeth you to inherit, and He giveth you rest from all your enemies round about, so that ye dwell in safety;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָיָ֣ה הַמָּק֗וֹם אֲשֶׁר־יִבְחַר֩ יְהֹוָ֨ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֥ם בּוֹ֙ לְשַׁכֵּ֤ן שְׁמוֹ֙ שָׁ֔ם שָׁ֣מָּה תָבִ֔יאוּ אֵ֛ת כׇּל־אֲשֶׁ֥ר אָנֹכִ֖י מְצַוֶּ֣ה אֶתְכֶ֑ם עוֹלֹתֵיכֶ֣ם וְזִבְחֵיכֶ֗ם מַעְשְׂרֹֽתֵיכֶם֙ וּתְרֻמַ֣ת יֶדְכֶ֔ם וְכֹל֙ מִבְחַ֣ר נִדְרֵיכֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר תִּדְּר֖וּ לַיהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: vhyh hmqvm 'shrybchr yhvh 'lhykhm bv lshkhn shmv shm shmh tby'v 't khl'shr 'nkhy mtsvh 'tkhm 'vltykhm vzbchykhm m'shrtykhm vtrmt ydkhm vkhl mbchr ndrykhm 'shr tdrv lyhvh
verses.translation: then it shall come to pass that the place which the LORD your God shall choose to cause His name to dwell there, thither shall ye bring all that I command you: your burnt-offerings, and your sacrifices, your tithes, and the offering of your hand, and all your choice vows which ye vow unto the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּשְׂמַחְתֶּ֗ם לִפְנֵי֮ יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶם֒ אַתֶּ֗ם וּבְנֵיכֶם֙ וּבְנֹ֣תֵיכֶ֔ם וְעַבְדֵיכֶ֖ם וְאַמְהֹתֵיכֶ֑ם וְהַלֵּוִי֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּשַֽׁעֲרֵיכֶ֔ם כִּ֣י אֵ֥ין ל֛וֹ חֵ֥לֶק וְנַחֲלָ֖ה אִתְּכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vshmchtm lpny yhvh 'lhykhm 'tm vbnykhm vbntykhm v'bdykhm v'mhtykhm vhlvy 'shr bsh'rykhm khy 'yn lv chlq vnchlh 'tkhm
verses.translation: And ye shall rejoice before the LORD your God, ye, and your sons, and your daughters, and your men-servants, and your maid-servants, and the Levite that is within your gates, forasmuch as he hath no portion nor inheritance with you.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִשָּׁ֣מֶר לְךָ֔ פֶּֽן־תַּעֲלֶ֖ה עֹלֹתֶ֑יךָ בְּכׇל־מָק֖וֹם אֲשֶׁ֥ר תִּרְאֶֽה׃
verses.translit: hshmr lkh pnt'lh 'ltykh bkhlmqvm 'shr tr'h
verses.translation: Take heed to thyself that thou offer not thy burnt-offerings in every place that thou seest;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֣י אִם־בַּמָּק֞וֹם אֲשֶׁר־יִבְחַ֤ר יְהֹוָה֙ בְּאַחַ֣ד שְׁבָטֶ֔יךָ שָׁ֖ם תַּעֲלֶ֣ה עֹלֹתֶ֑יךָ וְשָׁ֣ם תַּעֲשֶׂ֔ה כֹּ֛ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר אָנֹכִ֖י מְצַוֶּֽךָּ׃
verses.translit: khy 'mbmqvm 'shrybchr yhvh b'chd shbtykh shm t'lh 'ltykh vshm t'shh khl 'shr 'nkhy mtsvkh
verses.translation: but in the place which the LORD shall choose in one of thy tribes, there thou shalt offer thy burnt-offerings, and there thou shalt do all that I command thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: רַק֩ בְּכׇל־אַוַּ֨ת נַפְשְׁךָ֜ תִּזְבַּ֣ח  וְאָכַלְתָּ֣ בָשָׂ֗ר כְּבִרְכַּ֨ת יְהֹוָ֧ה אֱלֹהֶ֛יךָ אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָֽתַן־לְךָ֖ בְּכׇל־שְׁעָרֶ֑יךָ הַטָּמֵ֤א וְהַטָּהוֹר֙ יֹאכְלֶ֔נּוּ כַּצְּבִ֖י וְכָאַיָּֽל׃
verses.translit: rq bkhl'vt npshkh tzbch  v'khlt bshr khbrkht yhvh 'lhykh 'shr ntnlkh bkhlsh'rykh htm' vhthvr y'khlnv khtsby vkh'yl
verses.translation: Notwithstanding thou mayest kill and eat flesh within all thy gates, after all the desire of thy soul, according to the blessing of the LORD thy God which He hath given thee; the unclean and the clean may eat thereof, as of the gazelle, and as of the hart.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: רַ֥ק הַדָּ֖ם לֹ֣א תֹאכֵ֑לוּ עַל־הָאָ֥רֶץ תִּשְׁפְּכֶ֖נּוּ כַּמָּֽיִם׃
verses.translit: rq hdm l' t'khlv 'lh'rts tshpkhnv khmym
verses.translation: Only ye shall not eat the blood; thou shalt pour it out upon the earth as water.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֹֽא־תוּכַ֞ל לֶאֱכֹ֣ל בִּשְׁעָרֶ֗יךָ מַעְשַׂ֤ר דְּגָֽנְךָ֙ וְתִירֹשְׁךָ֣ וְיִצְהָרֶ֔ךָ וּבְכֹרֹ֥ת בְּקָרְךָ֖ וְצֹאנֶ֑ךָ וְכׇל־נְדָרֶ֙יךָ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תִּדֹּ֔ר וְנִדְבֹתֶ֖יךָ וּתְרוּמַ֥ת יָדֶֽךָ׃
verses.translit: l'tvkhl l'khl bsh'rykh m'shr dgnkh vtyrshkh vytshrkh vbkhrt bqrkh vts'nkh vkhlndrykh 'shr tdr vndbtykh vtrvmt ydkh
verses.translation: Thou mayest not eat within thy gates the tithe of thy corn, or of thy wine, or of thine oil, or the firstlings of thy herd or of thy flock, nor any of thy vows which thou vowest, nor thy freewill-offerings, nor the offering of thy hand;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֡י אִם־לִפְנֵי֩ יְהֹוָ֨ה אֱלֹהֶ֜יךָ תֹּאכְלֶ֗נּוּ בַּמָּקוֹם֙ אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִבְחַ֜ר יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֘יךָ֮ בּוֹ֒ אַתָּ֨ה וּבִנְךָ֤ וּבִתֶּ֙ךָ֙ וְעַבְדְּךָ֣ וַאֲמָתֶ֔ךָ וְהַלֵּוִ֖י אֲשֶׁ֣ר בִּשְׁעָרֶ֑יךָ וְשָׂמַחְתָּ֗ לִפְנֵי֙ יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ בְּכֹ֖ל מִשְׁלַ֥ח יָדֶֽךָ׃
verses.translit: khy 'mlpny yhvh 'lhykh t'khlnv bmqvm 'shr ybchr yhvh 'lhykh bv 'th vbnkh vbtkh v'bdkh v'mtkh vhlvy 'shr bsh'rykh vshmcht lpny yhvh 'lhykh bkhl mshlch ydkh
verses.translation: but thou shalt eat them before the LORD thy God in the place which the LORD thy God shall choose, thou, and thy son, and thy daughter, and thy man-servant, and thy maid-servant, and the Levite that is within thy gates; and thou shalt rejoice before the LORD thy God in all that thou puttest thy hand unto.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִשָּׁ֣מֶר לְךָ֔ פֶּֽן־תַּעֲזֹ֖ב אֶת־הַלֵּוִ֑י כׇּל־יָמֶ֖יךָ עַל־אַדְמָתֶֽךָ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: hshmr lkh pnt'zb 'thlvy khlymykh 'l'dmtkh {s}
verses.translation: Take heed to thyself that thou forsake not the Levite as long as thou livest upon thy land.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־יַרְחִיב֩ יְהֹוָ֨ה אֱלֹהֶ֥יךָ אֶֽת־גְּבֻלְךָ֮ כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר דִּבֶּר־לָךְ֒ וְאָמַרְתָּ֙ אֹכְלָ֣ה בָשָׂ֔ר כִּֽי־תְאַוֶּ֥ה נַפְשְׁךָ֖ לֶאֱכֹ֣ל בָּשָׂ֑ר בְּכׇל־אַוַּ֥ת נַפְשְׁךָ֖ תֹּאכַ֥ל בָּשָֽׂר׃
verses.translit: khyyrchyb yhvh 'lhykh 'tgblkh kh'shr dbrlkh v'mrt 'khlh bshr khyt'vh npshkh l'khl bshr bkhl'vt npshkh t'khl bshr
verses.translation: When the LORD thy God shall enlarge thy border, as He hath promised thee, and thou shalt say: ‘I will eat flesh’, because thy soul desireth to eat flesh; thou mayest eat flesh, after all the desire of thy soul.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־יִרְחַ֨ק מִמְּךָ֜ הַמָּק֗וֹם אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִבְחַ֜ר יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֘יךָ֮ לָשׂ֣וּם שְׁמ֣וֹ שָׁם֒ וְזָבַחְתָּ֞ מִבְּקָרְךָ֣ וּמִצֹּֽאנְךָ֗ אֲשֶׁ֨ר נָתַ֤ן יְהֹוָה֙ לְךָ֔ כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר צִוִּיתִ֑ךָ וְאָֽכַלְתָּ֙ בִּשְׁעָרֶ֔יךָ בְּכֹ֖ל אַוַּ֥ת נַפְשֶֽׁךָ׃
verses.translit: khyyrchq mmkh hmqvm 'shr ybchr yhvh 'lhykh lshvm shmv shm vzbcht mbqrkh vmts'nkh 'shr ntn yhvh lkh kh'shr tsvytkh v'khlt bsh'rykh bkhl 'vt npshkh
verses.translation: If the place which the LORD thy God shall choose to put His name there be too far from thee, then thou shalt kill of thy herd and of thy flock, which the LORD hath given thee, as I have commanded thee, and thou shalt eat within thy gates, after all the desire of thy soul.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַ֗ךְ כַּאֲשֶׁ֨ר יֵאָכֵ֤ל אֶֽת־הַצְּבִי֙ וְאֶת־הָ֣אַיָּ֔ל כֵּ֖ן תֹּאכְלֶ֑נּוּ הַטָּמֵא֙ וְהַטָּה֔וֹר יַחְדָּ֖ו יֹאכְלֶֽנּוּ׃
verses.translit: 'kh kh'shr y'khl 'thtsby v'th'yl khn t'khlnv htm' vhthvr ychdv y'khlnv
verses.translation: Howbeit as the gazelle and as the hart is eaten, so thou shalt eat thereof; the unclean and the clean may eat thereof alike.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: רַ֣ק חֲזַ֗ק לְבִלְתִּי֙ אֲכֹ֣ל הַדָּ֔ם כִּ֥י הַדָּ֖ם ה֣וּא הַנָּ֑פֶשׁ וְלֹא־תֹאכַ֥ל הַנֶּ֖פֶשׁ עִם־הַבָּשָֽׂר׃
verses.translit: rq chzq lblty 'khl hdm khy hdm hv' hnpsh vl't'khl hnpsh 'mhbshr
verses.translation: Only be stedfast in not eating the blood; for the blood is the life; and thou shalt not eat the life with the flesh.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֹ֖א תֹּאכְלֶ֑נּוּ עַל־הָאָ֥רֶץ תִּשְׁפְּכֶ֖נּוּ כַּמָּֽיִם׃
verses.translit: l' t'khlnv 'lh'rts tshpkhnv khmym
verses.translation: Thou shalt not eat it; thou shalt pour it out upon the earth as water.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֹ֖א תֹּאכְלֶ֑נּוּ לְמַ֨עַן יִיטַ֤ב לְךָ֙ וּלְבָנֶ֣יךָ אַחֲרֶ֔יךָ כִּֽי־תַעֲשֶׂ֥ה הַיָּשָׁ֖ר בְּעֵינֵ֥י יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: l' t'khlnv lm'n yytb lkh vlbnykh 'chrykh khyt'shh hyshr b'yny yhvh
verses.translation: Thou shalt not eat it; that it may go well with thee, and with thy children after thee, when thou shalt do that which is right in the eyes of the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: רַ֧ק קׇֽדָשֶׁ֛יךָ אֲשֶׁר־יִהְי֥וּ לְךָ֖ וּנְדָרֶ֑יךָ תִּשָּׂ֣א וּבָ֔אתָ אֶל־הַמָּק֖וֹם אֲשֶׁר־יִבְחַ֥ר יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: rq qdshykh 'shryhyv lkh vndrykh tsh' vb't 'lhmqvm 'shrybchr yhvh
verses.translation: Only thy holy things which thou hast, and thy vows, thou shalt take, and go unto the place which the LORD shall choose;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעָשִׂ֤יתָ עֹלֹתֶ֙יךָ֙ הַבָּשָׂ֣ר וְהַדָּ֔ם עַל־מִזְבַּ֖ח יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֑יךָ וְדַם־זְבָחֶ֗יךָ יִשָּׁפֵךְ֙ עַל־מִזְבַּח֙ יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ וְהַבָּשָׂ֖ר תֹּאכֵֽל׃
verses.translit: v'shyt 'ltykh hbshr vhdm 'lmzbch yhvh 'lhykh vdmzbchykh yshpkh 'lmzbch yhvh 'lhykh vhbshr t'khl
verses.translation: and thou shalt offer thy burnt-offerings, the flesh and the blood, upon the altar of the LORD thy God; and the blood of thy sacrifices shall be poured out against the altar of the LORD thy God, and thou shalt eat the flesh.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שְׁמֹ֣ר וְשָׁמַעְתָּ֗ אֵ֚ת כׇּל־הַדְּבָרִ֣ים הָאֵ֔לֶּה אֲשֶׁ֥ר אָנֹכִ֖י מְצַוֶּ֑ךָּ לְמַ֩עַן֩ יִיטַ֨ב לְךָ֜ וּלְבָנֶ֤יךָ אַחֲרֶ֙יךָ֙ עַד־עוֹלָ֔ם כִּ֤י תַעֲשֶׂה֙ הַטּ֣וֹב וְהַיָּשָׁ֔ר בְּעֵינֵ֖י יְהֹוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶֽיךָ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: shmr vshm't 't khlhdbrym h'lh 'shr 'nkhy mtsvkh lm'n yytb lkh vlbnykh 'chrykh 'd'vlm khy t'shh htvb vhyshr b'yny yhvh 'lhykh {s}
verses.translation: Observe and hear all these words which I command thee, that it may go well with thee, and with thy children after thee for ever, when thou doest that which is good and right in the eyes of the LORD thy God.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־יַכְרִית֩ יְהֹוָ֨ה אֱלֹהֶ֜יךָ אֶת־הַגּוֹיִ֗ם אֲשֶׁ֨ר אַתָּ֥ה בָא־שָׁ֛מָּה לָרֶ֥שֶׁת אוֹתָ֖ם מִפָּנֶ֑יךָ וְיָרַשְׁתָּ֣ אֹתָ֔ם וְיָשַׁבְתָּ֖ בְּאַרְצָֽם׃
verses.translit: khyykhryt yhvh 'lhykh 'thgvym 'shr 'th b'shmh lrsht 'vtm mpnykh vyrsht 'tm vyshbt b'rtsm
verses.translation: When the LORD thy God shall cut off the nations from before thee, whither thou goest in to dispossess them, and thou dispossessest them, and dwellest in their land;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִשָּׁ֣מֶר לְךָ֗ פֶּן־תִּנָּקֵשׁ֙ אַחֲרֵיהֶ֔ם אַחֲרֵ֖י הִשָּׁמְדָ֣ם מִפָּנֶ֑יךָ וּפֶן־תִּדְרֹ֨שׁ לֵאלֹֽהֵיהֶ֜ם לֵאמֹ֗ר אֵיכָ֨ה יַעַבְד֜וּ הַגּוֹיִ֤ם הָאֵ֙לֶּה֙ אֶת־אֱלֹ֣הֵיהֶ֔ם וְאֶעֱשֶׂה־כֵּ֖ן גַּם־אָֽנִי׃
verses.translit: hshmr lkh pntnqsh 'chryhm 'chry hshmdm mpnykh vpntdrsh l'lhyhm l'mr 'ykhh y'bdv hgvym h'lh 't'lhyhm v''shhkhn gm'ny
verses.translation: take heed to thyself that thou be not ensnared to follow them, after that they are destroyed from before thee; and that thou inquire not after their gods, saying: ‘How used these nations to serve their gods? even so will I do likewise.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֹא־תַעֲשֶׂ֣ה כֵ֔ן לַיהֹוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֶ֑יךָ כִּי֩ כׇל־תּוֹעֲבַ֨ת יְהֹוָ֜ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר שָׂנֵ֗א עָשׂוּ֙ לֵאלֹ֣הֵיהֶ֔ם כִּ֣י גַ֤ם אֶת־בְּנֵיהֶם֙ וְאֶת־בְּנֹ֣תֵיהֶ֔ם יִשְׂרְפ֥וּ בָאֵ֖שׁ לֵאלֹֽהֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: l't'shh khn lyhvh 'lhykh khy khltv'bt yhvh 'shr shn' 'shv l'lhyhm khy gm 'tbnyhm v'tbntyhm yshrpv b'sh l'lhyhm
verses.translation: Thou shalt not do so unto the LORD thy God; for every abomination to the LORD, which He hateth, have they done unto their gods; for even their sons and their daughters do they burn in the fire to their gods.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֵ֣ת כׇּל־הַדָּבָ֗ר אֲשֶׁ֤ר אָנֹכִי֙ מְצַוֶּ֣ה אֶתְכֶ֔ם אֹת֥וֹ תִשְׁמְר֖וּ לַעֲשׂ֑וֹת לֹא־תֹסֵ֣ף עָלָ֔יו וְלֹ֥א תִגְרַ֖ע מִמֶּֽנּוּ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: 't khlhdbr 'shr 'nkhy mtsvh 'tkhm 'tv tshmrv l'shvt l'tsf 'lyv vl' tgr' mmnv {p}
verses.translation: All this word which I command you, that shall ye observe to do; thou shalt not add thereto, nor diminish from it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־יָק֤וּם בְּקִרְבְּךָ֙ נָבִ֔יא א֖וֹ חֹלֵ֣ם חֲל֑וֹם וְנָתַ֥ן אֵלֶ֛יךָ א֖וֹת א֥וֹ מוֹפֵֽת׃
verses.translit: khyyqvm bqrbkh nby' 'v chlm chlvm vntn 'lykh 'vt 'v mvpt
verses.translation: If there arise in the midst of thee a prophet, or a dreamer of dreams—and he give thee a sign or a wonder,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבָ֤א הָאוֹת֙ וְהַמּוֹפֵ֔ת אֲשֶׁר־דִּבֶּ֥ר אֵלֶ֖יךָ לֵאמֹ֑ר נֵֽלְכָ֞ה אַחֲרֵ֨י אֱלֹהִ֧ים אֲחֵרִ֛ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹֽא־יְדַעְתָּ֖ם וְנׇֽעׇבְדֵֽם׃
verses.translit: vb' h'vt vhmvpt 'shrdbr 'lykh l'mr nlkhh 'chry 'lhym 'chrym 'shr l'yd'tm vn'bdm
verses.translation: and the sign or the wonder come to pass, whereof he spoke unto thee—saying: ‘Let us go after other gods, which thou hast not known, and let us serve them’;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֹ֣א תִשְׁמַ֗ע אֶל־דִּבְרֵי֙ הַנָּבִ֣יא הַה֔וּא א֛וֹ אֶל־חוֹלֵ֥ם הַחֲל֖וֹם הַה֑וּא כִּ֣י מְנַסֶּ֞ה יְהֹוָ֤ה אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶם֙ אֶתְכֶ֔ם לָדַ֗עַת הֲיִשְׁכֶ֤ם אֹֽהֲבִים֙ אֶת־יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֔ם בְּכׇל־לְבַבְכֶ֖ם וּבְכׇל־נַפְשְׁכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: l' tshm' 'ldbry hnby' hhv' 'v 'lchvlm hchlvm hhv' khy mnsh yhvh 'lhykhm 'tkhm ld't hyshkhm 'hbym 'tyhvh 'lhykhm bkhllbbkhm vbkhlnpshkhm
verses.translation: thou shalt not hearken unto the words of that prophet, or unto that dreamer of dreams; for the LORD your God putteth you to proof, to know whether ye do love the LORD your God with all your heart and with all your soul.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַחֲרֵ֨י יְהֹוָ֧ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֛ם תֵּלֵ֖כוּ וְאֹת֣וֹ תִירָ֑אוּ וְאֶת־מִצְוֺתָ֤יו תִּשְׁמֹ֙רוּ֙ וּבְקֹל֣וֹ תִשְׁמָ֔עוּ וְאֹת֥וֹ תַעֲבֹ֖דוּ וּב֥וֹ תִדְבָּקֽוּן׃
verses.translit: 'chry yhvh 'lhykhm tlkhv v'tv tyr'v v'tmtsvtyv tshmrv vbqlv tshm'v v'tv t'bdv vbv tdbqvn
verses.translation: After the LORD your God shall ye walk, and Him shall ye fear, and His commandments shall ye keep, and unto His voice shall ye hearken, and Him shall ye serve, and unto Him shall ye cleave.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהַנָּבִ֣יא הַה֡וּא א֣וֹ חֹלֵם֩ הַחֲל֨וֹם הַה֜וּא יוּמָ֗ת כִּ֣י דִבֶּר־סָ֠רָ֠ה עַל־יְהֹוָ֨ה אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶ֜ם הַמּוֹצִ֥יא אֶתְכֶ֣ם  מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֗יִם וְהַפֹּֽדְךָ֙ מִבֵּ֣ית עֲבָדִ֔ים לְהַדִּֽיחֲךָ֙ מִן־הַדֶּ֔רֶךְ אֲשֶׁ֧ר צִוְּךָ֛ יְהֹוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ לָלֶ֣כֶת בָּ֑הּ וּבִֽעַרְתָּ֥ הָרָ֖ע מִקִּרְבֶּֽךָ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vhnby' hhv' 'v chlm hchlvm hhv' yvmt khy dbrsrh 'lyhvh 'lhykhm hmvtsy' 'tkhm  m'rts mtsrym vhpdkh mbyt 'bdym lhdychkh mnhdrkh 'shr tsvkh yhvh 'lhykh llkht bh vb'rt hr' mqrbkh {s}
verses.translation: And that prophet, or that dreamer of dreams, shall be put to death; because he hath spoken perversion against the LORD your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, and redeemed thee out of the house of bondage, to draw thee aside out of the way which the LORD thy God commanded thee to walk in. So shalt thou put away the evil from the midst of thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֣י יְסִֽיתְךָ֡ אָחִ֣יךָ בֶן־אִ֠מֶּ֠ךָ אֽוֹ־בִנְךָ֨ אֽוֹ־בִתְּךָ֜ א֣וֹ  אֵ֣שֶׁת חֵיקֶ֗ךָ א֧וֹ רֵֽעֲךָ֛ אֲשֶׁ֥ר כְּנַפְשְׁךָ֖ בַּסֵּ֣תֶר לֵאמֹ֑ר נֵֽלְכָ֗ה וְנַֽעַבְדָה֙ אֱלֹהִ֣ים אֲחֵרִ֔ים אֲשֶׁר֙ לֹ֣א יָדַ֔עְתָּ אַתָּ֖ה וַאֲבֹתֶֽיךָ׃
verses.translit: khy ysytkh 'chykh bn'mkh 'vbnkh 'vbtkh 'v  'sht chyqkh 'v r'kh 'shr khnpshkh bstr l'mr nlkhh vn'bdh 'lhym 'chrym 'shr l' yd't 'th v'btykh
verses.translation: If thy brother, the son of thy mother, or thy son, or thy daughter, or the wife of thy bosom, or thy friend, that is as thine own soul, entice thee secretly, saying: 'Let us go and serve other gods,' which thou hast not known, thou, nor thy fathers;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מֵאֱלֹהֵ֣י הָֽעַמִּ֗ים אֲשֶׁר֙ סְבִיבֹ֣תֵיכֶ֔ם הַקְּרֹבִ֣ים אֵלֶ֔יךָ א֖וֹ הָרְחֹקִ֣ים מִמֶּ֑ךָּ מִקְצֵ֥ה הָאָ֖רֶץ וְעַד־קְצֵ֥ה הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translit: m'lhy h'mym 'shr sbybtykhm hqrbym 'lykh 'v hrchqym mmkh mqtsh h'rts v'dqtsh h'rts
verses.translation: of the gods of the peoples that are round about you, nigh unto thee, or far off from thee, from the one end of the earth even unto the other end of the earth;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֹא־תֹאבֶ֣ה ל֔וֹ וְלֹ֥א תִשְׁמַ֖ע אֵלָ֑יו וְלֹא־תָח֤וֹס עֵֽינְךָ֙ עָלָ֔יו וְלֹֽא־תַחְמֹ֥ל וְלֹֽא־תְכַסֶּ֖ה עָלָֽיו׃
verses.translit: l't'bh lv vl' tshm' 'lyv vl'tchvs 'ynkh 'lyv vl'tchml vl'tkhsh 'lyv
verses.translation: thou shalt not consent unto him, nor hearken unto him; neither shall thine eye pity him, neither shalt thou spare, neither shalt thou conceal him;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֤י הָרֹג֙ תַּֽהַרְגֶ֔נּוּ יָ֥דְךָ֛ תִּֽהְיֶה־בּ֥וֹ בָרִֽאשׁוֹנָ֖ה לַהֲמִית֑וֹ וְיַ֥ד כׇּל־הָעָ֖ם בָּאַחֲרֹנָֽה׃
verses.translit: khy hrg thrgnv ydkh thyhbv br'shvnh lhmytv vyd khlh'm b'chrnh
verses.translation: but thou shalt surely kill him; thy hand shall be first upon him to put him to death, and afterwards the hand of all the people.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּסְקַלְתּ֥וֹ בָאֲבָנִ֖ים וָמֵ֑ת כִּ֣י בִקֵּ֗שׁ לְהַדִּֽיחֲךָ֙ מֵעַל֙ יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ הַמּוֹצִיאֲךָ֛ מֵאֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרַ֖יִם מִבֵּ֥ית עֲבָדִֽים׃
verses.translit: vsqltv b'bnym vmt khy bqsh lhdychkh m'l yhvh 'lhykh hmvtsy'kh m'rts mtsrym mbyt 'bdym
verses.translation: And thou shalt stone him with stones, that he die; because he hath sought to draw thee away from the LORD thy God, who brought thee out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְכׇ֨ל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל יִשְׁמְע֖וּ וְיִֽרָא֑וּן וְלֹֽא־יוֹסִ֣פוּ לַעֲשׂ֗וֹת כַּדָּבָ֥ר הָרָ֛ע הַזֶּ֖ה בְּקִרְבֶּֽךָ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vkhlyshr'l yshm'v vyr'vn vl'yvspv l'shvt khdbr hr' hzh bqrbkh {s}
verses.translation: And all Israel shall hear, and fear, and shall do no more any such wickedness as this is in the midst of thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־תִשְׁמַ֞ע בְּאַחַ֣ת עָרֶ֗יךָ אֲשֶׁר֩ יְהֹוָ֨ה אֱלֹהֶ֜יךָ נֹתֵ֥ן לְךָ֛ לָשֶׁ֥בֶת שָׁ֖ם לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: khytshm' b'cht 'rykh 'shr yhvh 'lhykh ntn lkh lshbt shm l'mr
verses.translation: If thou shalt hear tell concerning one of thy cities, which the LORD thy God giveth thee to dwell there, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יָצְא֞וּ אֲנָשִׁ֤ים בְּנֵֽי־בְלִיַּ֙עַל֙ מִקִּרְבֶּ֔ךָ וַיַּדִּ֛יחוּ אֶת־יֹשְׁבֵ֥י עִירָ֖ם לֵאמֹ֑ר נֵלְכָ֗ה וְנַעַבְדָ֛ה אֱלֹהִ֥ים אֲחֵרִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹא־יְדַעְתֶּֽם׃
verses.translit: yts'v 'nshym bnybly'l mqrbkh vydychv 'tyshby 'yrm l'mr nlkhh vn'bdh 'lhym 'chrym 'shr l'yd'tm
verses.translation: ’Certain base fellows are gone out from the midst of thee, and have drawn away the inhabitants of their city, saying: Let us go and serve other gods, which ye have not known’;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְדָרַשְׁתָּ֧ וְחָקַרְתָּ֛ וְשָׁאַלְתָּ֖ הֵיטֵ֑ב וְהִנֵּ֤ה אֱמֶת֙ נָכ֣וֹן הַדָּבָ֔ר נֶעֶשְׂתָ֛ה הַתּוֹעֵבָ֥ה הַזֹּ֖את בְּקִרְבֶּֽךָ׃
verses.translit: vdrsht vchqrt vsh'lt hytb vhnh 'mt nkhvn hdbr n'shth htv'bh hz't bqrbkh
verses.translation: then shalt thou inquire, and make search, and ask diligently; and, behold, if it be truth, and the thing certain, that such abomination is wrought in the midst of thee;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַכֵּ֣ה תַכֶּ֗ה אֶת־יֹ֥שְׁבֵ֛י הָעִ֥יר הַהִ֖וא לְפִי־חָ֑רֶב הַחֲרֵ֨ם אֹתָ֧הּ וְאֶת־כׇּל־אֲשֶׁר־בָּ֛הּ וְאֶת־בְּהֶמְתָּ֖הּ לְפִי־חָֽרֶב׃
verses.translit: hkhh tkhh 'tyshby h'yr hhv' lpychrb hchrm 'th v'tkhl'shrbh v'tbhmth lpychrb
verses.translation: thou shalt surely smite the inhabitants of that city with the edge of the sword, destroying it utterly, and all that is therein and the cattle thereof, with the edge of the sword.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֶת־כׇּל־שְׁלָלָ֗הּ תִּקְבֹּץ֮ אֶל־תּ֣וֹךְ רְחֹבָהּ֒ וְשָׂרַפְתָּ֨ בָאֵ֜שׁ אֶת־הָעִ֤יר וְאֶת־כׇּל־שְׁלָלָהּ֙ כָּלִ֔יל לַיהֹוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֶ֑יךָ וְהָיְתָה֙ תֵּ֣ל עוֹלָ֔ם לֹ֥א תִבָּנֶ֖ה עֽוֹד׃
verses.translit: v'tkhlshllh tqbts 'ltvkh rchbh vshrpt b'sh 'th'yr v'tkhlshllh khlyl lyhvh 'lhykh vhyth tl 'vlm l' tbnh 'vd
verses.translation: And thou shalt gather all the spoil of it into the midst of the broad place thereof, and shall burn with fire the city, and all the spoil thereof every whit, unto the LORD thy God; and it shall be a heap for ever; it shall not be built again.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלֹֽא־יִדְבַּ֧ק בְּיָדְךָ֛ מְא֖וּמָה מִן־הַחֵ֑רֶם לְמַ֩עַן֩ יָשׁ֨וּב יְהֹוָ֜ה מֵחֲר֣וֹן אַפּ֗וֹ וְנָֽתַן־לְךָ֤ רַחֲמִים֙ וְרִֽחַמְךָ֣ וְהִרְבֶּ֔ךָ כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר נִשְׁבַּ֖ע לַאֲבֹתֶֽיךָ׃
verses.translit: vl'ydbq bydkh m'vmh mnhchrm lm'n yshvb yhvh mchrvn 'pv vntnlkh rchmym vrchmkh vhrbkh kh'shr nshb' l'btykh
verses.translation: And there shall cleave nought of the devoted thing to thy hand, that the LORD may turn from the fierceness of His anger, and show thee mercy, and have compassion upon thee, and multiply thee, as He hath sworn unto thy fathers;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֣י תִשְׁמַ֗ע בְּקוֹל֙ יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ לִשְׁמֹר֙ אֶת־כׇּל־מִצְוֺתָ֔יו אֲשֶׁ֛ר אָנֹכִ֥י מְצַוְּךָ֖ הַיּ֑וֹם לַעֲשׂוֹת֙ הַיָּשָׁ֔ר בְּעֵינֵ֖י יְהֹוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶֽיךָ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: khy tshm' bqvl yhvh 'lhykh lshmr 'tkhlmtsvtyv 'shr 'nkhy mtsvkh hyvm l'shvt hyshr b'yny yhvh 'lhykh {s}
verses.translation: when thou shalt hearken to the voice of the LORD thy God, to keep all His commandments which I command thee this day, to do that which is right in the eyes of the LORD thy God.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בָּנִ֣ים אַתֶּ֔ם לַיהֹוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֑ם לֹ֣א תִתְגֹּֽדְד֗וּ וְלֹֽא־תָשִׂ֧ימוּ קׇרְחָ֛ה בֵּ֥ין עֵינֵיכֶ֖ם לָמֵֽת׃
verses.translit: bnym 'tm lyhvh 'lhykhm l' ttgddv vl'tshymv qrchh byn 'ynykhm lmt
verses.translation: Ye are the children of the LORD your God: ye shall not cut yourselves, nor make any baldness between your eyes for the dead.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֣י עַ֤ם קָדוֹשׁ֙ אַתָּ֔ה לַיהֹוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֶ֑יךָ וּבְךָ֞ בָּחַ֣ר יְהֹוָ֗ה לִֽהְי֥וֹת לוֹ֙ לְעַ֣ם סְגֻלָּ֔ה מִכֹּל֙ הָֽעַמִּ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל־פְּנֵ֥י הָאֲדָמָֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: khy 'm qdvsh 'th lyhvh 'lhykh vbkh bchr yhvh lhyvt lv l'm sglh mkhl h'mym 'shr 'lpny h'dmh {s}
verses.translation: For thou art a holy people unto the LORD thy God, and the LORD hath chosen thee to be His own treasure out of all peoples that are upon the face of the earth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֹ֥א תֹאכַ֖ל כׇּל־תּוֹעֵבָֽה׃
verses.translit: l' t'khl khltv'bh
verses.translation: Thou shalt not eat any abominable thing.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: זֹ֥את הַבְּהֵמָ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר תֹּאכֵ֑לוּ שׁ֕וֹר שֵׂ֥ה כְשָׂבִ֖ים וְשֵׂ֥ה עִזִּֽים׃
verses.translit: z't hbhmh 'shr t'khlv shvr shh khshbym vshh 'zym
verses.translation: These are the beasts which ye may eat: the ox, the sheep, and the goat,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַיָּ֥ל וּצְבִ֖י וְיַחְמ֑וּר וְאַקּ֥וֹ וְדִישֹׁ֖ן וּתְא֥וֹ וָזָֽמֶר׃
verses.translit: 'yl vtsby vychmvr v'qv vdyshn vt'v vzmr
verses.translation: the hart, and the gazelle, and the roebuck, and the wild goat, and the pygarg, and the antelope, and the mountain-sheep.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְכׇל־בְּהֵמָ֞ה מַפְרֶ֣סֶת פַּרְסָ֗ה וְשֹׁסַ֤עַת שֶׁ֙סַע֙ שְׁתֵּ֣י פְרָס֔וֹת מַעֲלַ֥ת גֵּרָ֖ה בַּבְּהֵמָ֑ה אֹתָ֖הּ תֹּאכֵֽלוּ׃
verses.translit: vkhlbhmh mprst prsh vshs't shs' shty prsvt m'lt grh bbhmh 'th t'khlv
verses.translation: And every beast that parteth the hoof, and hath the hoof wholly cloven in two, and cheweth the cud, among the beasts, that ye may eat.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַ֣ךְ אֶת־זֶ֞ה לֹ֤א תֹֽאכְלוּ֙ מִמַּֽעֲלֵ֣י הַגֵּרָ֔ה וּמִמַּפְרִיסֵ֥י הַפַּרְסָ֖ה הַשְּׁסוּעָ֑ה אֶֽת־הַ֠גָּמָ֠ל וְאֶת־הָאַרְנֶ֨בֶת וְאֶת־הַשָּׁפָ֜ן כִּֽי־מַעֲלֵ֧ה גֵרָ֣ה הֵ֗מָּה וּפַרְסָה֙ לֹ֣א הִפְרִ֔יסוּ טְמֵאִ֥ים הֵ֖ם לָכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: 'kh 'tzh l' t'khlv mm'ly hgrh vmmprysy hprsh hshsv'h 'thgml v'th'rnbt v'thshpn khym'lh grh hmh vprsh l' hprysv tm'ym hm lkhm
verses.translation: Nevertheless these ye shall not eat of them that only chew the cud, or of them that only have the hoof cloven: the camel, and the hare, and the rock-badger, because they chew the cud but part not the hoof, they are unclean unto you;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֶת־הַ֠חֲזִ֠יר כִּֽי־מַפְרִ֨יס פַּרְסָ֥ה הוּא֙ וְלֹ֣א גֵרָ֔ה טָמֵ֥א ה֖וּא לָכֶ֑ם מִבְּשָׂרָם֙ לֹ֣א תֹאכֵ֔לוּ וּבְנִבְלָתָ֖ם לֹ֥א תִגָּֽעוּ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: v'thchzyr khymprys prsh hv' vl' grh tm' hv' lkhm mbshrm l' t'khlv vbnbltm l' tg'v {s}
verses.translation: and the swine, because he parteth the hoof but cheweth not the cud, he is unclean unto you; of their flesh ye shall not eat, and their carcasses ye shall not touch.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֶת־זֶה֙ תֹּֽאכְל֔וּ מִכֹּ֖ל אֲשֶׁ֣ר בַּמָּ֑יִם כֹּ֧ל אֲשֶׁר־ל֛וֹ סְנַפִּ֥יר וְקַשְׂקֶ֖שֶׂת תֹּאכֵֽלוּ׃
verses.translit: 'tzh t'khlv mkhl 'shr bmym khl 'shrlv snpyr vqshqsht t'khlv
verses.translation: These ye may eat of all that are in the waters: whatsoever hath fins and scales may ye eat;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְכֹ֨ל אֲשֶׁ֧ר אֵֽין־ל֛וֹ סְנַפִּ֥יר וְקַשְׂקֶ֖שֶׂת לֹ֣א תֹאכֵ֑לוּ טָמֵ֥א ה֖וּא לָכֶֽם׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vkhl 'shr 'ynlv snpyr vqshqsht l' t'khlv tm' hv' lkhm {s}
verses.translation: and whatsoever hath not fins and scales ye shall not eat; it is unclean unto you.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כׇּל־צִפּ֥וֹר טְהֹרָ֖ה תֹּאכֵֽלוּ׃
verses.translit: khltspvr thrh t'khlv
verses.translation: Of all clean birds ye may eat.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְזֶ֕ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹֽא־תֹאכְל֖וּ מֵהֶ֑ם הַנֶּ֥שֶׁר וְהַפֶּ֖רֶס וְהָֽעׇזְנִיָּֽה׃
verses.translit: vzh 'shr l't'khlv mhm hnshr vhprs vh'znyh
verses.translation: But these are they of which ye shall not eat: the great vulture, and the bearded vulture, and the ospray;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָרָאָה֙ וְאֶת־הָ֣אַיָּ֔ה וְהַדַּיָּ֖ה לְמִינָֽהּ׃
verses.translit: vhr'h v'th'yh vhdyh lmynh
verses.translation: and the glede, and the falcon, and the kite after its kinds;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֵ֥ת כׇּל־עֹרֵ֖ב לְמִינֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: v't khl'rb lmynv
verses.translation: and every raven after its kinds;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֵת֙ בַּ֣ת הַֽיַּעֲנָ֔ה וְאֶת־הַתַּחְמָ֖ס וְאֶת־הַשָּׁ֑חַף וְאֶת־הַנֵּ֖ץ לְמִינֵֽהוּ׃
verses.translit: v't bt hy'nh v'thtchms v'thshchf v'thnts lmynhv
verses.translation: and the ostrich, and the night-hawk, and the sea-mew, and the hawk after its kinds;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֶת־הַכּ֥וֹס וְאֶת־הַיַּנְשׁ֖וּף וְהַתִּנְשָֽׁמֶת׃
verses.translit: 'thkhvs v'thynshvf vhtnshmt
verses.translation: the little owl, and the great owl, and the horned owl;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהַקָּאָ֥ת וְאֶֽת־הָרָחָ֖מָה וְאֶת־הַשָּׁלָֽךְ׃
verses.translit: vhq't v'thrchmh v'thshlkh
verses.translation: and the pelican, and the carrion-vulture, and the cormorant;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהַ֣חֲסִידָ֔ה וְהָאֲנָפָ֖ה לְמִינָ֑הּ וְהַדּוּכִיפַ֖ת וְהָעֲטַלֵּֽף׃
verses.translit: vhchsydh vh'nph lmynh vhdvkhypt vh'tlf
verses.translation: and the stork, and the heron after its kinds, and the hoopoe, and the bat.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְכֹל֙ שֶׁ֣רֶץ הָע֔וֹף טָמֵ֥א ה֖וּא לָכֶ֑ם לֹ֖א יֵאָכֵֽלוּ׃
verses.translit: vkhl shrts h'vf tm' hv' lkhm l' y'khlv
verses.translation: And all winged swarming things are unclean unto you; they shall not be eaten.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כׇּל־ע֥וֹף טָה֖וֹר תֹּאכֵֽלוּ׃
verses.translit: khl'vf thvr t'khlv
verses.translation: Of all clean winged things ye may eat.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֹ֣א תֹאכְל֣וּ כׇל־נְ֠בֵלָ֠ה לַגֵּ֨ר אֲשֶׁר־בִּשְׁעָרֶ֜יךָ תִּתְּנֶ֣נָּה וַאֲכָלָ֗הּ א֤וֹ מָכֹר֙ לְנׇכְרִ֔י כִּ֣י עַ֤ם קָדוֹשׁ֙ אַתָּ֔ה לַיהֹוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֶ֑יךָ לֹֽא־תְבַשֵּׁ֥ל גְּדִ֖י בַּחֲלֵ֥ב אִמּֽוֹ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: l' t'khlv khlnblh lgr 'shrbsh'rykh ttnnh v'khlh 'v mkhr lnkhry khy 'm qdvsh 'th lyhvh 'lhykh l'tbshl gdy bchlb 'mv {p}
verses.translation: Ye shall not eat of any thing that dieth of itself; thou mayest give it unto the stranger that is within thy gates, that he may eat it; or thou mayest sell it unto a foreigner; for thou art a holy people unto the LORD thy God. Thou shalt not seethe a kid in its mother’s milk.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַשֵּׂ֣ר תְּעַשֵּׂ֔ר אֵ֖ת כׇּל־תְּבוּאַ֣ת זַרְעֶ֑ךָ הַיֹּצֵ֥א הַשָּׂדֶ֖ה שָׁנָ֥ה שָׁנָֽה׃
verses.translit: 'shr t'shr 't khltbv't zr'kh hyts' hshdh shnh shnh
verses.translation: Thou shalt surely tithe all the increase of thy seed, that which is brought forth in the field year by year.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאָכַלְתָּ֞ לִפְנֵ֣י  יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֗יךָ בַּמָּק֣וֹם אֲשֶׁר־יִבְחַר֮ לְשַׁכֵּ֣ן שְׁמ֣וֹ שָׁם֒ מַעְשַׂ֤ר דְּגָֽנְךָ֙ תִּירֹשְׁךָ֣ וְיִצְהָרֶ֔ךָ וּבְכֹרֹ֥ת בְּקָרְךָ֖ וְצֹאנֶ֑ךָ לְמַ֣עַן תִּלְמַ֗ד לְיִרְאָ֛ה אֶת־יְהֹוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ כׇּל־הַיָּמִֽים׃
verses.translit: v'khlt lpny  yhvh 'lhykh bmqvm 'shrybchr lshkhn shmv shm m'shr dgnkh tyrshkh vytshrkh vbkhrt bqrkh vts'nkh lm'n tlmd lyr'h 'tyhvh 'lhykh khlhymym
