verses.translation: The LORD will smite thee with consumption, and with fever, and with inflammation, and with fiery heat, and with drought, and with blasting, and with mildew; and they shall pursue thee until thou perish.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָי֥וּ שָׁמֶ֛יךָ אֲשֶׁ֥ר עַל־רֹאשְׁךָ֖ נְחֹ֑שֶׁת וְהָאָ֥רֶץ אֲשֶׁר־תַּחְתֶּ֖יךָ בַּרְזֶֽל׃
verses.translit: vhyv shmykh 'shr 'lr'shkh nchsht vh'rts 'shrtchtykh brzl
verses.translation: And thy heaven that is over thy head shall be brass, and the earth that is under thee shall be iron.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יִתֵּ֧ן יְהֹוָ֛ה אֶת־מְטַ֥ר אַרְצְךָ֖ אָבָ֣ק וְעָפָ֑ר מִן־הַשָּׁמַ֙יִם֙ יֵרֵ֣ד עָלֶ֔יךָ עַ֖ד הִשָּׁמְדָֽךְ׃
verses.translit: ytn yhvh 'tmtr 'rtskh 'bq v'pr mnhshmym yrd 'lykh 'd hshmdkh
verses.translation: The LORD will make the rain of thy land powder and dust; from heaven shall it come down upon thee, until thou be destroyed.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יִתֶּנְךָ֨ יְהֹוָ֥ה ׀ נִגָּף֮ לִפְנֵ֣י אֹיְבֶ֒יךָ֒ בְּדֶ֤רֶךְ אֶחָד֙ תֵּצֵ֣א אֵלָ֔יו וּבְשִׁבְעָ֥ה דְרָכִ֖ים תָּנ֣וּס לְפָנָ֑יו וְהָיִ֣יתָ לְזַֽעֲוָ֔ה לְכֹ֖ל מַמְלְכ֥וֹת הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translit: ytnkh yhvh  ngf lpny 'ybykh bdrkh 'chd tts' 'lyv vbshb'h drkhym tnvs lpnyv vhyyt lz'vh lkhl mmlkhvt h'rts
verses.translation: The LORD will cause thee to be smitten before thine enemies; thou shalt go out one way against them, and shalt flee seven ways before them; and thou shalt be a horror unto all the kingdoms of the earth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָיְתָ֤ה נִבְלָֽתְךָ֙ לְמַֽאֲכָ֔ל לְכׇל־ע֥וֹף הַשָּׁמַ֖יִם וּלְבֶהֱמַ֣ת הָאָ֑רֶץ וְאֵ֖ין מַחֲרִֽיד׃
verses.translit: vhyth nbltkh lm'khl lkhl'vf hshmym vlbhmt h'rts v'yn mchryd
verses.translation: And thy carcasses shall be food unto all fowls of the air, and unto the beasts of the earth, and there shall be none to frighten them away.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יַכְּכָ֨ה יְהֹוָ֜ה בִּשְׁחִ֤ין מִצְרַ֙יִם֙ (ובעפלים) [וּבַטְּחֹרִ֔ים] וּבַגָּרָ֖ב וּבֶחָ֑רֶס אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹא־תוּכַ֖ל לְהֵרָפֵֽא׃
verses.translit: ykhkhh yhvh bshchyn mtsrym (vb'plym) [vbtchrym] vbgrb vbchrs 'shr l'tvkhl lhrp'
verses.translation: The LORD will smite thee with the boil of Egypt, and with the emerods, and with the scab, and with the itch, whereof thou canst not be healed.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יַכְּכָ֣ה יְהֹוָ֔ה בְּשִׁגָּע֖וֹן וּבְעִוָּר֑וֹן וּבְתִמְה֖וֹן לֵבָֽב׃
verses.translit: ykhkhh yhvh bshg'vn vb'vrvn vbtmhvn lbb
verses.translation: The LORD will smite thee with madness, and with blindness, and with astonishment of heart.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָיִ֜יתָ מְמַשֵּׁ֣שׁ בַּֽצׇּהֳרַ֗יִם כַּאֲשֶׁ֨ר יְמַשֵּׁ֤שׁ הַֽעִוֵּר֙ בָּאֲפֵלָ֔ה וְלֹ֥א תַצְלִ֖יחַ אֶת־דְּרָכֶ֑יךָ וְהָיִ֜יתָ אַ֣ךְ עָשׁ֧וּק וְגָז֛וּל כׇּל־הַיָּמִ֖ים וְאֵ֥ין מוֹשִֽׁיעַ׃
verses.translit: vhyyt mmshsh btshrym kh'shr ymshsh h'vr b'plh vl' ttslych 'tdrkhykh vhyyt 'kh 'shvq vgzvl khlhymym v'yn mvshy'
verses.translation: And thou shalt grope at noonday, as the blind gropeth in darkness, and thou shalt not make thy ways prosperous; and thou shalt be only oppressed and robbed alway, and there shall be none to save thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִשָּׁ֣ה תְאָרֵ֗שׂ וְאִ֤ישׁ אַחֵר֙ (ישגלנה) [יִשְׁכָּבֶ֔נָּה] בַּ֥יִת תִּבְנֶ֖ה וְלֹא־תֵשֵׁ֣ב בּ֑וֹ כֶּ֥רֶם תִּטַּ֖ע וְלֹ֥א תְחַלְּלֶֽנּוּ׃
verses.translit: 'shh t'rsh v'ysh 'chr (yshglnh) [yshkhbnh] byt tbnh vl'tshb bv khrm tt' vl' tchllnv
verses.translation: Thou shalt betroth a wife, and another man shall lie with her; thou shalt build a house, and thou shalt not dwell therein; thou shalt plant a vineyard, and shalt not use the fruit thereof.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שׁוֹרְךָ֞ טָב֣וּחַ לְעֵינֶ֗יךָ וְלֹ֣א תֹאכַל֮ מִמֶּ֒נּוּ֒ חֲמֹֽרְךָ֙ גָּז֣וּל מִלְּפָנֶ֔יךָ וְלֹ֥א יָשׁ֖וּב לָ֑ךְ צֹֽאנְךָ֙ נְתֻנ֣וֹת לְאֹיְבֶ֔יךָ וְאֵ֥ין לְךָ֖ מוֹשִֽׁיעַ׃
verses.translit: shvrkh tbvch l'ynykh vl' t'khl mmnv chmrkh gzvl mlpnykh vl' yshvb lkh ts'nkh ntnvt l'ybykh v'yn lkh mvshy'
verses.translation: Thine ox shall be slain before thine eyes, and thou shalt not eat thereof; thine ass shall be violently taken away from before thy face, and shall not be restored to thee; thy sheep shall be given unto thine enemies; and thou shalt have none to save thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בָּנֶ֨יךָ וּבְנֹתֶ֜יךָ נְתֻנִ֨ים לְעַ֤ם אַחֵר֙ וְעֵינֶ֣יךָ רֹא֔וֹת וְכָל֥וֹת אֲלֵיהֶ֖ם כׇּל־הַיּ֑וֹם וְאֵ֥ין לְאֵ֖ל יָדֶֽךָ׃
verses.translit: bnykh vbntykh ntnym l'm 'chr v'ynykh r'vt vkhlvt 'lyhm khlhyvm v'yn l'l ydkh
verses.translation: Thy sons and thy daughters shall be given unto another people, and thine eyes shall look, and fail with longing for them all the day; and there shall be nought in the power of thy hand.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: פְּרִ֤י אַדְמָֽתְךָ֙ וְכׇל־יְגִ֣יעֲךָ֔ יֹאכַ֥ל עַ֖ם אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹא־יָדָ֑עְתָּ וְהָיִ֗יתָ רַ֛ק עָשׁ֥וּק וְרָצ֖וּץ כׇּל־הַיָּמִֽים׃
verses.translit: pry 'dmtkh vkhlygy'kh y'khl 'm 'shr l'yd't vhyyt rq 'shvq vrtsvts khlhymym
verses.translation: The fruit of thy land, and all thy labours, shall a nation which thou knowest not eat up; and thou shalt be only oppressed and crushed away:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָיִ֖יתָ מְשֻׁגָּ֑ע מִמַּרְאֵ֥ה עֵינֶ֖יךָ אֲשֶׁ֥ר תִּרְאֶֽה׃
verses.translit: vhyyt mshg' mmr'h 'ynykh 'shr tr'h
verses.translation: so that thou shalt be mad for the sight of thine eyes which thou shalt see.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יַכְּכָ֨ה יְהֹוָ֜ה בִּשְׁחִ֣ין רָ֗ע עַל־הַבִּרְכַּ֙יִם֙ וְעַל־הַשֹּׁקַ֔יִם אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹא־תוּכַ֖ל לְהֵרָפֵ֑א מִכַּ֥ף רַגְלְךָ֖ וְעַ֥ד קׇדְקֳדֶֽךָ׃
verses.translit: ykhkhh yhvh bshchyn r' 'lhbrkhym v'lhshqym 'shr l'tvkhl lhrp' mkhf rglkh v'd qdqdkh
verses.translation: The LORD will smite thee in the knees, and in the legs, with a sore boil, whereof thou canst not be healed, from the sole of thy foot unto the crown of thy head.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יוֹלֵ֨ךְ יְהֹוָ֜ה אֹתְךָ֗ וְאֶֽת־מַלְכְּךָ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תָּקִ֣ים עָלֶ֔יךָ אֶל־גּ֕וֹי אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹא־יָדַ֖עְתָּ אַתָּ֣ה וַאֲבֹתֶ֑יךָ וְעָבַ֥דְתָּ שָּׁ֛ם אֱלֹהִ֥ים אֲחֵרִ֖ים עֵ֥ץ וָאָֽבֶן׃
verses.translit: yvlkh yhvh 'tkh v'tmlkhkh 'shr tqym 'lykh 'lgvy 'shr l'yd't 'th v'btykh v'bdt shm 'lhym 'chrym 'ts v'bn
verses.translation: The LORD will bring thee, and thy king whom thou shalt set over thee, unto a nation that thou hast not known, thou nor thy fathers; and there shalt thou serve other gods, wood and stone.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָיִ֣יתָ לְשַׁמָּ֔ה לְמָשָׁ֖ל וְלִשְׁנִינָ֑ה בְּכֹל֙ הָֽעַמִּ֔ים אֲשֶׁר־יְנַהֶגְךָ֥ יְהֹוָ֖ה שָֽׁמָּה׃
verses.translit: vhyyt lshmh lmshl vlshnynh bkhl h'mym 'shrynhgkh yhvh shmh
verses.translation: And thou shalt become an astonishment, a proverb, and a byword, among all the peoples whither the LORD shall lead thee away.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: זֶ֥רַע רַ֖ב תּוֹצִ֣יא הַשָּׂדֶ֑ה וּמְעַ֣ט תֶּאֱסֹ֔ף כִּ֥י יַחְסְלֶ֖נּוּ הָאַרְבֶּֽה׃
verses.translit: zr' rb tvtsy' hshdh vm't t'sf khy ychslnv h'rbh
verses.translation: Thou shalt carry much seed out into the field, and shalt gather little in; for the locust shall consume it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כְּרָמִ֥ים תִּטַּ֖ע וְעָבָ֑דְתָּ וְיַ֤יִן לֹֽא־תִשְׁתֶּה֙ וְלֹ֣א תֶאֱגֹ֔ר כִּ֥י תֹאכְלֶ֖נּוּ הַתֹּלָֽעַת׃
verses.translit: khrmym tt' v'bdt vyyn l'tshth vl' t'gr khy t'khlnv htl't
verses.translation: Thou shalt plant vineyards and dress them, but thou shalt neither drink of the wine, nor gather the grapes; for the worm shall eat them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: זֵיתִ֛ים יִהְי֥וּ לְךָ֖ בְּכׇל־גְּבוּלֶ֑ךָ וְשֶׁ֙מֶן֙ לֹ֣א תָס֔וּךְ כִּ֥י יִשַּׁ֖ל זֵיתֶֽךָ׃
verses.translit: zytym yhyv lkh bkhlgbvlkh vshmn l' tsvkh khy yshl zytkh
verses.translation: Thou shalt have olive-trees throughout all thy borders, but thou shalt not anoint thyself with the oil; for thine olives shall drop off.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בָּנִ֥ים וּבָנ֖וֹת תּוֹלִ֑יד וְלֹא־יִהְי֣וּ לָ֔ךְ כִּ֥י יֵלְכ֖וּ בַּשֶּֽׁבִי׃
verses.translit: bnym vbnvt tvlyd vl'yhyv lkh khy ylkhv bshby
verses.translation: Thou shalt beget sons and daughters, but they shall not be thine; for they shall go into captivity.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כׇּל־עֵצְךָ֖ וּפְרִ֣י אַדְמָתֶ֑ךָ יְיָרֵ֖שׁ הַצְּלָצַֽל׃
verses.translit: khl'tskh vpry 'dmtkh yyrsh htsltsl
verses.translation: All thy trees and the fruit of thy land shall the locust possess.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַגֵּר֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּקִרְבְּךָ֔ יַעֲלֶ֥ה עָלֶ֖יךָ מַ֣עְלָה מָּ֑עְלָה וְאַתָּ֥ה תֵרֵ֖ד מַ֥טָּה מָּֽטָּה׃
verses.translit: hgr 'shr bqrbkh y'lh 'lykh m'lh m'lh v'th trd mth mth
verses.translation: The stranger that is in the midst of thee shall mount up above thee higher and higher; and thou shalt come down lower and lower.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ה֣וּא יַלְוְךָ֔ וְאַתָּ֖ה לֹ֣א תַלְוֶ֑נּוּ ה֚וּא יִהְיֶ֣ה לְרֹ֔אשׁ וְאַתָּ֖ה תִּֽהְיֶ֥ה לְזָנָֽב׃
verses.translit: hv' ylvkh v'th l' tlvnv hv' yhyh lr'sh v'th thyh lznb
verses.translation: He shall lend to thee, and thou shalt not lend to him; he shall be the head, and thou shalt be the tail.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבָ֨אוּ עָלֶ֜יךָ כׇּל־הַקְּלָל֣וֹת הָאֵ֗לֶּה וּרְדָפ֙וּךָ֙ וְהִשִּׂיג֔וּךָ עַ֖ד הִשָּׁמְדָ֑ךְ כִּי־לֹ֣א שָׁמַ֗עְתָּ בְּקוֹל֙ יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ לִשְׁמֹ֛ר מִצְוֺתָ֥יו וְחֻקֹּתָ֖יו אֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוָּֽךְ׃
verses.translit: vb'v 'lykh khlhqllvt h'lh vrdpvkh vhshygvkh 'd hshmdkh khyl' shm't bqvl yhvh 'lhykh lshmr mtsvtyv vchqtyv 'shr tsvkh
verses.translation: And all these curses shall come upon thee, and shall pursue thee, and overtake thee, till thou be destroyed; because thou didst not hearken unto the voice of the LORD thy God, to keep His commandments and His statutes which He commanded thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָי֣וּ בְךָ֔ לְא֖וֹת וּלְמוֹפֵ֑ת וּֽבְזַרְעֲךָ֖ עַד־עוֹלָֽם׃
verses.translit: vhyv bkh l'vt vlmvpt vbzr'kh 'd'vlm
verses.translation: And they shall be upon thee for a sign and for a wonder, and upon thy seed for ever;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תַּ֗חַת אֲשֶׁ֤ר לֹא־עָבַ֙דְתָּ֙ אֶת־יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ בְּשִׂמְחָ֖ה וּבְט֣וּב לֵבָ֑ב מֵרֹ֖ב כֹּֽל׃
verses.translit: tcht 'shr l''bdt 'tyhvh 'lhykh bshmchh vbtvb lbb mrb khl
verses.translation: because thou didst not serve the LORD thy God with joyfulness, and with gladness of heart, by reason of the abundance of all things;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעָבַדְתָּ֣ אֶת־אֹיְבֶ֗יךָ אֲשֶׁ֨ר יְשַׁלְּחֶ֤נּוּ יְהֹוָה֙ בָּ֔ךְ בְּרָעָ֧ב וּבְצָמָ֛א וּבְעֵירֹ֖ם וּבְחֹ֣סֶר כֹּ֑ל וְנָתַ֞ן עֹ֤ל בַּרְזֶל֙ עַל־צַוָּארֶ֔ךָ עַ֥ד הִשְׁמִיד֖וֹ אֹתָֽךְ׃
verses.translit: v'bdt 't'ybykh 'shr yshlchnv yhvh bkh br'b vbtsm' vb'yrm vbchsr khl vntn 'l brzl 'ltsv'rkh 'd hshmydv 'tkh
verses.translation: therefore shalt thou serve thine enemy whom the LORD shall send against thee, in hunger, and in thirst, and in nakedness, and in want of all things; and he shall put a yoke of iron upon thy neck, until he have destroyed thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יִשָּׂ֣א יְהֹוָה֩ עָלֶ֨יךָ גּ֤וֹי מֵֽרָחֹק֙ מִקְצֵ֣ה הָאָ֔רֶץ כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר יִדְאֶ֖ה הַנָּ֑שֶׁר גּ֕וֹי אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹא־תִשְׁמַ֖ע לְשֹׁנֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: ysh' yhvh 'lykh gvy mrchq mqtsh h'rts kh'shr yd'h hnshr gvy 'shr l'tshm' lshnv
verses.translation: The LORD will bring a nation against thee from far, from the end of the earth, as the vulture swoopeth down; a nation whose tongue thou shalt not understand;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: גּ֖וֹי עַ֣ז פָּנִ֑ים אֲשֶׁ֨ר לֹא־יִשָּׂ֤א פָנִים֙ לְזָקֵ֔ן וְנַ֖עַר לֹ֥א יָחֹֽן׃
verses.translit: gvy 'z pnym 'shr l'ysh' pnym lzqn vn'r l' ychn
verses.translation: a nation of fierce countenance, that shall not regard the person of the old, nor show favour to the young.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְ֠אָכַ֠ל פְּרִ֨י בְהֶמְתְּךָ֥ וּפְרִֽי־אַדְמָתְךָ֮ עַ֣ד הִשָּׁמְדָךְ֒ אֲשֶׁ֨ר לֹא־יַשְׁאִ֜יר לְךָ֗ דָּגָן֙ תִּיר֣וֹשׁ וְיִצְהָ֔ר שְׁגַ֥ר אֲלָפֶ֖יךָ וְעַשְׁתְּרֹ֣ת צֹאנֶ֑ךָ עַ֥ד הַאֲבִיד֖וֹ אֹתָֽךְ׃
verses.translit: v'khl pry bhmtkh vpry'dmtkh 'd hshmdkh 'shr l'ysh'yr lkh dgn tyrvsh vytshr shgr 'lpykh v'shtrt ts'nkh 'd h'bydv 'tkh
verses.translation: And he shall eat the fruit of thy cattle, and the fruit of thy ground, until thou be destroyed; that also shall not leave thee corn, wine, or oil, the increase of thy kine, or the young of thy flock, until he have caused thee to perish.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהֵצַ֨ר לְךָ֜ בְּכׇל־שְׁעָרֶ֗יךָ עַ֣ד רֶ֤דֶת חֹמֹתֶ֙יךָ֙ הַגְּבֹהֹ֣ת וְהַבְּצֻר֔וֹת אֲשֶׁ֥ר אַתָּ֛ה בֹּטֵ֥חַ בָּהֵ֖ן בְּכׇל־אַרְצֶ֑ךָ וְהֵצַ֤ר לְךָ֙ בְּכׇל־שְׁעָרֶ֔יךָ בְּכׇ֨ל־אַרְצְךָ֔ אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָתַ֛ן יְהֹוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ לָֽךְ׃
verses.translit: vhtsr lkh bkhlsh'rykh 'd rdt chmtykh hgbht vhbtsrvt 'shr 'th btch bhn bkhl'rtskh vhtsr lkh bkhlsh'rykh bkhl'rtskh 'shr ntn yhvh 'lhykh lkh
verses.translation: And he shall besiege thee in all thy gates, until thy high and fortified walls come down, wherein thou didst trust, throughout all thy land; and he shall besiege thee in all thy gates throughout all thy land, which the LORD thy God hath given thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאָכַלְתָּ֣ פְרִֽי־בִטְנְךָ֗ בְּשַׂ֤ר בָּנֶ֙יךָ֙ וּבְנֹתֶ֔יךָ אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָתַן־לְךָ֖ יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֑יךָ בְּמָצוֹר֙ וּבְמָצ֔וֹק אֲשֶׁר־יָצִ֥יק לְךָ֖ אֹיְבֶֽךָ׃
verses.translit: v'khlt prybtnkh bshr bnykh vbntykh 'shr ntnlkh yhvh 'lhykh bmtsvr vbmtsvq 'shrytsyq lkh 'ybkh
verses.translation: And thou shalt eat the fruit of thine own body, the flesh of thy sons and of thy daughters whom the LORD thy God hath given thee; in the siege and in the straitness, wherewith thine enemies shall straiten thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הָאִישׁ֙ הָרַ֣ךְ בְּךָ֔ וְהֶעָנֹ֖ג מְאֹ֑ד תֵּרַ֨ע עֵינ֤וֹ בְאָחִיו֙ וּבְאֵ֣שֶׁת חֵיק֔וֹ וּבְיֶ֥תֶר בָּנָ֖יו אֲשֶׁ֥ר יוֹתִֽיר׃
verses.translit: h'ysh hrkh bkh vh'ng m'd tr' 'ynv b'chyv vb'sht chyqv vbytr bnyv 'shr yvtyr
verses.translation: The man that is tender among you, and very delicate, his eye shall be evil against his brother, and against the wife of his bosom, and against the remnant of his children whom he hath remaining;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִתֵּ֣ת  לְאַחַ֣ד מֵהֶ֗ם מִבְּשַׂ֤ר בָּנָיו֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יֹאכֵ֔ל מִבְּלִ֥י הִשְׁאִֽיר־ל֖וֹ כֹּ֑ל בְּמָצוֹר֙ וּבְמָצ֔וֹק אֲשֶׁ֨ר יָצִ֥יק לְךָ֛ אֹיִבְךָ֖ בְּכׇל־שְׁעָרֶֽיךָ׃
verses.translit: mtt  l'chd mhm mbshr bnyv 'shr y'khl mbly hsh'yrlv khl bmtsvr vbmtsvq 'shr ytsyq lkh 'ybkh bkhlsh'rykh
verses.translation: so that he will not give to any of them of the flesh of his children whom he shall eat, because he hath nothing left him; in the siege and in the straitness, wherewith thine enemy shall straiten thee in all thy gates.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הָרַכָּ֨ה בְךָ֜ וְהָעֲנֻגָּ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר לֹֽא־נִסְּתָ֤ה כַף־רַגְלָהּ֙ הַצֵּ֣ג עַל־הָאָ֔רֶץ מֵהִתְעַנֵּ֖ג וּמֵרֹ֑ךְ תֵּרַ֤ע עֵינָהּ֙ בְּאִ֣ישׁ חֵיקָ֔הּ וּבִבְנָ֖הּ וּבְבִתָּֽהּ׃
verses.translit: hrkhh bkh vh'ngh 'shr l'nsth khfrglh htsg 'lh'rts mht'ng vmrkh tr' 'ynh b'ysh chyqh vbbnh vbbth
verses.translation: The tender and delicate woman among you, who would not adventure to set the sole of her foot upon the ground for delicateness and tenderness, her eye shall be evil against the husband of her bosom, and against her son, and against her daughter;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּֽבְשִׁלְיָתָ֞הּ הַיּוֹצֵ֣ת  מִבֵּ֣ין רַגְלֶ֗יהָ וּבְבָנֶ֙יהָ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תֵּלֵ֔ד כִּֽי־תֹאכְלֵ֥ם בְּחֹסֶר־כֹּ֖ל בַּסָּ֑תֶר בְּמָצוֹר֙ וּבְמָצ֔וֹק אֲשֶׁ֨ר יָצִ֥יק לְךָ֛ אֹיִבְךָ֖ בִּשְׁעָרֶֽיךָ׃
verses.translit: vbshlyth hyvtst  mbyn rglyh vbbnyh 'shr tld khyt'khlm bchsrkhl bstr bmtsvr vbmtsvq 'shr ytsyq lkh 'ybkh bsh'rykh
verses.translation: and against her afterbirth that cometh out from between her feet, and against her children whom she shall bear; for she shall eat them for want of all things secretly; in the siege and in the straitness, wherewith thine enemy shall straiten thee in thy gates.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִם־לֹ֨א תִשְׁמֹ֜ר לַעֲשׂ֗וֹת אֶת־כׇּל־דִּבְרֵי֙ הַתּוֹרָ֣ה הַזֹּ֔את הַכְּתֻבִ֖ים בַּסֵּ֣פֶר הַזֶּ֑ה לְ֠יִרְאָ֠ה אֶת־הַשֵּׁ֞ם הַנִּכְבָּ֤ד וְהַנּוֹרָא֙ הַזֶּ֔ה אֵ֖ת יְהֹוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶֽיךָ׃
verses.translit: 'ml' tshmr l'shvt 'tkhldbry htvrh hz't hkhtbym bspr hzh lyr'h 'thshm hnkhbd vhnvr' hzh 't yhvh 'lhykh
verses.translation: If thou wilt not observe to do all the words of this law that are written in this book, that thou mayest fear this glorious and awful Name, the LORD thy God;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהִפְלָ֤א יְהֹוָה֙ אֶת־מַכֹּ֣תְךָ֔ וְאֵ֖ת מַכּ֣וֹת זַרְעֶ֑ךָ מַכּ֤וֹת גְּדֹלֹת֙ וְנֶ֣אֱמָנ֔וֹת וׇחֳלָיִ֖ם רָעִ֥ים וְנֶאֱמָנִֽים׃
verses.translit: vhpl' yhvh 'tmkhtkh v't mkhvt zr'kh mkhvt gdlt vn'mnvt vchlym r'ym vn'mnym
verses.translation: then the LORD will make thy plagues wonderful, and the plagues of thy seed, even great plagues, and of long continuance, and sore sicknesses, and of long continuance.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהֵשִׁ֣יב בְּךָ֗ אֵ֚ת כׇּל־מַדְוֵ֣ה מִצְרַ֔יִם אֲשֶׁ֥ר יָגֹ֖רְתָּ מִפְּנֵיהֶ֑ם וְדָבְק֖וּ בָּֽךְ׃
verses.translit: vhshyb bkh 't khlmdvh mtsrym 'shr ygrt mpnyhm vdbqv bkh
verses.translation: And He will bring back upon thee all the diseases of Egypt, which thou wast in dread of; and they shall cleave unto thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: גַּ֤ם כׇּל־חֳלִי֙ וְכׇל־מַכָּ֔ה אֲשֶׁר֙ לֹ֣א כָת֔וּב בְּסֵ֖פֶר הַתּוֹרָ֣ה הַזֹּ֑את יַעְלֵ֤ם יְהֹוָה֙ עָלֶ֔יךָ עַ֖ד הִשָּׁמְדָֽךְ׃
verses.translit: gm khlchly vkhlmkhh 'shr l' khtvb bspr htvrh hz't y'lm yhvh 'lykh 'd hshmdkh
verses.translation: Also every sickness, and every plague, which is not written in the book of this law, them will the LORD bring upon thee, until thou be destroyed.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנִשְׁאַרְתֶּם֙ בִּמְתֵ֣י מְעָ֔ט תַּ֚חַת אֲשֶׁ֣ר הֱיִיתֶ֔ם כְּכוֹכְבֵ֥י הַשָּׁמַ֖יִם לָרֹ֑ב כִּֽי־לֹ֣א שָׁמַ֔עְתָּ בְּק֖וֹל יְהֹוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶֽיךָ׃
verses.translit: vnsh'rtm bmty m't tcht 'shr hyytm khkhvkhby hshmym lrb khyl' shm't bqvl yhvh 'lhykh
verses.translation: And ye shall be left few in number, whereas ye were as the stars of heaven for multitude; because thou didst not hearken unto the voice of the LORD thy God.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְ֠הָיָ֠ה כַּאֲשֶׁר־שָׂ֨שׂ יְהֹוָ֜ה עֲלֵיכֶ֗ם לְהֵיטִ֣יב אֶתְכֶם֮ וּלְהַרְבּ֣וֹת אֶתְכֶם֒ כֵּ֣ן יָשִׂ֤ישׂ יְהֹוָה֙ עֲלֵיכֶ֔ם לְהַאֲבִ֥יד אֶתְכֶ֖ם וּלְהַשְׁמִ֣יד אֶתְכֶ֑ם וְנִסַּחְתֶּם֙ מֵעַ֣ל הָאֲדָמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־אַתָּ֥ה בָא־שָׁ֖מָּה לְרִשְׁתָּֽהּ׃
verses.translit: vhyh kh'shrshsh yhvh 'lykhm lhytyb 'tkhm vlhrbvt 'tkhm khn yshysh yhvh 'lykhm lh'byd 'tkhm vlhshmyd 'tkhm vnschtm m'l h'dmh 'shr'th b'shmh lrshth
verses.translation: And it shall come to pass, that as the LORD rejoiced over you to do you good, and to multiply you; so the LORD will rejoice over you to cause you to perish, and to destroy you; and ye shall be plucked from off the land whither thou goest in to possess it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וֶהֱפִֽיצְךָ֤ יְהֹוָה֙ בְּכׇל־הָ֣עַמִּ֔ים מִקְצֵ֥ה הָאָ֖רֶץ וְעַד־קְצֵ֣ה הָאָ֑רֶץ וְעָבַ֨דְתָּ שָּׁ֜ם אֱלֹהִ֣ים אֲחֵרִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֧ר לֹא־יָדַ֛עְתָּ אַתָּ֥ה וַאֲבֹתֶ֖יךָ עֵ֥ץ וָאָֽבֶן׃
verses.translit: vhpytskh yhvh bkhlh'mym mqtsh h'rts v'dqtsh h'rts v'bdt shm 'lhym 'chrym 'shr l'yd't 'th v'btykh 'ts v'bn
verses.translation: And the LORD shall scatter thee among all peoples, from the one end of the earth even unto the other end of the earth; and there thou shalt serve other gods, which thou hast not known, thou nor thy fathers, even wood and stone.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבַגּוֹיִ֤ם הָהֵם֙ לֹ֣א תַרְגִּ֔יעַ וְלֹא־יִהְיֶ֥ה מָנ֖וֹחַ לְכַף־רַגְלֶ֑ךָ וְנָתַן֩ יְהֹוָ֨ה לְךָ֥ שָׁם֙ לֵ֣ב רַגָּ֔ז וְכִלְי֥וֹן עֵינַ֖יִם וְדַאֲב֥וֹן נָֽפֶשׁ׃
verses.translit: vbgvym hhm l' trgy' vl'yhyh mnvch lkhfrglkh vntn yhvh lkh shm lb rgz vkhlyvn 'ynym vd'bvn npsh
verses.translation: And among these nations shalt thou have no repose, and there shall be no rest for the sole of thy foot; but the LORD shall give thee there a trembling heart, and failing of eyes, and languishing of soul.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָי֣וּ חַיֶּ֔יךָ תְּלֻאִ֥ים לְךָ֖ מִנֶּ֑גֶד וּפָֽחַדְתָּ֙ לַ֣יְלָה וְיוֹמָ֔ם וְלֹ֥א תַאֲמִ֖ין בְּחַיֶּֽיךָ׃
verses.translit: vhyv chyykh tl'ym lkh mngd vpchdt lylh vyvmm vl' t'myn bchyykh
verses.translation: And thy life shall hang in doubt before thee; and thou shalt fear night and day, and shalt have no assurance of thy life.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בַּבֹּ֤קֶר תֹּאמַר֙ מִֽי־יִתֵּ֣ן עֶ֔רֶב וּבָעֶ֥רֶב תֹּאמַ֖ר מִֽי־יִתֵּ֣ן בֹּ֑קֶר מִפַּ֤חַד לְבָֽבְךָ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תִּפְחָ֔ד וּמִמַּרְאֵ֥ה עֵינֶ֖יךָ אֲשֶׁ֥ר תִּרְאֶֽה׃
verses.translit: bbqr t'mr myytn 'rb vb'rb t'mr myytn bqr mpchd lbbkh 'shr tpchd vmmr'h 'ynykh 'shr tr'h
verses.translation: In the morning thou shalt say: ‘Would it were even! ’ and at even thou shalt say: ‘Would it were morning! ’ for the fear of thy heart which thou shalt fear, and for the sight of thine eyes which thou shalt see.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וֶהֱשִֽׁיבְךָ֨ יְהֹוָ֥ה ׀ מִצְרַ֘יִם֮ בׇּאֳנִיּוֹת֒ בַּדֶּ֙רֶךְ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אָמַ֣רְתִּֽי לְךָ֔ לֹא־תֹסִ֥יף ע֖וֹד לִרְאֹתָ֑הּ וְהִתְמַכַּרְתֶּ֨ם שָׁ֧ם לְאֹיְבֶ֛יךָ לַעֲבָדִ֥ים וְלִשְׁפָח֖וֹת וְאֵ֥ין קֹנֶֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vhshybkh yhvh  mtsrym b'nyvt bdrkh 'shr 'mrty lkh l'tsyf 'vd lr'th vhtmkhrtm shm l'ybykh l'bdym vlshpchvt v'yn qnh {s}
verses.translation: And the LORD shall bring thee back into Egypt in ships, by the way whereof I said unto thee: ‘Thou shalt see it no more again’; and there ye shall sell yourselves unto your enemies for bondmen and for bondwoman, and no man shall buy you.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֵ֩לֶּה֩ דִבְרֵ֨י הַבְּרִ֜ית אֲֽשֶׁר־צִוָּ֧ה יְהֹוָ֣ה אֶת־מֹשֶׁ֗ה לִכְרֹ֛ת אֶת־בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בְּאֶ֣רֶץ מוֹאָ֑ב מִלְּבַ֣ד הַבְּרִ֔ית אֲשֶׁר־כָּרַ֥ת אִתָּ֖ם בְּחֹרֵֽב׃ {פ}
verses.translit: 'lh dbry hbryt 'shrtsvh yhvh 'tmshh lkhrt 'tbny yshr'l b'rts mv'b mlbd hbryt 'shrkhrt 'tm bchrb {p}
verses.translation: These are the words of the covenant which the LORD commanded Moses to make with the children of Israel in the land of Moab, beside the covenant which He made with them in Horeb.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּקְרָ֥א מֹשֶׁ֛ה אֶל־כׇּל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֲלֵהֶ֑ם אַתֶּ֣ם רְאִיתֶ֗ם אֵ֣ת כׇּל־אֲשֶׁר֩ עָשָׂ֨ה יְהֹוָ֤ה לְעֵֽינֵיכֶם֙ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם לְפַרְעֹ֥ה וּלְכׇל־עֲבָדָ֖יו וּלְכׇל־אַרְצֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vyqr' mshh 'lkhlyshr'l vy'mr 'lhm 'tm r'ytm 't khl'shr 'shh yhvh l'ynykhm b'rts mtsrym lpr'h vlkhl'bdyv vlkhl'rtsv
verses.translation: And Moses called unto all Israel, and said unto them: Ye have seen all that the LORD did before your eyes in the land of Egypt unto Pharaoh, and unto all his servants, and unto all his land;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַמַּסּוֹת֙ הַגְּדֹלֹ֔ת אֲשֶׁ֥ר רָא֖וּ עֵינֶ֑יךָ הָאֹתֹ֧ת וְהַמֹּפְתִ֛ים הַגְּדֹלִ֖ים הָהֵֽם׃
verses.translit: hmsvt hgdlt 'shr r'v 'ynykh h'tt vhmptym hgdlym hhm
verses.translation: the great trials which thine eyes saw, the signs and those great wonders;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלֹא־נָתַן֩ יְהֹוָ֨ה לָכֶ֥ם לֵב֙ לָדַ֔עַת וְעֵינַ֥יִם לִרְא֖וֹת וְאׇזְנַ֣יִם לִשְׁמֹ֑עַ עַ֖ד הַיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃
verses.translit: vl'ntn yhvh lkhm lb ld't v'ynym lr'vt v'znym lshm' 'd hyvm hzh
verses.translation: but the LORD hath not given you a heart to know, and eyes to see, and ears to hear, unto this day.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וָאוֹלֵ֥ךְ אֶתְכֶ֛ם אַרְבָּעִ֥ים שָׁנָ֖ה בַּמִּדְבָּ֑ר לֹֽא־בָל֤וּ שַׂלְמֹֽתֵיכֶם֙ מֵעֲלֵיכֶ֔ם וְנַעַלְךָ֥ לֹֽא־בָלְתָ֖ה מֵעַ֥ל רַגְלֶֽךָ׃
verses.translit: v'vlkh 'tkhm 'rb'ym shnh bmdbr l'blv shlmtykhm m'lykhm vn'lkh l'blth m'l rglkh
verses.translation: And I have led you forty years in the wilderness; your clothes are not waxen old upon you, and thy shoe is not waxen old upon thy foot.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֶ֚חֶם לֹ֣א אֲכַלְתֶּ֔ם וְיַ֥יִן וְשֵׁכָ֖ר לֹ֣א שְׁתִיתֶ֑ם לְמַ֙עַן֙ תֵּֽדְע֔וּ כִּ֛י אֲנִ֥י יְהֹוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: lchm l' 'khltm vyyn vshkhr l' shtytm lm'n td'v khy 'ny yhvh 'lhykhm
verses.translation: Ye have not eaten bread, neither have ye drunk wine or strong drink; that ye might know that I am the LORD your God.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתָּבֹ֖אוּ אֶל־הַמָּק֣וֹם הַזֶּ֑ה וַיֵּצֵ֣א סִיחֹ֣ן מֶֽלֶךְ־חֶ֠שְׁבּ֠וֹן וְע֨וֹג מֶלֶךְ־הַבָּשָׁ֧ן לִקְרָאתֵ֛נוּ לַמִּלְחָמָ֖ה וַנַּכֵּֽם׃
verses.translit: vtb'v 'lhmqvm hzh vyts' sychn mlkhchshbvn v'vg mlkhhbshn lqr'tnv lmlchmh vnkhm
verses.translation: And when ye came unto this place, Sihon the king of Heshbon, and Og the king of Bashan, came out against us unto battle, and we smote them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַנִּקַּח֙ אֶת־אַרְצָ֔ם וַנִּתְּנָ֣הּ לְנַחֲלָ֔ה לָראוּבֵנִ֖י וְלַגָּדִ֑י וְלַחֲצִ֖י שֵׁ֥בֶט הַֽמְנַשִּֽׁי׃
verses.translit: vnqch 't'rtsm vntnh lnchlh lr'vbny vlgdy vlchtsy shbt hmnshy
verses.translation: And we took their land, and gave it for an inheritance unto the Reubenites, and to the Gadites, and to the half-tribe of the Manassites.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּשְׁמַרְתֶּ֗ם אֶת־דִּבְרֵי֙ הַבְּרִ֣ית הַזֹּ֔את וַעֲשִׂיתֶ֖ם אֹתָ֑ם לְמַ֣עַן תַּשְׂכִּ֔ילוּ אֵ֖ת כׇּל־אֲשֶׁ֥ר תַּעֲשֽׂוּן׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vshmrtm 'tdbry hbryt hz't v'shytm 'tm lm'n tshkhylv 't khl'shr t'shvn {p}
verses.translation: Observe therefore the words of this covenant, and do them, that ye may make all that ye do to prosper.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַתֶּ֨ם נִצָּבִ֤ים הַיּוֹם֙ כֻּלְּכֶ֔ם לִפְנֵ֖י יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֑ם רָאשֵׁיכֶ֣ם שִׁבְטֵיכֶ֗ם זִקְנֵיכֶם֙ וְשֹׁ֣טְרֵיכֶ֔ם כֹּ֖ל אִ֥ישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: 'tm ntsbym hyvm khlkhm lpny yhvh 'lhykhm r'shykhm shbtykhm zqnykhm vshtrykhm khl 'ysh yshr'l
verses.translation: Ye are standing this day all of you before the LORD your God: your heads, your tribes, your elders, and your officers, even all the men of Israel,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: טַפְּכֶ֣ם נְשֵׁיכֶ֔ם וְגֵ֣רְךָ֔ אֲשֶׁ֖ר בְּקֶ֣רֶב מַחֲנֶ֑יךָ מֵחֹטֵ֣ב עֵצֶ֔יךָ עַ֖ד שֹׁאֵ֥ב מֵימֶֽיךָ׃
verses.translit: tpkhm nshykhm vgrkh 'shr bqrb mchnykh mchtb 'tsykh 'd sh'b mymykh
verses.translation: your little ones, your wives, and thy stranger that is in the midst of thy camp, from the hewer of thy wood unto the drawer of thy water;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְעׇבְרְךָ֗ בִּבְרִ֛ית יְהֹוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ וּבְאָלָת֑וֹ אֲשֶׁר֙ יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ כֹּרֵ֥ת עִמְּךָ֖ הַיּֽוֹם׃
verses.translit: l'brkh bbryt yhvh 'lhykh vb'ltv 'shr yhvh 'lhykh khrt 'mkh hyvm
verses.translation: that thou shouldest enter into the covenant of the LORD thy God—and into His oath—which the LORD thy God maketh with thee this day;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְמַ֣עַן הָקִֽים־אֹתְךָ֩ הַיּ֨וֹם ׀ ל֜וֹ לְעָ֗ם וְה֤וּא יִֽהְיֶה־לְּךָ֙ לֵֽאלֹהִ֔ים כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר דִּבֶּר־לָ֑ךְ וְכַאֲשֶׁ֤ר נִשְׁבַּע֙ לַאֲבֹתֶ֔יךָ לְאַבְרָהָ֥ם לְיִצְחָ֖ק וּֽלְיַעֲקֹֽב׃
verses.translit: lm'n hqym'tkh hyvm  lv l'm vhv' yhyhlkh l'lhym kh'shr dbrlkh vkh'shr nshb' l'btykh l'brhm lytschq vly'qb
verses.translation: that He may establish thee this day unto Himself for a people, and that He may be unto thee a God, as He spoke unto thee, and as He swore unto thy fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלֹ֥א אִתְּכֶ֖ם לְבַדְּכֶ֑ם אָנֹכִ֗י כֹּרֵת֙ אֶת־הַבְּרִ֣ית הַזֹּ֔את וְאֶת־הָאָלָ֖ה הַזֹּֽאת׃
verses.translit: vl' 'tkhm lbdkhm 'nkhy khrt 'thbryt hz't v'th'lh hz't
verses.translation: Neither with you only do I make this covenant and this oath;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּי֩ אֶת־אֲשֶׁ֨ר יֶשְׁנ֜וֹ פֹּ֗ה עִמָּ֙נוּ֙ עֹמֵ֣ד הַיּ֔וֹם לִפְנֵ֖י יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֑ינוּ וְאֵ֨ת אֲשֶׁ֥ר אֵינֶ֛נּוּ פֹּ֖ה עִמָּ֥נוּ הַיּֽוֹם׃
verses.translit: khy 't'shr yshnv ph 'mnv 'md hyvm lpny yhvh 'lhynv v't 'shr 'ynnv ph 'mnv hyvm
verses.translation: but with him that standeth here with us this day before the LORD our God, and also with him that is not here with us this day—
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־אַתֶּ֣ם יְדַעְתֶּ֔ם אֵ֥ת אֲשֶׁר־יָשַׁ֖בְנוּ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם וְאֵ֧ת אֲשֶׁר־עָבַ֛רְנוּ בְּקֶ֥רֶב הַגּוֹיִ֖ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר עֲבַרְתֶּֽם׃
verses.translit: khy'tm yd'tm 't 'shryshbnv b'rts mtsrym v't 'shr'brnv bqrb hgvym 'shr 'brtm
verses.translation: for ye know how we dwelt in the land of Egypt; and how we came through the midst of the nations through which ye passed;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתִּרְאוּ֙ אֶת־שִׁקּ֣וּצֵיהֶ֔ם וְאֵ֖ת גִּלֻּלֵיהֶ֑ם עֵ֣ץ וָאֶ֔בֶן כֶּ֥סֶף וְזָהָ֖ב אֲשֶׁ֥ר עִמָּהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vtr'v 'tshqvtsyhm v't gllyhm 'ts v'bn khsf vzhb 'shr 'mhm
verses.translation: and ye have seen their detestable things, and their idols, wood and stone, silver and gold, which were with them—
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: פֶּן־יֵ֣שׁ בָּ֠כֶ֠ם אִ֣ישׁ אֽוֹ־אִשָּׁ֞ה א֧וֹ מִשְׁפָּחָ֣ה אוֹ־שֵׁ֗בֶט אֲשֶׁר֩ לְבָב֨וֹ פֹנֶ֤ה הַיּוֹם֙ מֵעִם֙ יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֔ינוּ לָלֶ֣כֶת לַעֲבֹ֔ד אֶת־אֱלֹהֵ֖י הַגּוֹיִ֣ם הָהֵ֑ם פֶּן־יֵ֣שׁ בָּכֶ֗ם שֹׁ֛רֶשׁ פֹּרֶ֥ה רֹ֖אשׁ וְלַעֲנָֽה׃
verses.translit: pnysh bkhm 'ysh 'v'shh 'v mshpchh 'vshbt 'shr lbbv pnh hyvm m'm yhvh 'lhynv llkht l'bd 't'lhy hgvym hhm pnysh bkhm shrsh prh r'sh vl'nh
verses.translation: lest there should be among you man, or woman, or family, or tribe, whose heart turneth away this day from the LORD our God, to go to serve the gods of those nations; lest there should be among you a root that beareth gall and wormwood;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָיָ֡ה בְּשׇׁמְעוֹ֩ אֶת־דִּבְרֵ֨י הָאָלָ֜ה הַזֹּ֗את וְהִתְבָּרֵ֨ךְ בִּלְבָב֤וֹ לֵאמֹר֙ שָׁל֣וֹם יִֽהְיֶה־לִּ֔י כִּ֛י בִּשְׁרִר֥וּת לִבִּ֖י אֵלֵ֑ךְ לְמַ֛עַן סְפ֥וֹת הָרָוָ֖ה אֶת־הַצְּמֵאָֽה׃
verses.translit: vhyh bshm'v 'tdbry h'lh hz't vhtbrkh blbbv l'mr shlvm yhyhly khy bshrrvt lby 'lkh lm'n spvt hrvh 'thtsm'h
verses.translation: and it come to pass, when he heareth the words of this curse, that he bless himself in his heart, saying: ‘I shall have peace, though I walk in the stubbornness of my heart—that the watered be swept away with the dry’;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֹא־יֹאבֶ֣ה יְהֹוָה֮ סְלֹ֣חַֽ לוֹ֒ כִּ֣י אָ֠ז יֶעְשַׁ֨ן אַף־יְהֹוָ֤ה וְקִנְאָתוֹ֙ בָּאִ֣ישׁ הַה֔וּא וְרָ֤בְצָה בּוֹ֙ כׇּל־הָ֣אָלָ֔ה הַכְּתוּבָ֖ה בַּסֵּ֣פֶר הַזֶּ֑ה וּמָחָ֤ה יְהֹוָה֙ אֶת־שְׁמ֔וֹ מִתַּ֖חַת הַשָּׁמָֽיִם׃
verses.translit: l'y'bh yhvh slch lv khy 'z y'shn 'fyhvh vqn'tv b'ysh hhv' vrbtsh bv khlh'lh hkhtvbh bspr hzh vmchh yhvh 'tshmv mtcht hshmym
verses.translation: the LORD will not be willing to pardon him, but then the anger of the LORD and His jealousy shall be kindled against that man, and all the curse that is written in this book shall lie upon him, and the LORD shall blot out his name from under heaven;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהִבְדִּיל֤וֹ יְהֹוָה֙ לְרָעָ֔ה מִכֹּ֖ל שִׁבְטֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל כְּכֹל֙ אָל֣וֹת הַבְּרִ֔ית הַכְּתוּבָ֕ה בְּסֵ֥פֶר הַתּוֹרָ֖ה הַזֶּֽה׃
verses.translit: vhbdylv yhvh lr'h mkhl shbty yshr'l khkhl 'lvt hbryt hkhtvbh bspr htvrh hzh
verses.translation: and the LORD shall separate him unto evil out of all the tribes of Israel, according to all the curses of the covenant that is written in this book of the law.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאָמַ֞ר הַדּ֣וֹר הָאַחֲר֗וֹן בְּנֵיכֶם֙ אֲשֶׁ֤ר יָק֙וּמוּ֙ מֵאַ֣חֲרֵיכֶ֔ם וְהַ֨נׇּכְרִ֔י אֲשֶׁ֥ר יָבֹ֖א מֵאֶ֣רֶץ רְחוֹקָ֑ה וְ֠רָא֠וּ אֶת־מַכּ֞וֹת הָאָ֤רֶץ הַהִוא֙ וְאֶת־תַּ֣חֲלֻאֶ֔יהָ אֲשֶׁר־חִלָּ֥ה יְהֹוָ֖ה בָּֽהּ׃
verses.translit: v'mr hdvr h'chrvn bnykhm 'shr yqvmv m'chrykhm vhnkhry 'shr yb' m'rts rchvqh vr'v 'tmkhvt h'rts hhv' v'ttchl'yh 'shrchlh yhvh bh
verses.translation: And the generation to come, your children that shall rise up after you, and the foreigner that shall come from a far land, shall say, when they see the plagues of that land, and the sicknesses wherewith the LORD hath made it sick;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: גׇּפְרִ֣ית וָמֶ֘לַח֮ שְׂרֵפָ֣ה כׇל־אַרְצָהּ֒ לֹ֤א תִזָּרַע֙ וְלֹ֣א תַצְמִ֔חַ וְלֹא־יַעֲלֶ֥ה בָ֖הּ כׇּל־עֵ֑שֶׂב כְּֽמַהְפֵּכַ֞ת סְדֹ֤ם וַעֲמֹרָה֙ אַדְמָ֣ה (וצביים) [וּצְבוֹיִ֔ם] אֲשֶׁר֙ הָפַ֣ךְ יְהֹוָ֔ה בְּאַפּ֖וֹ וּבַחֲמָתֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: gpryt vmlch shrph khl'rtsh l' tzr' vl' ttsmch vl'y'lh bh khl'shb khmhpkht sdm v'mrh 'dmh (vtsbyym) [vtsbvym] 'shr hpkh yhvh b'pv vbchmtv
verses.translation: and that the whole land thereof is brimstone, and salt, and a burning, that it is not sown, nor beareth, nor any grass groweth therein, like the overthrow of Sodom and Gomorrah, Admah and Zeboiim, which the LORD overthrew in His anger, and in His wrath;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאָֽמְרוּ֙ כׇּל־הַגּוֹיִ֔ם עַל־מֶ֨ה עָשָׂ֧ה יְהֹוָ֛ה כָּ֖כָה לָאָ֣רֶץ הַזֹּ֑את מֶ֥ה חֳרִ֛י הָאַ֥ף הַגָּד֖וֹל הַזֶּֽה׃
verses.translit: v'mrv khlhgvym 'lmh 'shh yhvh khkhh l'rts hz't mh chry h'f hgdvl hzh
verses.translation: even all the nations shall say ‘Wherefore hath the LORD done thus unto this land? what meaneth the heat of this great anger?’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאָ֣מְר֔וּ עַ֚ל אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָזְב֔וּ אֶת־בְּרִ֥ית יְהֹוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֣י אֲבֹתָ֑ם אֲשֶׁר֙ כָּרַ֣ת עִמָּ֔ם בְּהוֹצִיא֥וֹ אֹתָ֖ם מֵאֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם׃
verses.translit: v'mrv 'l 'shr 'zbv 'tbryt yhvh 'lhy 'btm 'shr khrt 'mm bhvtsy'v 'tm m'rts mtsrym
verses.translation: then men shall say: ‘Because they forsook the covenant of the LORD, the God of their fathers, which He made with them when He brought them forth out of the land of Egypt;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֵּלְכ֗וּ וַיַּֽעַבְדוּ֙ אֱלֹהִ֣ים אֲחֵרִ֔ים וַיִּֽשְׁתַּחֲו֖וּ לָהֶ֑ם אֱלֹהִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹֽא־יְדָע֔וּם וְלֹ֥א חָלַ֖ק לָהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vylkhv vy'bdv 'lhym 'chrym vyshtchvv lhm 'lhym 'shr l'yd'vm vl' chlq lhm
verses.translation: and went and served other gods, and worshipped them, gods that they knew not, and that He had not allotted unto them;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּחַר־אַ֥ף יְהֹוָ֖ה בָּאָ֣רֶץ הַהִ֑וא לְהָבִ֤יא עָלֶ֙יהָ֙ אֶת־כׇּל־הַקְּלָלָ֔ה הַכְּתוּבָ֖ה בַּסֵּ֥פֶר הַזֶּֽה׃
verses.translit: vychr'f yhvh b'rts hhv' lhby' 'lyh 'tkhlhqllh hkhtvbh bspr hzh
verses.translation: therefore the anger of the LORD was kindled against this land, to bring upon it all the curse that is written in this book;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּתְּשֵׁ֤ם יְהֹוָה֙ מֵעַ֣ל אַדְמָתָ֔ם בְּאַ֥ף וּבְחֵמָ֖ה וּבְקֶ֣צֶף גָּד֑וֹל וַיַּשְׁלִכֵ֛ם אֶל־אֶ֥רֶץ אַחֶ֖רֶת כַּיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃
verses.translit: vytshm yhvh m'l 'dmtm b'f vbchmh vbqtsf gdvl vyshlkhm 'l'rts 'chrt khyvm hzh
verses.translation: and the LORD rooted them out of their land in anger, and in wrath, and in great indignation, and cast them into another land, as it is this day’.—
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַנִּ֨סְתָּרֹ֔ת לַיהֹוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֑ינוּ וְהַנִּגְלֹ֞ת לָ֤ׄנׄוּׄ וּׄלְׄבָׄנֵ֙ׄיׄנׄוּ֙ׄ עַׄד־עוֹלָ֔ם לַעֲשׂ֕וֹת אֶת־כׇּל־דִּבְרֵ֖י הַתּוֹרָ֥ה הַזֹּֽאת׃ {ס}
verses.translit: hnstrt lyhvh 'lhynv vhnglt lnv vlbnynv 'd'vlm l'shvt 'tkhldbry htvrh hz't {s}
verses.translation: The secret things belong unto the LORD our God; but the things that are revealed belong unto us and to our children for ever, that we may do all the words of this law.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָיָה֩ כִֽי־יָבֹ֨אוּ עָלֶ֜יךָ כׇּל־הַדְּבָרִ֣ים הָאֵ֗לֶּה הַבְּרָכָה֙ וְהַקְּלָלָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָתַ֖תִּי לְפָנֶ֑יךָ וַהֲשֵׁבֹתָ֙ אֶל־לְבָבֶ֔ךָ בְּכׇ֨ל־הַגּוֹיִ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֧ר הִדִּיחֲךָ֛ יְהֹוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ שָֽׁמָּה׃
verses.translit: vhyh khyyb'v 'lykh khlhdbrym h'lh hbrkhh vhqllh 'shr ntty lpnykh vhshbt 'llbbkh bkhlhgvym 'shr hdychkh yhvh 'lhykh shmh
verses.translation: And it shall come to pass, when all these things are come upon thee, the blessing and the curse, which I have set before thee, and thou shalt bethink thyself among all the nations, whither the LORD thy God hath driven thee,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְשַׁבְתָּ֞ עַד־יְהֹוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֶ֙יךָ֙ וְשָׁמַעְתָּ֣ בְקֹל֔וֹ כְּכֹ֛ל אֲשֶׁר־אָנֹכִ֥י מְצַוְּךָ֖ הַיּ֑וֹם אַתָּ֣ה וּבָנֶ֔יךָ בְּכׇל־לְבָבְךָ֖ וּבְכׇל־נַפְשֶֽׁךָ׃
verses.translit: vshbt 'dyhvh 'lhykh vshm't bqlv khkhl 'shr'nkhy mtsvkh hyvm 'th vbnykh bkhllbbkh vbkhlnpshkh
verses.translation: and shalt return unto the LORD thy God, and hearken to His voice according to all that I command thee this day, thou and thy children, with all thy heart, and with all thy soul;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְשָׁ֨ב יְהֹוָ֧ה אֱלֹהֶ֛יךָ אֶת־שְׁבוּתְךָ֖ וְרִחֲמֶ֑ךָ וְשָׁ֗ב וְקִבֶּצְךָ֙ מִכׇּל־הָ֣עַמִּ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֧ר הֱפִֽיצְךָ֛ יְהֹוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ שָֽׁמָּה׃
verses.translit: vshb yhvh 'lhykh 'tshbvtkh vrchmkh vshb vqbtskh mkhlh'mym 'shr hpytskh yhvh 'lhykh shmh
verses.translation: that then the LORD thy God will turn thy captivity, and have compassion upon thee, and will return and gather thee from all the peoples, whither the LORD thy God hath scattered thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִם־יִהְיֶ֥ה נִֽדַּחֲךָ֖ בִּקְצֵ֣ה הַשָּׁמָ֑יִם מִשָּׁ֗ם יְקַבֶּצְךָ֙ יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ וּמִשָּׁ֖ם יִקָּחֶֽךָ׃
verses.translit: 'myhyh ndchkh bqtsh hshmym mshm yqbtskh yhvh 'lhykh vmshm yqchkh
verses.translation: If any of thine that are dispersed be in the uttermost parts of heaven, from thence will the LORD thy God gather thee, and from thence will He fetch thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וֶהֱבִיאֲךָ֞ יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֗יךָ אֶל־הָאָ֛רֶץ אֲשֶׁר־יָרְשׁ֥וּ אֲבֹתֶ֖יךָ וִֽירִשְׁתָּ֑הּ וְהֵיטִֽבְךָ֥ וְהִרְבְּךָ֖ מֵאֲבֹתֶֽיךָ׃
verses.translit: vhby'kh yhvh 'lhykh 'lh'rts 'shryrshv 'btykh vyrshth vhytbkh vhrbkh m'btykh
verses.translation: And the LORD thy God will bring thee into the land which thy fathers possessed, and thou shalt possess it; and He will do thee good, and multiply thee above thy fathers. .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמָ֨ל יְהֹוָ֧ה אֱלֹהֶ֛יךָ אֶת־לְבָבְךָ֖ וְאֶת־לְבַ֣ב זַרְעֶ֑ךָ לְאַהֲבָ֞ה אֶת־יְהֹוָ֧ה אֱלֹהֶ֛יךָ בְּכׇל־לְבָבְךָ֥ וּבְכׇל־נַפְשְׁךָ֖ לְמַ֥עַן חַיֶּֽיךָ׃
verses.translit: vml yhvh 'lhykh 'tlbbkh v'tlbb zr'kh l'hbh 'tyhvh 'lhykh bkhllbbkh vbkhlnpshkh lm'n chyykh
verses.translation: And the LORD thy God will circumcise thy heart, and the heart of thy seed, to love the LORD thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy soul, that thou mayest live.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנָתַן֙ יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ אֵ֥ת כׇּל־הָאָל֖וֹת הָאֵ֑לֶּה עַל־אֹיְבֶ֥יךָ וְעַל־שֹׂנְאֶ֖יךָ אֲשֶׁ֥ר רְדָפֽוּךָ׃
verses.translit: vntn yhvh 'lhykh 't khlh'lvt h'lh 'l'ybykh v'lshn'ykh 'shr rdpvkh
verses.translation: And the LORD thy God will put all these curses upon thine enemies, and on them that hate thee, that persecuted thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאַתָּ֣ה תָשׁ֔וּב וְשָׁמַעְתָּ֖ בְּק֣וֹל יְהֹוָ֑ה וְעָשִׂ֙יתָ֙ אֶת־כׇּל־מִצְוֺתָ֔יו אֲשֶׁ֛ר אָנֹכִ֥י מְצַוְּךָ֖ הַיּֽוֹם׃
verses.translit: v'th tshvb vshm't bqvl yhvh v'shyt 'tkhlmtsvtyv 'shr 'nkhy mtsvkh hyvm
verses.translation: And thou shalt return and hearken to the voice of the LORD, and do all His commandments which I command thee this day.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהוֹתִֽירְךָ֩ יְהֹוָ֨ה אֱלֹהֶ֜יךָ בְּכֹ֣ל  מַעֲשֵׂ֣ה יָדֶ֗ךָ בִּפְרִ֨י בִטְנְךָ֜ וּבִפְרִ֧י בְהֶמְתְּךָ֛ וּבִפְרִ֥י אַדְמָתְךָ֖ לְטֹבָ֑ה כִּ֣י  יָשׁ֣וּב יְהֹוָ֗ה לָשׂ֤וּשׂ עָלֶ֙יךָ֙ לְט֔וֹב כַּאֲשֶׁר־שָׂ֖שׂ עַל־אֲבֹתֶֽיךָ׃
verses.translit: vhvtyrkh yhvh 'lhykh bkhl  m'shh ydkh bpry btnkh vbpry bhmtkh vbpry 'dmtkh ltbh khy  yshvb yhvh lshvsh 'lykh ltvb kh'shrshsh 'l'btykh
verses.translation: And the LORD thy God will make thee over-abundant in all the work of thy hand, in the fruit of thy body, and in the fruit of thy cattle, and in the fruit of thy land, for good; for the LORD will again rejoice over thee for good, as He rejoiced over thy fathers;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֣י תִשְׁמַ֗ע בְּקוֹל֙ יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ לִשְׁמֹ֤ר מִצְוֺתָיו֙ וְחֻקֹּתָ֔יו הַכְּתוּבָ֕ה בְּסֵ֥פֶר הַתּוֹרָ֖ה הַזֶּ֑ה כִּ֤י תָשׁוּב֙ אֶל־יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ בְּכׇל־לְבָבְךָ֖ וּבְכׇל־נַפְשֶֽׁךָ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: khy tshm' bqvl yhvh 'lhykh lshmr mtsvtyv vchqtyv hkhtvbh bspr htvrh hzh khy tshvb 'lyhvh 'lhykh bkhllbbkh vbkhlnpshkh {s}
verses.translation: if thou shalt hearken to the voice of the LORD thy God, to keep His commandments and His statutes which are written in this book of the law; if thou turn unto the LORD thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy soul.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֚י הַמִּצְוָ֣ה הַזֹּ֔את אֲשֶׁ֛ר אָנֹכִ֥י מְצַוְּךָ֖ הַיּ֑וֹם לֹא־נִפְלֵ֥את הִוא֙ מִמְּךָ֔ וְלֹ֥א רְחֹקָ֖ה הִֽוא׃
verses.translit: khy hmtsvh hz't 'shr 'nkhy mtsvkh hyvm l'npl't hv' mmkh vl' rchqh hv'
verses.translation: For this commandment which I command thee this day, it is not too hard for thee, neither is it far off.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֹ֥א בַשָּׁמַ֖יִם הִ֑וא לֵאמֹ֗ר מִ֣י יַעֲלֶה־לָּ֤נוּ הַשָּׁמַ֙יְמָה֙ וְיִקָּחֶ֣הָ לָּ֔נוּ וְיַשְׁמִעֵ֥נוּ אֹתָ֖הּ וְנַעֲשֶֽׂנָּה׃
verses.translit: l' bshmym hv' l'mr my y'lhlnv hshmymh vyqchh lnv vyshm'nv 'th vn'shnh
verses.translation: It is not in heaven, that thou shouldest say: ‘Who shall go up for us to heaven, and bring it unto us, and make us to hear it, that we may do it?’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלֹא־מֵעֵ֥בֶר לַיָּ֖ם הִ֑וא לֵאמֹ֗ר מִ֣י יַעֲבׇר־לָ֜נוּ אֶל־עֵ֤בֶר הַיָּם֙ וְיִקָּחֶ֣הָ לָּ֔נוּ וְיַשְׁמִעֵ֥נוּ אֹתָ֖הּ וְנַעֲשֶֽׂנָּה׃
verses.translit: vl'm'br lym hv' l'mr my y'brlnv 'l'br hym vyqchh lnv vyshm'nv 'th vn'shnh
verses.translation: Neither is it beyond the sea, that thou shouldest say: ‘Who shall go over the sea for us, and bring it unto us, and make us to hear it, that we may do it?’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־קָר֥וֹב אֵלֶ֛יךָ הַדָּבָ֖ר מְאֹ֑ד בְּפִ֥יךָ וּבִֽלְבָבְךָ֖ לַעֲשֹׂתֽוֹ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: khyqrvb 'lykh hdbr m'd bpykh vblbbkh l'shtv {s}
verses.translation: But the word is very nigh unto thee, in thy mouth, and in thy heart, that thou mayest do it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: רְאֵ֨ה נָתַ֤תִּי לְפָנֶ֙יךָ֙ הַיּ֔וֹם אֶת־הַֽחַיִּ֖ים וְאֶת־הַטּ֑וֹב וְאֶת־הַמָּ֖וֶת וְאֶת־הָרָֽע׃
verses.translit: r'h ntty lpnykh hyvm 'thchyym v'thtvb v'thmvt v'thr'
verses.translation: See, I have set before thee this day life and good, and death and evil,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲשֶׁ֨ר אָנֹכִ֣י מְצַוְּךָ֮ הַיּוֹם֒ לְאַהֲבָ֞ה אֶת־יְהֹוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֶ֙יךָ֙ לָלֶ֣כֶת בִּדְרָכָ֔יו וְלִשְׁמֹ֛ר מִצְוֺתָ֥יו וְחֻקֹּתָ֖יו וּמִשְׁפָּטָ֑יו וְחָיִ֣יתָ וְרָבִ֔יתָ וּבֵֽרַכְךָ֙ יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ בָּאָ֕רֶץ אֲשֶׁר־אַתָּ֥ה בָא־שָׁ֖מָּה לְרִשְׁתָּֽהּ׃
verses.translit: 'shr 'nkhy mtsvkh hyvm l'hbh 'tyhvh 'lhykh llkht bdrkhyv vlshmr mtsvtyv vchqtyv vmshptyv vchyyt vrbyt vbrkhkh yhvh 'lhykh b'rts 'shr'th b'shmh lrshth
verses.translation: in that I command thee this day to love the LORD thy God, to walk in His ways, and to keep His commandments and His statutes and His ordinances; then thou shalt live and multiply, and the LORD thy God shall bless thee in the land whither thou goest in to possess it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאִם־יִפְנֶ֥ה לְבָבְךָ֖ וְלֹ֣א תִשְׁמָ֑ע וְנִדַּחְתָּ֗ וְהִֽשְׁתַּחֲוִ֛יתָ לֵאלֹהִ֥ים אֲחֵרִ֖ים וַעֲבַדְתָּֽם׃
verses.translit: v'mypnh lbbkh vl' tshm' vndcht vhshtchvyt l'lhym 'chrym v'bdtm
verses.translation: But if thy heart turn away, and thou wilt not hear, but shalt be drawn away, and worship other gods, and serve them;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִגַּ֤דְתִּי לָכֶם֙ הַיּ֔וֹם כִּ֥י אָבֹ֖ד תֹּאבֵד֑וּן לֹא־תַאֲרִיכֻ֤ן יָמִים֙ עַל־הָ֣אֲדָמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר אַתָּ֤ה עֹבֵר֙ אֶת־הַיַּרְדֵּ֔ן לָב֥וֹא שָׁ֖מָּה לְרִשְׁתָּֽהּ׃
verses.translit: hgdty lkhm hyvm khy 'bd t'bdvn l't'rykhn ymym 'lh'dmh 'shr 'th 'br 'thyrdn lbv' shmh lrshth
verses.translation: I declare unto you this day, that ye shall surely perish; ye shall not prolong your days upon the land, whither thou passest over the Jordan to go in to possess it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַעִדֹ֨תִי בָכֶ֣ם הַיּוֹם֮ אֶת־הַשָּׁמַ֣יִם וְאֶת־הָאָ֒רֶץ֒ הַחַיִּ֤ים וְהַמָּ֙וֶת֙ נָתַ֣תִּי לְפָנֶ֔יךָ הַבְּרָכָ֖ה וְהַקְּלָלָ֑ה וּבָֽחַרְתָּ֙ בַּחַיִּ֔ים לְמַ֥עַן תִּֽחְיֶ֖ה אַתָּ֥ה וְזַרְעֶֽךָ׃
verses.translit: h'dty bkhm hyvm 'thshmym v'th'rts hchyym vhmvt ntty lpnykh hbrkhh vhqllh vbchrt bchyym lm'n tchyh 'th vzr'kh
verses.translation: I call heaven and earth to witness against you this day, that I have set before thee life and death, the blessing and the curse; therefore choose life, that thou mayest live, thou and thy seed;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְאַֽהֲבָה֙ אֶת־יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ לִשְׁמֹ֥עַ בְּקֹל֖וֹ וּלְדׇבְקָה־ב֑וֹ כִּ֣י ה֤וּא חַיֶּ֙יךָ֙ וְאֹ֣רֶךְ יָמֶ֔יךָ לָשֶׁ֣בֶת עַל־הָאֲדָמָ֗ה אֲשֶׁר֩ נִשְׁבַּ֨ע יְהֹוָ֧ה לַאֲבֹתֶ֛יךָ לְאַבְרָהָ֛ם לְיִצְחָ֥ק וּֽלְיַעֲקֹ֖ב לָתֵ֥ת לָהֶֽם׃ {פ}
verses.translit: l'hbh 'tyhvh 'lhykh lshm' bqlv vldbqhbv khy hv' chyykh v'rkh ymykh lshbt 'lh'dmh 'shr nshb' yhvh l'btykh l'brhm lytschq vly'qb ltt lhm {p}
verses.translation: to love the LORD thy God, to hearken to His voice, and to cleave unto Him; for that is thy life, and the length of thy days; that thou mayest dwell in the land which the LORD swore unto thy fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, to give them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֵּ֖לֶךְ מֹשֶׁ֑ה וַיְדַבֵּ֛ר אֶת־הַדְּבָרִ֥ים הָאֵ֖לֶּה אֶל־כׇּל־יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: vylkh mshh vydbr 'thdbrym h'lh 'lkhlyshr'l
verses.translation: And Moses went and spoke these words unto all Israel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֲלֵהֶ֗ם בֶּן־מֵאָה֩ וְעֶשְׂרִ֨ים שָׁנָ֤ה אָנֹכִי֙ הַיּ֔וֹם לֹא־אוּכַ֥ל ע֖וֹד לָצֵ֣את וְלָב֑וֹא וַֽיהֹוָה֙ אָמַ֣ר אֵלַ֔י לֹ֥א תַעֲבֹ֖ר אֶת־הַיַּרְדֵּ֥ן הַזֶּֽה׃
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lhm bnm'h v'shrym shnh 'nkhy hyvm l''vkhl 'vd lts't vlbv' vyhvh 'mr 'ly l' t'br 'thyrdn hzh
verses.translation: And he said unto them: ‘I am a hundred and twenty years old this day; I can no more go out and come in; and the LORD hath said unto me: Thou shalt not go over this Jordan.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְהֹוָ֨ה אֱלֹהֶ֜יךָ ה֣וּא  עֹבֵ֣ר לְפָנֶ֗יךָ הֽוּא־יַשְׁמִ֞יד אֶת־הַגּוֹיִ֥ם הָאֵ֛לֶּה מִלְּפָנֶ֖יךָ וִירִשְׁתָּ֑ם יְהוֹשֻׁ֗עַ ה֚וּא עֹבֵ֣ר לְפָנֶ֔יךָ כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר דִּבֶּ֥ר יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: yhvh 'lhykh hv'  'br lpnykh hv'yshmyd 'thgvym h'lh mlpnykh vyrshtm yhvsh' hv' 'br lpnykh kh'shr dbr yhvh
verses.translation: The LORD thy God, He will go over before thee; He will destroy these nations from before thee, and thou shalt dispossess them; and Joshua, he shall go over before thee, as the LORD hath spoken.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעָשָׂ֤ה יְהֹוָה֙ לָהֶ֔ם כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֗ה לְסִיח֥וֹן וּלְע֛וֹג מַלְכֵ֥י הָאֱמֹרִ֖י וּלְאַרְצָ֑ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר הִשְׁמִ֖יד אֹתָֽם׃
verses.translit: v'shh yhvh lhm kh'shr 'shh lsychvn vl'vg mlkhy h'mry vl'rtsm 'shr hshmyd 'tm
verses.translation: And the LORD will do unto them as He did to Sihon and to Og, the kings of the Amorites, and unto their land; whom He destroyed.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּנְתָנָ֥ם יְהֹוָ֖ה לִפְנֵיכֶ֑ם וַעֲשִׂיתֶ֣ם לָהֶ֔ם כְּכׇ֨ל־הַמִּצְוָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוִּ֖יתִי אֶתְכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vntnm yhvh lpnykhm v'shytm lhm khkhlhmtsvh 'shr tsvyty 'tkhm
verses.translation: And the LORD will deliver them up before you, and ye shall do unto them according unto all the commandment which I have commanded you.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: חִזְק֣וּ וְאִמְצ֔וּ אַל־תִּֽירְא֥וּ וְאַל־תַּעַרְצ֖וּ מִפְּנֵיהֶ֑ם כִּ֣י  יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֗יךָ ה֚וּא הַהֹלֵ֣ךְ עִמָּ֔ךְ לֹ֥א יַרְפְּךָ֖ וְלֹ֥א יַעַזְבֶֽךָּ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: chzqv v'mtsv 'ltyr'v v'lt'rtsv mpnyhm khy  yhvh 'lhykh hv' hhlkh 'mkh l' yrpkh vl' y'zbkh {s}
verses.translation: Be strong and of good courage, fear not, nor be affrighted at them; for the LORD thy God, He it is that doth go with thee; He will not fail thee, nor forsake thee.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּקְרָ֨א מֹשֶׁ֜ה לִיהוֹשֻׁ֗עַ וַיֹּ֨אמֶר אֵלָ֜יו לְעֵינֵ֣י כׇל־יִשְׂרָאֵל֮ חֲזַ֣ק וֶאֱמָץ֒ כִּ֣י אַתָּ֗ה תָּבוֹא֙ אֶת־הָעָ֣ם הַזֶּ֔ה אֶל־הָאָ֕רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֨ר נִשְׁבַּ֧ע יְהֹוָ֛ה לַאֲבֹתָ֖ם לָתֵ֣ת לָהֶ֑ם וְאַתָּ֖ה תַּנְחִילֶ֥נָּה אוֹתָֽם׃
verses.translit: vyqr' mshh lyhvsh' vy'mr 'lyv l'yny khlyshr'l chzq v'mts khy 'th tbv' 'th'm hzh 'lh'rts 'shr nshb' yhvh l'btm ltt lhm v'th tnchylnh 'vtm
verses.translation: And Moses called unto Joshua, and said unto him in the sight of all Israel: ‘Be strong and of good courage; for thou shalt go with this people into the land which the LORD hath sworn unto their fathers to give them; and thou shalt cause them to inherit it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיהֹוָ֞ה ה֣וּא  הַהֹלֵ֣ךְ לְפָנֶ֗יךָ ה֚וּא יִהְיֶ֣ה עִמָּ֔ךְ לֹ֥א יַרְפְּךָ֖ וְלֹ֣א יַעַזְבֶ֑ךָּ לֹ֥א תִירָ֖א וְלֹ֥א תֵחָֽת׃
verses.translit: vyhvh hv'  hhlkh lpnykh hv' yhyh 'mkh l' yrpkh vl' y'zbkh l' tyr' vl' tcht
verses.translation: And the LORD, He it is that doth go before thee; He will be with thee, He will not fail thee, neither forsake thee; fear not, neither be dismayed.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּכְתֹּ֣ב מֹשֶׁה֮ אֶת־הַתּוֹרָ֣ה הַזֹּאת֒ וַֽיִּתְּנָ֗הּ אֶל־הַכֹּֽהֲנִים֙ בְּנֵ֣י לֵוִ֔י הַנֹּ֣שְׂאִ֔ים אֶת־אֲר֖וֹן בְּרִ֣ית יְהֹוָ֑ה וְאֶל־כׇּל־זִקְנֵ֖י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: vykhtb mshh 'thtvrh hz't vytnh 'lhkhhnym bny lvy hnsh'ym 't'rvn bryt yhvh v'lkhlzqny yshr'l
verses.translation: And Moses wrote this law, and delivered it unto the priests the sons of Levi, that bore the ark of the covenant of the LORD, and unto all the elders of Israel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְצַ֥ו מֹשֶׁ֖ה אוֹתָ֣ם לֵאמֹ֑ר מִקֵּ֣ץ  שֶׁ֣בַע שָׁנִ֗ים בְּמֹעֵ֛ד שְׁנַ֥ת הַשְּׁמִטָּ֖ה בְּחַ֥ג הַסֻּכּֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: vytsv mshh 'vtm l'mr mqts  shb' shnym bm'd shnt hshmth bchg hskhvt
verses.translation: And Moses commanded them, saying: ‘At the end of every seven years, in the set time of the year of release, in the feast of tabernacles,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּב֣וֹא כׇל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל לֵֽרָאוֹת֙ אֶת־פְּנֵי֙ יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ בַּמָּק֖וֹם אֲשֶׁ֣ר יִבְחָ֑ר תִּקְרָ֞א אֶת־הַתּוֹרָ֥ה הַזֹּ֛את נֶ֥גֶד כׇּל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בְּאׇזְנֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: bbv' khlyshr'l lr'vt 'tpny yhvh 'lhykh bmqvm 'shr ybchr tqr' 'thtvrh hz't ngd khlyshr'l b'znyhm
verses.translation: when all Israel is come to appear before the LORD thy God in the place which He shall choose, thou shalt read this law before all Israel in their hearing.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַקְהֵ֣ל אֶת־הָעָ֗ם הָֽאֲנָשִׁ֤ים וְהַנָּשִׁים֙ וְהַטַּ֔ף וְגֵרְךָ֖ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בִּשְׁעָרֶ֑יךָ לְמַ֨עַן יִשְׁמְע֜וּ וּלְמַ֣עַן יִלְמְד֗וּ וְיָֽרְאוּ֙ אֶת־יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֔ם וְשָׁמְר֣וּ לַעֲשׂ֔וֹת אֶת־כׇּל־דִּבְרֵ֖י הַתּוֹרָ֥ה הַזֹּֽאת׃
verses.translit: hqhl 'th'm h'nshym vhnshym vhtf vgrkh 'shr bsh'rykh lm'n yshm'v vlm'n ylmdv vyr'v 'tyhvh 'lhykhm vshmrv l'shvt 'tkhldbry htvrh hz't
verses.translation: Assemble the people, the men and the women and the little ones, and thy stranger that is within thy gates, that they may hear, and that they may learn, and fear the LORD your God, and observe to do all the words of this law;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבְנֵיהֶ֞ם אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹא־יָדְע֗וּ יִשְׁמְעוּ֙ וְלָ֣מְד֔וּ לְיִרְאָ֖ה אֶת־יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֑ם כׇּל־הַיָּמִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֨ר אַתֶּ֤ם חַיִּים֙ עַל־הָ֣אֲדָמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר אַתֶּ֜ם עֹבְרִ֧ים אֶת־הַיַּרְדֵּ֛ן שָׁ֖מָּה לְרִשְׁתָּֽהּ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vbnyhm 'shr l'yd'v yshm'v vlmdv lyr'h 'tyhvh 'lhykhm khlhymym 'shr 'tm chyym 'lh'dmh 'shr 'tm 'brym 'thyrdn shmh lrshth {p}
verses.translation: and that their children, who have not known, may hear, and learn to fear the LORD your God, as long as ye live in the land whither ye go over the Jordan to possess it.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהֹוָ֜ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֗ה הֵ֣ן קָרְב֣וּ יָמֶ֘יךָ֮ לָמוּת֒ קְרָ֣א אֶת־יְהוֹשֻׁ֗עַ וְהִֽתְיַצְּב֛וּ בְּאֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵ֖ד וַאֲצַוֶּ֑נּוּ וַיֵּ֤לֶךְ מֹשֶׁה֙ וִיהוֹשֻׁ֔עַ וַיִּֽתְיַצְּב֖וּ בְּאֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד׃
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'lmshh hn qrbv ymykh lmvt qr' 'tyhvsh' vhtytsbv b'hl mv'd v'tsvnv vylkh mshh vyhvsh' vytytsbv b'hl mv'd
verses.translation: And the LORD said unto Moses: ‘Behold, thy days approach that thou must die; call Joshua, and present yourselves in the tent of meeting, that I may give him a charge.’ And Moses and Joshua went, and presented themselves in the tent of meeting.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֵּרָ֧א יְהֹוָ֛ה בָּאֹ֖הֶל בְּעַמּ֣וּד עָנָ֑ן וַֽיַּעֲמֹ֛ד עַמּ֥וּד הֶעָנָ֖ן עַל־פֶּ֥תַח הָאֹֽהֶל׃
verses.translit: vyr' yhvh b'hl b'mvd 'nn vy'md 'mvd h'nn 'lptch h'hl
verses.translation: And the LORD appeared in the Tent in a pillar of cloud; and the pillar of cloud stood over the door of the Tent.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהֹוָה֙ אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֔ה הִנְּךָ֥ שֹׁכֵ֖ב עִם־אֲבֹתֶ֑יךָ וְקָם֩ הָעָ֨ם הַזֶּ֜ה וְזָנָ֣ה  אַחֲרֵ֣י  אֱלֹהֵ֣י נֵכַר־הָאָ֗רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֨ר ה֤וּא בָא־שָׁ֙מָּה֙ בְּקִרְבּ֔וֹ וַעֲזָבַ֕נִי וְהֵפֵר֙ אֶת־בְּרִיתִ֔י אֲשֶׁ֥ר כָּרַ֖תִּי אִתּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'lmshh hnkh shkhb 'm'btykh vqm h'm hzh vznh  'chry  'lhy nkhrh'rts 'shr hv' b'shmh bqrbv v'zbny vhpr 'tbryty 'shr khrty 'tv
verses.translation: And the LORD said unto Moses: ‘Behold, thou art about to sleep with thy fathers; and this people will rise up, and go astray after the foreign gods of the land, whither they go to be among them, and will forsake Me, and break My covenant which I have made with them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְחָרָ֣ה אַפִּ֣י ב֣וֹ בַיּוֹם־הַ֠ה֠וּא וַעֲזַבְתִּ֞ים וְהִסְתַּרְתִּ֨י פָנַ֤י מֵהֶם֙ וְהָיָ֣ה לֶאֱכֹ֔ל וּמְצָאֻ֛הוּ רָע֥וֹת רַבּ֖וֹת וְצָר֑וֹת וְאָמַר֙ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֔וּא הֲלֹ֗א עַ֣ל כִּי־אֵ֤ין אֱלֹהַי֙ בְּקִרְבִּ֔י מְצָא֖וּנִי הָרָע֥וֹת הָאֵֽלֶּה׃
verses.translit: vchrh 'py bv byvmhhv' v'zbtym vhstrty pny mhm vhyh l'khl vmts'hv r'vt rbvt vtsrvt v'mr byvm hhv' hl' 'l khy'yn 'lhy bqrby mts'vny hr'vt h'lh
verses.translation: Then My anger shall be kindled against them in that day, and I will forsake them, and I will hide My face from them, and they shall be devoured, and many evils and troubles shall come upon them; so that they will say in that day: Are not these evils come upon us because our God is not among us?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאָנֹכִ֗י הַסְתֵּ֨ר אַסְתִּ֤יר פָּנַי֙ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֔וּא עַ֥ל כׇּל־הָרָעָ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֑ה כִּ֣י פָנָ֔ה אֶל־אֱלֹהִ֖ים אֲחֵרִֽים׃
verses.translit: v'nkhy hstr 'styr pny byvm hhv' 'l khlhr'h 'shr 'shh khy pnh 'l'lhym 'chrym
verses.translation: And I will surely hide My face in that day for all the evil which they shall have wrought, in that they are turned unto other gods.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֗ה כִּתְב֤וּ לָכֶם֙ אֶת־הַשִּׁירָ֣ה הַזֹּ֔את וְלַמְּדָ֥הּ אֶת־בְּנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל שִׂימָ֣הּ בְּפִיהֶ֑ם לְמַ֨עַן תִּֽהְיֶה־לִּ֜י הַשִּׁירָ֥ה הַזֹּ֛את לְעֵ֖ד בִּבְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: v'th khtbv lkhm 'thshyrh hz't vlmdh 'tbnyyshr'l shymh bpyhm lm'n thyhly hshyrh hz't l'd bbny yshr'l
verses.translation: Now therefore write ye this song for you, and teach thou it the children of Israel; put it in their mouths, that this song may be a witness for Me against the children of Israel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־אֲבִיאֶ֜נּוּ אֶֽל־הָאֲדָמָ֣ה  אֲשֶׁר־נִשְׁבַּ֣עְתִּי לַאֲבֹתָ֗יו זָבַ֤ת חָלָב֙ וּדְבַ֔שׁ וְאָכַ֥ל וְשָׂבַ֖ע וְדָשֵׁ֑ן וּפָנָ֞ה אֶל־אֱלֹהִ֤ים אֲחֵרִים֙ וַעֲבָד֔וּם וְנִ֣אֲצ֔וּנִי וְהֵפֵ֖ר אֶת־בְּרִיתִֽי׃
verses.translit: khy'by'nv 'lh'dmh  'shrnshb'ty l'btyv zbt chlb vdbsh v'khl vshb' vdshn vpnh 'l'lhym 'chrym v'bdvm vn'tsvny vhpr 'tbryty
verses.translation: For when I shall have brought them into the land which I swore unto their fathers, flowing with milk and honey; and they shall have eaten their fill, and waxen fat; and turned unto other gods, and served them, and despised Me, and broken My covenant;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְ֠הָיָ֠ה כִּי־תִמְצֶ֨אןָ אֹת֜וֹ רָע֣וֹת רַבּוֹת֮ וְצָרוֹת֒ וְ֠עָנְתָ֠ה הַשִּׁירָ֨ה הַזֹּ֤את לְפָנָיו֙ לְעֵ֔ד כִּ֛י לֹ֥א תִשָּׁכַ֖ח מִפִּ֣י זַרְע֑וֹ כִּ֧י יָדַ֣עְתִּי אֶת־יִצְר֗וֹ אֲשֶׁ֨ר ה֤וּא עֹשֶׂה֙ הַיּ֔וֹם בְּטֶ֣רֶם אֲבִיאֶ֔נּוּ אֶל־הָאָ֖רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֥ר נִשְׁבַּֽעְתִּי׃
verses.translit: vhyh khytmts'n 'tv r'vt rbvt vtsrvt v'nth hshyrh hz't lpnyv l'd khy l' tshkhch mpy zr'v khy yd'ty 'tytsrv 'shr hv' 'shh hyvm btrm 'by'nv 'lh'rts 'shr nshb'ty
verses.translation: then it shall come to pass, when many evils and troubles are come upon them, that this song shall testify before them as a witness; for it shall not be forgotten out of the mouths of their seed; for I know their imagination how they do even now, before I have brought them into the land which I swore.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּכְתֹּ֥ב מֹשֶׁ֛ה אֶת־הַשִּׁירָ֥ה הַזֹּ֖את בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֑וּא וַֽיְלַמְּדָ֖הּ אֶת־בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: vykhtb mshh 'thshyrh hz't byvm hhv' vylmdh 'tbny yshr'l
verses.translation: So Moses wrote this song the same day, and taught it the children of Israel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְצַ֞ו אֶת־יְהוֹשֻׁ֣עַ בִּן־נ֗וּן וַיֹּ֘אמֶר֮ חֲזַ֣ק וֶאֱמָץ֒ כִּ֣י אַתָּ֗ה תָּבִיא֙ אֶת־בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֶל־הָאָ֖רֶץ אֲשֶׁר־נִשְׁבַּ֣עְתִּי לָהֶ֑ם וְאָנֹכִ֖י אֶהְיֶ֥ה עִמָּֽךְ׃
verses.translit: vytsv 'tyhvsh' bnnvn vy'mr chzq v'mts khy 'th tby' 'tbny yshr'l 'lh'rts 'shrnshb'ty lhm v'nkhy 'hyh 'mkh
verses.translation: And he gave Joshua the son of Nun a charge, and said: ‘Be strong and of good courage; for thou shalt bring the children of Israel into the land which I swore unto them; and I will be with thee.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֣י  כְּכַלּ֣וֹת מֹשֶׁ֗ה לִכְתֹּ֛ב אֶת־דִּבְרֵ֥י הַתּוֹרָֽה־הַזֹּ֖את עַל־סֵ֑פֶר עַ֖ד תֻּמָּֽם׃
verses.translit: vyhy  khkhlvt mshh lkhtb 'tdbry htvrhhz't 'lspr 'd tmm
verses.translation: And it came to pass, when Moses had made an end of writing the words of this law in a book, until they were finished,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְצַ֤ו מֹשֶׁה֙ אֶת־הַלְוִיִּ֔ם נֹ֥שְׂאֵ֛י אֲר֥וֹן בְּרִית־יְהֹוָ֖ה לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: vytsv mshh 'thlvym nsh'y 'rvn brytyhvh l'mr
verses.translation: that Moses commanded the Levites, that bore the ark of the covenant of the LORD, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לָקֹ֗חַ אֵ֣ת סֵ֤פֶר הַתּוֹרָה֙ הַזֶּ֔ה וְשַׂמְתֶּ֣ם אֹת֔וֹ מִצַּ֛ד אֲר֥וֹן בְּרִית־יְהֹוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֑ם וְהָיָה־שָׁ֥ם בְּךָ֖ לְעֵֽד׃
verses.translit: lqch 't spr htvrh hzh vshmtm 'tv mtsd 'rvn brytyhvh 'lhykhm vhyhshm bkh l'd
verses.translation: ’Take this book of the law, and put it by the side of the ark of the covenant of the LORD your God, that it may be there for a witness against thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֣י אָנֹכִ֤י יָדַ֙עְתִּי֙ אֶֽת־מֶרְיְךָ֔ וְאֶֽת־עׇרְפְּךָ֖ הַקָּשֶׁ֑ה הֵ֣ן בְּעוֹדֶ֩נִּי֩ חַ֨י עִמָּכֶ֜ם הַיּ֗וֹם מַמְרִ֤ים הֱיִתֶם֙ עִם־יְהֹוָ֔ה וְאַ֖ף כִּי־אַחֲרֵ֥י מוֹתִֽי׃
verses.translit: khy 'nkhy yd'ty 'tmrykh v't'rpkh hqshh hn b'vdny chy 'mkhm hyvm mmrym hytm 'myhvh v'f khy'chry mvty
verses.translation: For I know thy rebellion, and thy stiff neck; behold, while I am yet alive with you this day, ye have been rebellious against the LORD; and how much more after my death?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַקְהִ֧ילוּ אֵלַ֛י אֶת־כׇּל־זִקְנֵ֥י שִׁבְטֵיכֶ֖ם וְשֹׁטְרֵיכֶ֑ם וַאֲדַבְּרָ֣ה בְאׇזְנֵיהֶ֗ם אֵ֚ת הַדְּבָרִ֣ים הָאֵ֔לֶּה וְאָעִ֣ידָה בָּ֔ם אֶת־הַשָּׁמַ֖יִם וְאֶת־הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translit: hqhylv 'ly 'tkhlzqny shbtykhm vshtrykhm v'dbrh b'znyhm 't hdbrym h'lh v''ydh bm 'thshmym v'th'rts
verses.translation: Assemble unto me all the elders of your tribes, and your officers, that I may speak these words in their ears, and call heaven and earth to witness against them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֣י יָדַ֗עְתִּי אַחֲרֵ֤י מוֹתִי֙ כִּֽי־הַשְׁחֵ֣ת תַּשְׁחִת֔וּן וְסַרְתֶּ֣ם מִן־הַדֶּ֔רֶךְ אֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוִּ֖יתִי אֶתְכֶ֑ם וְקָרָ֨את אֶתְכֶ֤ם הָרָעָה֙ בְּאַחֲרִ֣ית הַיָּמִ֔ים כִּֽי־תַעֲשׂ֤וּ אֶת־הָרַע֙ בְּעֵינֵ֣י יְהֹוָ֔ה לְהַכְעִיס֖וֹ בְּמַעֲשֵׂ֥ה יְדֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: khy yd'ty 'chry mvty khyhshcht tshchtvn vsrtm mnhdrkh 'shr tsvyty 'tkhm vqr't 'tkhm hr'h b'chryt hymym khyt'shv 'thr' b'yny yhvh lhkh'ysv bm'shh ydykhm
verses.translation: For I know that after my death ye will in any wise deal corruptly, and turn aside from the way which I have commanded you; and evil will befall you in the end of days; because ye will do that which is evil in the sight of the LORD, to provoke Him through the work of your hands.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֣ר מֹשֶׁ֗ה בְּאׇזְנֵי֙ כׇּל־קְהַ֣ל יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֶת־דִּבְרֵ֥י הַשִּׁירָ֖ה הַזֹּ֑את עַ֖ד תֻּמָּֽם׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vydbr mshh b'zny khlqhl yshr'l 'tdbry hshyrh hz't 'd tmm {p}
verses.translation: And Moses spoke in the ears of all the assembly of Israel the words of this song, until they were finished:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַאֲזִ֥ינוּ הַשָּׁמַ֖יִם וַאֲדַבֵּ֑רָה וְתִשְׁמַ֥ע הָאָ֖רֶץ אִמְרֵי־פִֽי׃
verses.translit: h'zynv hshmym v'dbrh vtshm' h'rts 'mrypy
verses.translation: Give ear, ye heavens, and I will speak; And let the earth hear the words of my mouth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יַעֲרֹ֤ף כַּמָּטָר֙ לִקְחִ֔י תִּזַּ֥ל כַּטַּ֖ל אִמְרָתִ֑י כִּשְׂעִירִ֣ם עֲלֵי־דֶ֔שֶׁא וְכִרְבִיבִ֖ים עֲלֵי־עֵֽשֶׂב׃
verses.translit: y'rf khmtr lqchy tzl khtl 'mrty khsh'yrm 'lydsh' vkhrbybym 'ly'shb
verses.translation: My doctrine shall drop as the rain, My speech shall distil as the dew; As the small rain upon the tender grass, And as the showers upon the herb.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֛י שֵׁ֥ם יְהֹוָ֖ה אֶקְרָ֑א הָב֥וּ גֹ֖דֶל לֵאלֹהֵֽינוּ׃
verses.translit: khy shm yhvh 'qr' hbv gdl l'lhynv
verses.translation: For I will proclaim the name of the LORD; Ascribe ye greatness unto our God.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַצּוּר֙ תָּמִ֣ים פׇּֽעֳל֔וֹ כִּ֥י כׇל־דְּרָכָ֖יו מִשְׁפָּ֑ט אֵ֤ל אֱמוּנָה֙ וְאֵ֣ין עָ֔וֶל צַדִּ֥יק וְיָשָׁ֖ר הֽוּא׃
verses.translit: htsvr tmym p'lv khy khldrkhyv mshpt 'l 'mvnh v'yn 'vl tsdyq vyshr hv'
verses.translation: The Rock, His work is perfect; For all His ways are justice; A God of faithfulness and without iniquity, Just and right is He. .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שִׁחֵ֥ת ל֛וֹ לֹ֖א בָּנָ֣יו מוּמָ֑ם דּ֥וֹר עִקֵּ֖שׁ וּפְתַלְתֹּֽל׃
verses.translit: shcht lv l' bnyv mvmm dvr 'qsh vptltl
verses.translation: Is corruption His? No; His children’s is the blemish; A generation crooked and perverse.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַ לְיְהֹוָה֙ תִּגְמְלוּ־זֹ֔את עַ֥ם נָבָ֖ל וְלֹ֣א חָכָ֑ם הֲלוֹא־הוּא֙ אָבִ֣יךָ קָּנֶ֔ךָ ה֥וּא עָשְׂךָ֖ וַֽיְכֹנְנֶֽךָ׃
verses.translit: h lyhvh tgmlvz't 'm nbl vl' chkhm hlv'hv' 'bykh qnkh hv' 'shkh vykhnnkh
verses.translation: Do ye thus requite the LORD, O foolish people and unwise? Is not He thy father that hath gotten thee? Hath He not made thee, and established thee?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: זְכֹר֙ יְמ֣וֹת עוֹלָ֔ם בִּ֖ינוּ שְׁנ֣וֹת דֹּר־וָדֹ֑ר שְׁאַ֤ל אָבִ֙יךָ֙ וְיַגֵּ֔דְךָ זְקֵנֶ֖יךָ וְיֹ֥אמְרוּ לָֽךְ׃
verses.translit: zkhr ymvt 'vlm bynv shnvt drvdr sh'l 'bykh vygdkh zqnykh vy'mrv lkh
verses.translation: Remember the days of old, Consider the years of many generations; Ask thy father, and he will declare unto thee, Thine elders, and they will tell thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּהַנְחֵ֤ל עֶלְיוֹן֙ גּוֹיִ֔ם בְּהַפְרִיד֖וֹ בְּנֵ֣י אָדָ֑ם יַצֵּב֙ גְּבֻלֹ֣ת עַמִּ֔ים לְמִסְפַּ֖ר בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: bhnchl 'lyvn gvym bhprydv bny 'dm ytsb gblt 'mym lmspr bny yshr'l
verses.translation: When the Most High gave to the nations their inheritance, when He separated the children of men, He set the borders of the peoples according to the number of the children of Israel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֛י חֵ֥לֶק יְהֹוָ֖ה עַמּ֑וֹ יַעֲקֹ֖ב חֶ֥בֶל נַחֲלָתֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: khy chlq yhvh 'mv y'qb chbl nchltv
verses.translation: For the portion of the LORD is His people, Jacob the lot of His inheritance.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יִמְצָאֵ֙הוּ֙ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ מִדְבָּ֔ר וּבְתֹ֖הוּ יְלֵ֣ל יְשִׁמֹ֑ן יְסֹבְבֶ֙נְהוּ֙ יְב֣וֹנְנֵ֔הוּ יִצְּרֶ֖נְהוּ כְּאִישׁ֥וֹן עֵינֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: ymts'hv b'rts mdbr vbthv yll yshmn ysbbnhv ybvnnhv ytsrnhv kh'yshvn 'ynv
verses.translation: He found him in a desert land, and in the waste, a howling wilderness; He compassed him about, He cared for him, He kept him as the apple of His eye.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כְּנֶ֙שֶׁר֙ יָעִ֣יר קִנּ֔וֹ עַל־גּוֹזָלָ֖יו יְרַחֵ֑ף יִפְרֹ֤שׂ כְּנָפָיו֙ יִקָּחֵ֔הוּ יִשָּׂאֵ֖הוּ עַל־אֶבְרָתֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: khnshr y'yr qnv 'lgvzlyv yrchf yprsh khnpyv yqchhv ysh'hv 'l'brtv
verses.translation: As an eagle that stirreth up her nest, Hovereth over her young, Spreadeth abroad her wings, taketh them, Beareth them on her pinions—
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְהֹוָ֖ה בָּדָ֣ד יַנְחֶ֑נּוּ וְאֵ֥ין עִמּ֖וֹ אֵ֥ל נֵכָֽר׃
verses.translit: yhvh bdd ynchnv v'yn 'mv 'l nkhr
verses.translation: The LORD alone did lead him, And there was no strange god with Him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יַרְכִּבֵ֙הוּ֙ עַל־[בָּ֣מֳתֵי] (במותי) אָ֔רֶץ וַיֹּאכַ֖ל תְּנוּבֹ֣ת שָׂדָ֑י וַיֵּנִקֵ֤הֽוּ דְבַשׁ֙ מִסֶּ֔לַע וְשֶׁ֖מֶן מֵחַלְמִ֥ישׁ צֽוּר׃
verses.translit: yrkhbhv 'l[bmty] (bmvty) 'rts vy'khl tnvbt shdy vynqhv dbsh msl' vshmn mchlmysh tsvr
verses.translation: He made him ride on the high places of the earth, And he did eat the fruitage of the field; And He made him to suck honey out of the crag, And oil out of the flinty rock;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: חֶמְאַ֨ת בָּקָ֜ר וַחֲלֵ֣ב צֹ֗אן עִם־חֵ֨לֶב כָּרִ֜ים וְאֵילִ֤ים בְּנֵֽי־בָשָׁן֙ וְעַתּוּדִ֔ים עִם־חֵ֖לֶב כִּלְי֣וֹת חִטָּ֑ה וְדַם־עֵנָ֖ב תִּשְׁתֶּה־חָֽמֶר׃
verses.translit: chm't bqr vchlb ts'n 'mchlb khrym v'ylym bnybshn v'tvdym 'mchlb khlyvt chth vdm'nb tshthchmr
verses.translation: Curd of kine, and milk of sheep, With fat of lambs, And rams of the breed of Bashan, and he-goats, With the kidney-fat of wheat; And of the blood of the grape thou drankest foaming wine.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁמַ֤ן יְשֻׁרוּן֙ וַיִּבְעָ֔ט שָׁמַ֖נְתָּ עָבִ֣יתָ כָּשִׂ֑יתָ וַיִּטֹּשׁ֙ אֱל֣וֹהַּ עָשָׂ֔הוּ וַיְנַבֵּ֖ל צ֥וּר יְשֻׁעָתֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vyshmn yshrvn vyb't shmnt 'byt khshyt vytsh 'lvh 'shhv vynbl tsvr ysh'tv
verses.translation: But Jeshurun waxed fat, and kicked— Thou didst wax fat, thou didst grow thick, thou didst become gross— And he forsook God who made him, And contemned the Rock of his salvation.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יַקְנִאֻ֖הוּ בְּזָרִ֑ים בְּתוֹעֵבֹ֖ת יַכְעִיסֻֽהוּ׃
verses.translit: yqn'hv bzrym btv'bt ykh'yshv
verses.translation: They roused Him to jealousy with strange gods, With abominations did they provoke Him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יִזְבְּח֗וּ לַשֵּׁדִים֙ לֹ֣א אֱלֹ֔הַּ אֱלֹהִ֖ים לֹ֣א יְדָע֑וּם חֲדָשִׁים֙ מִקָּרֹ֣ב בָּ֔אוּ לֹ֥א שְׂעָר֖וּם אֲבֹתֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: yzbchv lshdym l' 'lh 'lhym l' yd'vm chdshym mqrb b'v l' sh'rvm 'btykhm
verses.translation: They sacrificed unto demons, no-gods, Gods that they knew not, New gods that came up of late, Which your fathers dreaded not.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: צ֥וּר יְלָדְךָ֖ תֶּ֑שִׁי וַתִּשְׁכַּ֖ח אֵ֥ל מְחֹלְלֶֽךָ׃
verses.translit: tsvr yldkh tshy vtshkhch 'l mchllkh
verses.translation: Of the Rock that begot thee thou wast unmindful, And didst forget God that bore thee. .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֥רְא יְהֹוָ֖ה וַיִּנְאָ֑ץ מִכַּ֥עַס בָּנָ֖יו וּבְנֹתָֽיו׃
verses.translit: vyr' yhvh vyn'ts mkh's bnyv vbntyv
verses.translation: And the LORD saw, and spurned, Because of the provoking of His sons and His daughters.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֗אמֶר אַסְתִּ֤ירָה פָנַי֙ מֵהֶ֔ם אֶרְאֶ֖ה מָ֣ה אַחֲרִיתָ֑ם כִּ֣י ד֤וֹר תַּהְפֻּכֹת֙ הֵ֔מָּה בָּנִ֖ים לֹא־אֵמֻ֥ן בָּֽם׃
verses.translit: vy'mr 'styrh pny mhm 'r'h mh 'chrytm khy dvr thpkht hmh bnym l''mn bm
verses.translation: And He said: ‘I will hide My face from them, I will see what their end shall be; For they are a very froward generation, Children in whom is no faithfulness.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֵ֚ם קִנְא֣וּנִי בְלֹא־אֵ֔ל כִּעֲס֖וּנִי בְּהַבְלֵיהֶ֑ם וַֽאֲנִי֙ אַקְנִיאֵ֣ם בְּלֹא־עָ֔ם בְּג֥וֹי נָבָ֖ל אַכְעִיסֵֽם׃
verses.translit: hm qn'vny bl''l kh'svny bhblyhm v'ny 'qny'm bl''m bgvy nbl 'kh'ysm
verses.translation: They have roused Me to jealousy with a no-god; They have provoked Me with their vanities; And I will rouse them to jealousy with a no-people; I will provoke them with a vile nation.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּי־אֵשׁ֙ קָדְחָ֣ה בְאַפִּ֔י וַתִּיקַ֖ד עַד־שְׁא֣וֹל תַּחְתִּ֑ית וַתֹּ֤אכַל אֶ֙רֶץ֙ וִֽיבֻלָ֔הּ וַתְּלַהֵ֖ט מוֹסְדֵ֥י הָרִֽים׃
verses.translit: khy'sh qdchh b'py vtyqd 'dsh'vl tchtyt vt'khl 'rts vyblh vtlht mvsdy hrym
verses.translation: For a fire is kindled in My nostril, And burneth unto the depths of the nether-world, And devoureth the earth with her produce, And setteth ablaze the foundations of the mountains.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַסְפֶּ֥ה עָלֵ֖ימוֹ רָע֑וֹת חִצַּ֖י אֲכַלֶּה־בָּֽם׃
verses.translit: 'sph 'lymv r'vt chtsy 'khlhbm
verses.translation: I will heap evils upon them; I will spend Mine arrows upon them;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מְזֵ֥י רָעָ֛ב וּלְחֻ֥מֵי רֶ֖שֶׁף וְקֶ֣טֶב מְרִירִ֑י וְשֶׁן־בְּהֵמֹת֙ אֲשַׁלַּח־בָּ֔ם עִם־חֲמַ֖ת זֹחֲלֵ֥י עָפָֽר׃
verses.translit: mzy r'b vlchmy rshf vqtb mryry vshnbhmt 'shlchbm 'mchmt zchly 'pr
verses.translation: The wasting of hunger, and the devouring of the fiery bolt, And bitter destruction; And the teeth of beasts will I send upon them, With the venom of crawling things of the dust.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִחוּץ֙ תְּשַׁכֶּל־חֶ֔רֶב וּמֵחֲדָרִ֖ים אֵימָ֑ה גַּם־בָּחוּר֙ גַּם־בְּתוּלָ֔ה יוֹנֵ֖ק עִם־אִ֥ישׁ שֵׂיבָֽה׃
verses.translit: mchvts tshkhlchrb vmchdrym 'ymh gmbchvr gmbtvlh yvnq 'm'ysh shybh
verses.translation: Without shall the sword bereave, And in the chambers terror; Slaying both young man and virgin, The suckling with the man of gray hairs.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אָמַ֖רְתִּי אַפְאֵיהֶ֑ם אַשְׁבִּ֥יתָה מֵאֱנ֖וֹשׁ זִכְרָֽם׃
verses.translit: 'mrty 'p'yhm 'shbyth m'nvsh zkhrm
verses.translation: I thought I would make an end of them, I would make their memory cease from among men;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לוּלֵ֗י כַּ֤עַס אוֹיֵב֙ אָג֔וּר פֶּֽן־יְנַכְּר֖וּ צָרֵ֑ימוֹ פֶּן־יֹֽאמְרוּ֙ יָדֵ֣נוּ רָ֔מָה וְלֹ֥א יְהֹוָ֖ה פָּעַ֥ל כׇּל־זֹֽאת׃
verses.translit: lvly kh's 'vyb 'gvr pnynkhrv tsrymv pny'mrv ydnv rmh vl' yhvh p'l khlz't
verses.translation: Were it not that I dreaded the enemy’s provocation, Lest their adversaries should misdeem, Lest they should say: Our hand is exalted, And not the LORD hath wrought all this.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּי־ג֛וֹי אֹבַ֥ד עֵצ֖וֹת הֵ֑מָּה וְאֵ֥ין בָּהֶ֖ם תְּבוּנָֽה׃
verses.translit: khygvy 'bd 'tsvt hmh v'yn bhm tbvnh
verses.translation: For they are a nation void of counsel, And there is no understanding in them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ל֥וּ חָכְמ֖וּ יַשְׂכִּ֣ילוּ זֹ֑את יָבִ֖ינוּ לְאַחֲרִיתָֽם׃
verses.translit: lv chkhmv yshkhylv z't ybynv l'chrytm
verses.translation: If they were wise, they would understand this, They would discern their latter end.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֵיכָ֞ה יִרְדֹּ֤ף אֶחָד֙ אֶ֔לֶף וּשְׁנַ֖יִם יָנִ֣יסוּ רְבָבָ֑ה אִם־לֹא֙ כִּֽי־צוּרָ֣ם מְכָרָ֔ם וַֽיהֹוָ֖ה הִסְגִּירָֽם׃
verses.translit: 'ykhh yrdf 'chd 'lf vshnym ynysv rbbh 'ml' khytsvrm mkhrm vyhvh hsgyrm
verses.translation: How should one chase a thousand, And two put ten thousand to flight, Except their Rock had given them over And the LORD had delivered them up?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֛י לֹ֥א כְצוּרֵ֖נוּ צוּרָ֑ם וְאֹיְבֵ֖ינוּ פְּלִילִֽים׃
verses.translit: khy l' khtsvrnv tsvrm v'ybynv plylym
verses.translation: For their rock is not as our Rock, Even our enemies themselves being judges.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־מִגֶּ֤פֶן סְדֹם֙ גַּפְנָ֔ם וּמִשַּׁדְמֹ֖ת עֲמֹרָ֑ה עֲנָבֵ֙מוֹ֙ עִנְּבֵי־ר֔וֹשׁ אַשְׁכְּלֹ֥ת מְרֹרֹ֖ת לָֽמוֹ׃
verses.translit: khymgpn sdm gpnm vmshdmt 'mrh 'nbmv 'nbyrvsh 'shkhlt mrrt lmv
verses.translation: For their vine is of the vine of Sodom, And of the fields of Gomorrah; Their grapes are grapes of gall, Their clusters are bitter;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: חֲמַ֥ת תַּנִּינִ֖ם יֵינָ֑ם וְרֹ֥אשׁ פְּתָנִ֖ים אַכְזָֽר׃
verses.translit: chmt tnynm yynm vr'sh ptnym 'khzr
verses.translation: Their wine is the venom of serpents, And the cruel poison of asps.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֲלֹא־ה֖וּא כָּמֻ֣ס עִמָּדִ֑י חָת֖וּם בְּאוֹצְרֹתָֽי׃
