verses.translit: hl'hv' khms 'mdy chtvm b'vtsrty
verses.translation: ’Is not this laid up in store with Me, Sealed up in My treasuries?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לִ֤י נָקָם֙ וְשִׁלֵּ֔ם לְעֵ֖ת תָּמ֣וּט רַגְלָ֑ם כִּ֤י קָרוֹב֙ י֣וֹם אֵידָ֔ם וְחָ֖שׁ עֲתִדֹ֥ת לָֽמוֹ׃
verses.translit: ly nqm vshlm l't tmvt rglm khy qrvb yvm 'ydm vchsh 'tdt lmv
verses.translation: Vengeance is Mine, and recompense, Against the time when their foot shall slip; For the day of their calamity is at hand, And the things that are to come upon them shall make haste.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־יָדִ֤ין יְהֹוָה֙ עַמּ֔וֹ וְעַל־עֲבָדָ֖יו יִתְנֶחָ֑ם כִּ֤י יִרְאֶה֙ כִּֽי־אָ֣זְלַת יָ֔ד וְאֶ֖פֶס עָצ֥וּר וְעָזֽוּב׃
verses.translit: khyydyn yhvh 'mv v'l'bdyv ytnchm khy yr'h khy'zlt yd v'ps 'tsvr v'zvb
verses.translation: For the LORD will judge His people, And repent Himself for His servants; When He seeth that their stay is gone, And there is none remaining, shut up or left at large.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאָמַ֖ר אֵ֣י אֱלֹהֵ֑ימוֹ צ֖וּר חָסָ֥יוּ בֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: v'mr 'y 'lhymv tsvr chsyv bv
verses.translation: And it is said: Where are their gods, The rock in whom they trusted;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲשֶׁ֨ר חֵ֤לֶב זְבָחֵ֙ימוֹ֙ יֹאכֵ֔לוּ יִשְׁתּ֖וּ יֵ֣ין נְסִיכָ֑ם יָק֙וּמוּ֙ וְיַעְזְרֻכֶ֔ם יְהִ֥י עֲלֵיכֶ֖ם סִתְרָֽה׃
verses.translit: 'shr chlb zbchymv y'khlv yshtv yyn nsykhm yqvmv vy'zrkhm yhy 'lykhm strh
verses.translation: Who did eat the fat of their sacrifices, and drank the wine of their drink-offering? Let him rise up and help you, Let him be your protection.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: רְא֣וּ  עַתָּ֗ה כִּ֣י אֲנִ֤י אֲנִי֙ ה֔וּא וְאֵ֥ין אֱלֹהִ֖ים עִמָּדִ֑י אֲנִ֧י אָמִ֣ית וַאֲחַיֶּ֗ה מָחַ֙צְתִּי֙ וַאֲנִ֣י אֶרְפָּ֔א וְאֵ֥ין מִיָּדִ֖י מַצִּֽיל׃
verses.translit: r'v  'th khy 'ny 'ny hv' v'yn 'lhym 'mdy 'ny 'myt v'chyh mchtsty v'ny 'rp' v'yn mydy mtsyl
verses.translation: See now that I, even I, am He, And there is no god with Me; I kill, and I make alive; I have wounded, and I heal; And there is none that can deliver out of My hand.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־אֶשָּׂ֥א אֶל־שָׁמַ֖יִם יָדִ֑י וְאָמַ֕רְתִּי חַ֥י אָנֹכִ֖י לְעֹלָֽם׃
verses.translit: khy'sh' 'lshmym ydy v'mrty chy 'nkhy l'lm
verses.translation: For I lift up My hand to heaven, And say: As I live for ever,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִם־שַׁנּוֹתִי֙ בְּרַ֣ק חַרְבִּ֔י וְתֹאחֵ֥ז בְּמִשְׁפָּ֖ט יָדִ֑י אָשִׁ֤יב נָקָם֙ לְצָרָ֔י וְלִמְשַׂנְאַ֖י אֲשַׁלֵּֽם׃
verses.translit: 'mshnvty brq chrby vt'chz bmshpt ydy 'shyb nqm ltsry vlmshn'y 'shlm
verses.translation: If I whet My glittering sword, And My hand take hold on judgment; I will render vengeance to Mine adversaries, And will recompense them that hate Me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַשְׁכִּ֤יר חִצַּי֙ מִדָּ֔ם וְחַרְבִּ֖י תֹּאכַ֣ל בָּשָׂ֑ר מִדַּ֤ם חָלָל֙ וְשִׁבְיָ֔ה מֵרֹ֖אשׁ פַּרְע֥וֹת אוֹיֵֽב׃
verses.translit: 'shkhyr chtsy mdm vchrby t'khl bshr mdm chll vshbyh mr'sh pr'vt 'vyb
verses.translation: I will make Mine arrows drunk with blood, And My sword shall devour flesh; With the blood of the slain and the captives, From the long-haired heads of the enemy.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַרְנִ֤ינוּ גוֹיִם֙ עַמּ֔וֹ כִּ֥י דַם־עֲבָדָ֖יו יִקּ֑וֹם וְנָקָם֙ יָשִׁ֣יב לְצָרָ֔יו וְכִפֶּ֥ר אַדְמָת֖וֹ עַמּֽוֹ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: hrnynv gvym 'mv khy dm'bdyv yqvm vnqm yshyb ltsryv vkhpr 'dmtv 'mv {p}
verses.translation: Sing aloud, O ye nations, of His people; For He doth avenge the blood of His servants, And doth render vengeance to His adversaries, And doth make expiation for the land of His people.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּבֹ֣א מֹשֶׁ֗ה וַיְדַבֵּ֛ר אֶת־כׇּל־דִּבְרֵ֥י הַשִּׁירָֽה־הַזֹּ֖את בְּאׇזְנֵ֣י הָעָ֑ם ה֖וּא וְהוֹשֵׁ֥עַ בִּן־נֽוּן׃
verses.translit: vyb' mshh vydbr 'tkhldbry hshyrhhz't b'zny h'm hv' vhvsh' bnnvn
verses.translation: And Moses came and spoke all the words of this song in the ears of the people, he, and Hoshea the son of Nun.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְכַ֣ל מֹשֶׁ֗ה לְדַבֵּ֛ר אֶת־כׇּל־הַדְּבָרִ֥ים הָאֵ֖לֶּה אֶל־כׇּל־יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: vykhl mshh ldbr 'tkhlhdbrym h'lh 'lkhlyshr'l
verses.translation: And when Moses made an end of speaking all these words to all Israel,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֲלֵהֶם֙ שִׂ֣ימוּ לְבַבְכֶ֔ם לְכׇ֨ל־הַדְּבָרִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֧ר אָנֹכִ֛י מֵעִ֥יד בָּכֶ֖ם הַיּ֑וֹם אֲשֶׁ֤ר תְּצַוֻּם֙ אֶת־בְּנֵיכֶ֔ם לִשְׁמֹ֣ר לַעֲשׂ֔וֹת אֶת־כׇּל־דִּבְרֵ֖י הַתּוֹרָ֥ה הַזֹּֽאת׃
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lhm shymv lbbkhm lkhlhdbrym 'shr 'nkhy m'yd bkhm hyvm 'shr ttsvm 'tbnykhm lshmr l'shvt 'tkhldbry htvrh hz't
verses.translation: he said unto them: ‘Set your heart unto all the words wherewith I testify against you this day; that ye may charge your children therewith to observe to do all the words of this law.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֠י לֹא־דָבָ֨ר רֵ֥ק הוּא֙ מִכֶּ֔ם כִּי־ה֖וּא חַיֵּיכֶ֑ם וּבַדָּבָ֣ר הַזֶּ֗ה תַּאֲרִ֤יכוּ יָמִים֙ עַל־הָ֣אֲדָמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר אַתֶּ֜ם עֹבְרִ֧ים אֶת־הַיַּרְדֵּ֛ן שָׁ֖מָּה לְרִשְׁתָּֽהּ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: khy l'dbr rq hv' mkhm khyhv' chyykhm vbdbr hzh t'rykhv ymym 'lh'dmh 'shr 'tm 'brym 'thyrdn shmh lrshth {p}
verses.translation: For it is no vain thing for you; because it is your life, and through this thing ye shall prolong your days upon the land, whither ye go over the Jordan to possess it.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֤ר יְהֹוָה֙ אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֔ה בְּעֶ֛צֶם הַיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּ֖ה לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: vydbr yhvh 'lmshh b'tsm hyvm hzh l'mr
verses.translation: And the LORD spoke unto Moses that selfsame day, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עֲלֵ֡ה אֶל־הַר֩ הָעֲבָרִ֨ים הַזֶּ֜ה הַר־נְב֗וֹ אֲשֶׁר֙ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ מוֹאָ֔ב אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל־פְּנֵ֣י יְרֵח֑וֹ וּרְאֵה֙ אֶת־אֶ֣רֶץ כְּנַ֔עַן אֲשֶׁ֨ר אֲנִ֥י נֹתֵ֛ן לִבְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לַאֲחֻזָּֽה׃
verses.translit: 'lh 'lhr h'brym hzh hrnbv 'shr b'rts mv'b 'shr 'lpny yrchv vr'h 't'rts khn'n 'shr 'ny ntn lbny yshr'l l'chzh
verses.translation: ’Get thee up into this mountain of Abarim, unto mount Nebo, which is in the land of Moab, that is over against Jericho; and behold the land of Canaan, which I give unto the children of Israel for a possession;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמֻ֗ת בָּהָר֙ אֲשֶׁ֤ר אַתָּה֙ עֹלֶ֣ה שָׁ֔מָּה וְהֵאָסֵ֖ף אֶל־עַמֶּ֑יךָ כַּֽאֲשֶׁר־מֵ֞ת אַהֲרֹ֤ן אָחִ֙יךָ֙ בְּהֹ֣ר הָהָ֔ר וַיֵּאָ֖סֶף אֶל־עַמָּֽיו׃
verses.translit: vmt bhr 'shr 'th 'lh shmh vh'sf 'l'mykh kh'shrmt 'hrn 'chykh bhr hhr vy'sf 'l'myv
verses.translation: and die in the mount whither thou goest up, and be gathered unto thy people; as Aaron thy brother died in mount Hor, and was gathered unto his people.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַל֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר מְעַלְתֶּ֜ם בִּ֗י בְּתוֹךְ֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל בְּמֵֽי־מְרִיבַ֥ת קָדֵ֖שׁ מִדְבַּר־צִ֑ן עַ֣ל אֲשֶׁ֤ר לֹֽא־קִדַּשְׁתֶּם֙ אוֹתִ֔י בְּת֖וֹךְ בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: 'l 'shr m'ltm by btvkh bny yshr'l bmymrybt qdsh mdbrtsn 'l 'shr l'qdshtm 'vty btvkh bny yshr'l
verses.translation: Because ye trespassed against Me in the midst of the children of Israel at the waters of Meribath-kadesh, in the wilderness of Zin; because ye sanctified Me not in the midst of the children of Israel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֥י מִנֶּ֖גֶד תִּרְאֶ֣ה אֶת־הָאָ֑רֶץ וְשָׁ֙מָּה֙ לֹ֣א תָב֔וֹא אֶל־הָאָ֕רֶץ אֲשֶׁר־אֲנִ֥י נֹתֵ֖ן לִבְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ {פ}
verses.translit: khy mngd tr'h 'th'rts vshmh l' tbv' 'lh'rts 'shr'ny ntn lbny yshr'l {p}
verses.translation: For thou shalt see the land afar off; but thou shalt not go thither into the land which I give the children of Israel.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְזֹ֣את הַבְּרָכָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר בֵּרַ֥ךְ מֹשֶׁ֛ה אִ֥ישׁ הָאֱלֹהִ֖ים אֶת־בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל לִפְנֵ֖י מוֹתֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vz't hbrkhh 'shr brkh mshh 'ysh h'lhym 'tbny yshr'l lpny mvtv
verses.translation: And this is the blessing wherewith Moses the man of God blessed the children of Israel before his death.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּאמַ֗ר יְהֹוָ֞ה מִסִּינַ֥י בָּא֙ וְזָרַ֤ח מִשֵּׂעִיר֙ לָ֔מוֹ הוֹפִ֙יעַ֙ מֵהַ֣ר פָּארָ֔ן וְאָתָ֖ה מֵרִבְבֹ֣ת קֹ֑דֶשׁ מִימִינ֕וֹ (אשדת) [אֵ֥שׁ דָּ֖ת] לָֽמוֹ׃
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh msyny b' vzrch msh'yr lmv hvpy' mhr p'rn v'th mrbbt qdsh mymynv ('shdt) ['sh dt] lmv
verses.translation: And he said: The LORD came from Sinai, And rose from Seir unto them; He shined forth from mount Paran, And He came from the myriads holy, At His right hand was a fiery law unto them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַ֚ף חֹבֵ֣ב עַמִּ֔ים כׇּל־קְדֹשָׁ֖יו בְּיָדֶ֑ךָ וְהֵם֙ תֻּכּ֣וּ לְרַגְלֶ֔ךָ יִשָּׂ֖א מִדַּבְּרֹתֶֽיךָ׃
verses.translit: 'f chbb 'mym khlqdshyv bydkh vhm tkhv lrglkh ysh' mdbrtykh
verses.translation: Yea, He loveth the peoples, All His holy ones—they are in Thy hand; And they sit down at Thy feet, Receiving of Thy words.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תּוֹרָ֥ה צִוָּה־לָ֖נוּ מֹשֶׁ֑ה מוֹרָשָׁ֖ה קְהִלַּ֥ת יַעֲקֹֽב׃
verses.translit: tvrh tsvhlnv mshh mvrshh qhlt y'qb
verses.translation: Moses commanded us a law, An inheritance of the congregation of Jacob.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֥י בִישֻׁר֖וּן מֶ֑לֶךְ בְּהִתְאַסֵּף֙ רָ֣אשֵׁי עָ֔ם יַ֖חַד שִׁבְטֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: vyhy byshrvn mlkh bht'sf r'shy 'm ychd shbty yshr'l
verses.translation: And there was a king in Jeshurun, When the heads of the people were gathered, All the tribes of Israel together.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְחִ֥י רְאוּבֵ֖ן וְאַל־יָמֹ֑ת וִיהִ֥י מְתָ֖יו מִסְפָּֽר׃ {ס}
verses.translit: ychy r'vbn v'lymt vyhy mtyv mspr {s}
verses.translation: Let Reuben live, and not die In that his men become few.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְזֹ֣את לִיהוּדָה֮ וַיֹּאמַר֒ שְׁמַ֤ע יְהֹוָה֙ ק֣וֹל יְהוּדָ֔ה וְאֶל־עַמּ֖וֹ תְּבִיאֶ֑נּוּ יָדָיו֙ רָ֣ב ל֔וֹ וְעֵ֥זֶר מִצָּרָ֖יו תִּהְיֶֽה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vz't lyhvdh vy'mr shm' yhvh qvl yhvdh v'l'mv tby'nv ydyv rb lv v'zr mtsryv thyh {p}
verses.translation: And this for Judah, and he said: Hear, LORD, the voice of Judah, And bring him in unto his people; His hands shall contend for him, And Thou shalt be a help against his adversaries.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּלְלֵוִ֣י אָמַ֔ר תֻּמֶּ֥יךָ וְאוּרֶ֖יךָ לְאִ֣ישׁ חֲסִידֶ֑ךָ אֲשֶׁ֤ר נִסִּיתוֹ֙ בְּמַסָּ֔ה תְּרִיבֵ֖הוּ עַל־מֵ֥י מְרִיבָֽה׃
verses.translit: vllvy 'mr tmykh v'vrykh l'ysh chsydkh 'shr nsytv bmsh trybhv 'lmy mrybh
verses.translation: And of Levi he said: Thy Thummim and Thy Urim be with Thy holy one, Whom Thou didst prove at Massah, With whom Thou didst strive at the waters of Meribah;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הָאֹמֵ֞ר לְאָבִ֤יו וּלְאִמּוֹ֙ לֹ֣א רְאִיתִ֔יו וְאֶת־אֶחָיו֙ לֹ֣א הִכִּ֔יר וְאֶת־בָּנָ֖ו לֹ֣א יָדָ֑ע כִּ֤י שָֽׁמְרוּ֙ אִמְרָתֶ֔ךָ וּבְרִיתְךָ֖ יִנְצֹֽרוּ׃
verses.translit: h'mr l'byv vl'mv l' r'ytyv v't'chyv l' hkhyr v'tbnv l' yd' khy shmrv 'mrtkh vbrytkh yntsrv
verses.translation: Who said of his father, and of his mother: ‘I have not seen him’; Neither did he acknowledge his brethren, Nor knew he his own children; For they have observed Thy word, And keep Thy covenant.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יוֹר֤וּ מִשְׁפָּטֶ֙יךָ֙ לְיַֽעֲקֹ֔ב וְתוֹרָתְךָ֖ לְיִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל יָשִׂ֤ימוּ קְטוֹרָה֙ בְּאַפֶּ֔ךָ וְכָלִ֖יל עַֽל־מִזְבְּחֶֽךָ׃
verses.translit: yvrv mshptykh ly'qb vtvrtkh lyshr'l yshymv qtvrh b'pkh vkhlyl 'lmzbchkh
verses.translation: They shall teach Jacob Thine ordinances, And Israel Thy law; They shall put incense before Thee, And whole burnt-offering upon Thine altar. .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בָּרֵ֤ךְ יְהֹוָה֙ חֵיל֔וֹ וּפֹ֥עַל יָדָ֖יו תִּרְצֶ֑ה מְחַ֨ץ מׇתְנַ֧יִם קָמָ֛יו וּמְשַׂנְאָ֖יו מִן־יְקוּמֽוּן׃ {ס}
verses.translit: brkh yhvh chylv vp'l ydyv trtsh mchts mtnym qmyv vmshn'yv mnyqvmvn {s}
verses.translation: Bless, LORD, his substance, And accept the work of his hands; Smite through the loins of them that rise up against him, And of them that hate him, that they rise not again.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְבִנְיָמִ֣ן אָמַ֔ר יְדִ֣יד יְהֹוָ֔ה יִשְׁכֹּ֥ן לָבֶ֖טַח עָלָ֑יו חֹפֵ֤ף עָלָיו֙ כׇּל־הַיּ֔וֹם וּבֵ֥ין כְּתֵפָ֖יו שָׁכֵֽן׃ {ס}
verses.translit: lbnymn 'mr ydyd yhvh yshkhn lbtch 'lyv chpf 'lyv khlhyvm vbyn khtpyv shkhn {s}
verses.translation: Of Benjamin he said: The beloved of the LORD shall dwell in safety by Him; He covereth him all the day, And He dwelleth between his shoulders.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּלְיוֹסֵ֣ף אָמַ֔ר מְבֹרֶ֥כֶת יְהֹוָ֖ה אַרְצ֑וֹ מִמֶּ֤גֶד שָׁמַ֙יִם֙ מִטָּ֔ל וּמִתְּה֖וֹם רֹבֶ֥צֶת תָּֽחַת׃
verses.translit: vlyvsf 'mr mbrkht yhvh 'rtsv mmgd shmym mtl vmthvm rbtst tcht
verses.translation: And of Joseph he said: Blessed of the LORD be his land; For the precious things of heaven, for the dew, And for the deep that coucheth beneath,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמִמֶּ֖גֶד תְּבוּאֹ֣ת שָׁ֑מֶשׁ וּמִמֶּ֖גֶד גֶּ֥רֶשׁ יְרָחִֽים׃
verses.translit: vmmgd tbv't shmsh vmmgd grsh yrchym
verses.translation: And for the precious things of the fruits of the sun, And for the precious things of the yield of the moons,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמֵרֹ֖אשׁ הַרְרֵי־קֶ֑דֶם וּמִמֶּ֖גֶד גִּבְע֥וֹת עוֹלָֽם׃
verses.translit: vmr'sh hrryqdm vmmgd gb'vt 'vlm
verses.translation: And for the tops of the ancient mountains, And for the precious things of the everlasting hills,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמִמֶּ֗גֶד אֶ֚רֶץ וּמְלֹאָ֔הּ וּרְצ֥וֹן שֹׁכְנִ֖י סְנֶ֑ה תָּב֙וֹאתָה֙ לְרֹ֣אשׁ יוֹסֵ֔ף וּלְקׇדְקֹ֖ד נְזִ֥יר אֶחָֽיו׃
verses.translit: vmmgd 'rts vml'h vrtsvn shkhny snh tbv'th lr'sh yvsf vlqdqd nzyr 'chyv
verses.translation: And for the precious things of the earth and the fulness thereof, And the good will of Him that dwelt in the bush; Let the blessing come upon the head of Joseph, And upon the crown of the head of him that is prince among his brethren.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּכ֨וֹר שׁוֹר֜וֹ הָדָ֣ר ל֗וֹ וְקַרְנֵ֤י רְאֵם֙ קַרְנָ֔יו בָּהֶ֗ם עַמִּ֛ים יְנַגַּ֥ח יַחְדָּ֖ו אַפְסֵי־אָ֑רֶץ וְהֵם֙ רִבְב֣וֹת אֶפְרַ֔יִם וְהֵ֖ם אַלְפֵ֥י מְנַשֶּֽׁה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: bkhvr shvrv hdr lv vqrny r'm qrnyv bhm 'mym yngch ychdv 'psy'rts vhm rbbvt 'prym vhm 'lpy mnshh {s}
verses.translation: His firstling bullock, majesty is his; And his horns are the horns of the wild-ox; With them he shall gore the peoples all of them, even the ends of the earth; And they are the ten thousands of Ephraim, And they are the thousands of Manasseh.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלִזְבוּלֻ֣ן אָמַ֔ר שְׂמַ֥ח זְבוּלֻ֖ן בְּצֵאתֶ֑ךָ וְיִשָּׂשכָ֖ר בְּאֹהָלֶֽיךָ׃
verses.translit: vlzbvln 'mr shmch zbvln bts'tkh vyshshkhr b'hlykh
verses.translation: And of Zebulun he said: Rejoice, Zebulun, in thy going out, And, Issachar, in thy tents.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַמִּים֙ הַר־יִקְרָ֔אוּ שָׁ֖ם יִזְבְּח֣וּ זִבְחֵי־צֶ֑דֶק כִּ֣י שֶׁ֤פַע יַמִּים֙ יִינָ֔קוּ וּשְׂפֻנֵ֖י טְמ֥וּנֵי חֽוֹל׃ {ס}
verses.translit: 'mym hryqr'v shm yzbchv zbchytsdq khy shp' ymym yynqv vshpny tmvny chvl {s}
verses.translation: They shall call peoples unto the mountain; There shall they offer sacrifices of righteousness; For they shall suck the abundance of the seas, And the hidden treasures of the sand.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּלְגָ֣ד אָמַ֔ר בָּר֖וּךְ מַרְחִ֣יב גָּ֑ד כְּלָבִ֣יא שָׁכֵ֔ן וְטָרַ֥ף זְר֖וֹעַ אַף־קׇדְקֹֽד׃
verses.translit: vlgd 'mr brvkh mrchyb gd khlby' shkhn vtrf zrv' 'fqdqd
verses.translation: And of Gad he said: Blessed be He that enlargeth Gad; He dwelleth as a lioness, And teareth the arm, yea, the crown of the head.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֤רְא רֵאשִׁית֙ ל֔וֹ כִּי־שָׁ֛ם חֶלְקַ֥ת מְחֹקֵ֖ק סָפ֑וּן וַיֵּתֵא֙ רָ֣אשֵׁי עָ֔ם צִדְקַ֤ת יְהֹוָה֙ עָשָׂ֔ה וּמִשְׁפָּטָ֖יו עִם־יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vyr' r'shyt lv khyshm chlqt mchqq spvn vyt' r'shy 'm tsdqt yhvh 'shh vmshptyv 'myshr'l {s}
verses.translation: And he chose a first part for himself, For there a portion of a ruler was reserved; And there came the heads of the people, He executed the righteousness of the LORD, And His ordinances with Israel. .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּלְדָ֣ן אָמַ֔ר דָּ֖ן גּ֣וּר אַרְיֵ֑ה יְזַנֵּ֖ק מִן־הַבָּשָֽׁן׃
verses.translit: vldn 'mr dn gvr 'ryh yznq mnhbshn
verses.translation: And of Dan he said: Dan is a lion’s whelp, That leapeth forth from Bashan.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּלְנַפְתָּלִ֣י אָמַ֔ר נַפְתָּלִי֙ שְׂבַ֣ע רָצ֔וֹן וּמָלֵ֖א בִּרְכַּ֣ת יְהֹוָ֑ה יָ֥ם וְדָר֖וֹם יְרָֽשָׁה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vlnptly 'mr nptly shb' rtsvn vml' brkht yhvh ym vdrvm yrshh {s}
verses.translation: And of Naphtali he said: O Naphtali, satisfied with favour, And full with the blessing of the LORD: Possess thou the sea and the south.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּלְאָשֵׁ֣ר אָמַ֔ר בָּר֥וּךְ מִבָּנִ֖ים אָשֵׁ֑ר יְהִ֤י רְצוּי֙ אֶחָ֔יו וְטֹבֵ֥ל בַּשֶּׁ֖מֶן רַגְלֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vl'shr 'mr brvkh mbnym 'shr yhy rtsvy 'chyv vtbl bshmn rglv
verses.translation: And of Asher he said: Blessed be Asher above sons; Let him be the favoured of his brethren, And let him dip his foot in oil.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בַּרְזֶ֥ל וּנְחֹ֖שֶׁת מִנְעָלֶ֑ךָ וּכְיָמֶ֖יךָ דׇּבְאֶֽךָ׃
verses.translit: brzl vnchsht mn'lkh vkhymykh db'kh
verses.translation: Iron and brass shall be thy bars; And as thy days, so shall thy strength be.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֵ֥ין כָּאֵ֖ל יְשֻׁר֑וּן רֹכֵ֤ב שָׁמַ֙יִם֙ בְּעֶזְרֶ֔ךָ וּבְגַאֲוָת֖וֹ שְׁחָקִֽים׃
verses.translit: 'yn kh'l yshrvn rkhb shmym b'zrkh vbg'vtv shchqym
verses.translation: There is none like unto God, O Jeshurun, Who rideth upon the heaven as thy help, And in His excellency on the skies.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מְעֹנָהֿ֙ אֱלֹ֣הֵי קֶ֔דֶם וּמִתַּ֖חַת זְרֹעֹ֣ת עוֹלָ֑ם וַיְגָ֧רֶשׁ מִפָּנֶ֛יךָ אוֹיֵ֖ב וַיֹּ֥אמֶר הַשְׁמֵֽד׃
verses.translit: m'nh 'lhy qdm vmtcht zr't 'vlm vygrsh mpnykh 'vyb vy'mr hshmd
verses.translation: The eternal God is a dwelling-place, And underneath are the everlasting arms; And He thrust out the enemy from before thee, And said: ‘Destroy.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁכֹּן֩ יִשְׂרָאֵ֨ל בֶּ֤טַח בָּדָד֙ עֵ֣ין יַֽעֲקֹ֔ב אֶל־אֶ֖רֶץ דָּגָ֣ן וְתִיר֑וֹשׁ אַף־שָׁמָ֖יו יַ֥עַרְפוּ טָֽל׃
verses.translit: vyshkhn yshr'l btch bdd 'yn y'qb 'l'rts dgn vtyrvsh 'fshmyv y'rpv tl
verses.translation: And Israel dwelleth in safety, The fountain of Jacob alone, In a land of corn and wine; Yea, his heavens drop down dew.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַשְׁרֶ֨יךָ יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל מִ֣י כָמ֗וֹךָ עַ֚ם נוֹשַׁ֣ע בַּֽיהֹוָ֔ה מָגֵ֣ן עֶזְרֶ֔ךָ וַאֲשֶׁר־חֶ֖רֶב גַּאֲוָתֶ֑ךָ וְיִכָּחֲשׁ֤וּ אֹיְבֶ֙יךָ֙ לָ֔ךְ וְאַתָּ֖ה עַל־בָּמוֹתֵ֥ימוֹ תִדְרֹֽךְ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: 'shrykh yshr'l my khmvkh 'm nvsh' byhvh mgn 'zrkh v'shrchrb g'vtkh vykhchshv 'ybykh lkh v'th 'lbmvtymv tdrkh {s}
verses.translation: Happy art thou, O Israel, who is like unto thee? A people saved by the LORD, The shield of thy help, And that is the sword of thy excellency! And thine enemies shall dwindle away before thee; And thou shalt tread upon their high places.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֨עַל מֹשֶׁ֜ה מֵעַרְבֹ֤ת מוֹאָב֙ אֶל־הַ֣ר נְב֔וֹ רֹ֚אשׁ הַפִּסְגָּ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל־פְּנֵ֣י יְרֵח֑וֹ וַיַּרְאֵ֨הוּ יְהֹוָ֧ה אֶת־כׇּל־הָאָ֛רֶץ אֶת־הַגִּלְעָ֖ד עַד־דָּֽן׃
verses.translit: vy'l mshh m'rbt mv'b 'lhr nbv r'sh hpsgh 'shr 'lpny yrchv vyr'hv yhvh 'tkhlh'rts 'thgl'd 'ddn
verses.translation: And Moses went up from the plains of Moab unto mount Nebo, to the top of Pisgah, that is over against Jericho. And the LORD showed him all the land, even Gilead as far as Dan;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֵת֙ כׇּל־נַפְתָּלִ֔י וְאֶת־אֶ֥רֶץ אֶפְרַ֖יִם וּמְנַשֶּׁ֑ה וְאֵת֙ כׇּל־אֶ֣רֶץ יְהוּדָ֔ה עַ֖ד הַיָּ֥ם הָאַחֲרֽוֹן׃
verses.translit: v't khlnptly v't'rts 'prym vmnshh v't khl'rts yhvdh 'd hym h'chrvn
verses.translation: and all Naphtali, and the land of Ephraim and Manasseh, and all the land of Judah as far as the hinder sea;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֶת־הַנֶּ֗גֶב וְֽאֶת־הַכִּכָּ֞ר בִּקְעַ֧ת יְרֵח֛וֹ עִ֥יר הַתְּמָרִ֖ים עַד־צֹֽעַר׃
verses.translit: v'thngb v'thkhkhr bq't yrchv 'yr htmrym 'dts'r
verses.translation: and the South, and the Plain, even the valley of Jericho the city of palm-trees, as far as Zoar.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהֹוָ֜ה אֵלָ֗יו זֹ֤את הָאָ֙רֶץ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר נִ֠שְׁבַּ֠עְתִּי לְאַבְרָהָ֨ם לְיִצְחָ֤ק וּֽלְיַעֲקֹב֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר לְזַרְעֲךָ֖ אֶתְּנֶ֑נָּה הֶרְאִיתִ֣יךָ בְעֵינֶ֔יךָ וְשָׁ֖מָּה לֹ֥א תַעֲבֹֽר׃
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'lyv z't h'rts 'shr nshb'ty l'brhm lytschq vly'qb l'mr lzr'kh 'tnnh hr'ytykh b'ynykh vshmh l' t'br
verses.translation: And the LORD said unto him: ‘This is the land which I swore unto Abraham, unto Isaac, and unto Jacob, saying: I will give it unto thy seed; I have caused thee to see it with thine eyes, but thou shalt not go over thither.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּ֨מׇת שָׁ֜ם מֹשֶׁ֧ה עֶבֶד־יְהֹוָ֛ה בְּאֶ֥רֶץ מוֹאָ֖ב עַל־פִּ֥י יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: vymt shm mshh 'bdyhvh b'rts mv'b 'lpy yhvh
verses.translation: So Moses the servant of the LORD died there in the land of Moab, according to the word of the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּקְבֹּ֨ר אֹת֤וֹ בַגַּי֙ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ מוֹאָ֔ב מ֖וּל בֵּ֣ית פְּע֑וֹר וְלֹא־יָדַ֥ע אִישׁ֙ אֶת־קְבֻ֣רָת֔וֹ עַ֖ד הַיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃
verses.translit: vyqbr 'tv bgy b'rts mv'b mvl byt p'vr vl'yd' 'ysh 'tqbrtv 'd hyvm hzh
verses.translation: And he was buried in the valley in the land of Moab over against Beth-peor; and no man knoweth of his sepulchre unto this day.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמֹשֶׁ֗ה בֶּן־מֵאָ֧ה וְעֶשְׂרִ֛ים שָׁנָ֖ה בְּמֹת֑וֹ לֹא־כָהֲתָ֥ה עֵינ֖וֹ וְלֹא־נָ֥ס לֵחֹֽה׃
verses.translit: vmshh bnm'h v'shrym shnh bmtv l'khhth 'ynv vl'ns lchh
verses.translation: And Moses was a hundred and twenty years old when he died: his eye was not dim, nor his natural force abated.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּבְכּוּ֩ בְנֵ֨י יִשְׂרָאֵ֧ל אֶת־מֹשֶׁ֛ה בְּעַֽרְבֹ֥ת מוֹאָ֖ב שְׁלֹשִׁ֣ים י֑וֹם וַֽיִּתְּמ֔וּ יְמֵ֥י בְכִ֖י אֵ֥בֶל מֹשֶֽׁה׃
verses.translit: vybkhv bny yshr'l 'tmshh b'rbt mv'b shlshym yvm vytmv ymy bkhy 'bl mshh
verses.translation: And the children of Israel wept for Moses in the plains of Moab thirty days; so the days of weeping in the mourning for Moses were ended.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וִיהוֹשֻׁ֣עַ בִּן־נ֗וּן מָלֵא֙ ר֣וּחַ חׇכְמָ֔ה כִּֽי־סָמַ֥ךְ מֹשֶׁ֛ה אֶת־יָדָ֖יו עָלָ֑יו וַיִּשְׁמְע֨וּ אֵלָ֤יו בְּנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ וַֽיַּעֲשׂ֔וּ כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהֹוָ֖ה אֶת־מֹשֶֽׁה׃
verses.translit: vyhvsh' bnnvn ml' rvch chkhmh khysmkh mshh 'tydyv 'lyv vyshm'v 'lyv bnyyshr'l vy'shv kh'shr tsvh yhvh 'tmshh
verses.translation: And Joshua the son of Nun was full of the spirit of wisdom; for Moses had laid his hands upon him; and the children of Israel hearkened unto him, and did as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלֹא־קָ֨ם נָבִ֥יא ע֛וֹד בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל כְּמֹשֶׁ֑ה אֲשֶׁר֙ יְדָע֣וֹ יְהֹוָ֔ה פָּנִ֖ים אֶל־פָּנִֽים׃
verses.translit: vl'qm nby' 'vd byshr'l khmshh 'shr yd'v yhvh pnym 'lpnym
verses.translation: And there hath not arisen a prophet since in Israel like unto Moses, whom the LORD knew face to face;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְכׇל־הָ֨אֹתֹ֜ת וְהַמּוֹפְתִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֤ר שְׁלָחוֹ֙ יְהֹוָ֔ה לַעֲשׂ֖וֹת בְּאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם לְפַרְעֹ֥ה וּלְכׇל־עֲבָדָ֖יו וּלְכׇל־אַרְצֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: lkhlh'tt vhmvptym 'shr shlchv yhvh l'shvt b'rts mtsrym lpr'h vlkhl'bdyv vlkhl'rtsv
verses.translation: in all the signs and the wonders, which the LORD sent him to do in the land of Egypt, to Pharaoh, and to all his servants, and to all his land;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּלְכֹל֙ הַיָּ֣ד הַחֲזָקָ֔ה וּלְכֹ֖ל הַמּוֹרָ֣א הַגָּד֑וֹל אֲשֶׁר֙ עָשָׂ֣ה מֹשֶׁ֔ה לְעֵינֵ֖י כׇּל־יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: vlkhl hyd hchzqh vlkhl hmvr' hgdvl 'shr 'shh mshh l'yny khlyshr'l
verses.translation: and in all the mighty hand, and in all the great terror, which Moses wrought in the sight of all Israel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽיְהִ֗י אַחֲרֵ֛י מ֥וֹת מֹשֶׁ֖ה עֶ֣בֶד יְהֹוָ֑ה וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהֹוָה֙ אֶל־יְהוֹשֻׁ֣עַ בִּן־נ֔וּן מְשָׁרֵ֥ת מֹשֶׁ֖ה לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: vyhy 'chry mvt mshh 'bd yhvh vy'mr yhvh 'lyhvsh' bnnvn mshrt mshh l'mr
verses.translation: Now it came to pass after the death of Moses the servant of the LORD, that the LORD spoke unto Joshua the son of Nun, Moses’ minister, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מֹשֶׁ֥ה עַבְדִּ֖י מֵ֑ת וְעַתָּה֩ ק֨וּם עֲבֹ֜ר אֶת־הַיַּרְדֵּ֣ן הַזֶּ֗ה אַתָּה֙ וְכׇל־הָעָ֣ם הַזֶּ֔ה אֶל־הָאָ֕רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֧ר אָנֹכִ֛י נֹתֵ֥ן לָהֶ֖ם לִבְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: mshh 'bdy mt v'th qvm 'br 'thyrdn hzh 'th vkhlh'm hzh 'lh'rts 'shr 'nkhy ntn lhm lbny yshr'l
verses.translation: ’Moses My servant is dead; now therefore arise, go over this Jordan, thou, and all this people, unto the land which I do give to them, even to the children of Israel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כׇּל־מָק֗וֹם אֲשֶׁ֨ר תִּדְרֹ֧ךְ כַּֽף־רַגְלְכֶ֛ם בּ֖וֹ לָכֶ֣ם נְתַתִּ֑יו כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבַּ֖רְתִּי אֶל־מֹשֶֽׁה׃
verses.translit: khlmqvm 'shr tdrkh khfrglkhm bv lkhm nttyv kh'shr dbrty 'lmshh
verses.translation: Every place that the sole of your foot shall tread upon, to you have I given it, as I spoke unto Moses.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מֵהַמִּדְבָּר֩ וְהַלְּבָנ֨וֹן הַזֶּ֜ה וְֽעַד־הַנָּהָ֧ר הַגָּד֣וֹל נְהַר־פְּרָ֗ת כֹּ֚ל אֶ֣רֶץ הַֽחִתִּ֔ים וְעַד־הַיָּ֥ם הַגָּד֖וֹל מְב֣וֹא הַשָּׁ֑מֶשׁ יִֽהְיֶ֖ה גְּבוּלְכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: mhmdbr vhlbnvn hzh v'dhnhr hgdvl nhrprt khl 'rts hchtym v'dhym hgdvl mbv' hshmsh yhyh gbvlkhm
verses.translation: From the wilderness, and this Lebanon, even unto the great river, the river Euphrates, all the land of the Hittites, and unto the Great Sea toward the going down of the sun, shall be your border.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֹא־יִתְיַצֵּ֥ב אִישׁ֙ לְפָנֶ֔יךָ כֹּ֖ל יְמֵ֣י חַיֶּ֑יךָ כַּאֲשֶׁ֨ר הָיִ֤יתִי עִם־מֹשֶׁה֙ אֶהְיֶ֣ה עִמָּ֔ךְ לֹ֥א אַרְפְּךָ֖ וְלֹ֥א אֶעֶזְבֶֽךָּ׃
verses.translit: l'ytytsb 'ysh lpnykh khl ymy chyykh kh'shr hyyty 'mmshh 'hyh 'mkh l' 'rpkh vl' ''zbkh
verses.translation: There shall not any man be able to stand before thee all the days of thy life; as I was with Moses, so I will be with thee; I will not fail thee, nor forsake thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: חֲזַ֖ק וֶאֱמָ֑ץ כִּ֣י אַתָּ֗ה תַּנְחִיל֙ אֶת־הָעָ֣ם הַזֶּ֔ה אֶת־הָאָ֕רֶץ אֲשֶׁר־נִשְׁבַּ֥עְתִּי לַאֲבוֹתָ֖ם לָתֵ֥ת לָהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: chzq v'mts khy 'th tnchyl 'th'm hzh 'th'rts 'shrnshb'ty l'bvtm ltt lhm
verses.translation: Be strong and of good courage; for thou shalt cause this people to inherit the land which I swore unto their fathers to give them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: רַק֩ חֲזַ֨ק וֶאֱמַ֜ץ מְאֹ֗ד לִשְׁמֹ֤ר לַֽעֲשׂוֹת֙ כְּכׇל־הַתּוֹרָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֤ר צִוְּךָ֙ מֹשֶׁ֣ה עַבְדִּ֔י אַל־תָּס֥וּר מִמֶּ֖נּוּ יָמִ֣ין וּשְׂמֹ֑אול לְמַ֣עַן תַּשְׂכִּ֔יל בְּכֹ֖ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר תֵּלֵֽךְ׃
verses.translit: rq chzq v'mts m'd lshmr l'shvt khkhlhtvrh 'shr tsvkh mshh 'bdy 'ltsvr mmnv ymyn vshm'vl lm'n tshkhyl bkhl 'shr tlkh
verses.translation: Only be strong and very courageous, to observe to do according to all the law, which Moses My servant commanded thee; turn not from it to the right hand or to the left, that thou mayest have good success whithersoever thou goest.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֹֽא־יָמ֡וּשׁ סֵ֩פֶר֩ הַתּוֹרָ֨ה הַזֶּ֜ה מִפִּ֗יךָ וְהָגִ֤יתָ בּוֹ֙ יוֹמָ֣ם וָלַ֔יְלָה לְמַ֙עַן֙ תִּשְׁמֹ֣ר לַעֲשׂ֔וֹת כְּכׇל־הַכָּת֖וּב בּ֑וֹ כִּי־אָ֛ז תַּצְלִ֥יחַ אֶת־דְּרָכֶ֖ךָ וְאָ֥ז תַּשְׂכִּֽיל׃
verses.translit: l'ymvsh spr htvrh hzh mpykh vhgyt bv yvmm vlylh lm'n tshmr l'shvt khkhlhkhtvb bv khy'z ttslych 'tdrkhkh v'z tshkhyl
verses.translation: This book of the law shall not depart out of thy mouth, but thou shalt meditate therein day and night, that thou mayest observe to do according to all that is written therein; for then thou shalt make thy ways prosperous, and then thou shalt have good success.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֲל֤וֹא צִוִּיתִ֙יךָ֙ חֲזַ֣ק וֶאֱמָ֔ץ אַֽל־תַּעֲרֹ֖ץ וְאַל־תֵּחָ֑ת כִּ֤י עִמְּךָ֙ יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ בְּכֹ֖ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר תֵּלֵֽךְ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: hlv' tsvytykh chzq v'mts 'lt'rts v'ltcht khy 'mkh yhvh 'lhykh bkhl 'shr tlkh {p}
verses.translation: Have not I commanded thee? Be strong and of good courage; be not affrighted, neither be thou dismayed: for the LORD thy God is with thee whithersoever thou goest.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְצַ֣ו יְהוֹשֻׁ֔עַ אֶת־שֹׁטְרֵ֥י הָעָ֖ם לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: vytsv yhvsh' 'tshtry h'm l'mr
verses.translation: Then Joshua commanded the officers of the people, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עִבְר֣וּ  בְּקֶ֣רֶב הַֽמַּחֲנֶ֗ה וְצַוּ֤וּ אֶת־הָעָם֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר הָכִ֥ינוּ לָכֶ֖ם צֵידָ֑ה כִּ֞י בְּע֣וֹד  שְׁלֹ֣שֶׁת יָמִ֗ים אַתֶּם֙ עֹֽבְרִים֙ אֶת־הַיַּרְדֵּ֣ן הַזֶּ֔ה לָבוֹא֙ לָרֶ֣שֶׁת אֶת־הָאָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁר֙ יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶ֔ם נֹתֵ֥ן לָכֶ֖ם לְרִשְׁתָּֽהּ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: 'brv  bqrb hmchnh vtsvv 'th'm l'mr hkhynv lkhm tsydh khy b'vd  shlsht ymym 'tm 'brym 'thyrdn hzh lbv' lrsht 'th'rts 'shr yhvh 'lhykhm ntn lkhm lrshth {p}
verses.translation: ’Pass through the midst of the camp, and command the people, saying: Prepare you victuals; for within three days ye are to pass over this Jordan, to go in to possess the land, which the LORD your God giveth you to possess it.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלָרֽאוּבֵנִי֙ וְלַגָּדִ֔י וְלַחֲצִ֖י שֵׁ֣בֶט הַֽמְנַשֶּׁ֑ה אָמַ֥ר יְהוֹשֻׁ֖עַ לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: vlr'vbny vlgdy vlchtsy shbt hmnshh 'mr yhvsh' l'mr
verses.translation: And to the Reubenites, and to the Gadites, and to the half-tribe of Manasseh, spoke Joshua, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: זָכוֹר֙ אֶת־הַדָּבָ֔ר אֲשֶׁ֨ר צִוָּ֥ה אֶתְכֶ֛ם מֹשֶׁ֥ה עֶבֶד־יְהֹוָ֖ה לֵאמֹ֑ר יְהֹוָ֤ה אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶם֙ מֵנִ֣יחַ לָכֶ֔ם וְנָתַ֥ן לָכֶ֖ם אֶת־הָאָ֥רֶץ הַזֹּֽאת׃
verses.translit: zkhvr 'thdbr 'shr tsvh 'tkhm mshh 'bdyhvh l'mr yhvh 'lhykhm mnych lkhm vntn lkhm 'th'rts hz't
verses.translation: ’Remember the word which Moses the servant of the LORD commanded, you, saying: The LORD your God giveth you rest, and will give you this land.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נְשֵׁיכֶ֣ם טַפְּכֶם֮ וּמִקְנֵיכֶם֒ יֵשְׁב֕וּ בָּאָ֕רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֨ר נָתַ֥ן לָכֶ֛ם מֹשֶׁ֖ה בְּעֵ֣בֶר הַיַּרְדֵּ֑ן וְאַתֶּם֩ תַּעַבְר֨וּ חֲמֻשִׁ֜ים לִפְנֵ֣י אֲחֵיכֶ֗ם כֹּ֚ל גִּבּוֹרֵ֣י הַחַ֔יִל וַעֲזַרְתֶּ֖ם אוֹתָֽם׃
verses.translit: nshykhm tpkhm vmqnykhm yshbv b'rts 'shr ntn lkhm mshh b'br hyrdn v'tm t'brv chmshym lpny 'chykhm khl gbvry hchyl v'zrtm 'vtm
verses.translation: Your wives, your little ones, and your cattle, shall abide in the land which Moses gave you beyond the Jordan; but ye shall pass over before your brethren armed, all the mighty men of valour, and shall help them;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַ֠ד אֲשֶׁר־יָנִ֨יחַ יְהֹוָ֥ה ׀ לַאֲחֵיכֶם֮ כָּכֶם֒ וְיָרְשׁ֣וּ גַם־הֵ֔מָּה אֶת־הָאָ֕רֶץ אֲשֶׁר־יְהֹוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֖ם נֹתֵ֣ן לָהֶ֑ם וְשַׁבְתֶּ֞ם לְאֶ֤רֶץ יְרֻשַּׁתְכֶם֙ וִירִשְׁתֶּ֣ם אוֹתָ֔הּ אֲשֶׁ֣ר  נָתַ֣ן לָכֶ֗ם מֹשֶׁה֙ עֶ֣בֶד יְהֹוָ֔ה בְּעֵ֥בֶר הַיַּרְדֵּ֖ן מִזְרַ֥ח הַשָּֽׁמֶשׁ׃
verses.translit: 'd 'shrynych yhvh  l'chykhm khkhm vyrshv gmhmh 'th'rts 'shryhvh 'lhykhm ntn lhm vshbtm l'rts yrshtkhm vyrshtm 'vth 'shr  ntn lkhm mshh 'bd yhvh b'br hyrdn mzrch hshmsh
verses.translation: until the LORD have given your brethren rest, as unto you, and they also have possessed the land which the LORD your God giveth them; then ye shall return unto the land of your possession, and possess it, which Moses the servant of the LORD gave you beyond the Jordan toward the sunrising.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽיַּעֲנ֔וּ אֶת־יְהוֹשֻׁ֖עַ לֵאמֹ֑ר כֹּ֤ל אֲשֶׁר־צִוִּיתָ֙נוּ֙ נַעֲשֶׂ֔ה וְאֶֽל־כׇּל־אֲשֶׁ֥ר תִּשְׁלָחֵ֖נוּ נֵלֵֽךְ׃
verses.translit: vy'nv 'tyhvsh' l'mr khl 'shrtsvytnv n'shh v'lkhl'shr tshlchnv nlkh
verses.translation: And they answered Joshua, saying: ‘All that thou hast commanded us we will do, and whithersoever thou sendest us we will go.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כְּכֹ֤ל אֲשֶׁר־שָׁמַ֙עְנוּ֙ אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֔ה כֵּ֖ן נִשְׁמַ֣ע אֵלֶ֑יךָ רַ֠ק יִֽהְיֶ֞ה יְהֹוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֶ֙יךָ֙ עִמָּ֔ךְ כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר הָיָ֖ה עִם־מֹשֶֽׁה׃
verses.translit: khkhl 'shrshm'nv 'lmshh khn nshm' 'lykh rq yhyh yhvh 'lhykh 'mkh kh'shr hyh 'mmshh
verses.translation: According as we hearkened unto Moses in all things, so will we hearken unto thee; only the LORD thy God be with thee, as He was with Moses.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כׇּל־אִ֞ישׁ אֲשֶׁר־יַמְרֶ֣ה אֶת־פִּ֗יךָ וְלֹֽא־יִשְׁמַ֧ע אֶת־דְּבָרֶ֛יךָ לְכֹ֥ל אֲשֶׁר־תְּצַוֶּ֖נּוּ יוּמָ֑ת רַ֖ק חֲזַ֥ק וֶאֱמָֽץ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: khl'ysh 'shrymrh 'tpykh vl'yshm' 'tdbrykh lkhl 'shrttsvnv yvmt rq chzq v'mts {p}
verses.translation: Whosoever he be that shall rebel against thy commandment, and shall not hearken unto thy words in all that thou commandest him, he shall be put to death; only be strong and of good courage.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁלַ֣ח יְהוֹשֻֽׁעַ־בִּן־נ֠וּן מִֽן־הַשִּׁטִּ֞ים שְׁנַֽיִם־אֲנָשִׁ֤ים מְרַגְּלִים֙ חֶ֣רֶשׁ לֵאמֹ֔ר לְכ֛וּ רְא֥וּ אֶת־הָאָ֖רֶץ וְאֶת־יְרִיח֑וֹ וַיֵּ֨לְכ֜וּ וַ֠יָּבֹ֠אוּ בֵּית־אִשָּׁ֥ה זוֹנָ֛ה וּשְׁמָ֥הּ רָחָ֖ב וַיִּשְׁכְּבוּ־שָֽׁמָּה׃
verses.translit: vyshlch yhvsh'bnnvn mnhshtym shnym'nshym mrglym chrsh l'mr lkhv r'v 'th'rts v'tyrychv vylkhv vyb'v byt'shh zvnh vshmh rchb vyshkhbvshmh
verses.translation: And Joshua the son of Nun sent out of Shittim two spies secretly, saying: ‘Go view the land, and Jericho.’ And they went, and came into the house of a harlot whose name was Rahab, and lay there.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֵּ֣אָמַ֔ר לְמֶ֥לֶךְ יְרִיח֖וֹ לֵאמֹ֑ר הִנֵּ֣ה אֲ֠נָשִׁ֠ים בָּ֣אוּ הֵ֧נָּה הַלַּ֛יְלָה מִבְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לַחְפֹּ֥ר אֶת־הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translit: vy'mr lmlkh yrychv l'mr hnh 'nshym b'v hnh hlylh mbny yshr'l lchpr 'th'rts
verses.translation: And it was told the king of Jericho, saying: ‘Behold, there came men in hither to-night of the children of Israel to search out the land.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁלַח֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ יְרִיח֔וֹ אֶל־רָחָ֖ב לֵאמֹ֑ר ה֠וֹצִ֠יאִי הָאֲנָשִׁ֨ים הַבָּאִ֤ים אֵלַ֙יִךְ֙ אֲשֶׁר־בָּ֣אוּ לְבֵיתֵ֔ךְ כִּ֛י לַחְפֹּ֥ר אֶת־כׇּל־הָאָ֖רֶץ בָּֽאוּ׃
verses.translit: vyshlch mlkh yrychv 'lrchb l'mr hvtsy'y h'nshym hb'ym 'lykh 'shrb'v lbytkh khy lchpr 'tkhlh'rts b'v
verses.translation: And the king of Jericho sent unto Rahab, saying: ‘Bring forth the men that are come to thee, that are entered into thy house; for they are come to search out all the land.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתִּקַּ֧ח הָאִשָּׁ֛ה אֶת־שְׁנֵ֥י הָאֲנָשִׁ֖ים וַֽתִּצְפְּנ֑וֹ וַתֹּ֣אמֶר  כֵּ֗ן בָּ֤אוּ אֵלַי֙ הָאֲנָשִׁ֔ים וְלֹ֥א יָדַ֖עְתִּי מֵאַ֥יִן הֵֽמָּה׃
verses.translit: vtqch h'shh 'tshny h'nshym vttspnv vt'mr  khn b'v 'ly h'nshym vl' yd'ty m'yn hmh
verses.translation: And the woman took the two men, and hid them; and she said: ‘Yea, the men came unto me, but I knew not whence they were;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֨י הַשַּׁ֜עַר לִסְגּ֗וֹר בַּחֹ֙שֶׁךְ֙ וְהָאֲנָשִׁ֣ים יָצָ֔אוּ לֹ֣א יָדַ֔עְתִּי אָ֥נָה הָלְכ֖וּ הָאֲנָשִׁ֑ים רִדְפ֥וּ מַהֵ֛ר אַחֲרֵיהֶ֖ם כִּ֥י תַשִּׂיגֽוּם׃
verses.translit: vyhy hsh'r lsgvr bchshkh vh'nshym yts'v l' yd'ty 'nh hlkhv h'nshym rdpv mhr 'chryhm khy tshygvm
verses.translation: and it came to pass about the time of the shutting of the gate, when it was dark, that the men went out; whither the men went I know not; pursue after them quickly; for ye shall overtake them.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהִ֖יא הֶעֱלָ֣תַם הַגָּ֑גָה וַֽתִּטְמְנֵם֙ בְּפִשְׁתֵּ֣י הָעֵ֔ץ הָעֲרֻכ֥וֹת לָ֖הּ עַל־הַגָּֽג׃
verses.translit: vhy' h'ltm hggh vttmnm bpshty h'ts h'rkhvt lh 'lhgg
verses.translation: But she had brought them up to the roof, and hid them with the stalks of flax, which she had spread out upon the roof.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָאֲנָשִׁ֗ים רָדְפ֤וּ אַֽחֲרֵיהֶם֙ דֶּ֣רֶךְ הַיַּרְדֵּ֔ן עַ֖ל הַֽמַּעְבְּר֑וֹת וְהַשַּׁ֣עַר סָגָ֔רוּ אַחֲרֵ֕י כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר יָצְא֥וּ הָרֹדְפִ֖ים אַחֲרֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vh'nshym rdpv 'chryhm drkh hyrdn 'l hm'brvt vhsh'r sgrv 'chry kh'shr yts'v hrdpym 'chryhm
verses.translation: And the men pursued after them the way to the Jordan unto the fords; and as soon as they that pursued after them were gone out, the gate was shut.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהֵ֖מָּה טֶ֣רֶם יִשְׁכָּב֑וּן וְהִ֛יא עָלְתָ֥ה עֲלֵיהֶ֖ם עַל־הַגָּֽג׃
verses.translit: vhmh trm yshkhbvn vhy' 'lth 'lyhm 'lhgg
verses.translation: And before they were laid down, she came up unto them upon the roof;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתֹּ֙אמֶר֙ אֶל־הָ֣אֲנָשִׁ֔ים יָדַ֕עְתִּי כִּֽי־נָתַ֧ן יְהֹוָ֛ה לָכֶ֖ם אֶת־הָאָ֑רֶץ וְכִֽי־נָפְלָ֤ה אֵֽימַתְכֶם֙ עָלֵ֔ינוּ וְכִ֥י נָמֹ֛גוּ כׇּל־יֹשְׁבֵ֥י הָאָ֖רֶץ מִפְּנֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vt'mr 'lh'nshym yd'ty khyntn yhvh lkhm 'th'rts vkhynplh 'ymtkhm 'lynv vkhy nmgv khlyshby h'rts mpnykhm
verses.translation: and she said unto the men: ‘I know that the LORD hath given you the land, and that your terror is fallen upon us, and that all the inhabitants of the land melt away before you.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֣י שָׁמַ֗עְנוּ אֵ֠ת אֲשֶׁר־הוֹבִ֨ישׁ יְהֹוָ֜ה אֶת־מֵ֤י יַם־סוּף֙ מִפְּנֵיכֶ֔ם בְּצֵאתְכֶ֖ם מִמִּצְרָ֑יִם וַאֲשֶׁ֣ר עֲשִׂיתֶ֡ם לִשְׁנֵי֩ מַלְכֵ֨י הָאֱמֹרִ֜י אֲשֶׁ֨ר בְּעֵ֤בֶר הַיַּרְדֵּן֙ לְסִיחֹ֣ן וּלְע֔וֹג אֲשֶׁ֥ר הֶחֱרַמְתֶּ֖ם אוֹתָֽם׃
verses.translit: khy shm'nv 't 'shrhvbysh yhvh 'tmy ymsvf mpnykhm bts'tkhm mmtsrym v'shr 'shytm lshny mlkhy h'mry 'shr b'br hyrdn lsychn vl'vg 'shr hchrmtm 'vtm
verses.translation: For we have heard how the LORD dried up the water of the Red Sea before you, when ye came out of Egypt; and what ye did unto the two kings of the Amorites, that were beyond the Jordan, unto Sihon and to Og, whom ye utterly destroyed.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַנִּשְׁמַע֙ וַיִּמַּ֣ס לְבָבֵ֔נוּ וְלֹא־קָ֨מָה ע֥וֹד ר֛וּחַ בְּאִ֖ישׁ מִפְּנֵיכֶ֑ם כִּ֚י יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֔ם ה֤וּא אֱלֹהִים֙ בַּשָּׁמַ֣יִם מִמַּ֔עַל וְעַל־הָאָ֖רֶץ מִתָּֽחַת׃
verses.translit: vnshm' vyms lbbnv vl'qmh 'vd rvch b'ysh mpnykhm khy yhvh 'lhykhm hv' 'lhym bshmym mm'l v'lh'rts mtcht
verses.translation: And as soon as we had heard it, our hearts did melt, neither did there remain any more spirit in any man, because of you; for the LORD your God, He is God in heaven above, and on earth beneath.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֗ה הִשָּֽׁבְעוּ־נָ֥א לִי֙ בַּֽיהֹוָ֔ה כִּֽי־עָשִׂ֥יתִי עִמָּכֶ֖ם חָ֑סֶד וַעֲשִׂיתֶ֨ם גַּם־אַתֶּ֜ם עִם־בֵּ֤ית אָבִי֙ חֶ֔סֶד וּנְתַתֶּ֥ם לִ֖י א֥וֹת אֱמֶֽת׃
verses.translit: v'th hshb'vn' ly byhvh khy'shyty 'mkhm chsd v'shytm gm'tm 'mbyt 'by chsd vnttm ly 'vt 'mt
verses.translation: Now therefore, I pray you, swear unto me by the LORD, since I have dealt kindly with you, that ye also will deal kindly with my father’s house—and give me a true token—
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהַחֲיִתֶ֞ם אֶת־אָבִ֣י וְאֶת־אִמִּ֗י וְאֶת־אַחַי֙ וְאֶת־[אַחְיוֹתַ֔י] (אחותי) וְאֵ֖ת כׇּל־אֲשֶׁ֣ר לָהֶ֑ם וְהִצַּלְתֶּ֥ם אֶת־נַפְשֹׁתֵ֖ינוּ מִמָּֽוֶת׃
verses.translit: vhchytm 't'by v't'my v't'chy v't['chyvty] ('chvty) v't khl'shr lhm vhtsltm 'tnpshtynv mmvt
verses.translation: and save alive my father, and my mother, and my brethren, and my sisters, and all that they have, and deliver our lives from death.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֧אמְרוּ לָ֣הּ הָאֲנָשִׁ֗ים נַפְשֵׁ֤נוּ תַחְתֵּיכֶם֙ לָמ֔וּת אִ֚ם לֹ֣א תַגִּ֔ידוּ אֶת־דְּבָרֵ֖נוּ זֶ֑ה וְהָיָ֗ה בְּתֵת־יְהֹוָ֥ה לָ֙נוּ֙ אֶת־הָאָ֔רֶץ וְעָשִׂ֥ינוּ עִמָּ֖ךְ חֶ֥סֶד וֶאֱמֶֽת׃
verses.translit: vy'mrv lh h'nshym npshnv tchtykhm lmvt 'm l' tgydv 'tdbrnv zh vhyh bttyhvh lnv 'th'rts v'shynv 'mkh chsd v'mt
verses.translation: And the men said unto her: ‘Our life for yours, if ye tell not this our business; and it shall be, when the LORD giveth us the land, that we will deal kindly and truly with thee.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתּוֹרִדֵ֥ם בַּחֶ֖בֶל בְּעַ֣ד הַחַלּ֑וֹן כִּ֤י בֵיתָהּ֙ בְּקִ֣יר הַחוֹמָ֔ה וּבַחוֹמָ֖ה הִ֥יא יוֹשָֽׁבֶת׃
verses.translit: vtvrdm bchbl b'd hchlvn khy byth bqyr hchvmh vbchvmh hy' yvshbt
verses.translation: Then she let them down by a cord through the window; for her house was upon the side of the wall, and she dwelt upon the wall.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתֹּ֤אמֶר לָהֶם֙ הָהָ֣רָה לֵּ֔כוּ פֶּֽן־יִפְגְּע֥וּ בָכֶ֖ם הָרֹֽדְפִ֑ים וְנַחְבֵּתֶ֨ם שָׁ֜מָּה שְׁלֹ֣שֶׁת יָמִ֗ים עַ֚ד שׁ֣וֹב הָרֹֽדְפִ֔ים וְאַחַ֖ר תֵּלְכ֥וּ לְדַרְכְּכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vt'mr lhm hhrh lkhv pnypg'v bkhm hrdpym vnchbtm shmh shlsht ymym 'd shvb hrdpym v'chr tlkhv ldrkhkhm
verses.translation: And she said unto them: ‘Get you to the mountain, lest the pursuers light upon you; and hide yourselves there three days, until the pursuers be returned; and afterward may ye go your way.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּאמְר֥וּ אֵלֶ֖יהָ הָאֲנָשִׁ֑ים נְקִיִּ֣ם אֲנַ֔חְנוּ מִשְּׁבֻעָתֵ֥ךְ הַזֶּ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר הִשְׁבַּעְתָּֽנוּ׃
verses.translit: vy'mrv 'lyh h'nshym nqym 'nchnv mshb'tkh hzh 'shr hshb'tnv
verses.translation: And the men said unto her: ‘We will be guiltless of this thine oath which thou hast made us to swear.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִנֵּ֛ה אֲנַ֥חְנוּ בָאִ֖ים בָּאָ֑רֶץ אֶת־תִּקְוַ֡ת חוּט֩ הַשָּׁנִ֨י הַזֶּ֜ה תִּקְשְׁרִ֗י בַּֽחַלּוֹן֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הוֹרַדְתֵּ֣נוּ ב֔וֹ וְאֶת־אָבִ֨יךְ וְאֶת־אִמֵּ֜ךְ וְאֶת־אַחַ֗יִךְ וְאֵת֙ כׇּל־בֵּ֣ית אָבִ֔יךְ תַּאַסְפִ֥י אֵלַ֖יִךְ הַבָּֽיְתָה׃
verses.translit: hnh 'nchnv b'ym b'rts 'ttqvt chvt hshny hzh tqshry bchlvn 'shr hvrdtnv bv v't'bykh v't'mkh v't'chykh v't khlbyt 'bykh t'spy 'lykh hbyth
verses.translation: Behold, when we come into the land, thou shalt bind this line of scarlet thread in the window which thou didst let us down by; and thou shalt gather unto thee into the house thy father, and thy mother, and thy brethren, and all thy father’s household.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָיָ֡ה כֹּ֣ל אֲשֶׁר־יֵצֵא֩ מִדַּלְתֵ֨י בֵיתֵ֧ךְ ׀ הַח֛וּצָה דָּמ֥וֹ בְרֹאשׁ֖וֹ וַאֲנַ֣חְנוּ נְקִיִּ֑ם וְ֠כֹ֠ל אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִֽהְיֶ֤ה אִתָּךְ֙ בַּבַּ֔יִת דָּמ֣וֹ בְרֹאשֵׁ֔נוּ אִם־יָ֖ד תִּֽהְיֶה־בּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vhyh khl 'shryts' mdlty bytkh  hchvtsh dmv br'shv v'nchnv nqym vkhl 'shr yhyh 'tkh bbyt dmv br'shnv 'myd thyhbv
verses.translation: And it shall be, that whosoever shall go out of the doors of thy house into the street, his blood shall be upon his head, and we will be guiltless; and whosoever shall be with thee in the house, his blood shall be on our head, if any hand be upon him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאִם־תַּגִּ֖ידִי אֶת־דְּבָרֵ֣נוּ זֶ֑ה וְהָיִ֣ינוּ נְקִיִּ֔ם מִשְּׁבֻעָתֵ֖ךְ אֲשֶׁ֥ר הִשְׁבַּעְתָּֽנוּ׃
verses.translit: v'mtgydy 'tdbrnv zh vhyynv nqym mshb'tkh 'shr hshb'tnv
verses.translation: But if thou utter this our business, then we will be guiltless of thine oath which thou hast made us to swear.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתֹּ֙אמֶר֙ כְּדִבְרֵיכֶ֣ם כֶּן־ה֔וּא וַֽתְּשַׁלְּחֵ֖ם וַיֵּלֵ֑כוּ וַתִּקְשֹׁ֛ר אֶת־תִּקְוַ֥ת הַשָּׁנִ֖י בַּחַלּֽוֹן׃
verses.translit: vt'mr khdbrykhm khnhv' vtshlchm vylkhv vtqshr 'ttqvt hshny bchlvn
verses.translation: And she said: ‘According unto your words, so be it.’ And she sent them away, and they departed; and she bound the scarlet line in the window.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֵּֽלְכוּ֙ וַיָּבֹ֣אוּ הָהָ֔רָה וַיֵּ֤שְׁבוּ שָׁם֙ שְׁלֹ֣שֶׁת יָמִ֔ים עַד־שָׁ֖בוּ הָרֹֽדְפִ֑ים וַיְבַקְשׁ֧וּ הָרֹדְפִ֛ים בְּכׇל־הַדֶּ֖רֶךְ וְלֹ֥א מָצָֽאוּ׃
verses.translit: vylkhv vyb'v hhrh vyshbv shm shlsht ymym 'dshbv hrdpym vybqshv hrdpym bkhlhdrkh vl' mts'v
verses.translation: And they went, and came unto the mountain, and abode there three days, until the pursuers were returned; and the pursuers sought them throughout all the way, but found them not.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּשֻׁ֜בוּ שְׁנֵ֤י הָֽאֲנָשִׁים֙ וַיֵּרְד֣וּ מֵֽהָהָ֔ר וַיַּֽעַבְרוּ֙ וַיָּבֹ֔אוּ אֶל־יְהוֹשֻׁ֖עַ בִּן־נ֑וּן וַ֨יְסַפְּרוּ־ל֔וֹ אֵ֥ת כׇּל־הַמֹּצְא֖וֹת אוֹתָֽם׃
verses.translit: vyshbv shny h'nshym vyrdv mhhr vy'brv vyb'v 'lyhvsh' bnnvn vysprvlv 't khlhmts'vt 'vtm
verses.translation: Then the two men returned, and descended from the mountain, and passed over, and came to Joshua the son of Nun; and they told him all that had befallen them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּֽאמְרוּ֙ אֶל־יְהוֹשֻׁ֔עַ כִּֽי־נָתַ֧ן יְהֹוָ֛ה בְּיָדֵ֖נוּ אֶת־כׇּל־הָאָ֑רֶץ וְגַם־נָמֹ֛גוּ כׇּל־יֹשְׁבֵ֥י הָאָ֖רֶץ מִפָּנֵֽינוּ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vy'mrv 'lyhvsh' khyntn yhvh bydnv 'tkhlh'rts vgmnmgv khlyshby h'rts mpnynv {s}
verses.translation: And they said unto Joshua: ‘Truly the LORD hath delivered into our hands all the land; and moreover all the inhabitants of the land do melt away before us.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּשְׁכֵּם֩ יְהוֹשֻׁ֨עַ בַּבֹּ֜קֶר וַיִּסְע֣וּ מֵהַשִּׁטִּ֗ים וַיָּבֹ֙אוּ֙ עַד־הַיַּרְדֵּ֔ן ה֖וּא וְכׇל־בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיָּלִ֥נוּ שָׁ֖ם טֶ֥רֶם יַעֲבֹֽרוּ׃
verses.translit: vyshkhm yhvsh' bbqr vys'v mhshtym vyb'v 'dhyrdn hv' vkhlbny yshr'l vylnv shm trm y'brv
verses.translation: And Joshua rose up early in the morning, and they removed from Shittim, and came to the Jordan, he and all the children of Israel; and they lodged there before they passed over.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֕י מִקְצֵ֖ה שְׁלֹ֣שֶׁת יָמִ֑ים וַיַּעַבְר֥וּ הַשֹּׁטְרִ֖ים בְּקֶ֥רֶב הַֽמַּחֲנֶֽה׃
verses.translit: vyhy mqtsh shlsht ymym vy'brv hshtrym bqrb hmchnh
verses.translation: And it came to pass after three days, that the officers went through the midst of the camp;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְצַוּוּ֮ אֶת־הָעָ֣ם לֵאמֹר֒ כִּרְאֹתְכֶ֗ם אֵ֣ת אֲר֤וֹן בְּרִית־יְהֹוָה֙ אֱלֹ֣הֵיכֶ֔ם וְהַכֹּֽהֲנִים֙ הַלְוִיִּ֔ם נֹשְׂאִ֖ים אֹת֑וֹ וְאַתֶּ֗ם תִּסְעוּ֙ מִמְּק֣וֹמְכֶ֔ם וַהֲלַכְתֶּ֖ם אַחֲרָֽיו׃
verses.translit: vytsvv 'th'm l'mr khr'tkhm 't 'rvn brytyhvh 'lhykhm vhkhhnym hlvym nsh'ym 'tv v'tm ts'v mmqvmkhm vhlkhtm 'chryv
verses.translation: and they commanded the people, saying: ‘When ye see the ark of the covenant of the LORD your God, and the priests the Levites bearing it, then ye shall remove from your place, and go after it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַ֣ךְ  רָח֣וֹק יִֽהְיֶ֗ה בֵּֽינֵיכֶם֙ וּבֵנָ֔יו כְּאַלְפַּ֥יִם אַמָּ֖ה בַּמִּדָּ֑ה אַֽל־תִּקְרְב֣וּ אֵלָ֗יו לְמַ֤עַן אֲשֶׁר־תֵּֽדְעוּ֙ אֶת־הַדֶּ֙רֶךְ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תֵּֽלְכוּ־בָ֔הּ כִּ֣י לֹ֧א עֲבַרְתֶּ֛ם בַּדֶּ֖רֶךְ מִתְּמ֥וֹל שִׁלְשֽׁוֹם׃ {פ}
verses.translit: 'kh  rchvq yhyh bynykhm vbnyv kh'lpym 'mh bmdh 'ltqrbv 'lyv lm'n 'shrtd'v 'thdrkh 'shr tlkhvbh khy l' 'brtm bdrkh mtmvl shlshvm {p}
verses.translation: Yet there shall be a space between you and it, about two thousand cubits by measure; come not near unto it, that ye may know the way by which ye must go; for ye have not passed this way heretofore.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֧אמֶר יְהוֹשֻׁ֛עַ אֶל־הָעָ֖ם הִתְקַדָּ֑שׁוּ כִּ֣י מָחָ֗ר יַעֲשֶׂ֧ה יְהֹוָ֛ה בְּקִרְבְּכֶ֖ם נִפְלָאֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvsh' 'lh'm htqdshv khy mchr y'shh yhvh bqrbkhm npl'vt
verses.translation: And Joshua said unto the people: ‘Sanctify yourselves; for to-morrow the LORD will do wonders among you.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוֹשֻׁ֙עַ֙ אֶל־הַכֹּהֲנִ֣ים לֵאמֹ֔ר שְׂאוּ֙ אֶת־אֲר֣וֹן הַבְּרִ֔ית וְעִבְר֖וּ לִפְנֵ֣י הָעָ֑ם וַיִּשְׂאוּ֙ אֶת־אֲר֣וֹן הַבְּרִ֔ית וַיֵּֽלְכ֖וּ לִפְנֵ֥י הָעָֽם׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvsh' 'lhkhhnym l'mr sh'v 't'rvn hbryt v'brv lpny h'm vysh'v 't'rvn hbryt vylkhv lpny h'm {s}
verses.translation: And Joshua spoke unto the priests, saying: ‘Take up the ark of the covenant, and pass on before the people.’ And they took up the ark of the covenant, and went before the people.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהֹוָה֙ אֶל־יְהוֹשֻׁ֔עַ הַיּ֣וֹם הַזֶּ֗ה אָחֵל֙ גַּדֶּלְךָ֔ בְּעֵינֵ֖י כׇּל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל אֲשֶׁר֙ יֵֽדְע֔וּן כִּ֗י כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר הָיִ֛יתִי עִם־מֹשֶׁ֖ה אֶהְיֶ֥ה עִמָּֽךְ׃
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'lyhvsh' hyvm hzh 'chl gdlkh b'yny khlyshr'l 'shr yd'vn khy kh'shr hyyty 'mmshh 'hyh 'mkh
verses.translation: And the LORD said unto Joshua: ‘This day will I begin to magnify thee in the sight of all Israel, that they may know that, as I was with Moses, so I will be with thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאַתָּ֗ה תְּצַוֶּה֙ אֶת־הַכֹּ֣הֲנִ֔ים נֹֽשְׂאֵ֥י אֲרֽוֹן־הַבְּרִ֖ית לֵאמֹ֑ר כְּבֹאֲכֶ֗ם עַד־קְצֵה֙ מֵ֣י הַיַּרְדֵּ֔ן בַּיַּרְדֵּ֖ן תַּעֲמֹֽדוּ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: v'th ttsvh 'thkhhnym nsh'y 'rvnhbryt l'mr khb'khm 'dqtsh my hyrdn byrdn t'mdv {p}
verses.translation: And thou shalt command the priests that bear the ark of the covenant, saying: When ye are come to the brink of the waters of the Jordan, ye shall stand still in the Jordan.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר יְהוֹשֻׁ֖עַ אֶל־בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל גֹּ֣שׁוּ הֵ֔נָּה וְשִׁמְע֕וּ אֶת־דִּבְרֵ֖י יְהֹוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvsh' 'lbny yshr'l gshv hnh vshm'v 'tdbry yhvh 'lhykhm
verses.translation: And Joshua said unto the children of Israel: ‘Come hither, and hear the words of the LORD your God.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר יְהוֹשֻׁ֔עַ בְּזֹאת֙ תֵּֽדְע֔וּן כִּ֛י אֵ֥ל חַ֖י בְּקִרְבְּכֶ֑ם וְהוֹרֵ֣שׁ יוֹרִ֣ישׁ מִ֠פְּנֵיכֶ֠ם אֶת־הַכְּנַעֲנִ֨י וְאֶת־הַחִתִּ֜י וְאֶת־הַחִוִּ֗י וְאֶת־הַפְּרִזִּי֙ וְאֶת־הַגִּרְגָּשִׁ֔י וְהָאֱמֹרִ֖י וְהַיְבוּסִֽי׃
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvsh' bz't td'vn khy 'l chy bqrbkhm vhvrsh yvrysh mpnykhm 'thkhn'ny v'thchty v'thchvy v'thprzy v'thgrgshy vh'mry vhybvsy
verses.translation: And Joshua said: ‘Hereby ye shall know that the living God is among you, and that He will without fail drive out from before you the Canaanite, and the Hittite, and the Hivite, and the Perizzite, and the Girgashite, and the Amorite, and the Jebusite.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִנֵּה֙ אֲר֣וֹן הַבְּרִ֔ית אֲד֖וֹן כׇּל־הָאָ֑רֶץ עֹבֵ֥ר לִפְנֵיכֶ֖ם בַּיַּרְדֵּֽן׃
verses.translit: hnh 'rvn hbryt 'dvn khlh'rts 'br lpnykhm byrdn
verses.translation: Behold, the ark of the covenant of the Lord of all the earth passeth on before you over the Jordan.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֗ה קְח֤וּ לָכֶם֙ שְׁנֵ֣י עָשָׂ֣ר אִ֔ישׁ מִשִּׁבְטֵ֖י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל אִישׁ־אֶחָ֥ד אִישׁ־אֶחָ֖ד לַשָּֽׁבֶט׃
verses.translit: v'th qchv lkhm shny 'shr 'ysh mshbty yshr'l 'ysh'chd 'ysh'chd lshbt
verses.translation: Now therefore take you twelve men out of the tribes of Israel, for every tribe a man.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָיָ֡ה כְּנ֣וֹחַ כַּפּ֣וֹת רַגְלֵ֣י הַכֹּהֲנִ֡ים נֹשְׂאֵי֩ אֲר֨וֹן יְהֹוָ֜ה אֲד֤וֹן כׇּל־הָאָ֙רֶץ֙ בְּמֵ֣י הַיַּרְדֵּ֔ן מֵ֤י הַיַּרְדֵּן֙ יִכָּ֣רֵת֔וּן הַמַּ֥יִם הַיֹּרְדִ֖ים מִלְמָ֑עְלָה וְיַעַמְד֖וּ נֵ֥ד אֶחָֽד׃
verses.translit: vhyh khnvch khpvt rgly hkhhnym nsh'y 'rvn yhvh 'dvn khlh'rts bmy hyrdn my hyrdn ykhrtvn hmym hyrdym mlm'lh vy'mdv nd 'chd
verses.translation: And it shall come to pass, when the soles of the feet of the priests that bear the ark of the LORD, the Lord of all the earth, shall rest in the waters of the Jordan, that the waters of the Jordan shall be cut off, even the waters that come down from above; and they shall stand in one heap.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֗י בִּנְסֹ֤עַ הָעָם֙ מֵאׇ֣הֳלֵיהֶ֔ם לַֽעֲבֹ֖ר אֶת־הַיַּרְדֵּ֑ן וְהַכֹּהֲנִ֗ים נֹ֥שְׂאֵ֛י הָאָר֥וֹן הַבְּרִ֖ית לִפְנֵ֥י הָעָֽם׃
verses.translit: vyhy bns' h'm m'hlyhm l'br 'thyrdn vhkhhnym nsh'y h'rvn hbryt lpny h'm
verses.translation: And it came to pass, when the people removed from their tents, to pass over the Jordan, the priests that bore the ark of the covenant being before the people;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּכְב֞וֹא נֹשְׂאֵ֤י הָֽאָרוֹן֙ עַד־הַיַּרְדֵּ֔ן וְרַגְלֵ֤י הַכֹּֽהֲנִים֙ נֹשְׂאֵ֣י הָאָר֔וֹן נִטְבְּל֖וּ בִּקְצֵ֣ה הַמָּ֑יִם וְהַיַּרְדֵּ֗ן מָלֵא֙ עַל־כׇּל־גְּדוֹתָ֔יו כֹּ֖ל יְמֵ֥י קָצִֽיר׃
verses.translit: vkhbv' nsh'y h'rvn 'dhyrdn vrgly hkhhnym nsh'y h'rvn ntblv bqtsh hmym vhyrdn ml' 'lkhlgdvtyv khl ymy qtsyr
verses.translation: and when they that bore the ark were come unto the Jordan, and the feet of the priests that bore the ark were dipped in the brink of the water—for the Jordan overfloweth all its banks all the time of harvest—
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּֽעַמְד֡וּ הַמַּ֩יִם֩ הַיֹּרְדִ֨ים מִלְמַ֜עְלָה קָ֣מוּ נֵד־אֶחָ֗ד הַרְחֵ֨ק מְאֹ֜ד (באדם) [מֵֽאָדָ֤ם] הָעִיר֙ אֲשֶׁר֙ מִצַּ֣ד צָֽרְתָ֔ן וְהַיֹּרְדִ֗ים עַ֣ל יָ֧ם הָעֲרָבָ֛ה יָם־הַמֶּ֖לַח תַּ֣מּוּ נִכְרָ֑תוּ וְהָעָ֥ם עָבְר֖וּ נֶ֥גֶד יְרִיחֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vy'mdv hmym hyrdym mlm'lh qmv nd'chd hrchq m'd (b'dm) [m'dm] h'yr 'shr mtsd tsrtn vhyrdym 'l ym h'rbh ymhmlch tmv nkhrtv vh'm 'brv ngd yrychv
verses.translation: that the waters which came down from above stood, and rose up in one heap, a great way off from Adam, the city that is beside Zarethan; and those that went down toward the sea of the Arabah, even the Salt Sea, were wholly cut off; and the people passed over right against Jericho.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּעַמְד֣וּ הַכֹּהֲנִ֡ים נֹ֠שְׂאֵ֠י הָאָר֨וֹן בְּרִית־יְהֹוָ֜ה בֶּחָרָבָ֛ה בְּת֥וֹךְ הַיַּרְדֵּ֖ן הָכֵ֑ן וְכׇל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל עֹֽבְרִים֙ בֶּחָ֣רָבָ֔ה עַ֤ד אֲשֶׁר־תַּ֙מּוּ֙ כׇּל־הַגּ֔וֹי לַעֲבֹ֖ר אֶת־הַיַּרְדֵּֽן׃
verses.translit: vy'mdv hkhhnym nsh'y h'rvn brytyhvh bchrbh btvkh hyrdn hkhn vkhlyshr'l 'brym bchrbh 'd 'shrtmv khlhgvy l'br 'thyrdn
verses.translation: And the priests that bore the ark of the covenant of the LORD stood firm on dry ground in the midst of the Jordan, while all Israel passed over on dry ground, until all the nation were passed clean over the Jordan.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽיְהִי֙ כַּאֲשֶׁר־תַּ֣מּוּ כׇל־הַגּ֔וֹי לַעֲב֖וֹר אֶת־הַיַּרְדֵּ֑ן {פ} וַיֹּ֣אמֶר יְהֹוָ֔ה אֶל־יְהוֹשֻׁ֖עַ לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: vyhy kh'shrtmv khlhgvy l'bvr 'thyrdn {p} vy'mr yhvh 'lyhvsh' l'mr
verses.translation: And it came to pass, when all the nation were clean passed over the Jordan, that the LORD spoke unto Joshua, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: קְח֤וּ לָכֶם֙ מִן־הָעָ֔ם שְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָׂ֖ר אֲנָשִׁ֑ים אִישׁ־אֶחָ֥ד אִישׁ־אֶחָ֖ד מִשָּֽׁבֶט׃
verses.translit: qchv lkhm mnh'm shnym 'shr 'nshym 'ysh'chd 'ysh'chd mshbt
verses.translation: ’Take you twelve men out of the people, out of every tribe a man,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְצַוּ֣וּ אוֹתָם֮ לֵאמֹר֒ שְׂאֽוּ־לָכֶ֨ם מִזֶּ֜ה מִתּ֣וֹךְ הַיַּרְדֵּ֗ן מִמַּצַּב֙ רַגְלֵ֣י הַכֹּהֲנִ֔ים הָכִ֖ין שְׁתֵּים־עֶשְׂרֵ֣ה אֲבָנִ֑ים וְהַעֲבַרְתֶּ֤ם אוֹתָם֙ עִמָּכֶ֔ם וְהִנַּחְתֶּ֣ם אוֹתָ֔ם בַּמָּל֕וֹן אֲשֶׁר־תָּלִ֥ינוּ ב֖וֹ הַלָּֽיְלָה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vtsvv 'vtm l'mr sh'vlkhm mzh mtvkh hyrdn mmtsb rgly hkhhnym hkhyn shtym'shrh 'bnym vh'brtm 'vtm 'mkhm vhnchtm 'vtm bmlvn 'shrtlynv bv hlylh {s}
verses.translation: and command ye them, saying: Take you hence out of the midst of the Jordan, out of the place where the priests’feet stood, twelve stones made ready, and carry them over with you, and lay them down in the lodging-place, where ye shall lodge this night.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּקְרָ֣א יְהוֹשֻׁ֗עַ אֶל־שְׁנֵ֤ים הֶעָשָׂר֙ אִ֔ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֥ר הֵכִ֖ין מִבְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל אִישׁ־אֶחָ֥ד אִישׁ־אֶחָ֖ד מִשָּֽׁבֶט׃
verses.translit: vyqr' yhvsh' 'lshnym h'shr 'ysh 'shr hkhyn mbny yshr'l 'ysh'chd 'ysh'chd mshbt
verses.translation: Then Joshua called the twelve men, whom he had prepared of the children of Israel, out of every tribe a man;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר לָהֶם֙ יְהוֹשֻׁ֔עַ עִ֠בְר֠וּ לִפְנֵ֨י אֲר֧וֹן יְהֹוָ֛ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֖ם אֶל־תּ֣וֹךְ הַיַּרְדֵּ֑ן וְהָרִ֨ימוּ לָכֶ֜ם אִ֣ישׁ אֶ֤בֶן אַחַת֙ עַל־שִׁכְמ֔וֹ לְמִסְפַּ֖ר שִׁבְטֵ֥י בְנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: vy'mr lhm yhvsh' 'brv lpny 'rvn yhvh 'lhykhm 'ltvkh hyrdn vhrymv lkhm 'ysh 'bn 'cht 'lshkhmv lmspr shbty bnyyshr'l
verses.translation: and Joshua said unto them: ‘Pass on before the ark of the LORD your God into the midst of the Jordan, and take you up every man of you a stone upon his shoulder, according unto the number of the tribes of the children of Israel;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְמַ֗עַן תִּֽהְיֶ֛ה זֹ֥את א֖וֹת בְּקִרְבְּכֶ֑ם כִּֽי־יִשְׁאָל֨וּן בְּנֵיכֶ֤ם מָחָר֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר מָ֛ה הָֽאֲבָנִ֥ים הָאֵ֖לֶּה לָכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: lm'n thyh z't 'vt bqrbkhm khyysh'lvn bnykhm mchr l'mr mh h'bnym h'lh lkhm
verses.translation: that this may be a sign among you, that when your children ask in time to come, saying: What mean ye by these stones?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַאֲמַרְתֶּ֣ם לָהֶ֗ם אֲשֶׁ֨ר נִכְרְת֜וּ מֵימֵ֤י הַיַּרְדֵּן֙ מִפְּנֵי֙ אֲר֣וֹן בְּרִית־יְהֹוָ֔ה בְּעׇבְרוֹ֙ בַּיַּרְדֵּ֔ן נִכְרְת֖וּ מֵ֣י הַיַּרְדֵּ֑ן וְ֠הָי֠וּ הָאֲבָנִ֨ים הָאֵ֧לֶּה לְזִכָּר֛וֹן לִבְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל עַד־עוֹלָֽם׃
verses.translit: v'mrtm lhm 'shr nkhrtv mymy hyrdn mpny 'rvn brytyhvh b'brv byrdn nkhrtv my hyrdn vhyv h'bnym h'lh lzkhrvn lbny yshr'l 'd'vlm
verses.translation: then ye shall say unto them: Because the waters of the Jordan were cut off before the ark of the covenant of the LORD; when it passed over the Jordan, the waters of the Jordan were cut off; and these stones shall be for a memorial unto the children of Israel for ever.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּעֲשׂוּ־כֵ֣ן בְּנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵל֮ כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר צִוָּ֣ה יְהוֹשֻׁ֒עַ֒ וַיִּשְׂא֡וּ שְׁתֵּֽי־עֶשְׂרֵ֨ה אֲבָנִ֜ים מִתּ֣וֹךְ הַיַּרְדֵּ֗ן כַּאֲשֶׁ֨ר דִּבֶּ֤ר יְהֹוָה֙ אֶל־יְהוֹשֻׁ֔עַ לְמִסְפַּ֖ר שִׁבְטֵ֣י בְנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיַּעֲבִר֤וּם עִמָּם֙ אֶל־הַמָּל֔וֹן וַיַּנִּח֖וּם שָֽׁם׃
verses.translit: vy'shvkhn bnyyshr'l kh'shr tsvh yhvsh' vysh'v shty'shrh 'bnym mtvkh hyrdn kh'shr dbr yhvh 'lyhvsh' lmspr shbty bnyyshr'l vy'brvm 'mm 'lhmlvn vynchvm shm
verses.translation: And the children of Israel did so as Joshua commanded, and took up twelve stones out of the midst of the Jordan, as the LORD spoke unto Joshua, according to the number of the tribes of the children of Israel; and they carried them over with them unto the place where they lodged, and laid them down there.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּשְׁתֵּ֧ים עֶשְׂרֵ֣ה אֲבָנִ֗ים הֵקִ֣ים יְהוֹשֻׁ֘עַ֮ בְּת֣וֹךְ הַיַּרְדֵּן֒ תַּ֗חַת מַצַּב֙ רַגְלֵ֣י הַכֹּהֲנִ֔ים נֹשְׂאֵ֖י אֲר֣וֹן הַבְּרִ֑ית וַיִּ֣הְיוּ שָׁ֔ם עַ֖ד הַיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃
verses.translit: vshtym 'shrh 'bnym hqym yhvsh' btvkh hyrdn tcht mtsb rgly hkhhnym nsh'y 'rvn hbryt vyhyv shm 'd hyvm hzh
verses.translation: Joshua also set up twelve stones in the midst of the Jordan, in the place where the feet of the priests that bore the ark of the covenant stood; and they are there unto this day.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהַכֹּהֲנִ֞ים נֹשְׂאֵ֣י הָֽאָר֗וֹן עֹמְדִים֮ בְּת֣וֹךְ הַיַּרְדֵּן֒ עַ֣ד תֹּ֣ם כׇּֽל־הַ֠דָּבָ֠ר אֲשֶׁר־צִוָּ֨ה יְהֹוָ֤ה אֶת־יְהוֹשֻׁ֙עַ֙ לְדַבֵּ֣ר אֶל־הָעָ֔ם כְּכֹ֛ל אֲשֶׁר־צִוָּ֥ה מֹשֶׁ֖ה אֶת־יְהוֹשֻׁ֑עַ וַיְמַהֲר֥וּ הָעָ֖ם וַיַּעֲבֹֽרוּ׃
verses.translit: vhkhhnym nsh'y h'rvn 'mdym btvkh hyrdn 'd tm khlhdbr 'shrtsvh yhvh 'tyhvsh' ldbr 'lh'm khkhl 'shrtsvh mshh 'tyhvsh' vymhrv h'm vy'brv
verses.translation: And the priests that bore the ark stood in the midst of the Jordan, until every thing was finished that the LORD commanded Joshua to speak unto the people, according to all that Moses commanded Joshua; and the people hastened and passed over.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֛י כַּֽאֲשֶׁר־תַּ֥ם כׇּל־הָעָ֖ם לַעֲב֑וֹר וַיַּעֲבֹ֧ר אֲרוֹן־יְהֹוָ֛ה וְהַכֹּהֲנִ֖ים לִפְנֵ֥י הָעָֽם׃
verses.translit: vyhy kh'shrtm khlh'm l'bvr vy'br 'rvnyhvh vhkhhnym lpny h'm
verses.translation: And it came to pass, when all the people were clean passed over, that the ark of the LORD passed on, and the priests, before the people.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַ֠יַּעַבְר֠וּ בְּנֵֽי־רְאוּבֵ֨ן וּבְנֵי־גָ֜ד וַחֲצִ֨י שֵׁ֤בֶט הַֽמְנַשֶּׁה֙ חֲמֻשִׁ֔ים לִפְנֵ֖י בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר דִּבֶּ֥ר אֲלֵיהֶ֖ם מֹשֶֽׁה׃
verses.translit: vy'brv bnyr'vbn vbnygd vchtsy shbt hmnshh chmshym lpny bny yshr'l kh'shr dbr 'lyhm mshh
verses.translation: And the children of Reuben, and the children of Gad, and the half-tribe of Manasseh, passed on armed before the children of Israel, as Moses spoke unto them;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כְּאַרְבָּעִ֥ים אֶ֖לֶף חֲלוּצֵ֣י הַצָּבָ֑א עָבְר֞וּ לִפְנֵ֤י יְהֹוָה֙ לַמִּלְחָמָ֔ה אֶ֖ל עַֽרְב֥וֹת יְרִיחֽוֹ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: kh'rb'ym 'lf chlvtsy htsb' 'brv lpny yhvh lmlchmh 'l 'rbvt yrychv {s}
verses.translation: about forty thousand ready armed for war passed on in the presence of the LORD unto battle, to the plains of Jericho.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֗וּא גִּדַּ֤ל יְהֹוָה֙ אֶת־יְהוֹשֻׁ֔עַ בְּעֵינֵ֖י כׇּל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיִּֽרְא֣וּ אֹת֔וֹ כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר יָֽרְא֥וּ אֶת־מֹשֶׁ֖ה כׇּל־יְמֵ֥י חַיָּֽיו׃ {פ}
verses.translit: byvm hhv' gdl yhvh 'tyhvsh' b'yny khlyshr'l vyr'v 'tv kh'shr yr'v 'tmshh khlymy chyyv {p}
verses.translation: On that day the LORD magnified Joshua in the sight of all Israel; and they feared him, as they feared Moses, all the days of his life.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר יְהֹוָ֔ה אֶל־יְהוֹשֻׁ֖עַ לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'lyhvsh' l'mr
verses.translation: And the LORD spoke unto Joshua, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: צַוֵּה֙ אֶת־הַכֹּ֣הֲנִ֔ים נֹשְׂאֵ֖י אֲר֣וֹן הָעֵד֑וּת וְיַעֲל֖וּ מִן־הַיַּרְדֵּֽן׃
verses.translit: tsvh 'thkhhnym nsh'y 'rvn h'dvt vy'lv mnhyrdn
verses.translation: ’Command the priests that bear the ark of the testimony, that they come up out of the Jordan.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְצַ֣ו יְהוֹשֻׁ֔עַ אֶת־הַכֹּהֲנִ֖ים לֵאמֹ֑ר עֲל֖וּ מִן־הַיַּרְדֵּֽן׃
verses.translit: vytsv yhvsh' 'thkhhnym l'mr 'lv mnhyrdn
verses.translation: Joshua therefore commanded the priests, saying: ‘Come ye up out of the Jordan.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַ֠יְהִ֠י (בעלות) [כַּעֲל֨וֹת] הַכֹּהֲנִ֜ים נֹשְׂאֵ֨י אֲר֤וֹן בְּרִית־יְהֹוָה֙ מִתּ֣וֹךְ הַיַּרְדֵּ֔ן נִתְּק֗וּ כַּפּוֹת֙ רַגְלֵ֣י הַכֹּהֲנִ֔ים אֶ֖ל הֶחָרָבָ֑ה וַיָּשֻׁ֤בוּ מֵֽי־הַיַּרְדֵּן֙ לִמְקוֹמָ֔ם וַיֵּלְכ֥וּ כִתְמוֹל־שִׁלְשׁ֖וֹם עַל־כׇּל־גְּדוֹתָֽיו׃
verses.translit: vyhy (b'lvt) [kh'lvt] hkhhnym nsh'y 'rvn brytyhvh mtvkh hyrdn ntqv khpvt rgly hkhhnym 'l hchrbh vyshbv myhyrdn lmqvmm vylkhv khtmvlshlshvm 'lkhlgdvtyv
verses.translation: And it came to pass, as the priests that bore the ark of the covenant of the LORD came up out of the midst of the Jordan, as soon as the soles of the priests’feet were drawn up unto the dry ground, that the waters of the Jordan returned unto their place, and went over all its banks, as aforetime.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָעָ֗ם עָלוּ֙ מִן־הַיַּרְדֵּ֔ן בֶּעָשׂ֖וֹר לַחֹ֣דֶשׁ הָרִאשׁ֑וֹן וַֽיַּחֲנוּ֙ בַּגִּלְגָּ֔ל בִּקְצֵ֖ה מִזְרַ֥ח יְרִיחֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vh'm 'lv mnhyrdn b'shvr lchdsh hr'shvn vychnv bglgl bqtsh mzrch yrychv
verses.translation: And the people came up out of the Jordan on the tenth day of the first month, and encamped in Gilgal, on the east border of Jericho.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֵת֩ שְׁתֵּ֨ים עֶשְׂרֵ֤ה הָֽאֲבָנִים֙ הָאֵ֔לֶּה אֲשֶׁ֥ר לָקְח֖וּ מִן־הַיַּרְדֵּ֑ן הֵקִ֥ים יְהוֹשֻׁ֖עַ בַּגִּלְגָּֽל׃
verses.translit: v't shtym 'shrh h'bnym h'lh 'shr lqchv mnhyrdn hqym yhvsh' bglgl
verses.translation: And those twelve stones, which they took out of the Jordan, did Joshua set up in Gilgal.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֛אמֶר אֶל־בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לֵאמֹ֑ר אֲשֶׁר֩ יִשְׁאָל֨וּן בְּנֵיכֶ֤ם מָחָר֙ אֶת־אֲבוֹתָ֣ם לֵאמֹ֔ר מָ֖ה הָאֲבָנִ֥ים הָאֵֽלֶּה׃
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lbny yshr'l l'mr 'shr ysh'lvn bnykhm mchr 't'bvtm l'mr mh h'bnym h'lh
verses.translation: And he spoke unto the children of Israel, saying: ‘When your children shall ask their fathers in time to come, saying: What mean these stones?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהוֹדַעְתֶּ֖ם אֶת־בְּנֵיכֶ֣ם לֵאמֹ֑ר בַּיַּבָּשָׁה֙ עָבַ֣ר יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֶת־הַיַּרְדֵּ֖ן הַזֶּֽה׃
verses.translit: vhvd'tm 'tbnykhm l'mr bybshh 'br yshr'l 'thyrdn hzh
verses.translation: then ye shall let your children know, saying: Israel came over this Jordan on dry land.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲשֶׁר־הוֹבִישׁ֩ יְהֹוָ֨ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֜ם אֶת־מֵ֧י הַיַּרְדֵּ֛ן מִפְּנֵיכֶ֖ם עַֽד־עׇבְרְכֶ֑ם כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂה֩ יְהֹוָ֨ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֧ם לְיַם־ס֛וּף אֲשֶׁר־הוֹבִ֥ישׁ מִפָּנֵ֖ינוּ עַד־עׇבְרֵֽנוּ׃
verses.translit: 'shrhvbysh yhvh 'lhykhm 'tmy hyrdn mpnykhm 'd'brkhm kh'shr 'shh yhvh 'lhykhm lymsvf 'shrhvbysh mpnynv 'd'brnv
verses.translation: For the LORD your God dried up the waters of Jordan from before you, until ye were passed over, as the LORD your God did to the Red Sea, which He dried up from before us, until we were passed over,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְ֠מַ֠עַן דַּ֜עַת כׇּל־עַמֵּ֤י הָאָ֙רֶץ֙ אֶת־יַ֣ד יְהֹוָ֔ה כִּ֥י חֲזָקָ֖ה הִ֑יא לְמַ֧עַן יְרָאתֶ֛ם אֶת־יְהֹוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֖ם כׇּל־הַיָּמִֽים׃ {פ}
verses.translit: lm'n d't khl'my h'rts 'tyd yhvh khy chzqh hy' lm'n yr'tm 'tyhvh 'lhykhm khlhymym {p}
verses.translation: that all the peoples of the earth may know the hand of the LORD, that it is mighty; that ye may fear the LORD your God for ever.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֣י כִשְׁמֹ֣עַ כׇּל־מַלְכֵ֣י הָאֱמֹרִ֡י אֲשֶׁר֩ בְּעֵ֨בֶר הַיַּרְדֵּ֜ן יָ֗מָּה וְכׇל־מַלְכֵ֤י הַֽכְּנַעֲנִי֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עַל־הַיָּ֔ם אֵ֠ת אֲשֶׁר־הוֹבִ֨ישׁ יְהֹוָ֜ה אֶת־מֵ֧י הַיַּרְדֵּ֛ן מִפְּנֵ֥י בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל עַד־[עׇבְרָ֑ם] (עברנו) וַיִּמַּ֣ס לְבָבָ֗ם וְלֹא־הָ֨יָה בָ֥ם עוֹד֙ ר֔וּחַ מִפְּנֵ֖י בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vyhy khshm' khlmlkhy h'mry 'shr b'br hyrdn ymh vkhlmlkhy hkhn'ny 'shr 'lhym 't 'shrhvbysh yhvh 'tmy hyrdn mpny bnyyshr'l 'd['brm] ('brnv) vyms lbbm vl'hyh bm 'vd rvch mpny bny yshr'l {p}
verses.translation: And it came to pass, when all the kings of the Amorites, that were beyond the Jordan westward, and all the kings of the Canaanites, that were by the sea, heard how that the LORD had dried up the waters of the Jordan from before the children of Israel, until they were passed over, that their heart melted, neither was there spirit in them any more, because of the children of Israel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בָּעֵ֣ת הַהִ֗יא אָמַ֤ר יְהֹוָה֙ אֶל־יְהוֹשֻׁ֔עַ עֲשֵׂ֥ה לְךָ֖ חַֽרְב֣וֹת צֻרִ֑ים וְשׁ֛וּב מֹ֥ל אֶת־בְּנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל שֵׁנִֽית׃
verses.translit: b't hhy' 'mr yhvh 'lyhvsh' 'shh lkh chrbvt tsrym vshvb ml 'tbnyyshr'l shnyt
verses.translation: At that time the LORD said unto Joshua: ‘Make thee knives of flint, and circumcise again the children of Israel the second time.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּעַשׂ־ל֥וֹ יְהוֹשֻׁ֖עַ חַֽרְב֣וֹת צֻרִ֑ים וַיָּ֙מׇל֙ אֶת־בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֶל־גִּבְעַ֖ת הָעֲרָלֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: vy'shlv yhvsh' chrbvt tsrym vyml 'tbny yshr'l 'lgb't h'rlvt
verses.translation: And Joshua made him knives of flint, and circumcised the children of Israel at Gibeath-ha-araloth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְזֶ֥ה הַדָּבָ֖ר אֲשֶׁר־מָ֣ל יְהוֹשֻׁ֑עַ כׇּל־הָעָ֣ם הַיֹּצֵא֩ מִמִּצְרַ֨יִם הַזְּכָרִ֜ים כֹּ֣ל  אַנְשֵׁ֣י הַמִּלְחָמָ֗ה מֵ֤תוּ בַמִּדְבָּר֙ בַּדֶּ֔רֶךְ בְּצֵאתָ֖ם מִמִּצְרָֽיִם׃
verses.translit: vzh hdbr 'shrml yhvsh' khlh'm hyts' mmtsrym hzkhrym khl  'nshy hmlchmh mtv bmdbr bdrkh bts'tm mmtsrym
verses.translation: And this is the cause why Joshua did circumcise: all the people that came forth out of Egypt, that were males, even all the men of war, died in the wilderness by the way, after they came forth out of Egypt.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־מֻלִ֣ים הָי֔וּ כׇּל־הָעָ֖ם הַיֹּצְאִ֑ים וְכׇל־הָ֠עָ֠ם הַיִּלֹּדִ֨ים בַּמִּדְבָּ֥ר בַּדֶּ֛רֶךְ בְּצֵאתָ֥ם מִמִּצְרַ֖יִם לֹא־מָֽלוּ׃
verses.translit: khymlym hyv khlh'm hyts'ym vkhlh'm hyldym bmdbr bdrkh bts'tm mmtsrym l'mlv
verses.translation: For all the people that came out were circumcised; but all the people that were born in the wilderness by the way as they came forth out of Egypt, had not been circumcised.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֣י  אַרְבָּעִ֣ים שָׁנָ֗ה הָלְכ֣וּ בְנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵל֮ בַּמִּדְבָּר֒ עַד־תֹּ֨ם כׇּל־הַגּ֜וֹי אַנְשֵׁ֤י הַמִּלְחָמָה֙ הַיֹּצְאִ֣ים מִמִּצְרַ֔יִם אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹא־שָׁמְע֖וּ בְּק֣וֹל יְהֹוָ֑ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר נִשְׁבַּ֤ע יְהֹוָה֙ לָהֶ֔ם לְבִלְתִּ֞י הַרְאוֹתָ֣ם אֶת־הָאָ֗רֶץ אֲשֶׁר֩ נִשְׁבַּ֨ע יְהֹוָ֤ה לַֽאֲבוֹתָם֙ לָ֣תֶת לָ֔נוּ אֶ֛רֶץ זָבַ֥ת חָלָ֖ב וּדְבָֽשׁ׃
verses.translit: khy  'rb'ym shnh hlkhv bnyyshr'l bmdbr 'dtm khlhgvy 'nshy hmlchmh hyts'ym mmtsrym 'shr l'shm'v bqvl yhvh 'shr nshb' yhvh lhm lblty hr'vtm 'th'rts 'shr nshb' yhvh l'bvtm ltt lnv 'rts zbt chlb vdbsh
verses.translation: For the children of Israel walked forty years in the wilderness, till all the nation, even the men of war that came forth out of Egypt, were consumed, because they hearkened not unto the voice of the LORD; unto whom the LORD swore that He would not let them see the land which the LORD swore unto their fathers that He would give us, a land flowing with milk and honey.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֶת־בְּנֵיהֶם֙ הֵקִ֣ים תַּחְתָּ֔ם אֹתָ֖ם מָ֣ל יְהוֹשֻׁ֑עַ כִּֽי־עֲרֵלִ֣ים הָי֔וּ כִּ֛י לֹֽא־מָ֥לוּ אוֹתָ֖ם בַּדָּֽרֶךְ׃
verses.translit: v'tbnyhm hqym tchtm 'tm ml yhvsh' khy'rlym hyv khy l'mlv 'vtm bdrkh
verses.translation: And He raised up their children in their stead; them did Joshua circumcise; for they were uncircumcised, because they had not been circumcised by the way.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֛י כַּאֲשֶׁר־תַּ֥מּוּ כׇל־הַגּ֖וֹי לְהִמּ֑וֹל וַיֵּשְׁב֥וּ תַחְתָּ֛ם בַּֽמַּחֲנֶ֖ה עַ֥ד חֲיוֹתָֽם׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vyhy kh'shrtmv khlhgvy lhmvl vyshbv tchtm bmchnh 'd chyvtm {p}
verses.translation: And it came to pass, when all the nation were circumcised, every one of them, that they abode in their places in the camp, till they were whole.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהֹוָה֙ אֶל־יְהוֹשֻׁ֔עַ הַיּ֗וֹם גַּלּ֛וֹתִי אֶת־חֶרְפַּ֥ת מִצְרַ֖יִם מֵעֲלֵיכֶ֑ם וַיִּקְרָ֞א שֵׁ֣ם הַמָּק֤וֹם הַהוּא֙ גִּלְגָּ֔ל עַ֖ד הַיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'lyhvsh' hyvm glvty 'tchrpt mtsrym m'lykhm vyqr' shm hmqvm hhv' glgl 'd hyvm hzh
verses.translation: And the LORD said unto Joshua: ‘This day have I rolled away the reproach of Egypt from off you.’ Wherefore the name of that place was called Gilgal, unto this day.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּחֲנ֥וּ בְנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בַּגִּלְגָּ֑ל וַיַּעֲשׂ֣וּ אֶת־הַפֶּ֡סַח בְּאַרְבָּעָה֩ עָשָׂ֨ר י֥וֹם לַחֹ֛דֶשׁ בָּעֶ֖רֶב בְּעַֽרְב֥וֹת יְרִיחֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vychnv bnyyshr'l bglgl vy'shv 'thpsch b'rb'h 'shr yvm lchdsh b'rb b'rbvt yrychv
verses.translation: And the children of Israel encamped in Gilgal; and they kept the passover on the fourteenth day of the month at even in the plains of Jericho.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אכְל֜וּ מֵעֲב֥וּר הָאָ֛רֶץ מִמׇּחֳרַ֥ת הַפֶּ֖סַח מַצּ֣וֹת וְקָל֑וּי בְּעֶ֖צֶם הַיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃
verses.translit: vy'khlv m'bvr h'rts mmchrt hpsch mtsvt vqlvy b'tsm hyvm hzh
verses.translation: And they did eat of the produce of the land on the morrow after the passover, unleavened cakes and parched corn, in the selfsame day.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁבֹּ֨ת הַמָּ֜ן מִֽמׇּחֳרָ֗ת בְּאׇכְלָם֙ מֵעֲב֣וּר הָאָ֔רֶץ וְלֹא־הָ֥יָה ע֛וֹד לִבְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל מָ֑ן וַיֹּאכְל֗וּ מִתְּבוּאַת֙ אֶ֣רֶץ כְּנַ֔עַן בַּשָּׁנָ֖ה הַהִֽיא׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vyshbt hmn mmchrt b'khlm m'bvr h'rts vl'hyh 'vd lbny yshr'l mn vy'khlv mtbv't 'rts khn'n bshnh hhy' {s}
verses.translation: And the manna ceased on the morrow, after they had eaten of the produce of the land; neither had the children of Israel manna any more; but they did eat of the fruit of the land of Canaan that year.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֗י בִּֽהְי֣וֹת יְהוֹשֻׁ֘עַ֮ בִּֽירִיחוֹ֒ וַיִּשָּׂ֤א עֵינָיו֙ וַיַּ֔רְא וְהִנֵּה־אִישׁ֙ עֹמֵ֣ד לְנֶגְדּ֔וֹ וְחַרְבּ֥וֹ שְׁלוּפָ֖ה בְּיָד֑וֹ וַיֵּ֨לֶךְ יְהוֹשֻׁ֤עַ אֵלָיו֙ וַיֹּ֣אמֶר ל֔וֹ הֲלָ֥נוּ אַתָּ֖ה אִם־לְצָרֵֽינוּ׃
verses.translit: vyhy bhyvt yhvsh' byrychv vysh' 'ynyv vyr' vhnh'ysh 'md lngdv vchrbv shlvph bydv vylkh yhvsh' 'lyv vy'mr lv hlnv 'th 'mltsrynv
verses.translation: And it came to pass, when Joshua was by Jericho, that he lifted up his eyes and looked, and, behold, there stood a man over against him with his sword drawn in his hand; and Joshua went unto him, and said unto him: ‘Art thou for us, or for our adversaries?’ .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר  לֹ֗א כִּ֛י אֲנִ֥י שַׂר־צְבָֽא־יְהֹוָ֖ה עַתָּ֣ה בָ֑אתִי וַיִּפֹּל֩ יְהוֹשֻׁ֨עַ אֶל־פָּנָ֥יו אַ֙רְצָה֙ וַיִּשְׁתָּ֔חוּ וַיֹּ֣אמֶר ל֔וֹ מָ֥ה אֲדֹנִ֖י מְדַבֵּ֥ר אֶל־עַבְדּֽוֹ׃
