verses.translit: vyhy l't  bv' hshmsh tsvh yhvsh' vyrydvm m'l h'tsym vyshlkhm 'lhm'rh 'shr nchb'vshm vyshmv 'bnym gdlvt 'lpy hm'rh 'd'tsm hyvm hzh {s}
verses.translation: And it came to pass at the time of the going down of the sun, that Joshua commanded, and they took them down off the trees, and cast them into the cave wherein they had hidden themselves, and laid great stones on the mouth of the cave, unto this very day.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֶת־מַקֵּדָה֩ לָכַ֨ד יְהוֹשֻׁ֜עַ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֗וּא וַיַּכֶּ֣הָ לְפִי־חֶ֘רֶב֮ וְאֶת־מַלְכָּהּ֒ הֶחֱרִ֣ם אוֹתָ֗ם וְאֶת־כׇּל־הַנֶּ֙פֶשׁ֙ אֲשֶׁר־בָּ֔הּ לֹ֥א הִשְׁאִ֖יר שָׂרִ֑יד וַיַּ֙עַשׂ֙ לְמֶ֣לֶךְ מַקֵּדָ֔ה כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשָׂ֖ה לְמֶ֥לֶךְ יְרִיחֽוֹ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: v'tmqdh lkhd yhvsh' byvm hhv' vykhh lpychrb v'tmlkhh hchrm 'vtm v'tkhlhnpsh 'shrbh l' hsh'yr shryd vy'sh lmlkh mqdh kh'shr 'shh lmlkh yrychv {s}
verses.translation: And Joshua took Makkedah on that day, and smote it with the edge of the sword, and the king thereof; he utterly destroyed them and all the souls that were therein, he left none remaining; and he did to the king of Makkedah as he had done unto the king of Jericho.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּעֲבֹ֣ר יְ֠הוֹשֻׁ֠עַ וְכׇֽל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֥ל עִמּ֛וֹ מִמַּקֵּדָ֖ה לִבְנָ֑ה וַיִּלָּ֖חֶם עִם־לִבְנָֽה׃
verses.translit: vy'br yhvsh' vkhlyshr'l 'mv mmqdh lbnh vylchm 'mlbnh
verses.translation: And Joshua passed from Makkedah, and all Israel with him, unto Libnah, and fought against Libnah.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּתֵּן֩ יְהֹוָ֨ה גַּם־אוֹתָ֜הּ בְּיַ֣ד יִשְׂרָאֵל֮ וְאֶת־מַלְכָּהּ֒ וַיַּכֶּ֣הָ לְפִי־חֶ֗רֶב וְאֶת־כׇּל־הַנֶּ֙פֶשׁ֙ אֲשֶׁר־בָּ֔הּ לֹא־הִשְׁאִ֥יר בָּ֖הּ שָׂרִ֑יד וַיַּ֣עַשׂ לְמַלְכָּ֔הּ כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשָׂ֖ה לְמֶ֥לֶךְ יְרִיחֽוֹ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vytn yhvh gm'vth byd yshr'l v'tmlkhh vykhh lpychrb v'tkhlhnpsh 'shrbh l'hsh'yr bh shryd vy'sh lmlkhh kh'shr 'shh lmlkh yrychv {s}
verses.translation: And the LORD delivered it also, and the king thereof, into the hand of Israel; and he smote it with the edge of the sword, and all the souls that were therein; he left none remaining in it; and he did unto the king thereof as he had done unto the king of Jericho.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּעֲבֹ֣ר יְ֠הוֹשֻׁ֠עַ וְכׇֽל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֥ל עִמּ֛וֹ מִלִּבְנָ֖ה לָכִ֑ישָׁה וַיִּ֣חַן עָלֶ֔יהָ וַיִּלָּ֖חֶם בָּֽהּ׃
verses.translit: vy'br yhvsh' vkhlyshr'l 'mv mlbnh lkhyshh vychn 'lyh vylchm bh
verses.translation: And Joshua passed from Libnah, and all Israel with him, unto Lachish, and encamped against it, and fought against it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּתֵּן֩ יְהֹוָ֨ה אֶת־לָכִ֜ישׁ בְּיַ֣ד יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל וַֽיִּלְכְּדָהּ֙ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַשֵּׁנִ֔י וַיַּכֶּ֣הָ לְפִי־חֶ֔רֶב וְאֶת־כׇּל־הַנֶּ֖פֶשׁ אֲשֶׁר־בָּ֑הּ כְּכֹ֥ל אֲשֶׁר־עָשָׂ֖ה לְלִבְנָֽה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vytn yhvh 'tlkhysh byd yshr'l vylkhdh byvm hshny vykhh lpychrb v'tkhlhnpsh 'shrbh khkhl 'shr'shh llbnh {p}
verses.translation: And the LORD delivered Lachish into the hand of Israel, and he took it on the second day, and smote it with the edge of the sword, and all the souls that were therein, according to all that he had done to Libnah.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אָ֣ז עָלָ֗ה הֹרָם֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ גֶּ֔זֶר לַעְזֹ֖ר אֶת־לָכִ֑ישׁ וַיַּכֵּ֤הוּ יְהוֹשֻׁ֙עַ֙ וְאֶת־עַמּ֔וֹ עַד־בִּלְתִּ֥י הִשְׁאִֽיר־ל֖וֹ שָׂרִֽיד׃
verses.translit: 'z 'lh hrm mlkh gzr l'zr 'tlkhysh vykhhv yhvsh' v't'mv 'dblty hsh'yrlv shryd
verses.translation: Then Horam king of Gezer came up to help Lachish; and Joshua smote him and his people, until he had left him none remaining.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּעֲבֹ֣ר יְ֠הוֹשֻׁ֠עַ וְכׇֽל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֥ל עִמּ֛וֹ מִלָּכִ֖ישׁ עֶגְלֹ֑נָה וַיַּחֲנ֣וּ עָלֶ֔יהָ וַיִּֽלָּחֲמ֖וּ עָלֶֽיהָ׃
verses.translit: vy'br yhvsh' vkhlyshr'l 'mv mlkhysh 'glnh vychnv 'lyh vylchmv 'lyh
verses.translation: And Joshua passed from Lachish, and all Israel with him, unto Eglon; and they encamped against it, and fought against it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽיִּלְכְּד֜וּהָ בַּיּ֤וֹם הַהוּא֙ וַיַּכּ֣וּהָ לְפִי־חֶ֔רֶב וְאֵת֙ כׇּל־הַנֶּ֣פֶשׁ אֲשֶׁר־בָּ֔הּ בַּיּ֥וֹם הַה֖וּא הֶחֱרִ֑ים כְּכֹ֥ל אֲשֶׁר־עָשָׂ֖ה לְלָכִֽישׁ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vylkhdvh byvm hhv' vykhvh lpychrb v't khlhnpsh 'shrbh byvm hhv' hchrym khkhl 'shr'shh llkhysh {p}
verses.translation: And they took it on that day, and smote it with the edge of the sword, and all the souls that were therein he utterly destroyed that day, according to all that he had done to Lachish.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֣עַל יְ֠הוֹשֻׁ֠עַ וְכׇֽל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֥ל עִמּ֛וֹ מֵעֶגְל֖וֹנָה חֶבְר֑וֹנָה וַיִּֽלָּחֲמ֖וּ עָלֶֽיהָ׃
verses.translit: vy'l yhvsh' vkhlyshr'l 'mv m'glvnh chbrvnh vylchmv 'lyh
verses.translation: And Joshua went up from Eglon, and all Israel with him, unto Hebron; and they fought against it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּלְכְּד֣וּהָ וַיַּכּֽוּהָ־לְפִי־חֶ֠רֶב וְאֶת־מַלְכָּ֨הּ וְאֶת־כׇּל־עָרֶ֜יהָ וְאֶת־כׇּל־הַנֶּ֤פֶשׁ אֲשֶׁר־בָּהּ֙ לֹא־הִשְׁאִ֣יר שָׂרִ֔יד כְּכֹ֥ל אֲשֶׁר־עָשָׂ֖ה לְעֶגְל֑וֹן וַיַּחֲרֵ֣ם אוֹתָ֔הּ וְאֶת־כׇּל־הַנֶּ֖פֶשׁ אֲשֶׁר־בָּֽהּ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vylkhdvh vykhvhlpychrb v'tmlkhh v'tkhl'ryh v'tkhlhnpsh 'shrbh l'hsh'yr shryd khkhl 'shr'shh l'glvn vychrm 'vth v'tkhlhnpsh 'shrbh {s}
verses.translation: And they took it, and smote it with the edge of the sword, and the king thereof, and all the cities thereof, and all the souls that were therein; he left none remaining, according to all that he had done to Eglon; but he utterly destroyed it, and all the souls that were therein.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּ֧שׇׁב יְהוֹשֻׁ֛עַ וְכׇל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֥ל עִמּ֖וֹ דְּבִ֑רָה וַיִּלָּ֖חֶם עָלֶֽיהָ׃
verses.translit: vyshb yhvsh' vkhlyshr'l 'mv dbrh vylchm 'lyh
verses.translation: And Joshua turned back, and all Israel with him, to Debir; and fought against it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽיִּלְכְּדָ֞הּ וְאֶת־מַלְכָּ֤הּ וְאֶת־כׇּל־עָרֶ֙יהָ֙ וַיַּכּ֣וּם לְפִי־חֶ֔רֶב וַֽיַּחֲרִ֙ימוּ֙ אֶת־כׇּל־נֶ֣פֶשׁ אֲשֶׁר־בָּ֔הּ לֹ֥א הִשְׁאִ֖יר שָׂרִ֑יד כַּאֲשֶׁ֨ר עָשָׂ֜ה לְחֶבְר֗וֹן כֵּן־עָשָׂ֤ה לִדְבִ֙רָה֙ וּלְמַלְכָּ֔הּ וְכַאֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשָׂ֛ה לְלִבְנָ֖ה וּלְמַלְכָּֽהּ׃
verses.translit: vylkhdh v'tmlkhh v'tkhl'ryh vykhvm lpychrb vychrymv 'tkhlnpsh 'shrbh l' hsh'yr shryd kh'shr 'shh lchbrvn khn'shh ldbrh vlmlkhh vkh'shr 'shh llbnh vlmlkhh
verses.translation: And he took it, and the king thereof, and all the cities thereof; and they smote them with the edge of the sword, and utterly destroyed all the souls that were therein; he left none remaining; as he had done to Hebron, so he did to Debir, and to the king thereof; as he had done also to Libnah, and to the king thereof.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּכֶּ֣ה יְהוֹשֻׁ֣עַ אֶת־כׇּל־הָאָ֡רֶץ הָהָר֩ וְהַנֶּ֨גֶב וְהַשְּׁפֵלָ֜ה וְהָאֲשֵׁד֗וֹת וְאֵת֙ כׇּל־מַלְכֵיהֶ֔ם לֹ֥א הִשְׁאִ֖יר שָׂרִ֑יד וְאֵ֤ת כׇּל־הַנְּשָׁמָה֙ הֶחֱרִ֔ים כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר צִוָּ֔ה יְהֹוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: vykhh yhvsh' 'tkhlh'rts hhr vhngb vhshplh vh'shdvt v't khlmlkhyhm l' hsh'yr shryd v't khlhnshmh hchrym kh'shr tsvh yhvh 'lhy yshr'l
verses.translation: So Joshua smote all the land, the hill-country, and the South, and the Lowland, and the slopes, and all their kings; he left none remaining; but he utterly destroyed all that breathed, as the LORD, the God of Israel, commanded.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּכֵּ֧ם יְהוֹשֻׁ֛עַ מִקָּדֵ֥שׁ בַּרְנֵ֖עַ וְעַד־עַזָּ֑ה וְאֵ֛ת כׇּל־אֶ֥רֶץ גֹּ֖שֶׁן וְעַד־גִּבְעֽוֹן׃
verses.translit: vykhm yhvsh' mqdsh brn' v'd'zh v't khl'rts gshn v'dgb'vn
verses.translation: And Joshua smote them from Kadesh-barnea even unto Gaza, and all the country of Goshen, even unto Gibeon.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֵ֨ת כׇּל־הַמְּלָכִ֤ים הָאֵ֙לֶּה֙ וְאֶת־אַרְצָ֔ם לָכַ֥ד יְהוֹשֻׁ֖עַ פַּ֣עַם אֶחָ֑ת כִּ֗י יְהֹוָה֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל נִלְחָ֖ם לְיִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: v't khlhmlkhym h'lh v't'rtsm lkhd yhvsh' p'm 'cht khy yhvh 'lhy yshr'l nlchm lyshr'l
verses.translation: And all these kings and their land did Joshua take at one time, because the LORD, the God of Israel, fought for Israel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּ֤שׇׁב יְהוֹשֻׁ֙עַ֙ וְכׇל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל עִמּ֔וֹ אֶל־הַֽמַּחֲנֶ֖ה הַגִּלְגָּֽלָה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vyshb yhvsh' vkhlyshr'l 'mv 'lhmchnh hglglh {p}
verses.translation: And Joshua returned, and all Israel with him, unto the camp to Gilgal.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֕י כִּשְׁמֹ֖עַ יָבִ֣ין מֶלֶךְ־חָצ֑וֹר וַיִּשְׁלַ֗ח אֶל־יוֹבָב֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ מָד֔וֹן וְאֶל־מֶ֥לֶךְ שִׁמְר֖וֹן וְאֶל־מֶ֥לֶךְ אַכְשָֽׁף׃
verses.translit: vyhy khshm' ybyn mlkhchtsvr vyshlch 'lyvbb mlkh mdvn v'lmlkh shmrvn v'lmlkh 'khshf
verses.translation: And it came to pass, when Jabin king of Hazor heard thereof, that he sent to Jobab king of Madon, and to the king of Shimron, and to the king of Achshaph,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְֽאֶל־הַמְּלָכִ֞ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר מִצְּפ֗וֹן בָּהָ֧ר וּבָעֲרָבָ֛ה נֶ֥גֶב כִּֽנְר֖וֹת וּבַשְּׁפֵלָ֑ה וּבְנָפ֥וֹת דּ֖וֹר מִיָּֽם׃
verses.translit: v'lhmlkhym 'shr mtspvn bhr vb'rbh ngb khnrvt vbshplh vbnpvt dvr mym
verses.translation: and to the kings that were on the north, in the hill-country and in the Arabah south of Chinneroth, and in the Lowland, and in the regions of Dor on the west,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַֽכְּנַעֲנִי֙ מִמִּזְרָ֣ח וּמִיָּ֔ם וְהָאֱמֹרִ֧י וְהַחִתִּ֛י וְהַפְּרִזִּ֥י וְהַיְבוּסִ֖י בָּהָ֑ר וְהַֽחִוִּי֙ תַּ֣חַת חֶרְמ֔וֹן בְּאֶ֖רֶץ הַמִּצְפָּֽה׃
verses.translit: hkhn'ny mmzrch vmym vh'mry vhchty vhprzy vhybvsy bhr vhchvy tcht chrmvn b'rts hmtsph
verses.translation: to the Canaanite on the east and on the west, and the Amorite, and the Hittite, and the Perizzite, and the Jebusite in the hill-country, and the Hivite under Hermon in the land of Mizpah.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֵּצְא֣וּ הֵ֗ם וְכׇל־מַֽחֲנֵיהֶם֙ עִמָּ֔ם עַם־רָ֕ב כַּח֛וֹל אֲשֶׁ֥ר עַל־שְׂפַֽת־הַיָּ֖ם לָרֹ֑ב וְס֥וּס וָרֶ֖כֶב רַב־מְאֹֽד׃
verses.translit: vyts'v hm vkhlmchnyhm 'mm 'mrb khchvl 'shr 'lshpthym lrb vsvs vrkhb rbm'd
verses.translation: And they went out, they and all their hosts with them, much people, even as the sand that is upon the sea-shore in multitude, with horses and chariots very many.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּוָּ֣עֲד֔וּ כֹּ֖ל הַמְּלָכִ֣ים הָאֵ֑לֶּה וַיָּבֹ֜אוּ וַיַּחֲנ֤וּ יַחְדָּו֙ אֶל־מֵ֣י מֵר֔וֹם לְהִלָּחֵ֖ם עִם־יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vyv'dv khl hmlkhym h'lh vyb'v vychnv ychdv 'lmy mrvm lhlchm 'myshr'l {p}
verses.translation: And all these kings met together, and they came and pitched together at the waters of Merom, to fight with Israel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהֹוָ֣ה אֶל־יְהוֹשֻׁ֘עַ֮ אַל־תִּירָ֣א מִפְּנֵיהֶם֒ כִּֽי־מָחָ֞ר כָּעֵ֣ת הַזֹּ֗את אָנֹכִ֞י נֹתֵ֧ן אֶת־כֻּלָּ֛ם חֲלָלִ֖ים לִפְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל אֶת־סוּסֵיהֶ֣ם תְּעַקֵּ֔ר וְאֶת־מַרְכְּבֹתֵיהֶ֖ם תִּשְׂרֹ֥ף בָּאֵֽשׁ׃
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'lyhvsh' 'ltyr' mpnyhm khymchr kh't hz't 'nkhy ntn 'tkhlm chllym lpny yshr'l 'tsvsyhm t'qr v'tmrkhbtyhm tshrf b'sh
verses.translation: And the LORD said unto Joshua: ‘Be not afraid because of them; for to-morrow at this time will I deliver them up all slain before Israel; thou shalt hough their horses, and burn their chariots with fire.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּבֹ֣א יְהוֹשֻׁ֡עַ וְכׇל־עַם֩ הַמִּלְחָמָ֨ה עִמּ֧וֹ עֲלֵיהֶ֛ם עַל־מֵ֥י מֵר֖וֹם פִּתְאֹ֑ם וַֽיִּפְּל֖וּ בָּהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vyb' yhvsh' vkhl'm hmlchmh 'mv 'lyhm 'lmy mrvm pt'm vyplv bhm
verses.translation: So Joshua came, and all the people of war with him, against them by the waters of Merom suddenly, and fell upon them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּתְּנֵ֨ם יְהֹוָ֥ה בְּיַֽד־יִשְׂרָאֵל֮ וַיַּכּוּם֒ וַֽיִּרְדְּפ֞וּם עַד־צִיד֣וֹן רַבָּ֗ה וְעַד֙ מִשְׂרְפ֣וֹת מַ֔יִם וְעַד־בִּקְעַ֥ת מִצְפֶּ֖ה מִזְרָ֑חָה וַיַּכֻּ֕ם עַד־בִּלְתִּ֥י הִשְׁאִיר־לָהֶ֖ם שָׂרִֽיד׃
verses.translit: vytnm yhvh bydyshr'l vykhvm vyrdpvm 'dtsydvn rbh v'd mshrpvt mym v'dbq't mtsph mzrchh vykhm 'dblty hsh'yrlhm shryd
verses.translation: And the LORD delivered them into the hand of Israel, and they smote them, and chased them unto great Zidon, and unto Misrephoth-maim, and unto the valley of Mizpeh eastward; and they smote them, until they left them none remaining.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֤עַשׂ לָהֶם֙ יְהוֹשֻׁ֔עַ כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר אָמַר־ל֖וֹ יְהֹוָ֑ה אֶת־סוּסֵיהֶ֣ם עִקֵּ֔ר וְאֶת־מַרְכְּבֹתֵיהֶ֖ם שָׂרַ֥ף בָּאֵֽשׁ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vy'sh lhm yhvsh' kh'shr 'mrlv yhvh 'tsvsyhm 'qr v'tmrkhbtyhm shrf b'sh {s}
verses.translation: And Joshua did unto them as the LORD bade him; he houghed their horses, and burnt their chariots with fire.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּ֨שׇׁב יְהוֹשֻׁ֜עַ בָּעֵ֤ת הַהִיא֙ וַיִּלְכֹּ֣ד אֶת־חָצ֔וֹר וְאֶת־מַלְכָּ֖הּ הִכָּ֣ה בֶחָ֑רֶב כִּֽי־חָצ֣וֹר לְפָנִ֔ים הִ֕יא רֹ֖אשׁ כׇּל־הַמַּמְלָכ֥וֹת הָאֵֽלֶּה׃
verses.translit: vyshb yhvsh' b't hhy' vylkhd 'tchtsvr v'tmlkhh hkhh bchrb khychtsvr lpnym hy' r'sh khlhmmlkhvt h'lh
verses.translation: And Joshua turned back at that time, and took Hazor, and smote the king thereof with the sword: for Hazor beforetime was the head of all those kingdoms.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַ֠יַּכּ֠וּ אֶת־כׇּל־הַנֶּ֨פֶשׁ אֲשֶׁר־בָּ֤הּ לְפִי־חֶ֙רֶב֙ הַחֲרֵ֔ם לֹ֥א נוֹתַ֖ר כׇּל־נְשָׁמָ֑ה וְאֶת־חָצ֖וֹר שָׂרַ֥ף בָּאֵֽשׁ׃
verses.translit: vykhv 'tkhlhnpsh 'shrbh lpychrb hchrm l' nvtr khlnshmh v'tchtsvr shrf b'sh
verses.translation: And they smote all the souls that were therein with the edge of the sword, utterly destroying them; there was none left that breathed; and he burnt Hazor with fire.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְֽאֶת־כׇּל־עָרֵ֣י הַמְּלָֽכִים־הָ֠אֵ֠לֶּה וְֽאֶת־כׇּל־מַלְכֵיהֶ֞ם לָכַ֧ד יְהוֹשֻׁ֛עַ וַיַּכֵּ֥ם לְפִי־חֶ֖רֶב הֶחֱרִ֣ים אוֹתָ֑ם כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר צִוָּ֔ה מֹשֶׁ֖ה עֶ֥בֶד יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: v'tkhl'ry hmlkhymh'lh v'tkhlmlkhyhm lkhd yhvsh' vykhm lpychrb hchrym 'vtm kh'shr tsvh mshh 'bd yhvh
verses.translation: And all the cities of those kings, and all the kings of them, did Joshua take, and he smote them with the edge of the sword, and utterly destroyed them; as Moses the servant of the LORD commanded.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: רַ֣ק כׇּל־הֶעָרִ֗ים הָעֹֽמְדוֹת֙ עַל־תִּלָּ֔ם לֹ֥א שְׂרָפָ֖ם יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל זוּלָתִ֛י אֶת־חָצ֥וֹר לְבַדָּ֖הּ שָׂרַ֥ף יְהוֹשֻֽׁעַ׃
verses.translit: rq khlh'rym h'mdvt 'ltlm l' shrpm yshr'l zvlty 'tchtsvr lbdh shrf yhvsh'
verses.translation: But as for the cities that stood on their mounds, Israel burned none of them, save Hazor only—that did Joshua burn.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְ֠כֹ֠ל שְׁלַ֞ל הֶעָרִ֤ים הָאֵ֙לֶּה֙ וְהַבְּהֵמָ֔ה בָּזְז֥וּ לָהֶ֖ם בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל רַ֣ק אֶֽת־כׇּל־הָאָדָ֞ם הִכּ֣וּ לְפִי־חֶ֗רֶב עַד־הִשְׁמִדָם֙ אוֹתָ֔ם לֹ֥א הִשְׁאִ֖ירוּ כׇּל־נְשָׁמָֽה׃
verses.translit: vkhl shll h'rym h'lh vhbhmh bzzv lhm bny yshr'l rq 'tkhlh'dm hkhv lpychrb 'dhshmdm 'vtm l' hsh'yrv khlnshmh
verses.translation: And all the spoil of these cities, and the cattle, the children of Israel took for a prey unto themselves; but every man they smote with the edge of the sword, until they had destroyed them, neither left they any that breathed.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כַּאֲשֶׁ֨ר צִוָּ֤ה יְהֹוָה֙ אֶת־מֹשֶׁ֣ה עַבְדּ֔וֹ כֵּן־צִוָּ֥ה מֹשֶׁ֖ה אֶת־יְהוֹשֻׁ֑עַ וְכֵן֙ עָשָׂ֣ה יְהוֹשֻׁ֔עַ לֹא־הֵסִ֣יר דָּבָ֔ר מִכֹּ֛ל אֲשֶׁר־צִוָּ֥ה יְהֹוָ֖ה אֶת־מֹשֶֽׁה׃
verses.translit: kh'shr tsvh yhvh 'tmshh 'bdv khntsvh mshh 'tyhvsh' vkhn 'shh yhvsh' l'hsyr dbr mkhl 'shrtsvh yhvh 'tmshh
verses.translation: As the LORD commanded Moses His servant, so did Moses command Joshua; and so did Joshua; he left nothing undone of all that the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּקַּ֨ח יְהוֹשֻׁ֜עַ אֶת־כׇּל־הָאָ֣רֶץ הַזֹּ֗את הָהָ֤ר וְאֶת־כׇּל־הַנֶּ֙גֶב֙ וְאֵת֙ כׇּל־אֶ֣רֶץ הַגֹּ֔שֶׁן וְאֶת־הַשְּׁפֵלָ֖ה וְאֶת־הָעֲרָבָ֑ה וְאֶת־הַ֥ר יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל וּשְׁפֵלָתֹֽה׃
verses.translit: vyqch yhvsh' 'tkhlh'rts hz't hhr v'tkhlhngb v't khl'rts hgshn v'thshplh v'th'rbh v'thr yshr'l vshplth
verses.translation: So Joshua took all that land, the hill-country, and all the South, and all the land of Goshen, and the Lowland, and the Arabah, and the hill-country of Israel, and the Lowland of the same;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִן־הָהָ֤ר הֶֽחָלָק֙ הָעוֹלֶ֣ה שֵׂעִ֔יר וְעַד־בַּ֤עַל גָּד֙ בְּבִקְעַ֣ת הַלְּבָנ֔וֹן תַּ֖חַת הַר־חֶרְמ֑וֹן וְאֵ֤ת כׇּל־מַלְכֵיהֶם֙ לָכַ֔ד וַיַּכֵּ֖ם וַיְמִיתֵֽם׃
verses.translit: mnhhr hchlq h'vlh sh'yr v'db'l gd bbq't hlbnvn tcht hrchrmvn v't khlmlkhyhm lkhd vykhm vymytm
verses.translation: from the bare mountain, that goeth up to Seir, even unto Baal-gad in the valley of Lebanon under mount Hermon; and all their kings he took, and smote them, and put them to death.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יָמִ֣ים רַבִּ֗ים עָשָׂ֧ה יְהוֹשֻׁ֛עַ אֶת־כׇּל־הַמְּלָכִ֥ים הָאֵ֖לֶּה מִלְחָמָֽה׃
verses.translit: ymym rbym 'shh yhvsh' 'tkhlhmlkhym h'lh mlchmh
verses.translation: Joshua made war a long time with all those kings.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֹא־הָיְתָ֣ה עִ֗יר אֲשֶׁ֤ר הִשְׁלִ֙ימָה֙ אֶל־בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל בִּלְתִּ֥י הַחִוִּ֖י יֹשְׁבֵ֣י גִבְע֑וֹן אֶת־הַכֹּ֖ל לָקְח֥וּ בַמִּלְחָמָֽה׃
verses.translit: l'hyth 'yr 'shr hshlymh 'lbny yshr'l blty hchvy yshby gb'vn 'thkhl lqchv bmlchmh
verses.translation: There was not a city that made peace with the children of Israel, save the Hivites the inhabitants of Gibeon; they took all in battle.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֣י מֵאֵ֣ת יְהֹוָ֣ה ׀ הָיְתָ֡ה לְחַזֵּ֣ק אֶת־לִבָּם֩ לִקְרַ֨את הַמִּלְחָמָ֤ה אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ לְמַ֣עַן הַחֲרִימָ֔ם לְבִלְתִּ֥י הֱיוֹת־לָהֶ֖ם תְּחִנָּ֑ה כִּ֚י לְמַ֣עַן הַשְׁמִידָ֔ם כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהֹוָ֖ה אֶת־מֹשֶֽׁה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: khy m't yhvh  hyth lchzq 'tlbm lqr't hmlchmh 'tyshr'l lm'n hchrymm lblty hyvtlhm tchnh khy lm'n hshmydm kh'shr tsvh yhvh 'tmshh {s}
verses.translation: For it was of the LORD to harden their hearts, to come against Israel in battle, that they might be utterly destroyed, that they might have no favour, but that they might be destroyed, as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּבֹ֨א יְהוֹשֻׁ֜עַ בָּעֵ֣ת הַהִ֗יא וַיַּכְרֵ֤ת אֶת־הָעֲנָקִים֙ מִן־הָהָ֤ר מִן־חֶבְרוֹן֙ מִן־דְּבִ֣ר מִן־עֲנָ֔ב וּמִכֹּל֙ הַ֣ר יְהוּדָ֔ה וּמִכֹּ֖ל הַ֣ר יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל עִם־עָרֵיהֶ֖ם הֶחֱרִימָ֥ם יְהוֹשֻֽׁעַ׃
verses.translit: vyb' yhvsh' b't hhy' vykhrt 'th'nqym mnhhr mnchbrvn mndbr mn'nb vmkhl hr yhvdh vmkhl hr yshr'l 'm'ryhm hchrymm yhvsh'
verses.translation: And Joshua came at that time, and cut off the Anakim from the hill-country, from Hebron, from Debir, from Anab, and from all the hill-country of Judah, and from all the hill-country of Israel; Joshua utterly destroyed them with their cities.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֹא־נוֹתַ֣ר עֲנָקִ֔ים בְּאֶ֖רֶץ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל רַ֗ק בְּעַזָּ֛ה בְּגַ֥ת וּבְאַשְׁדּ֖וֹד נִשְׁאָֽרוּ׃
verses.translit: l'nvtr 'nqym b'rts bny yshr'l rq b'zh bgt vb'shdvd nsh'rv
verses.translation: There was none of the Anakim left in the land of the children of Israel; only in Gaza, in Gath, and in Ashdod, did some remain.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּקַּ֨ח יְהוֹשֻׁ֜עַ אֶת־כׇּל־הָאָ֗רֶץ כְּ֠כֹ֠ל אֲשֶׁ֨ר דִּבֶּ֣ר יְהֹוָה֮ אֶל־מֹשֶׁה֒ וַיִּתְּנָהּ֩ יְהוֹשֻׁ֨עַ לְנַחֲלָ֧ה לְיִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל כְּמַחְלְקֹתָ֖ם לְשִׁבְטֵיהֶ֑ם וְהָאָ֥רֶץ שָׁקְטָ֖ה מִמִּלְחָמָֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vyqch yhvsh' 'tkhlh'rts khkhl 'shr dbr yhvh 'lmshh vytnh yhvsh' lnchlh lyshr'l khmchlqtm lshbtyhm vh'rts shqth mmlchmh {s}
verses.translation: So Joshua took the whole land, according to all that the LORD spoke unto Moses; and Joshua gave it for an inheritance unto Israel according to their divisions by their tribes. And the land had rest from war.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֵ֣לֶּה  מַלְכֵ֣י הָאָ֗רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֨ר הִכּ֤וּ בְנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ וַיִּֽרְשׁ֣וּ אֶת־אַרְצָ֔ם בְּעֵ֥בֶר הַיַּרְדֵּ֖ן מִזְרְחָ֣ה הַשָּׁ֑מֶשׁ מִנַּ֤חַל אַרְנוֹן֙ עַד־הַ֣ר חֶרְמ֔וֹן וְכׇל־הָעֲרָבָ֖ה מִזְרָֽחָה׃
verses.translit: v'lh  mlkhy h'rts 'shr hkhv bnyyshr'l vyrshv 't'rtsm b'br hyrdn mzrchh hshmsh mnchl 'rnvn 'dhr chrmvn vkhlh'rbh mzrchh
verses.translation: Now these are the kings of the land, whom the children of Israel smote, and possessed their land beyond the Jordan toward the sunrising, from the valley of Arnon unto mount Hermon, and all the Arabah eastward:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: סִיחוֹן֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ הָאֱמֹרִ֔י הַיּוֹשֵׁ֖ב בְּחֶשְׁבּ֑וֹן מֹשֵׁ֡ל מֵעֲרוֹעֵ֡ר אֲשֶׁר֩ עַל־שְׂפַת־נַ֨חַל אַרְנ֜וֹן וְת֤וֹךְ הַנַּ֙חַל֙ וַחֲצִ֣י הַגִּלְעָ֔ד וְעַד֙ יַבֹּ֣ק הַנַּ֔חַל גְּב֖וּל בְּנֵ֥י עַמּֽוֹן׃
verses.translit: sychvn mlkh h'mry hyvshb bchshbvn mshl m'rv'r 'shr 'lshptnchl 'rnvn vtvkh hnchl vchtsy hgl'd v'd ybq hnchl gbvl bny 'mvn
verses.translation: Sihon king of the Amorites, who dwelt in Heshbon, and ruled from Aroer, which is on the edge of the valley of Arnon, and the middle of the valley, and half Gilead, even unto the river Jabbok, the border of the children of Ammon;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָעֲרָבָה֩ עַד־יָ֨ם כִּנְר֜וֹת מִזְרָ֗חָה וְ֠עַ֠ד יָ֣ם הָעֲרָבָ֤ה יָם־הַמֶּ֙לַח֙ מִזְרָ֔חָה דֶּ֖רֶךְ בֵּ֣ית הַיְשִׁמ֑וֹת וּמִ֨תֵּימָ֔ן תַּ֖חַת אַשְׁדּ֥וֹת הַפִּסְגָּֽה׃
verses.translit: vh'rbh 'dym khnrvt mzrchh v'd ym h'rbh ymhmlch mzrchh drkh byt hyshmvt vmtymn tcht 'shdvt hpsgh
verses.translation: and the Arabah unto the sea of Chinneroth, eastward, and unto the sea of the Arabah, even the Salt Sea, eastward, the way to Beth-jeshimoth; and on the south, under the slopes of Pisgah;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּגְב֗וּל ע֚וֹג מֶ֣לֶךְ הַבָּשָׁ֔ן מִיֶּ֖תֶר הָרְפָאִ֑ים הַיּוֹשֵׁ֥ב בְּעַשְׁתָּר֖וֹת וּבְאֶדְרֶֽעִי׃
verses.translit: vgbvl 'vg mlkh hbshn mytr hrp'ym hyvshb b'shtrvt vb'dr'y
verses.translation: and the border of Og king of Bashan, of the remnant of the Rephaim, who dwelt at Ashtaroth and at Edrei,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּ֠מֹשֵׁ֠ל בְּהַ֨ר חֶרְמ֤וֹן וּבְסַלְכָה֙ וּבְכׇל־הַבָּשָׁ֔ן עַד־גְּב֥וּל הַגְּשׁוּרִ֖י וְהַמַּעֲכָתִ֑י וַֽחֲצִי֙ הַגִּלְעָ֔ד גְּב֖וּל סִיח֥וֹן מֶֽלֶךְ־חֶשְׁבּֽוֹן׃
verses.translit: vmshl bhr chrmvn vbslkhh vbkhlhbshn 'dgbvl hgshvry vhm'khty vchtsy hgl'd gbvl sychvn mlkhchshbvn
verses.translation: and ruled in mount Hermon, and in Salcah, and in all Bashan, unto the border of the Geshurites and the Maacathites, and half Gilead, even unto the border of Sihon king of Heshbon.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מֹשֶׁ֧ה עֶבֶד־יְהֹוָ֛ה וּבְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל הִכּ֑וּם וַֽ֠יִּתְּנָ֠הּ מֹשֶׁ֨ה עֶבֶד־יְהֹוָ֜ה יְרֻשָּׁ֗ה לָרֽאוּבֵנִי֙ וְלַגָּדִ֔י וְלַחֲצִ֖י שֵׁ֥בֶט הַֽמְנַשֶּֽׁה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: mshh 'bdyhvh vbny yshr'l hkhvm vytnh mshh 'bdyhvh yrshh lr'vbny vlgdy vlchtsy shbt hmnshh {s}
verses.translation: Moses the servant of the LORD and the children of Israel smote them; and Moses the servant of the LORD gave it for a possession unto the Reubenites, and the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֵ֣לֶּה מַלְכֵ֣י הָאָ֡רֶץ אֲשֶׁר֩ הִכָּ֨ה יְהוֹשֻׁ֜עַ וּבְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל בְּעֵ֤בֶר הַיַּרְדֵּן֙ יָ֔מָּה מִבַּ֤עַל גָּד֙ בְּבִקְעַ֣ת הַלְּבָנ֔וֹן וְעַד־הָהָ֥ר הֶחָלָ֖ק הָעֹלֶ֣ה שֵׂעִ֑ירָה וַיִּתְּנָ֨הּ יְהוֹשֻׁ֜עַ לְשִׁבְטֵ֧י יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל יְרֻשָּׁ֖ה כְּמַחְלְקֹתָֽם׃
verses.translit: v'lh mlkhy h'rts 'shr hkhh yhvsh' vbny yshr'l b'br hyrdn ymh mb'l gd bbq't hlbnvn v'dhhr hchlq h'lh sh'yrh vytnh yhvsh' lshbty yshr'l yrshh khmchlqtm
verses.translation: And these are the kings of the land whom Joshua and the children of Israel smote beyond the Jordan westward, from Baal-gad in the valley of Lebanon even unto the bare mountain, that goeth up to Seir; and Joshua gave it unto the tribes of Israel for a possession according to their divisions;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בָּהָ֣ר וּבַשְּׁפֵלָ֗ה וּבָֽעֲרָבָה֙ וּבָ֣אֲשֵׁד֔וֹת וּבַמִּדְבָּ֖ר וּבַנֶּ֑גֶב הַֽחִתִּי֙ הָאֱמֹרִ֔י וְהַֽכְּנַעֲנִי֙ הַפְּרִזִּ֔י הַחִוִּ֖י וְהַיְבוּסִֽי׃ {פ}
verses.translit: bhr vbshplh vb'rbh vb'shdvt vbmdbr vbngb hchty h'mry vhkhn'ny hprzy hchvy vhybvsy {p}
verses.translation: in the hill-country, and in the Lowland, and in the Arabah, and in the slopes, and in the wilderness, and in the South; the Hittite, the Amorite, and the Canaanite, the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מֶ֥לֶךְ יְרִיח֖וֹ אֶחָ֑ד מֶ֧לֶךְ הָעַ֛י אֲשֶׁר־מִצַּ֥ד בֵּֽית־אֵ֖ל אֶחָֽד׃
verses.translit: mlkh yrychv 'chd mlkh h'y 'shrmtsd byt'l 'chd
verses.translation: the king of Jericho, one; the king of Ai, which is beside Beth-el, one;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מֶ֤לֶךְ יְרֽוּשָׁלַ֙͏ִם֙ אֶחָ֔ד מֶ֥לֶךְ חֶבְר֖וֹן אֶחָֽד׃
verses.translit: mlkh yrvshl͏m 'chd mlkh chbrvn 'chd
verses.translation: the king of Jerusalem, one; the king of Hebron, one;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מֶ֤לֶךְ יַרְמוּת֙ אֶחָ֔ד מֶ֥לֶךְ לָכִ֖ישׁ אֶחָֽד׃
verses.translit: mlkh yrmvt 'chd mlkh lkhysh 'chd
verses.translation: the king of Jarmuth, one; the king of Lachish, one;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מֶ֤לֶךְ עֶגְלוֹן֙ אֶחָ֔ד מֶ֥לֶךְ גֶּ֖זֶר אֶחָֽד׃
verses.translit: mlkh 'glvn 'chd mlkh gzr 'chd
verses.translation: the king of Eglon, one; the king of Gezer, one; .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מֶ֤לֶךְ דְּבִר֙ אֶחָ֔ד מֶ֥לֶךְ גֶּ֖דֶר אֶחָֽד׃
verses.translit: mlkh dbr 'chd mlkh gdr 'chd
verses.translation: the king of Debir, one; the king of Geder, one;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מֶ֤לֶךְ חׇרְמָה֙ אֶחָ֔ד מֶ֥לֶךְ עֲרָ֖ד אֶחָֽד׃
verses.translit: mlkh chrmh 'chd mlkh 'rd 'chd
verses.translation: the king of Hormah, one; the king of Arad, one;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מֶ֤לֶךְ לִבְנָה֙ אֶחָ֔ד מֶ֥לֶךְ עֲדֻלָּ֖ם אֶחָֽד׃
verses.translit: mlkh lbnh 'chd mlkh 'dlm 'chd
verses.translation: the king of Libnah, one; the king of Adullam, one;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מֶ֤לֶךְ מַקֵּדָה֙ אֶחָ֔ד מֶ֥לֶךְ בֵּֽית־אֵ֖ל אֶחָֽד׃
verses.translit: mlkh mqdh 'chd mlkh byt'l 'chd
verses.translation: the king of Makkedah, one; the king of Beth-el, one;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מֶ֤לֶךְ תַּפּ֙וּחַ֙ אֶחָ֔ד מֶ֥לֶךְ חֵ֖פֶר אֶחָֽד׃
verses.translit: mlkh tpvch 'chd mlkh chpr 'chd
verses.translation: the king of Tappuah, one; the king of Hepher, one;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מֶ֤לֶךְ אֲפֵק֙ אֶחָ֔ד מֶ֥לֶךְ לַשָּׁר֖וֹן אֶחָֽד׃
verses.translit: mlkh 'pq 'chd mlkh lshrvn 'chd
verses.translation: the king of Aphek, one; the king of the Sharon, one;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מֶ֤לֶךְ מָדוֹן֙ אֶחָ֔ד מֶ֥לֶךְ חָצ֖וֹר אֶחָֽד׃
verses.translit: mlkh mdvn 'chd mlkh chtsvr 'chd
verses.translation: the king of Madon, one; the king of Hazor, one;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מֶ֣לֶךְ שִׁמְר֤וֹן מְרֹאון֙ אֶחָ֔ד מֶ֥לֶךְ אַכְשָׁ֖ף אֶחָֽד׃
verses.translit: mlkh shmrvn mr'vn 'chd mlkh 'khshf 'chd
verses.translation: the king of Shimron-meron, one; the king of Achshaph, one;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מֶ֤לֶךְ תַּעְנַךְ֙ אֶחָ֔ד מֶ֥לֶךְ מְגִדּ֖וֹ אֶחָֽד׃
verses.translit: mlkh t'nkh 'chd mlkh mgdv 'chd
verses.translation: the king of Taanach, one; the king of Megiddo, one;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מֶ֤לֶךְ קֶ֙דֶשׁ֙ אֶחָ֔ד מֶלֶךְ־יׇקְנְעָ֥ם לַכַּרְמֶ֖ל אֶחָֽד׃
verses.translit: mlkh qdsh 'chd mlkhyqn'm lkhrml 'chd
verses.translation: the king of Kedesh, one; the king of Jokneam in Carmel, one;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מֶ֥לֶךְ דּ֛וֹר לְנָפַ֥ת דּ֖וֹר אֶחָ֑ד מֶלֶךְ־גּוֹיִ֥ם לְגִלְגָּ֖ל אֶחָֽד׃
verses.translit: mlkh dvr lnpt dvr 'chd mlkhgvym lglgl 'chd
verses.translation: the king of Dor in the region of Dor, one; the king of Goiim in the Gilgal, one;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מֶ֥לֶךְ תִּרְצָ֖ה אֶחָ֑ד כׇּל־מְלָכִ֖ים שְׁלֹשִׁ֥ים וְאֶחָֽד׃ {פ}
verses.translit: mlkh trtsh 'chd khlmlkhym shlshym v'chd {p}
verses.translation: the king of Tirzah, one. All the kings thirty and one.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וִיהוֹשֻׁ֣עַ זָקֵ֔ן בָּ֖א בַּיָּמִ֑ים וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהֹוָ֜ה אֵלָ֗יו אַתָּ֤ה זָקַ֙נְתָּה֙ בָּ֣אתָ בַיָּמִ֔ים וְהָאָ֛רֶץ נִשְׁאֲרָ֥ה הַרְבֵּֽה־מְאֹ֖ד לְרִשְׁתָּֽהּ׃
verses.translit: vyhvsh' zqn b' bymym vy'mr yhvh 'lyv 'th zqnth b't bymym vh'rts nsh'rh hrbhm'd lrshth
verses.translation: Now Joshua was old and well stricken in years; and the LORD said unto him: ‘Thou art old and well stricken in years, and there remaineth yet very much land to be possessed.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: זֹ֥את הָאָ֖רֶץ הַנִּשְׁאָ֑רֶת כׇּל־גְּלִיל֥וֹת הַפְּלִשְׁתִּ֖ים וְכׇל־הַגְּשׁוּרִֽי׃
verses.translit: z't h'rts hnsh'rt khlglylvt hplshtym vkhlhgshvry
verses.translation: This is the land that yet remaineth: all the regions of the Philistines, and all the Geshurites;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִֽן־הַשִּׁיח֞וֹר אֲשֶׁ֣ר  עַל־פְּנֵ֣י מִצְרַ֗יִם וְעַ֨ד גְּב֤וּל עֶקְרוֹן֙ צָפ֔וֹנָה לַֽכְּנַעֲנִ֖י תֵּחָשֵׁ֑ב חֲמֵ֣שֶׁת  סַרְנֵ֣י פְלִשְׁתִּ֗ים הָֽעַזָּתִ֤י וְהָֽאַשְׁדּוֹדִי֙ הָאֶשְׁקְלוֹנִ֣י הַגִּתִּ֔י וְהָעֶקְרוֹנִ֖י וְהָעַוִּֽים׃
verses.translit: mnhshychvr 'shr  'lpny mtsrym v'd gbvl 'qrvn tspvnh lkhn'ny tchshb chmsht  srny plshtym h'zty vh'shdvdy h'shqlvny hgty vh'qrvny vh'vym
verses.translation: from the Shihor, which is before Egypt, even unto the border of Ekron northward—which is counted to the Canaanites; the five lords of the Philistines: the Gazite, and the Ashdodite, the Ashkelonite, the Gittite, and the Ekronite; also the Avvim
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִתֵּימָ֞ן כׇּל־אֶ֣רֶץ הַֽכְּנַעֲנִ֗י וּמְעָרָ֛ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר לַצִּידֹנִ֖ים עַד־אֲפֵ֑קָה עַ֖ד גְּב֥וּל הָאֱמֹרִֽי׃
verses.translit: mtymn khl'rts hkhn'ny vm'rh 'shr ltsydnym 'd'pqh 'd gbvl h'mry
verses.translation: on the south; all the land of the Canaanites, and Mearah that belongeth to the Zidonians, unto Aphek, to the border of the Amorites;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָאָ֣רֶץ הַגִּבְלִ֗י וְכׇל־הַלְּבָנוֹן֙ מִזְרַ֣ח הַשֶּׁ֔מֶשׁ מִבַּ֣עַל גָּ֔ד תַּ֖חַת הַר־חֶרְמ֑וֹן עַ֖ד לְב֥וֹא חֲמָֽת׃
verses.translit: vh'rts hgbly vkhlhlbnvn mzrch hshmsh mb'l gd tcht hrchrmvn 'd lbv' chmt
verses.translation: and the land of the Gebalites, and all Lebanon, toward the sunrising, from Baal-gad under mount Hermon unto the entrance of Hamath;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כׇּל־יֹשְׁבֵ֣י הָ֠הָ֠ר מִֽן־הַלְּבָנ֞וֹן עַד־מִשְׂרְפֹ֥ת מַ֙יִם֙ כׇּל־צִ֣ידֹנִ֔ים אָֽנֹכִי֙ אֽוֹרִישֵׁ֔ם מִפְּנֵ֖י בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל רַ֠ק הַפִּלֶ֤הָ לְיִשְׂרָאֵל֙ בְּֽנַחֲלָ֔ה כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר צִוִּיתִֽיךָ׃
verses.translit: khlyshby hhr mnhlbnvn 'dmshrpt mym khltsydnym 'nkhy 'vryshm mpny bny yshr'l rq hplh lyshr'l bnchlh kh'shr tsvytykh
verses.translation: all the inhabitants of the hill-country from Lebanon unto Misrephoth-maim, even all the Zidonians; them will I drive out from before the children of Israel; only allot thou it unto Israel for an inheritance, as I have commanded thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֗ה חַלֵּ֞ק אֶת־הָאָ֧רֶץ הַזֹּ֛את בְּנַחֲלָ֖ה לְתִשְׁעַ֣ת הַשְּׁבָטִ֑ים וַֽחֲצִ֖י הַשֵּׁ֥בֶט הַֽמְנַשֶּֽׁה׃
verses.translit: v'th chlq 'th'rts hz't bnchlh ltsh't hshbtym vchtsy hshbt hmnshh
verses.translation: Now therefore divide this land for an inheritance unto the nine tribes, and the half-tribe of Manasseh.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עִמּ֗וֹ הָרֽאוּבֵנִי֙ וְהַגָּדִ֔י לָקְח֖וּ נַחֲלָתָ֑ם אֲשֶׁר֩ נָתַ֨ן לָהֶ֜ם מֹשֶׁ֗ה בְּעֵ֤בֶר הַיַּרְדֵּן֙ מִזְרָ֔חָה כַּֽאֲשֶׁר֙ נָתַ֣ן לָהֶ֔ם מֹשֶׁ֖ה עֶ֥בֶד יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: 'mv hr'vbny vhgdy lqchv nchltm 'shr ntn lhm mshh b'br hyrdn mzrchh kh'shr ntn lhm mshh 'bd yhvh
verses.translation: With him the Reubenites and the Gadites received their inheritance, which Moses gave them, beyond the Jordan eastward, even as Moses the servant of the LORD gave them;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מֵעֲרוֹעֵ֡ר אֲשֶׁר֩ עַל־שְׂפַת־נַ֨חַל אַרְנ֜וֹן וְהָעִ֨יר אֲשֶׁ֧ר בְּתוֹךְ־הַנַּ֛חַל וְכׇל־הַמִּישֹׁ֥ר מֵידְבָ֖א עַד־דִּיבֽוֹן׃
verses.translit: m'rv'r 'shr 'lshptnchl 'rnvn vh'yr 'shr btvkhhnchl vkhlhmyshr mydb' 'ddybvn
verses.translation: from Aroer, that is on the edge of the valley of Arnon, and the city that is in the middle of the valley, and all the table-land from Medeba unto Dibon;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְכֹ֗ל עָרֵי֙ סִיחוֹן֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ הָאֱמֹרִ֔י אֲשֶׁ֥ר מָלַ֖ךְ בְּחֶשְׁבּ֑וֹן עַד־גְּב֖וּל בְּנֵ֥י עַמּֽוֹן׃
verses.translit: vkhl 'ry sychvn mlkh h'mry 'shr mlkh bchshbvn 'dgbvl bny 'mvn
verses.translation: and all the cities of Sihon king of the Amorites, who reigned in Heshbon, unto the border of the children of Ammon;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהַגִּלְעָ֞ד וּגְב֧וּל הַגְּשׁוּרִ֣י וְהַמַּעֲכָתִ֗י וְכֹ֨ל הַ֥ר חֶרְמ֛וֹן וְכׇל־הַבָּשָׁ֖ן עַד־סַלְכָֽה׃
verses.translit: vhgl'd vgbvl hgshvry vhm'khty vkhl hr chrmvn vkhlhbshn 'dslkhh
verses.translation: and Gilead, and the border of the Geshurites and Maacathites, and all mount Hermon, and all Bashan unto Salcah;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כׇּל־מַמְלְכ֥וּת עוֹג֙ בַּבָּשָׁ֔ן אֲשֶׁר־מָלַ֥ךְ בְּעַשְׁתָּר֖וֹת וּבְאֶדְרֶ֑עִי ה֤וּא נִשְׁאַר֙ מִיֶּ֣תֶר הָרְפָאִ֔ים וַיַּכֵּ֥ם מֹשֶׁ֖ה וַיֹּרִשֵֽׁם׃
verses.translit: khlmmlkhvt 'vg bbshn 'shrmlkh b'shtrvt vb'dr'y hv' nsh'r mytr hrp'ym vykhm mshh vyrshm
verses.translation: all the kingdom of Og in Bashan, who reigned in Ashtaroth and in Edrei—the same was left of the remnant of the Rephaim— for these did Moses smite, and drove them out.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלֹ֤א הוֹרִ֙ישׁוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֶת־הַגְּשׁוּרִ֖י וְאֶת־הַמַּעֲכָתִ֑י וַיֵּ֨שֶׁב גְּשׁ֤וּר וּמַֽעֲכָת֙ בְּקֶ֣רֶב יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל עַ֖ד הַיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃
verses.translit: vl' hvryshv bny yshr'l 'thgshvry v'thm'khty vyshb gshvr vm'kht bqrb yshr'l 'd hyvm hzh
verses.translation: Nevertheless the children of Israel drove not out the Geshurites, nor the Maacathites; but Geshur and Maacath dwelt in the midst of Israel unto this day.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: רַ֚ק לְשֵׁ֣בֶט הַלֵּוִ֔י לֹ֥א נָתַ֖ן נַחֲלָ֑ה אִשֵּׁ֨י יְהֹוָ֜ה אֱלֹהֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ ה֣וּא נַחֲלָת֔וֹ כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר דִּבֶּר־לֽוֹ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: rq lshbt hlvy l' ntn nchlh 'shy yhvh 'lhy yshr'l hv' nchltv kh'shr dbrlv {p}
verses.translation: Only unto the tribe of Levi he gave no inheritance; the offerings of the LORD, the God of Israel, made by fire are his inheritance, as He spoke unto him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּתֵּ֣ן מֹשֶׁ֔ה לְמַטֵּ֥ה בְנֵי־רְאוּבֵ֖ן לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָֽם׃
verses.translit: vytn mshh lmth bnyr'vbn lmshpchtm
verses.translation: And Moses gave unto the tribe of the children of Reuben according to their families.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֨י לָהֶ֜ם הַגְּב֗וּל מֵעֲרוֹעֵ֡ר אֲשֶׁר֩ עַל־שְׂפַת־נַ֨חַל אַרְנ֜וֹן וְהָעִ֨יר אֲשֶׁ֧ר בְּתוֹךְ־הַנַּ֛חַל וְכׇל־הַמִּישֹׁ֖ר עַל־מֵידְבָֽא׃
verses.translit: vyhy lhm hgbvl m'rv'r 'shr 'lshptnchl 'rnvn vh'yr 'shr btvkhhnchl vkhlhmyshr 'lmydb'
verses.translation: And their border was from Aroer, that is on the edge of the valley of Arnon, and the city that is in the middle of the valley, and all the table-land by Medeba;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: חֶשְׁבּ֥וֹן וְכׇל־עָרֶ֖יהָ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בַּמִּישֹׁ֑ר דִּיבֹן֙ וּבָמ֣וֹת בַּ֔עַל וּבֵ֖ית בַּ֥עַל מְעֽוֹן׃
verses.translit: chshbvn vkhl'ryh 'shr bmyshr dybn vbmvt b'l vbyt b'l m'vn
verses.translation: Heshbon, and all her cities that are in the table-land; Dibon, and Bamoth-baal, and Beth-baal-meon;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְיַ֥הְצָה וּקְדֵמֹ֖ת וּמֵפָֽעַת׃
verses.translit: vyhtsh vqdmt vmp't
verses.translation: and Jahaz, and Kedemoth, and Mephaath;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְקִרְיָתַ֣יִם וְשִׂבְמָ֔ה וְצֶ֥רֶת הַשַּׁ֖חַר בְּהַ֥ר הָעֵֽמֶק׃
verses.translit: vqrytym vshbmh vtsrt hshchr bhr h'mq
verses.translation: and Kiriathaim, and Sibmah, and Zerethshahar in the mount of the valley;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבֵ֥ית פְּע֛וֹר וְאַשְׁדּ֥וֹת הַפִּסְגָּ֖ה וּבֵ֥ית הַיְשִׁמֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: vbyt p'vr v'shdvt hpsgh vbyt hyshmvt
verses.translation: and Beth-peor, and the slopes of Pisgah, and Beth-jeshimoth;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְכֹל֙ עָרֵ֣י הַמִּישֹׁ֔ר וְכׇֽל־מַמְלְכ֗וּת סִיחוֹן֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ הָאֱמֹרִ֔י אֲשֶׁ֥ר מָלַ֖ךְ בְּחֶשְׁבּ֑וֹן אֲשֶׁר֩ הִכָּ֨ה מֹשֶׁ֜ה אֹת֣וֹ  וְאֶת־נְשִׂיאֵ֣י מִדְיָ֗ן אֶת־אֱוִ֤י וְאֶת־רֶ֙קֶם֙ וְאֶת־צ֤וּר וְאֶת־חוּר֙ וְאֶת־רֶ֔בַע נְסִיכֵ֣י סִיח֔וֹן יֹשְׁבֵ֖י הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translit: vkhl 'ry hmyshr vkhlmmlkhvt sychvn mlkh h'mry 'shr mlkh bchshbvn 'shr hkhh mshh 'tv  v'tnshy'y mdyn 't'vy v'trqm v'ttsvr v'tchvr v'trb' nsykhy sychvn yshby h'rts
verses.translation: and all the cities of the table-land, and all the kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorites, who reigned in Heshbon, whom Moses smote with the chiefs of Midian, Evi, and Rekem, and Zur, and Hur, and Reba, the princes of Sihon, that dwelt in the land.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֶת־בִּלְעָ֥ם בֶּן־בְּע֖וֹר הַקּוֹסֵ֑ם הָרְג֧וּ בְנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל בַּחֶ֖רֶב אֶל־חַלְלֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: v'tbl'm bnb'vr hqvsm hrgv bnyyshr'l bchrb 'lchllyhm
verses.translation: Balaam also the son of Beor, the soothsayer, did the children of Israel slay with the sword among the rest of their slain.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֗י גְּבוּל֙ בְּנֵ֣י רְאוּבֵ֔ן הַיַּרְדֵּ֖ן וּגְב֑וּל זֹ֣את נַחֲלַ֤ת בְּנֵֽי־רְאוּבֵן֙ לְמִשְׁפְּחוֹתָ֔ם הֶעָרִ֖ים וְחַצְרֵיהֶֽן׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vyhy gbvl bny r'vbn hyrdn vgbvl z't nchlt bnyr'vbn lmshpchvtm h'rym vchtsryhn {p}
verses.translation: And as for the border of the children of Reuben, the Jordan was their border. This was the inheritance of the children of Reuben according to their families, the cities and the villages thereof.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּתֵּ֤ן מֹשֶׁה֙ לְמַטֵּה־גָ֔ד לִבְנֵי־גָ֖ד לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָֽם׃
verses.translit: vytn mshh lmthgd lbnygd lmshpchtm
verses.translation: And Moses gave unto the tribe of Gad, unto the children of Gad, according to their families.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֤י לָהֶם֙ הַגְּב֔וּל יַעְזֵר֙ וְכׇל־עָרֵ֣י הַגִּלְעָ֔ד וַחֲצִ֕י אֶ֖רֶץ בְּנֵ֣י עַמּ֑וֹן עַד־עֲרוֹעֵ֕ר אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל־פְּנֵ֥י רַבָּֽה׃
verses.translit: vyhy lhm hgbvl y'zr vkhl'ry hgl'd vchtsy 'rts bny 'mvn 'd'rv'r 'shr 'lpny rbh
verses.translation: And their border was Jazer, and all the cities of Gilead, and half the land of the children of Ammon, unto Aroer that is before Rabbah;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמֵחֶשְׁבּ֛וֹן עַד־רָמַ֥ת הַמִּצְפֶּ֖ה וּבְטֹנִ֑ים וּמִֽמַּחֲנַ֖יִם עַד־גְּב֥וּל לִדְבִֽר׃
verses.translit: vmchshbvn 'drmt hmtsph vbtnym vmmchnym 'dgbvl ldbr
verses.translation: and from Heshbon unto Ramath-mizpeh, and Betonim; and from Mahanaim unto the border of Lidbir;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבָעֵ֡מֶק בֵּ֣ית הָרָם֩ וּבֵ֨ית נִמְרָ֜ה וְסֻכּ֣וֹת וְצָפ֗וֹן יֶ֚תֶר מַמְלְכ֗וּת סִיחוֹן֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ חֶשְׁבּ֔וֹן הַיַּרְדֵּ֖ן וּגְבֻ֑ל עַד־קְצֵה֙ יָם־כִּנֶּ֔רֶת עֵ֥בֶר הַיַּרְדֵּ֖ן מִזְרָֽחָה׃
verses.translit: vb'mq byt hrm vbyt nmrh vskhvt vtspvn ytr mmlkhvt sychvn mlkh chshbvn hyrdn vgbl 'dqtsh ymkhnrt 'br hyrdn mzrchh
verses.translation: and in the valley, Beth-haram, and Beth-nimrah, and Succoth, and Zaphon, the rest of the kingdom of Sihon king of Heshbon, the Jordan being the border thereof, unto the uttermost part of the sea of Chinnereth beyond the Jordan eastward.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: זֹ֛את נַחֲלַ֥ת בְּנֵי־גָ֖ד לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֑ם הֶעָרִ֖ים וְחַצְרֵיהֶֽם׃ {ס}
verses.translit: z't nchlt bnygd lmshpchtm h'rym vchtsryhm {s}
verses.translation: This is the inheritance of the children of Gad according to their families, the cities and the villages thereof.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּתֵּ֣ן מֹשֶׁ֔ה לַחֲצִ֖י שֵׁ֣בֶט מְנַשֶּׁ֑ה וַיְהִ֗י לַחֲצִ֛י מַטֵּ֥ה בְנֵי־מְנַשֶּׁ֖ה לְמִשְׁפְּחוֹתָֽם׃
verses.translit: vytn mshh lchtsy shbt mnshh vyhy lchtsy mth bnymnshh lmshpchvtm
verses.translation: And Moses gave inheritance unto the half-tribe of Manasseh; and it was for the half-tribe of the children of Manasseh according to their families.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֣י גְבוּלָ֗ם מִמַּחֲנַ֨יִם כׇּֽל־הַבָּשָׁ֜ן כׇּֽל־מַמְלְכ֣וּת  ע֣וֹג מֶֽלֶךְ־הַבָּשָׁ֗ן וְכׇל־חַוֺּ֥ת יָאִ֛יר אֲשֶׁ֥ר בַּבָּשָׁ֖ן שִׁשִּׁ֥ים עִֽיר׃
verses.translit: vyhy gbvlm mmchnym khlhbshn khlmmlkhvt  'vg mlkhhbshn vkhlchvt y'yr 'shr bbshn shshym 'yr
verses.translation: And their border was from Mahanaim, all Bashan, all the kingdom of Og king of Bashan, and all the villages of Jair, which are in Bashan, threescore cities;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַחֲצִ֤י הַגִּלְעָד֙ וְעַשְׁתָּר֣וֹת וְאֶדְרֶ֔עִי עָרֵ֛י מַמְלְכ֥וּת ע֖וֹג בַּבָּשָׁ֑ן לִבְנֵ֤י מָכִיר֙ בֶּן־מְנַשֶּׁ֔ה לַחֲצִ֥י בְנֵֽי־מָכִ֖יר לְמִשְׁפְּחוֹתָֽם׃
verses.translit: vchtsy hgl'd v'shtrvt v'dr'y 'ry mmlkhvt 'vg bbshn lbny mkhyr bnmnshh lchtsy bnymkhyr lmshpchvtm
verses.translation: and half Gilead, and Ashtaroth, and Edrei, the cities of the kingdom of Og in Bashan, were for the children of Machir the son of Manasseh, even for the half of the children of Machir according to their families.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֵ֕לֶּה אֲשֶׁר־נִחַ֥ל מֹשֶׁ֖ה בְּעַֽרְב֣וֹת מוֹאָ֑ב מֵעֵ֛בֶר לְיַרְדֵּ֥ן יְרִיח֖וֹ מִזְרָֽחָה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: 'lh 'shrnchl mshh b'rbvt mv'b m'br lyrdn yrychv mzrchh {p}
verses.translation: These are the inheritances which Moses distributed in the plains of Moab, beyond the Jordan at Jericho, eastward.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּלְשֵׁ֙בֶט֙ הַלֵּוִ֔י לֹא־נָתַ֥ן מֹשֶׁ֖ה נַחֲלָ֑ה יְהֹוָ֞ה אֱלֹהֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ ה֣וּא נַחֲלָתָ֔ם כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר דִּבֶּ֥ר לָהֶֽם׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vlshbt hlvy l'ntn mshh nchlh yhvh 'lhy yshr'l hv' nchltm kh'shr dbr lhm {s}
verses.translation: But unto the tribe of Levi Moses gave no inheritance; the LORD, the God of Israel, is their inheritance, as He spoke unto them. .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֵ֛לֶּה אֲשֶׁר־נָחֲל֥וּ בְנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בְּאֶ֣רֶץ כְּנָ֑עַן אֲשֶׁ֨ר נִחֲל֜וּ אוֹתָ֗ם אֶלְעָזָ֤ר הַכֹּהֵן֙ וִיהוֹשֻׁ֣עַ בִּן־נ֔וּן וְרָאשֵׁ֛י אֲב֥וֹת הַמַּטּ֖וֹת לִבְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: v'lh 'shrnchlv bnyyshr'l b'rts khn'n 'shr nchlv 'vtm 'l'zr hkhhn vyhvsh' bnnvn vr'shy 'bvt hmtvt lbny yshr'l
verses.translation: And these are the inheritances which the children of Israel took in the land of Canaan, which Eleazar the priest, and Joshua the son of Nun, and the heads of the fathers’houses of the tribes of the children of Israel, distributed unto them,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּגוֹרַ֖ל נַחֲלָתָ֑ם כַּאֲשֶׁ֨ר צִוָּ֤ה יְהֹוָה֙ בְּיַד־מֹשֶׁ֔ה לְתִשְׁעַ֥ת הַמַּטּ֖וֹת וַחֲצִ֥י הַמַּטֶּֽה׃
verses.translit: bgvrl nchltm kh'shr tsvh yhvh bydmshh ltsh't hmtvt vchtsy hmth
verses.translation: by the lot of their inheritance, as the LORD commanded by the hand of Moses, for the nine tribes, and for the half-tribe.—
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־נָתַ֨ן מֹשֶׁ֜ה נַחֲלַ֨ת שְׁנֵ֤י הַמַּטּוֹת֙ וַחֲצִ֣י הַמַּטֶּ֔ה מֵעֵ֖בֶר לַיַּרְדֵּ֑ן וְלַ֨לְוִיִּ֔ם לֹא־נָתַ֥ן נַחֲלָ֖ה בְּתוֹכָֽם׃
verses.translit: khyntn mshh nchlt shny hmtvt vchtsy hmth m'br lyrdn vllvym l'ntn nchlh btvkhm
verses.translation: For Moses had given the inheritance of the two tribes and the half-tribe beyond the Jordan; but unto the Levites he gave no inheritance among them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־הָי֧וּ בְנֵֽי־יוֹסֵ֛ף שְׁנֵ֥י מַטּ֖וֹת מְנַשֶּׁ֣ה וְאֶפְרָ֑יִם וְלֹֽא־נָתְנוּ֩ חֵ֨לֶק לַלְוִיִּ֜ם בָּאָ֗רֶץ כִּ֤י אִם־עָרִים֙ לָשֶׁ֔בֶת וּמִ֨גְרְשֵׁיהֶ֔ם לְמִקְנֵיהֶ֖ם וּלְקִנְיָנָֽם׃
verses.translit: khyhyv bnyyvsf shny mtvt mnshh v'prym vl'ntnv chlq llvym b'rts khy 'm'rym lshbt vmgrshyhm lmqnyhm vlqnynm
verses.translation: For the children of Joseph were two tribes, Manasseh and Ephraim; and they gave no portion unto the Levites in the land, save cities to dwell in, with the open land about them for their cattle and for their substance.—
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כַּאֲשֶׁ֨ר צִוָּ֤ה יְהֹוָה֙ אֶת־מֹשֶׁ֔ה כֵּ֥ן עָשׂ֖וּ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַֽיַּחְלְק֖וּ אֶת־הָאָֽרֶץ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: kh'shr tsvh yhvh 'tmshh khn 'shv bny yshr'l vychlqv 'th'rts {p}
verses.translation: As the LORD commanded Moses, so the children of Israel did, and they divided the land.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּגְּשׁ֨וּ בְנֵי־יְהוּדָ֤ה אֶל־יְהוֹשֻׁ֙עַ֙ בַּגִּלְגָּ֔ל וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלָ֔יו כָּלֵ֥ב בֶּן־יְפֻנֶּ֖ה הַקְּנִזִּ֑י אַתָּ֣ה יָדַ֡עְתָּ אֶֽת־הַדָּבָר֩ אֲשֶׁר־דִּבֶּ֨ר יְהֹוָ֜ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֣ה אִישׁ־הָאֱלֹהִ֗ים עַ֧ל אֹדוֹתַ֛י וְעַ֥ל אֹדוֹתֶ֖יךָ בְּקָדֵ֥שׁ בַּרְנֵֽעַ׃
verses.translit: vygshv bnyyhvdh 'lyhvsh' bglgl vy'mr 'lyv khlb bnypnh hqnzy 'th yd't 'thdbr 'shrdbr yhvh 'lmshh 'yshh'lhym 'l 'dvty v'l 'dvtykh bqdsh brn'
verses.translation: Then the children of Judah drew nigh unto Joshua in Gilgal; and Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite said unto him: ‘Thou knowest the thing that the LORD spoke unto Moses the man of God concerning me and concerning thee in Kadesh-barnea.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בֶּן־אַרְבָּעִ֨ים שָׁנָ֜ה אָנֹכִ֗י בִּ֠שְׁלֹ֠חַ מֹשֶׁ֨ה עֶבֶד־יְהֹוָ֥ה אֹתִ֛י מִקָּדֵ֥שׁ בַּרְנֵ֖עַ לְרַגֵּ֣ל אֶת־הָאָ֑רֶץ וָאָשֵׁ֤ב אֹתוֹ֙ דָּבָ֔ר כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר עִם־לְֽבָבִֽי׃
verses.translit: bn'rb'ym shnh 'nkhy bshlch mshh 'bdyhvh 'ty mqdsh brn' lrgl 'th'rts v'shb 'tv dbr kh'shr 'mlbby
verses.translation: Forty years old was I when Moses the servant of the LORD sent me from Kadesh-barnea to spy out the land; and I brought him back word as it was in my heart.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאַחַי֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָל֣וּ עִמִּ֔י הִמְסִ֖יו אֶת־לֵ֣ב הָעָ֑ם וְאָנֹכִ֣י מִלֵּ֔אתִי אַחֲרֵ֖י יְהֹוָ֥ה אֱלֹהָֽי׃
verses.translit: v'chy 'shr 'lv 'my hmsyv 'tlb h'm v'nkhy ml'ty 'chry yhvh 'lhy
verses.translation: Nevertheless my brethren that went up with me made the heart of the people melt; but I wholly followed the LORD my God.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּשָּׁבַ֣ע מֹשֶׁ֗ה בַּיּ֣וֹם הַהוּא֮ לֵאמֹר֒ אִם־לֹ֗א הָאָ֙רֶץ֙ אֲשֶׁ֨ר דָּרְכָ֤ה רַגְלְךָ֙ בָּ֔הּ לְךָ֨ תִהְיֶ֧ה לְנַחֲלָ֛ה וּלְבָנֶ֖יךָ עַד־עוֹלָ֑ם כִּ֣י מִלֵּ֔אתָ אַחֲרֵ֖י יְהֹוָ֥ה אֱלֹהָֽי׃
verses.translit: vyshb' mshh byvm hhv' l'mr 'ml' h'rts 'shr drkhh rglkh bh lkh thyh lnchlh vlbnykh 'd'vlm khy ml't 'chry yhvh 'lhy
verses.translation: And Moses swore on that day, saying: Surely the land whereon thy foot hath trodden shall be an inheritance to thee and to thy children for ever, because thou hast wholly followed the LORD my God.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֗ה הִנֵּה֩ הֶחֱיָ֨ה יְהֹוָ֥ה ׀ אוֹתִי֮ כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר דִּבֵּר֒ זֶה֩ אַרְבָּעִ֨ים וְחָמֵ֜שׁ שָׁנָ֗ה מֵ֠אָ֠ז דִּבֶּ֨ר יְהֹוָ֜ה אֶת־הַדָּבָ֤ר הַזֶּה֙ אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־הָלַ֥ךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בַּמִּדְבָּ֑ר וְעַתָּה֙ הִנֵּ֣ה אָנֹכִ֣י הַיּ֔וֹם בֶּן־חָמֵ֥שׁ וּשְׁמֹנִ֖ים שָׁנָֽה׃
verses.translit: v'th hnh hchyh yhvh  'vty kh'shr dbr zh 'rb'ym vchmsh shnh m'z dbr yhvh 'thdbr hzh 'lmshh 'shrhlkh yshr'l bmdbr v'th hnh 'nkhy hyvm bnchmsh vshmnym shnh
verses.translation: And now, behold, the LORD hath kept me alive, as He spoke, these forty and five years, from the time that the LORD spoke this word unto Moses, while Israel walked in the wilderness; and now, lo, I am this day fourscore and five years old.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עוֹדֶ֨נִּי הַיּ֜וֹם חָזָ֗ק כַּֽאֲשֶׁר֙ בְּי֨וֹם שְׁלֹ֤חַ אוֹתִי֙ מֹשֶׁ֔ה כְּכֹ֥חִי אָ֖ז וּכְכֹ֣חִי עָ֑תָּה לַמִּלְחָמָ֖ה וְלָצֵ֥את וְלָבֽוֹא׃
verses.translit: 'vdny hyvm chzq kh'shr byvm shlch 'vty mshh khkhchy 'z vkhkhchy 'th lmlchmh vlts't vlbv'
verses.translation: As yet I am as strong this day as I was in the day that Moses sent me; as my strength was then, even so is my strength now, for war, and to go out and to come in.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֗ה תְּנָה־לִּי֙ אֶת־הָהָ֣ר הַזֶּ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־דִּבֶּ֥ר יְהֹוָ֖ה בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֑וּא כִּ֣י אַתָּֽה־שָׁמַ֩עְתָּ֩ בַיּ֨וֹם הַה֜וּא כִּֽי־עֲנָקִ֣ים שָׁ֗ם וְעָרִים֙ גְּדֹל֣וֹת בְּצֻר֔וֹת אוּלַ֨י יְהֹוָ֤ה אוֹתִי֙ וְה֣וֹרַשְׁתִּ֔ים כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר דִּבֶּ֥ר יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: v'th tnhly 'thhr hzh 'shrdbr yhvh byvm hhv' khy 'thshm't byvm hhv' khy'nqym shm v'rym gdlvt btsrvt 'vly yhvh 'vty vhvrshtym kh'shr dbr yhvh
verses.translation: Now therefore give me this mountain, whereof the LORD spoke in that day; for thou heardest in that day how the Anakim were there, and cities great and fortified; it may be that the LORD will be with me, and I shall drive them out, as the LORD spoke.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽיְבָרְכֵ֖הוּ יְהוֹשֻׁ֑עַ וַיִּתֵּ֧ן אֶת־חֶבְר֛וֹן לְכָלֵ֥ב בֶּן־יְפֻנֶּ֖ה לְנַחֲלָֽה׃
verses.translit: vybrkhhv yhvsh' vytn 'tchbrvn lkhlb bnypnh lnchlh
verses.translation: And Joshua blessed him; and he gave Hebron unto Caleb the son of Jephunneh for an inheritance.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַל־כֵּ֣ן הָיְתָֽה־חֶ֠בְר֠וֹן לְכָלֵ֨ב בֶּן־יְפֻנֶּ֤ה הַקְּנִזִּי֙ לְֽנַחֲלָ֔ה עַ֖ד הַיּ֣וֹם הַזֶּ֑ה יַ֚עַן אֲשֶׁ֣ר מִלֵּ֔א אַחֲרֵ֕י יְהֹוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: 'lkhn hythchbrvn lkhlb bnypnh hqnzy lnchlh 'd hyvm hzh y'n 'shr ml' 'chry yhvh 'lhy yshr'l
verses.translation: Therefore Hebron became the inheritance of Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite, unto this day; because that he wholly followed the LORD, the God of Israel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְשֵׁ֨ם חֶבְר֤וֹן לְפָנִים֙ קִרְיַ֣ת אַרְבַּ֔ע הָאָדָ֧ם הַגָּד֛וֹל בָּעֲנָקִ֖ים ה֑וּא וְהָאָ֥רֶץ שָֽׁקְטָ֖ה מִמִּלְחָמָֽה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vshm chbrvn lpnym qryt 'rb' h'dm hgdvl b'nqym hv' vh'rts shqth mmlchmh {p}
verses.translation: Now the name of Hebron beforetime was Kiriath-arba, which Arba was the greatest man among the Anakim. And the land had rest from war.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֣י הַגּוֹרָ֗ל לְמַטֵּ֛ה בְּנֵ֥י יְהוּדָ֖ה לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֑ם אֶל־גְּב֨וּל אֱד֧וֹם מִדְבַּר־צִ֛ן נֶ֖גְבָּה מִקְצֵ֥ה תֵימָֽן׃
verses.translit: vyhy hgvrl lmth bny yhvdh lmshpchtm 'lgbvl 'dvm mdbrtsn ngbh mqtsh tymn
verses.translation: And the lot for the tribe of the children of Judah according to their families was unto the border of Edom, even to the wilderness of Zin southward, at the uttermost part of the south.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֤י לָהֶם֙ גְּב֣וּל נֶ֔גֶב מִקְצֵ֖ה יָ֣ם הַמֶּ֑לַח מִן־הַלָּשֹׁ֖ן הַפֹּנֶ֥ה נֶֽגְבָּה׃
verses.translit: vyhy lhm gbvl ngb mqtsh ym hmlch mnhlshn hpnh ngbh
verses.translation: And their south border was from the uttermost part of the Salt Sea, from the bay that looked southward.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְ֠יָצָ֠א אֶל־מִנֶּ֜גֶב לְמַעֲלֵ֤ה עַקְרַבִּים֙ וְעָ֣בַר צִ֔נָה וְעָלָ֥ה מִנֶּ֖גֶב לְקָדֵ֣שׁ בַּרְנֵ֑עַ וְעָבַ֤ר חֶצְרוֹן֙ וְעָלָ֣ה אַדָּ֔רָה וְנָסַ֖ב הַקַּרְקָֽעָה׃
verses.translit: vyts' 'lmngb lm'lh 'qrbym v'br tsnh v'lh mngb lqdsh brn' v'br chtsrvn v'lh 'drh vnsb hqrq'h
verses.translation: And it went out southward of the ascent of Akrabbim, and passed along to Zin, and went up by the south of Kadesh-barnea, and passed along by Hezron, and went up to Addar, and turned about to Karka.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעָבַ֣ר עַצְמ֗וֹנָה וְיָצָא֙ נַ֣חַל מִצְרַ֔יִם (והיה) [וְהָי֛וּ] תֹּצְא֥וֹת הַגְּב֖וּל יָ֑מָּה זֶה־יִֽהְיֶ֥ה לָכֶ֖ם גְּב֥וּל נֶֽגֶב׃
verses.translit: v'br 'tsmvnh vyts' nchl mtsrym (vhyh) [vhyv] tts'vt hgbvl ymh zhyhyh lkhm gbvl ngb
verses.translation: And it passed along to Azmon, and went out at the Brook of Egypt; and the goings out of the border were at the sea; this shall be your south border.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּגְב֥וּל קֵ֙דְמָה֙ יָ֣ם הַמֶּ֔לַח עַד־קְצֵ֖ה הַיַּרְדֵּ֑ן וּגְב֞וּל לִפְאַ֤ת צָפ֙וֹנָה֙ מִלְּשׁ֣וֹן הַיָּ֔ם מִקְצֵ֖ה הַיַּרְדֵּֽן׃
verses.translit: vgbvl qdmh ym hmlch 'dqtsh hyrdn vgbvl lp't tspvnh mlshvn hym mqtsh hyrdn
verses.translation: And the east border was the Salt Sea, even unto the end of the Jordan. And the border of the north side was from the bay of the sea at the end of the Jordan.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעָלָ֤ה הַגְּבוּל֙ בֵּ֣ית חׇגְלָ֔ה וְעָבַ֕ר מִצְּפ֖וֹן לְבֵ֣ית הָעֲרָבָ֑ה וְעָלָ֣ה הַגְּב֔וּל אֶ֥בֶן בֹּ֖הַן בֶּן־רְאוּבֵֽן׃
verses.translit: v'lh hgbvl byt chglh v'br mtspvn lbyt h'rbh v'lh hgbvl 'bn bhn bnr'vbn
verses.translation: And the border went up to Beth-hoglah, and passed along by the north of Beth-arabah; and the border went up to the Stone of Bohan the son of Reuben.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעָלָ֨ה הַגְּב֥וּל ׀ דְּבִ֘רָה֮ מֵעֵ֣מֶק עָכוֹר֒ וְצָפ֜וֹנָה פֹּנֶ֣ה אֶל־הַגִּלְגָּ֗ל אֲשֶׁר־נֹ֙כַח֙ לְמַעֲלֵ֣ה אֲדֻמִּ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר מִנֶּ֖גֶב לַנָּ֑חַל וְעָבַ֤ר הַגְּבוּל֙ אֶל־מֵי־עֵ֣ין שֶׁ֔מֶשׁ וְהָי֥וּ תֹצְאֹתָ֖יו אֶל־עֵ֥ין רֹגֵֽל׃
verses.translit: v'lh hgbvl  dbrh m'mq 'khvr vtspvnh pnh 'lhglgl 'shrnkhch lm'lh 'dmym 'shr mngb lnchl v'br hgbvl 'lmy'yn shmsh vhyv tts'tyv 'l'yn rgl
verses.translation: And the border went up to Debir from the valley of Achor, and so northward, looking toward Gilgal, that is over against the ascent of Adummim, which is on the south side of the brook; and the border passed along to the waters of En-shemesh, and the goings out thereof were at En-rogel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעָלָ֨ה הַגְּב֜וּל גֵּ֣י בֶן־הִנֹּ֗ם אֶל־כֶּ֤תֶף הַיְבוּסִי֙ מִנֶּ֔גֶב הִ֖יא יְרוּשָׁלָ֑͏ִם וְעָלָ֨ה הַגְּב֜וּל אֶל־רֹ֣אשׁ הָהָ֗ר אֲ֠שֶׁ֠ר עַל־פְּנֵ֤י גֵֽי־הִנֹּם֙ יָ֔מָּה אֲשֶׁ֛ר בִּקְצֵ֥ה עֵמֶק־רְפָאִ֖ים צָפֽוֹנָה׃
verses.translit: v'lh hgbvl gy bnhnm 'lkhtf hybvsy mngb hy' yrvshl͏m v'lh hgbvl 'lr'sh hhr 'shr 'lpny gyhnm ymh 'shr bqtsh 'mqrp'ym tspvnh
verses.translation: And the border went up by the Valley of the son of Hinnom unto the side of the Jebusite southward—the same is Jerusalem—and the border went up to the top of the mountain that lieth before the Valley of Hinnom westward, which is at the uttermost part of the vale of Rephaim northward.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְתָאַ֨ר הַגְּב֜וּל מֵרֹ֣אשׁ הָהָ֗ר אֶל־מַעְיַן֙ מֵ֣י נֶפְתּ֔וֹחַ וְיָצָ֖א אֶל־עָרֵ֣י הַר־עֶפְר֑וֹן וְתָאַ֤ר הַגְּבוּל֙ בַּעֲלָ֔ה הִ֖יא קִרְיַ֥ת יְעָרִֽים׃
verses.translit: vt'r hgbvl mr'sh hhr 'lm'yn my nptvch vyts' 'l'ry hr'prvn vt'r hgbvl b'lh hy' qryt y'rym
verses.translation: And the border was drawn from the top of the mountain unto the fountain of the waters of Nephtoah, and went out to the cities of mount Ephron; and the border was drawn to Baalah—the same is Kiriath-jearim.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנָסַב֩ הַגְּב֨וּל מִבַּעֲלָ֥ה יָ֙מָּה֙ אֶל־הַ֣ר שֵׂעִ֔יר וְעָבַ֞ר אֶל־כֶּ֧תֶף הַר־יְעָרִ֛ים מִצָּפ֖וֹנָה הִ֣יא כְסָל֑וֹן וְיָרַ֥ד בֵּֽית־שֶׁ֖מֶשׁ וְעָבַ֥ר תִּמְנָֽה׃
verses.translit: vnsb hgbvl mb'lh ymh 'lhr sh'yr v'br 'lkhtf hry'rym mtspvnh hy' khslvn vyrd bytshmsh v'br tmnh
verses.translation: And the border turned about from Baalah westward unto mount Seir, and passed along unto the side of mount Jearim on the north—the same is Chesalon—and went down to Beth-shemesh, and passed along by Timnah.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְיָצָ֨א הַגְּב֜וּל אֶל־כֶּ֣תֶף עֶקְרוֹן֮ צָפ֒וֹנָה֒ וְתָאַ֤ר הַגְּבוּל֙ שִׁכְּר֔וֹנָה וְעָבַ֥ר הַר־הַֽבַּעֲלָ֖ה וְיָצָ֣א יַבְנְאֵ֑ל וְהָי֛וּ תֹּצְא֥וֹת הַגְּב֖וּל יָֽמָּה׃
verses.translit: vyts' hgbvl 'lkhtf 'qrvn tspvnh vt'r hgbvl shkhrvnh v'br hrhb'lh vyts' ybn'l vhyv tts'vt hgbvl ymh
verses.translation: And the border went out unto the side of Ekron northward; and the border was drawn to Shikkeron, and passed along to mount Baalah, and went out at Jabneel; and the goings out of the border were at the sea.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּגְב֣וּל יָ֔ם הַיָּ֥מָּה הַגָּד֖וֹל וּגְב֑וּל זֶ֠ה גְּב֧וּל בְּנֵֽי־יְהוּדָ֛ה סָבִ֖יב לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָֽם׃
verses.translit: vgbvl ym hymh hgdvl vgbvl zh gbvl bnyyhvdh sbyb lmshpchtm
verses.translation: And as for the west border, the Great Sea was the border thereof. This is the border of the children of Judah round about according to their families.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּלְכָלֵ֣ב בֶּן־יְפֻנֶּ֗ה נָ֤תַן חֵ֙לֶק֙ בְּת֣וֹךְ בְּנֵֽי־יְהוּדָ֔ה אֶל־פִּ֥י יְהֹוָ֖ה לִיהוֹשֻׁ֑עַ אֶת־קִרְיַ֥ת אַרְבַּ֛ע אֲבִ֥י הָעֲנָ֖ק הִ֥יא חֶבְרֽוֹן׃
verses.translit: vlkhlb bnypnh ntn chlq btvkh bnyyhvdh 'lpy yhvh lyhvsh' 'tqryt 'rb' 'by h'nq hy' chbrvn
verses.translation: And unto Caleb the son of Jephunneh he gave a portion among the children of Judah, according to the commandment of the LORD to Joshua, even Kiriath-arba, which Arba was the father of Anak—the same is Hebron.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤רֶשׁ מִשָּׁם֙ כָּלֵ֔ב אֶת־שְׁלוֹשָׁ֖ה בְּנֵ֣י הָעֲנָ֑ק אֶת־שֵׁשַׁ֤י וְאֶת־אֲחִימַן֙ וְאֶת־תַּלְמַ֔י יְלִידֵ֖י הָעֲנָֽק׃
verses.translit: vyrsh mshm khlb 'tshlvshh bny h'nq 'tshshy v't'chymn v'ttlmy ylydy h'nq
verses.translation: And Caleb drove out thence the three sons of Anak, Sheshai, and Ahiman, and Talmai, the children of Anak.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֣עַל מִשָּׁ֔ם אֶל־יֹשְׁבֵ֖י דְּבִ֑ר וְשֵׁם־דְּבִ֥ר לְפָנִ֖ים קִרְיַת־סֵֽפֶר׃
verses.translit: vy'l mshm 'lyshby dbr vshmdbr lpnym qrytspr
verses.translation: And he went up thence against the inhabitants of Debir—now the name of Debir beforetime was Kiriath-sepher.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר כָּלֵ֔ב אֲשֶׁר־יַכֶּ֥ה אֶת־קִרְיַת־סֵ֖פֶר וּלְכָדָ֑הּ וְנָתַ֥תִּי ל֛וֹ אֶת־עַכְסָ֥ה בִתִּ֖י לְאִשָּֽׁה׃
verses.translit: vy'mr khlb 'shrykhh 'tqrytspr vlkhdh vntty lv 't'khsh bty l'shh
verses.translation: And Caleb said: ‘He that smiteth Kiriath-sepher, and taketh it, to him will I give Achsah my daughter to wife.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽיִּלְכְּדָ֛הּ עׇתְנִיאֵ֥ל בֶּן־קְנַ֖ז אֲחִ֣י כָלֵ֑ב וַיִּתֶּן־ל֛וֹ אֶת־עַכְסָ֥ה בִתּ֖וֹ לְאִשָּֽׁה׃
verses.translit: vylkhdh 'tny'l bnqnz 'chy khlb vytnlv 't'khsh btv l'shh
verses.translation: And Othniel the son of Kenaz, the brother of Caleb, took it; and he gave him Achsah his daughter to wife. .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֣י  בְּבוֹאָ֗הּ וַתְּסִיתֵ֙הוּ֙ לִשְׁא֤וֹל מֵאֵת־אָבִ֙יהָ֙ שָׂדֶ֔ה וַתִּצְנַ֖ח מֵעַ֣ל הַחֲמ֑וֹר וַיֹּֽאמֶר־לָ֥הּ כָּלֵ֖ב מַה־לָּֽךְ׃
verses.translit: vyhy  bbv'h vtsythv lsh'vl m't'byh shdh vttsnch m'l hchmvr vy'mrlh khlb mhlkh
verses.translation: And it came to pass, when she came unto him, that she persuaded him to ask of her father a field; and she alighted from off her ass; and Caleb said unto her: ‘What wouldest thou?’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתֹּ֜אמֶר תְּנָה־לִּ֣י בְרָכָ֗ה כִּ֣י אֶ֤רֶץ הַנֶּ֙גֶב֙ נְתַתָּ֔נִי וְנָתַתָּ֥ה לִ֖י גֻּלֹּ֣ת מָ֑יִם וַיִּתֶּן־לָ֗הּ אֵ֚ת גֻּלֹּ֣ת עִלִּיּ֔וֹת וְאֵ֖ת גֻּלֹּ֥ת תַּחְתִּיּֽוֹת׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vt'mr tnhly brkhh khy 'rts hngb nttny vntth ly glt mym vytnlh 't glt 'lyvt v't glt tchtyvt {p}
verses.translation: And she said: ‘Give me a blessing; for that thou hast set me in the Southland, give me therefore springs of water.’ And he gave her the Upper Springs and the Nether Springs.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: זֹ֗את נַחֲלַ֛ת מַטֵּ֥ה בְנֵֽי־יְהוּדָ֖ה לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָֽם׃
verses.translit: z't nchlt mth bnyyhvdh lmshpchtm
verses.translation: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Judah according to their families.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּֽהְי֣וּ הֶֽעָרִ֗ים מִקְצֵה֙ לְמַטֵּ֣ה בְנֵֽי־יְהוּדָ֔ה אֶל־גְּב֥וּל אֱד֖וֹם בַּנֶּ֑גְבָּה קַבְצְאֵ֥ל וְעֵ֖דֶר וְיָגֽוּר׃
verses.translit: vyhyv h'rym mqtsh lmth bnyyhvdh 'lgbvl 'dvm bngbh qbts'l v'dr vygvr
verses.translation: And the cities at the uttermost part of the tribe of the children of Judah toward the border of Edom in the South were Kabzeel, and Eder, and Jagur;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְקִינָ֥ה וְדִימוֹנָ֖ה וְעַדְעָדָֽה׃
verses.translit: vqynh vdymvnh v'd'dh
verses.translation: and Kinah, and Dimonah, and Adadah;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְקֶ֥דֶשׁ וְחָצ֖וֹר וְיִתְנָֽן׃
verses.translit: vqdsh vchtsvr vytnn
verses.translation: and Kedesh, and Hazor, and Ithnan;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: זִ֥יף וָטֶ֖לֶם וּבְעָלֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: zyf vtlm vb'lvt
verses.translation: Ziph, and Telem, and Bealoth;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְחָצ֤וֹר ׀ חֲדַתָּה֙ וּקְרִיּ֔וֹת חֶצְר֖וֹן הִ֥יא חָצֽוֹר׃
verses.translit: vchtsvr  chdth vqryvt chtsrvn hy' chtsvr
verses.translation: and Hazor, and Hadattah, and Kerioth, and Hezron—the same is Hazor;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲמָ֥ם וּשְׁמַ֖ע וּמוֹלָדָֽה׃
verses.translit: 'mm vshm' vmvldh
verses.translation: Amam, and Shema, and Moladah;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַחֲצַ֥ר גַּדָּ֛ה וְחֶשְׁמ֖וֹן וּבֵ֥ית פָּֽלֶט׃
verses.translit: vchtsr gdh vchshmvn vbyt plt
verses.translation: and Hazar-gaddah, and Heshmon, and Beth-pelet;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַחֲצַ֥ר שׁוּעָ֛ל וּבְאֵ֥ר שֶׁ֖בַע וּבִזְיוֹתְיָֽה׃
verses.translit: vchtsr shv'l vb'r shb' vbzyvtyh
verses.translation: and Hazar-shual, and Beer-sheba, and Biziothiah;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בַּעֲלָ֥ה וְעִיִּ֖ים וָעָֽצֶם׃
verses.translit: b'lh v'yym v'tsm
verses.translation: Baalah, and Iim, and Ezem;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֶלְתּוֹלַ֥ד וּכְסִ֖יל וְחׇרְמָֽה׃
verses.translit: v'ltvld vkhsyl vchrmh
verses.translation: and Eltolad, and Chesil, and Hormah;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְצִֽקְלַ֥ג וּמַדְמַנָּ֖ה וְסַנְסַנָּֽה׃
verses.translit: vtsqlg vmdmnh vsnsnh
verses.translation: and Ziklag, and Madmannah, and Sansannah;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּלְבָא֥וֹת וְשִׁלְחִ֖ים וְעַ֣יִן וְרִמּ֑וֹן כׇּל־עָרִ֛ים עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וָתֵ֖שַׁע וְחַצְרֵיהֶֽן׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vlb'vt vshlchym v'yn vrmvn khl'rym 'shrym vtsh' vchtsryhn {s}
verses.translation: and Lebaoth, and Shilhim, and Ain, and Rimmon; all the cities are twenty and nine, with their villages.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בַּשְּׁפֵלָ֑ה אֶשְׁתָּא֥וֹל וְצׇרְעָ֖ה וְאַשְׁנָֽה׃
verses.translit: bshplh 'sht'vl vtsr'h v'shnh
verses.translation: In the Lowland: Eshtaol, and Zorah, and Ashnah;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְזָנ֙וֹחַ֙ וְעֵ֣ין גַּנִּ֔ים תַּפּ֖וּחַ וְהָעֵינָֽם׃
verses.translit: vznvch v'yn gnym tpvch vh'ynm
verses.translation: and Zanoah, and En-gannim, Tappuah, and Enam;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יַרְמוּת֙ וַֽעֲדֻלָּ֔ם שׂוֹכֹ֖ה וַעֲזֵקָֽה׃
verses.translit: yrmvt v'dlm shvkhh v'zqh
verses.translation: Jarmuth, and Adullam, Socoh, and Azekah;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְשַׁעֲרַ֙יִם֙ וַֽעֲדִיתַ֔יִם וְהַגְּדֵרָ֖ה וּגְדֵרֹתָ֑יִם עָרִ֥ים אַרְבַּֽע־עֶשְׂרֵ֖ה וְחַצְרֵיהֶֽן׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vsh'rym v'dytym vhgdrh vgdrtym 'rym 'rb''shrh vchtsryhn {s}
verses.translation: and Shaaraim, and Adithaim, and Gederah, with Gederothaim; fourteen cities with their villages.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: צְנָ֥ן וַחֲדָשָׁ֖ה וּמִגְדַּל־גָּֽד׃
verses.translit: tsnn vchdshh vmgdlgd
verses.translation: Zenan, and Hadashah, and Migdal-gad;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְדִלְעָ֥ן וְהַמִּצְפֶּ֖ה וְיׇקְתְאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: vdl'n vhmtsph vyqt'l
verses.translation: and Dilan, and Mizpeh, and Joktheel;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לָכִ֥ישׁ וּבׇצְקַ֖ת וְעֶגְלֽוֹן׃
verses.translit: lkhysh vbtsqt v'glvn
verses.translation: Lachish, and Bozkath, and Eglon;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְכַבּ֥וֹן וְלַחְמָ֖ס וְכִתְלִֽישׁ׃
verses.translit: vkhbvn vlchms vkhtlysh
verses.translation: and Cabbon, and Lahmas, and Chithlish;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּגְדֵר֕וֹת בֵּית־דָּג֥וֹן וְנַעֲמָ֖ה וּמַקֵּדָ֑ה עָרִ֥ים שֵׁשׁ־עֶשְׂרֵ֖ה וְחַצְרֵיהֶֽן׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vgdrvt bytdgvn vn'mh vmqdh 'rym shsh'shrh vchtsryhn {s}
verses.translation: and Gederoth, Beth-dagon, and Naamah, and Makkedah; sixteen cities with their villages.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לִבְנָ֥ה וָעֶ֖תֶר וְעָשָֽׁן׃
verses.translit: lbnh v'tr v'shn
verses.translation: Libnah, and Ether, and Ashan;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְיִפְתָּ֥ח וְאַשְׁנָ֖ה וּנְצִֽיב׃
verses.translit: vyptch v'shnh vntsyb
verses.translation: and Iphtah, and Ashnah, and Nezib;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּקְעִילָ֥ה וְאַכְזִ֖יב וּמָֽרֵאשָׁ֑ה עָרִ֥ים תֵּ֖שַׁע וְחַצְרֵיהֶֽן׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vq'ylh v'khzyb vmr'shh 'rym tsh' vchtsryhn {s}
verses.translation: and Keilah, and Achzib, and Mareshah; nine cities with their villages.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עֶקְר֥וֹן וּבְנֹתֶ֖יהָ וַחֲצֵרֶֽיהָ׃
verses.translit: 'qrvn vbntyh vchtsryh
verses.translation: Ekron, with its towns and its villages;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מֵעֶקְר֖וֹן וָיָ֑מָּה כֹּ֛ל אֲשֶׁר־עַל־יַ֥ד אַשְׁדּ֖וֹד וְחַצְרֵיהֶֽן׃ {ס}
verses.translit: m'qrvn vymh khl 'shr'lyd 'shdvd vchtsryhn {s}
verses.translation: from Ekron even unto the sea, all that were by the side of Ashdod, with their villages.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַשְׁדּ֞וֹד בְּנוֹתֶ֣יהָ וַחֲצֵרֶ֗יהָ עַזָּ֛ה בְּנוֹתֶ֥יהָ וַחֲצֵרֶ֖יהָ עַד־נַ֣חַל מִצְרָ֑יִם וְהַיָּ֥ם (הגבול) [הַגָּד֖וֹל] וּגְבֽוּל׃ {ס}
verses.translit: 'shdvd bnvtyh vchtsryh 'zh bnvtyh vchtsryh 'dnchl mtsrym vhym (hgbvl) [hgdvl] vgbvl {s}
verses.translation: Ashdod, its towns and its villages; Gaza, its towns and its villages; unto the Brook of Egypt, the Great Sea being the border thereof.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבָהָ֑ר שָׁמִ֥יר וְיַתִּ֖יר וְשׂוֹכֹֽה׃
verses.translit: vbhr shmyr vytyr vshvkhh
verses.translation: And in the hill-country: Shamir, and Jattir, and Socoh;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְדַנָּ֥ה וְקִרְיַת־סַנָּ֖ה הִ֥יא דְבִֽר׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vdnh vqrytsnh hy' dbr {s}
verses.translation: and Dannah, and Kiriath-sannah—the same is Debir;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַעֲנָ֥ב וְאֶשְׁתְּמֹ֖ה וְעָנִֽים׃
verses.translit: v'nb v'shtmh v'nym
verses.translation: and Anab, and Eshtemoh, and Anim;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְגֹ֥שֶׁן וְחֹלֹ֖ן וְגִלֹ֑ה עָרִ֥ים אַחַת־עֶשְׂרֵ֖ה וְחַצְרֵיהֶֽן׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vgshn vchln vglh 'rym 'cht'shrh vchtsryhn {s}
verses.translation: and Goshen, and Holon, and Giloh; eleven cities with their villages.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲרַ֥ב וְרוּמָ֖ה וְאֶשְׁעָֽן׃
verses.translit: 'rb vrvmh v'sh'n
verses.translation: Arab, and Rumah, and Eshan;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: (וינים) [וְיָנ֥וּם] וּבֵית־תַּפּ֖וּחַ וַאֲפֵֽקָה׃
verses.translit: (vynym) [vynvm] vbyttpvch v'pqh
verses.translation: and Janum, and Beth-tappuah, and Aphekah;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְחֻמְטָ֗ה וְקִרְיַ֥ת אַרְבַּ֛ע הִ֥יא חֶבְר֖וֹן וְצִיעֹ֑ר עָרִ֥ים תֵּ֖שַׁע וְחַצְרֵיהֶֽן׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vchmth vqryt 'rb' hy' chbrvn vtsy'r 'rym tsh' vchtsryhn {s}
verses.translation: and Humtah, and Kiriath-arba—the same is Hebron, and Zior; nine cities with their villages.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מָע֥וֹן ׀ כַּרְמֶ֖ל וָזִ֥יף וְיוּטָּֽה׃
verses.translit: m'vn  khrml vzyf vyvth
verses.translation: Maon, Carmel, and Ziph, and Juttah;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְיִזְרְעֶ֥אל וְיׇקְדְעָ֖ם וְזָנֽוֹחַ׃
verses.translit: vyzr''l vyqd'm vznvch
verses.translation: and Jezreel, and Jokdeam, and Zanoah;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַקַּ֖יִן גִּבְעָ֣ה וְתִמְנָ֑ה עָרִ֥ים עֶ֖שֶׂר וְחַצְרֵיהֶֽן׃ {ס}
verses.translit: hqyn gb'h vtmnh 'rym 'shr vchtsryhn {s}
verses.translation: Kain, Gibeah, and Timnah; ten cities with their villages.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: חַלְח֥וּל בֵּֽית־צ֖וּר וּגְדֽוֹר׃
verses.translit: chlchvl byttsvr vgdvr
verses.translation: Halhul, Beth-zur, and Gedor;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמַעֲרָ֥ת וּבֵית־עֲנ֖וֹת וְאֶלְתְּקֹ֑ן עָרִ֥ים שֵׁ֖שׁ וְחַצְרֵיהֶֽן׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vm'rt vbyt'nvt v'ltqn 'rym shsh vchtsryhn {p}
verses.translation: and Maarath, and Beth-anoth, and Eltekon; six cities with their villages.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: קִרְיַת־בַּ֗עַל הִ֛יא קִרְיַ֥ת יְעָרִ֖ים וְהָרַבָּ֑ה עָרִ֥ים שְׁתַּ֖יִם וְחַצְרֵיהֶֽן׃ {ס}
verses.translit: qrytb'l hy' qryt y'rym vhrbh 'rym shtym vchtsryhn {s}
verses.translation: Kiriath-baal—the same is Kiriath-jearim, and Rabbah; two cities with their villages.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בַּמִּדְבָּ֑ר בֵּ֚ית הָעֲרָבָ֔ה מִדִּ֖ין וּסְכָכָֽה׃
verses.translit: bmdbr byt h'rbh mdyn vskhkhh
verses.translation: In the wilderness: Beth-arabah, Middin, and Secacah;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהַנִּבְשָׁ֥ן וְעִיר־הַמֶּ֖לַח וְעֵ֣ין גֶּ֑דִי עָרִ֥ים שֵׁ֖שׁ וְחַצְרֵיהֶֽן׃
verses.translit: vhnbshn v'yrhmlch v'yn gdy 'rym shsh vchtsryhn
verses.translation: and Nibshan, and the City of Salt, and En-gedi; six cities with their villages.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֶת־הַיְבוּסִי֙ יוֹשְׁבֵ֣י יְרוּשָׁלַ֔͏ִם לֹא־[יָכְל֥וּ] (יוכלו) בְנֵי־יְהוּדָ֖ה לְהוֹרִישָׁ֑ם וַיֵּ֨שֶׁב הַיְבוּסִ֜י אֶת־בְּנֵ֤י יְהוּדָה֙ בִּיר֣וּשָׁלַ֔͏ִם עַ֖ד הַיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: v'thybvsy yvshby yrvshl͏m l'[ykhlv] (yvkhlv) bnyyhvdh lhvryshm vyshb hybvsy 'tbny yhvdh byrvshl͏m 'd hyvm hzh {p}
verses.translation: And as for the Jebusites, the inhabitants of Jerusalem, the children of Judah could not drive them out; but the Jebusites dwelt with the children of Judah at Jerusalem, unto this day.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֵּצֵ֨א הַגּוֹרָ֜ל לִבְנֵ֤י יוֹסֵף֙ מִיַּרְדֵּ֣ן יְרִיח֔וֹ לְמֵ֥י יְרִיח֖וֹ מִזְרָ֑חָה הַמִּדְבָּ֗ר עֹלֶ֧ה מִירִיח֛וֹ בָּהָ֖ר בֵּֽית־אֵֽל׃
verses.translit: vyts' hgvrl lbny yvsf myrdn yrychv lmy yrychv mzrchh hmdbr 'lh myrychv bhr byt'l
verses.translation: And the lot for the children of Joseph went out from the Jordan at Jericho, at the waters of Jericho on the east, going up from Jericho through the hill-country to the wilderness, even to Beth-el.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְיָצָ֥א מִבֵּֽית־אֵ֖ל ל֑וּזָה וְעָבַ֛ר אֶל־גְּב֥וּל הָאַרְכִּ֖י עֲטָרֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: vyts' mbyt'l lvzh v'br 'lgbvl h'rkhy 'trvt
verses.translation: And it went out from Beth-el-luz, and passed along unto the border of the Archites to Ataroth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְיָֽרַד־יָ֜מָּה אֶל־גְּב֣וּל הַיַּפְלֵטִ֗י עַ֣ד גְּב֧וּל בֵּית־חוֹרֹ֛ן תַּחְתּ֖וֹן וְעַד־גָּ֑זֶר וְהָי֥וּ תֹצְאֹתָ֖ו יָֽמָּה׃
verses.translit: vyrdymh 'lgbvl hyplty 'd gbvl bytchvrn tchtvn v'dgzr vhyv tts'tv ymh
verses.translation: And it went down westward to the border of the Japhletites, unto the border of Beth-horon the nether, even unto Gezer; and the goings out thereof were at the sea.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּנְחֲל֥וּ בְנֵֽי־יוֹסֵ֖ף מְנַשֶּׁ֥ה וְאֶפְרָֽיִם׃
verses.translit: vynchlv bnyyvsf mnshh v'prym
verses.translation: And the children of Joseph, Manasseh and Ephraim, took their inheritance.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֛י גְּב֥וּל בְּנֵֽי־אֶפְרַ֖יִם לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֑ם וַיְהִ֞י גְּב֤וּל נַחֲלָתָם֙ מִזְרָ֔חָה עַטְר֣וֹת אַדָּ֔ר עַד־בֵּ֥ית חוֹרֹ֖ן עֶלְיֽוֹן׃
verses.translit: vyhy gbvl bny'prym lmshpchtm vyhy gbvl nchltm mzrchh 'trvt 'dr 'dbyt chvrn 'lyvn
verses.translation: And the border of the children of Ephraim according to their families was thus; even the border of their inheritance eastward was Atroth-addar, unto Beth-horon the upper.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְיָצָ֨א הַגְּב֜וּל הַיָּ֗מָּה הַֽמִּכְמְתָת֙ מִצָּפ֔וֹן וְנָסַ֧ב הַגְּב֛וּל מִזְרָ֖חָה תַּאֲנַ֣ת שִׁלֹ֑ה וְעָבַ֣ר אוֹת֔וֹ מִמִּזְרַ֖ח יָנֽוֹחָה׃
verses.translit: vyts' hgbvl hymh hmkhmtt mtspvn vnsb hgbvl mzrchh t'nt shlh v'br 'vtv mmzrch ynvchh
