verses.translation: And the border went out westward, Mich-methath being on the north; and the border turned about eastward unto Taanath-shiloh, and passed along it on the east of Janoah.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְיָרַ֥ד מִיָּנ֖וֹחָה עֲטָר֣וֹת וְנַעֲרָ֑תָה וּפָגַע֙ בִּֽירִיח֔וֹ וְיָצָ֖א הַיַּרְדֵּֽן׃
verses.translit: vyrd mynvchh 'trvt vn'rth vpg' byrychv vyts' hyrdn
verses.translation: And it went down from Janoah to Ataroth, and to Naarah, and reached unto Jericho, and went out at the Jordan.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִתַּפּ֜וּחַ יֵלֵ֨ךְ הַגְּב֥וּל יָ֙מָּה֙ נַ֣חַל קָנָ֔ה וְהָי֥וּ תֹצְאֹתָ֖יו הַיָּ֑מָּה זֹ֗את נַחֲלַ֛ת מַטֵּ֥ה בְנֵֽי־אֶפְרַ֖יִם לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָֽם׃
verses.translit: mtpvch ylkh hgbvl ymh nchl qnh vhyv tts'tyv hymh z't nchlt mth bny'prym lmshpchtm
verses.translation: From Tappuah the border went along westward to the brook of Kanah; and the goings out thereof were at the sea. This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Ephraim according to their families;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהֶעָרִ֗ים הַמִּבְדָּלוֹת֙ לִבְנֵ֣י אֶפְרַ֔יִם בְּת֖וֹךְ נַחֲלַ֣ת בְּנֵֽי־מְנַשֶּׁ֑ה כׇּל־הֶעָרִ֖ים וְחַצְרֵיהֶֽן׃
verses.translit: vh'rym hmbdlvt lbny 'prym btvkh nchlt bnymnshh khlh'rym vchtsryhn
verses.translation: together with the cities which were separated for the children of Ephraim in the midst of the inheritance of the children of Manasseh, all the cities with their villages.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלֹ֣א הוֹרִ֔ישׁוּ אֶת־הַֽכְּנַעֲנִ֖י הַיּוֹשֵׁ֣ב בְּגָ֑זֶר וַיֵּ֨שֶׁב הַֽכְּנַעֲנִ֜י בְּקֶ֤רֶב אֶפְרַ֙יִם֙ עַד־הַיּ֣וֹם הַזֶּ֔ה וַיְהִ֖י לְמַס־עֹבֵֽד׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vl' hvryshv 'thkhn'ny hyvshb bgzr vyshb hkhn'ny bqrb 'prym 'dhyvm hzh vyhy lms'bd {p}
verses.translation: And they drove not out the Canaanites that dwelt in Gezer; but the Canaanites dwelt in the midst of Ephraim, unto this day, and became servants to do taskwork.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֤י הַגּוֹרָל֙ לְמַטֵּ֣ה מְנַשֶּׁ֔ה כִּי־ה֖וּא בְּכ֣וֹר יוֹסֵ֑ף לְמָכִיר֩ בְּכ֨וֹר מְנַשֶּׁ֜ה אֲבִ֣י הַגִּלְעָ֗ד כִּ֣י ה֤וּא הָיָה֙ אִ֣ישׁ מִלְחָמָ֔ה וַֽיְהִי־ל֖וֹ הַגִּלְעָ֥ד וְהַבָּשָֽׁן׃
verses.translit: vyhy hgvrl lmth mnshh khyhv' bkhvr yvsf lmkhyr bkhvr mnshh 'by hgl'd khy hv' hyh 'ysh mlchmh vyhylv hgl'd vhbshn
verses.translation: And this was the lot for the tribe of Manasseh; for he was the first-born of Joseph. As for Machir the first-born of Manasseh, the father of Gilead, because he was a man of war, therefore he had Gilead and Bashan.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַ֠יְהִ֠י לִבְנֵ֨י מְנַשֶּׁ֥ה הַנּֽוֹתָרִים֮ לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם֒ לִבְנֵ֨י אֲבִיעֶ֜זֶר וְלִבְנֵי־חֵ֗לֶק וְלִבְנֵ֤י אַשְׂרִיאֵל֙ וְלִבְנֵי־שֶׁ֔כֶם וְלִבְנֵי־חֵ֖פֶר וְלִבְנֵ֣י שְׁמִידָ֑ע אֵ֠לֶּה בְּנֵ֨י מְנַשֶּׁ֧ה בֶן־יוֹסֵ֛ף הַזְּכָרִ֖ים לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָֽם׃
verses.translit: vyhy lbny mnshh hnvtrym lmshpchtm lbny 'by'zr vlbnychlq vlbny 'shry'l vlbnyshkhm vlbnychpr vlbny shmyd' 'lh bny mnshh bnyvsf hzkhrym lmshpchtm
verses.translation: And the lot was for the rest of the children of Manasseh according to their families; for the children of Abiezer, and for the children of Helek, and for the children of Asriel, and for the children of Shechem, and for the children of Hepher, and for the children of Shemida; these were the male children of Manasseh the son of Joseph according to their families.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלִצְלׇפְחָד֩ בֶּן־חֵ֨פֶר בֶּן־גִּלְעָ֜ד בֶּן־מָכִ֣יר בֶּן־מְנַשֶּׁ֗ה לֹא־הָ֥יוּ ל֛וֹ בָּנִ֖ים כִּ֣י אִם־בָּנ֑וֹת וְאֵ֙לֶּה֙ שְׁמ֣וֹת בְּנֹתָ֔יו מַחְלָ֣ה וְנֹעָ֔ה חׇגְלָ֥ה מִלְכָּ֖ה וְתִרְצָֽה׃
verses.translit: vltslpchd bnchpr bngl'd bnmkhyr bnmnshh l'hyv lv bnym khy 'mbnvt v'lh shmvt bntyv mchlh vn'h chglh mlkhh vtrtsh
verses.translation: But Zelophehad, the son of Hepher, the son of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, had no sons, but daughters; and these are the names of his daughters: Mahlah, and Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתִּקְרַ֡בְנָה לִפְנֵי֩ אֶלְעָזָ֨ר הַכֹּהֵ֜ן וְלִפְנֵ֣י  יְהוֹשֻׁ֣עַ בִּן־נ֗וּן וְלִפְנֵ֤י הַנְּשִׂיאִים֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר יְהֹוָה֙ צִוָּ֣ה אֶת־מֹשֶׁ֔ה לָתֶת־לָ֥נוּ נַחֲלָ֖ה בְּת֣וֹךְ אַחֵ֑ינוּ וַיִּתֵּ֨ן לָהֶ֜ם אֶל־פִּ֤י יְהֹוָה֙ נַחֲלָ֔ה בְּת֖וֹךְ אֲחֵ֥י אֲבִיהֶֽן׃
verses.translit: vtqrbnh lpny 'l'zr hkhhn vlpny  yhvsh' bnnvn vlpny hnshy'ym l'mr yhvh tsvh 'tmshh lttlnv nchlh btvkh 'chynv vytn lhm 'lpy yhvh nchlh btvkh 'chy 'byhn
verses.translation: And they came near before Eleazar the priest, and before Joshua the son of Nun, and before the princes, saying: ‘The LORD commanded Moses to give us an inheritance among our brethren’; therefore according to the commandment of the LORD he gave them an inheritance among the brethren of their father.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּפְּל֥וּ חַבְלֵֽי־מְנַשֶּׁ֖ה עֲשָׂרָ֑ה לְבַ֞ד מֵאֶ֤רֶץ הַגִּלְעָד֙ וְהַבָּשָׁ֔ן אֲשֶׁ֖ר מֵעֵ֥בֶר לַיַּרְדֵּֽן׃
verses.translit: vyplv chblymnshh 'shrh lbd m'rts hgl'd vhbshn 'shr m'br lyrdn
verses.translation: And there fell ten parts to Manasseh, beside the land of Gilead and Bashan, which is beyond the Jordan;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֚י בְּנ֣וֹת מְנַשֶּׁ֔ה נָחֲל֥וּ נַחֲלָ֖ה בְּת֣וֹךְ בָּנָ֑יו וְאֶ֙רֶץ֙ הַגִּלְעָ֔ד הָיְתָ֖ה לִבְנֵי־מְנַשֶּׁ֥ה הַנּוֹתָרִֽים׃
verses.translit: khy bnvt mnshh nchlv nchlh btvkh bnyv v'rts hgl'd hyth lbnymnshh hnvtrym
verses.translation: because the daughters of Manasseh had an inheritance among his sons; and the land of Gilead belonged unto the rest of the sons of Manasseh.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֤י גְבוּל־מְנַשֶּׁה֙ מֵאָשֵׁ֔ר הַֽמִּכְמְתָ֔ת אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל־פְּנֵ֣י שְׁכֶ֑ם וְהָלַ֤ךְ הַגְּבוּל֙ אֶל־הַיָּמִ֔ין אֶל־יֹשְׁבֵ֖י עֵ֥ין תַּפּֽוּחַ׃
verses.translit: vyhy gbvlmnshh m'shr hmkhmtt 'shr 'lpny shkhm vhlkh hgbvl 'lhymyn 'lyshby 'yn tpvch
verses.translation: And the border of Manasseh was, beginning from Asher, Michmethath, which is before Shechem; and the border went along to the right hand, unto the inhabitants of En-tappuah.—
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לִמְנַשֶּׁ֕ה הָיְתָ֖ה אֶ֣רֶץ תַּפּ֑וּחַ וְתַפּ֛וּחַ אֶל־גְּב֥וּל מְנַשֶּׁ֖ה לִבְנֵ֥י אֶפְרָֽיִם׃
verses.translit: lmnshh hyth 'rts tpvch vtpvch 'lgbvl mnshh lbny 'prym
verses.translation: The land of Tappuah belonged to Manasseh; but Tappuah on the border of Manasseh belonged to the children of Ephraim.—
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְיָרַ֣ד הַגְּבוּל֩ נַ֨חַל קָנָ֜ה נֶ֣גְבָּה לַנַּ֗חַל עָרִ֤ים הָאֵ֙לֶּה֙ לְאֶפְרַ֔יִם בְּת֖וֹךְ עָרֵ֣י מְנַשֶּׁ֑ה וּגְב֤וּל מְנַשֶּׁה֙ מִצְּפ֣וֹן לַנַּ֔חַל וַיְהִ֥י תֹצְאֹתָ֖יו הַיָּֽמָּה׃
verses.translit: vyrd hgbvl nchl qnh ngbh lnchl 'rym h'lh l'prym btvkh 'ry mnshh vgbvl mnshh mtspvn lnchl vyhy tts'tyv hymh
verses.translation: And the border went down unto the brook of Kanah, southward of the brook, by cities which belonged to Ephraim among the cities of Manasseh; but the border of Manasseh was on the north side of the brook; and the goings out thereof were at the sea:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נֶ֣גְבָּה לְאֶפְרַ֗יִם וְצָפ֙וֹנָה֙ לִמְנַשֶּׁ֔ה וַיְהִ֥י הַיָּ֖ם גְּבוּל֑וֹ וּבְאָשֵׁר֙ יִפְגְּע֣וּן מִצָּפ֔וֹן וּבְיִשָּׂשכָ֖ר מִמִּזְרָֽח׃
verses.translit: ngbh l'prym vtspvnh lmnshh vyhy hym gbvlv vb'shr ypg'vn mtspvn vbyshshkhr mmzrch
verses.translation: southward it was Ephraim’s, and northward it was Manasseh’s, and the sea was his border; and they reached to Asher on the north, and to Issachar on the east.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֨י לִמְנַשֶּׁ֜ה בְּיִשָּׂשכָ֣ר וּבְאָשֵׁ֗ר בֵּית־שְׁאָ֣ן וּ֠בְנוֹתֶ֠יהָ וְיִבְלְעָ֨ם וּבְנוֹתֶ֜יהָ וְֽאֶת־יֹשְׁבֵ֧י דֹ֣אר וּבְנוֹתֶ֗יהָ וְיֹשְׁבֵ֤י עֵֽין־דֹּר֙ וּבְנוֹתֶ֔יהָ וְיֹשְׁבֵ֤י תַעְנַךְ֙ וּבְנֹתֶ֔יהָ וְיֹשְׁבֵ֥י מְגִדּ֖וֹ וּבְנוֹתֶ֑יהָ שְׁלֹ֖שֶׁת הַנָּֽפֶת׃
verses.translit: vyhy lmnshh byshshkhr vb'shr bytsh'n vbnvtyh vybl'm vbnvtyh v'tyshby d'r vbnvtyh vyshby 'yndr vbnvtyh vyshby t'nkh vbntyh vyshby mgdv vbnvtyh shlsht hnpt
verses.translation: And Manasseh had in Issachar and in Asher Beth-shean and its towns, and Ibleam and its towns, and the inhabitants of Dor and its towns, and the inhabitants of En-dor and its towns, and the inhabitants of Taanach and its towns, and the inhabitants of Megiddo and its towns, even the three regions.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלֹ֤א יָֽכְלוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י מְנַשֶּׁ֔ה לְהוֹרִ֖ישׁ אֶת־הֶעָרִ֣ים הָאֵ֑לֶּה וַיּ֙וֹאֶל֙ הַֽכְּנַעֲנִ֔י לָשֶׁ֖בֶת בָּאָ֥רֶץ הַזֹּֽאת׃
verses.translit: vl' ykhlv bny mnshh lhvrysh 'th'rym h'lh vyv'l hkhn'ny lshbt b'rts hz't
verses.translation: Yet the children of Manasseh could not drive out the inhabitants of those cities; but the Canaanites were resolved to dwell in that land.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֗י כִּ֤י חָֽזְקוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וַיִּתְּנ֥וּ אֶת־הַֽכְּנַעֲנִ֖י לָמַ֑ס וְהוֹרֵ֖שׁ לֹ֥א הֽוֹרִישֽׁוֹ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vyhy khy chzqv bny yshr'l vytnv 'thkhn'ny lms vhvrsh l' hvryshv {s}
verses.translation: And it came to pass, when the children of Israel were waxen strong, that they put the Canaanites to taskwork, but did not utterly drive them out.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽיְדַבְּרוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י יוֹסֵ֔ף אֶת־יְהוֹשֻׁ֖עַ לֵאמֹ֑ר מַדּ֩וּעַ֩ נָתַ֨תָּה לִּ֜י נַחֲלָ֗ה גּוֹרָ֤ל אֶחָד֙ וְחֶ֣בֶל אֶחָ֔ד וַאֲנִ֣י עַם־רָ֔ב עַ֥ד אֲשֶׁר־עַד־כֹּ֖ה בֵּרְכַ֥נִי יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: vydbrv bny yvsf 'tyhvsh' l'mr mdv' ntth ly nchlh gvrl 'chd vchbl 'chd v'ny 'mrb 'd 'shr'dkhh brkhny yhvh
verses.translation: And the children of Joseph spoke unto Joshua, saying: ‘Why hast thou given me but one lot and one part for an inheritance, seeing I am a great people, forasmuch as the LORD hath blessed me thus?’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר אֲלֵיהֶ֜ם יְהוֹשֻׁ֗עַ אִם־עַם־רַ֤ב אַתָּה֙ עֲלֵ֣ה לְךָ֣ הַיַּ֔עְרָה וּבֵרֵאתָ֤ לְךָ֙ שָׁ֔ם בְּאֶ֥רֶץ הַפְּרִזִּ֖י וְהָרְפָאִ֑ים כִּי־אָ֥ץ לְךָ֖ הַר־אֶפְרָֽיִם׃
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lyhm yhvsh' 'm'mrb 'th 'lh lkh hy'rh vbr't lkh shm b'rts hprzy vhrp'ym khy'ts lkh hr'prym
verses.translation: And Joshua said unto them: ‘If thou be a great people, get thee up to the forest, and cut down for thyself there in the land of the Perizzites and of the Rephaim; since the hill-country of Ephraim is too narrow for thee.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּֽאמְרוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י יוֹסֵ֔ף לֹא־יִמָּ֥צֵא לָ֖נוּ הָהָ֑ר וְרֶ֣כֶב בַּרְזֶ֗ל בְּכׇל־הַֽכְּנַעֲנִי֙ הַיֹּשֵׁ֣ב בְּאֶרֶץ־הָעֵ֔מֶק לַאֲשֶׁ֤ר בְּבֵית־שְׁאָן֙ וּבְנוֹתֶ֔יהָ וְלַאֲשֶׁ֖ר בְּעֵ֥מֶק יִזְרְעֶֽאל׃
verses.translit: vy'mrv bny yvsf l'ymts' lnv hhr vrkhb brzl bkhlhkhn'ny hyshb b'rtsh'mq l'shr bbytsh'n vbnvtyh vl'shr b'mq yzr''l
verses.translation: And the children of Joseph said: ‘The hill-country will not be enough for us; and all the Canaanites that dwell in the land of the valley have chariots of iron, both they who are in Beth-shean and its towns, and they who are in the valley of Jezreel.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוֹשֻׁ֙עַ֙ אֶל־בֵּ֣ית יוֹסֵ֔ף לְאֶפְרַ֥יִם וְלִמְנַשֶּׁ֖ה לֵאמֹ֑ר עַם־רַ֣ב אַתָּ֗ה וְכֹ֤חַ גָּדוֹל֙ לָ֔ךְ לֹֽא־יִֽהְיֶ֥ה לְךָ֖ גּוֹרָ֥ל אֶחָֽד׃
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvsh' 'lbyt yvsf l'prym vlmnshh l'mr 'mrb 'th vkhch gdvl lkh l'yhyh lkh gvrl 'chd
verses.translation: And Joshua spoke unto the house of Joseph, even to Ephraim and to Manasseh, saying: ‘Thou art a great people, and hast great power; thou shalt not have one lot only;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֣י הַ֤ר יִֽהְיֶה־לָּךְ֙ כִּֽי־יַ֣עַר ה֔וּא וּבֵ֣רֵאת֔וֹ וְהָיָ֥ה לְךָ֖ תֹּצְאֹתָ֑יו כִּֽי־תוֹרִ֣ישׁ אֶת־הַֽכְּנַעֲנִ֗י כִּ֣י רֶ֤כֶב בַּרְזֶל֙ ל֔וֹ כִּ֥י חָזָ֖ק הֽוּא׃ {פ}
verses.translit: khy hr yhyhlkh khyy'r hv' vbr'tv vhyh lkh tts'tyv khytvrysh 'thkhn'ny khy rkhb brzl lv khy chzq hv' {p}
verses.translation: but the hill-country shall be thine; for though it is a forest, thou shalt cut it down, and the goings out thereof shall be thine; for thou shalt drive out the Canaanites, though they have chariots of iron, and though they be strong.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּקָּ֨הֲל֜וּ כׇּל־עֲדַ֤ת בְּנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ שִׁלֹ֔ה וַיַּשְׁכִּ֥ינוּ שָׁ֖ם אֶת־אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד וְהָאָ֥רֶץ נִכְבְּשָׁ֖ה לִפְנֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vyqhlv khl'dt bnyyshr'l shlh vyshkhynv shm 't'hl mv'd vh'rts nkhbshh lpnyhm
verses.translation: And the whole congregation of the children of Israel assembled themselves together at Shiloh, and set up the tent of meeting there; and the land was subdued before them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּוָּֽתְרוּ֙ בִּבְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹא־חָֽלְק֖וּ אֶת־נַחֲלָתָ֑ם שִׁבְעָ֖ה שְׁבָטִֽים׃
verses.translit: vyvtrv bbny yshr'l 'shr l'chlqv 'tnchltm shb'h shbtym
verses.translation: And there remained among the children of Israel seven tribes, which had not yet received their inheritance.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר יְהוֹשֻׁ֖עַ אֶל־בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל עַד־אָ֙נָה֙ אַתֶּ֣ם מִתְרַפִּ֔ים לָבוֹא֙ לָרֶ֣שֶׁת אֶת־הָאָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁר֙ נָתַ֣ן לָכֶ֔ם יְהֹוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י אֲבוֹתֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvsh' 'lbny yshr'l 'd'nh 'tm mtrpym lbv' lrsht 'th'rts 'shr ntn lkhm yhvh 'lhy 'bvtykhm
verses.translation: And Joshua said unto the children of Israel: ‘How long are ye slack to go in to possess the land, which the LORD, the God of your fathers, hath given you?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הָב֥וּ לָכֶ֛ם שְׁלֹשָׁ֥ה אֲנָשִׁ֖ים לַשָּׁ֑בֶט וְאֶשְׁלָחֵ֗ם וְיָקֻ֜מוּ וְיִֽתְהַלְּכ֥וּ בָאָ֛רֶץ וְיִכְתְּב֥וּ אוֹתָ֛הּ לְפִ֥י נַחֲלָתָ֖ם וְיָבֹ֥אוּ אֵלָֽי׃
verses.translit: hbv lkhm shlshh 'nshym lshbt v'shlchm vyqmv vythlkhv b'rts vykhtbv 'vth lpy nchltm vyb'v 'ly
verses.translation: Appoint for you three men for each tribe; and I will send them, and they shall arise, and walk through the land, and describe it according to their inheritance; and they shall come unto me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהִֽתְחַלְּק֥וּ אֹתָ֖הּ לְשִׁבְעָ֣ה חֲלָקִ֑ים יְהוּדָ֞ה יַעֲמֹ֤ד עַל־גְּבוּלוֹ֙ מִנֶּ֔גֶב וּבֵ֥ית יוֹסֵ֛ף יַעַמְד֥וּ עַל־גְּבוּלָ֖ם מִצָּפֽוֹן׃
verses.translit: vhtchlqv 'th lshb'h chlqym yhvdh y'md 'lgbvlv mngb vbyt yvsf y'mdv 'lgbvlm mtspvn
verses.translation: And they shall divide it into seven portions: Judah shall abide in his border on the south, and the house of Joseph shall abide in their border on the north.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאַתֶּ֞ם תִּכְתְּב֤וּ אֶת־הָאָ֙רֶץ֙ שִׁבְעָ֣ה חֲלָקִ֔ים וַהֲבֵאתֶ֥ם אֵלַ֖י הֵ֑נָּה וְיָרִ֨יתִי לָכֶ֤ם גּוֹרָל֙ פֹּ֔ה לִפְנֵ֖י יְהֹוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ׃
verses.translit: v'tm tkhtbv 'th'rts shb'h chlqym vhb'tm 'ly hnh vyryty lkhm gvrl ph lpny yhvh 'lhynv
verses.translation: And ye shall describe the land into seven portions, and bring the description hither to me; and I will cast lots for you here before the LORD our God.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֠י אֵֽין־חֵ֤לֶק לַלְוִיִּם֙ בְּקִרְבְּכֶ֔ם כִּֽי־כְהֻנַּ֥ת יְהֹוָ֖ה נַחֲלָת֑וֹ וְגָ֡ד וּרְאוּבֵ֡ן וַחֲצִי֩ שֵׁ֨בֶט הַֽמְנַשֶּׁ֜ה לָקְח֣וּ נַחֲלָתָ֗ם מֵעֵ֤בֶר לַיַּרְדֵּן֙ מִזְרָ֔חָה אֲשֶׁר֙ נָתַ֣ן לָהֶ֔ם מֹשֶׁ֖ה עֶ֥בֶד יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: khy 'ynchlq llvym bqrbkhm khykhhnt yhvh nchltv vgd vr'vbn vchtsy shbt hmnshh lqchv nchltm m'br lyrdn mzrchh 'shr ntn lhm mshh 'bd yhvh
verses.translation: For the Levites have no portion among you, for the priesthood of the LORD is their inheritance; and Gad and Reuben and the half-tribe of Manasseh have received their inheritance beyond the Jordan eastward, which Moses the servant of the LORD gave them.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּקֻ֥מוּ הָאֲנָשִׁ֖ים וַיֵּלֵ֑כוּ וַיְצַ֣ו יְהוֹשֻׁ֡עַ אֶת־הַהֹלְכִים֩ לִכְתֹּ֨ב אֶת־הָאָ֜רֶץ לֵאמֹ֗ר לְ֠כ֠וּ וְהִתְהַלְּכ֨וּ בָאָ֜רֶץ וְכִתְב֤וּ אוֹתָהּ֙ וְשׁ֣וּבוּ אֵלַ֔י וּ֠פֹ֠ה אַשְׁלִ֨יךְ לָכֶ֥ם גּוֹרָ֛ל לִפְנֵ֥י יְהֹוָ֖ה בְּשִׁלֹֽה׃
verses.translit: vyqmv h'nshym vylkhv vytsv yhvsh' 'thhlkhym lkhtb 'th'rts l'mr lkhv vhthlkhv b'rts vkhtbv 'vth vshvbv 'ly vph 'shlykh lkhm gvrl lpny yhvh bshlh
verses.translation: And the men arose, and went; and Joshua charged them that went to describe the land, saying: ‘Go and walk through the land, and describe it, and come back to me, and I will cast lots for you here before the LORD in Shiloh.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֵּלְכ֤וּ הָאֲנָשִׁים֙ וַיַּעַבְר֣וּ בָאָ֔רֶץ וַיִּכְתְּב֧וּהָ לֶעָרִ֛ים לְשִׁבְעָ֥ה חֲלָקִ֖ים עַל־סֵ֑פֶר וַיָּבֹ֧אוּ אֶל־יְהוֹשֻׁ֛עַ אֶל־הַֽמַּחֲנֶ֖ה שִׁלֹֽה׃
verses.translit: vylkhv h'nshym vy'brv b'rts vykhtbvh l'rym lshb'h chlqym 'lspr vyb'v 'lyhvsh' 'lhmchnh shlh
verses.translation: And the men went and passed through the land, and described it by cities into seven portions in a book, and they came to Joshua unto the camp at Shiloh.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּשְׁלֵךְ֩ לָהֶ֨ם יְהוֹשֻׁ֧עַ גּוֹרָ֛ל בְּשִׁלֹ֖ה לִפְנֵ֣י יְהֹוָ֑ה וַיְחַלֶּק־שָׁ֨ם יְהוֹשֻׁ֧עַ אֶת־הָאָ֛רֶץ לִבְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל כְּמַחְלְקֹתָֽם׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vyshlkh lhm yhvsh' gvrl bshlh lpny yhvh vychlqshm yhvsh' 'th'rts lbny yshr'l khmchlqtm {p}
verses.translation: And Joshua cast lots for them in Shiloh before the LORD; and there Joshua divided the land unto the children of Israel according to their divisions.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֗עַל גּוֹרַ֛ל מַטֵּ֥ה בְנֵֽי־בִנְיָמִ֖ן לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֑ם וַיֵּצֵא֙ גְּב֣וּל גּוֹרָלָ֔ם בֵּ֚ין בְּנֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֔ה וּבֵ֖ין בְּנֵ֥י יוֹסֵֽף׃
verses.translit: vy'l gvrl mth bnybnymn lmshpchtm vyts' gbvl gvrlm byn bny yhvdh vbyn bny yvsf
verses.translation: And the lot of the tribe of the children of Benjamin came up according to their families; and the border of their lot went out between the children of Judah and the children of Joseph.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֨י לָהֶ֧ם הַגְּב֛וּל לִפְאַ֥ת צָפ֖וֹנָה מִן־הַיַּרְדֵּ֑ן וְעָלָ֣ה הַגְּבוּל֩ אֶל־כֶּ֨תֶף יְרִיח֜וֹ מִצָּפ֗וֹן וְעָלָ֤ה בָהָר֙ יָ֔מָּה (והיה) [וְהָיוּ֙] תֹּֽצְאֹתָ֔יו מִדְבַּ֖רָה בֵּ֥ית אָֽוֶן׃
verses.translit: vyhy lhm hgbvl lp't tspvnh mnhyrdn v'lh hgbvl 'lkhtf yrychv mtspvn v'lh bhr ymh (vhyh) [vhyv] tts'tyv mdbrh byt 'vn
verses.translation: And their border on the north side was from the Jordan; and the border went up to the side of Jericho on the north, and went up through the hill-country westward; and the goings out thereof were at the wilderness of Beth-aven.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעָבַר֩ מִשָּׁ֨ם הַגְּב֜וּל ל֗וּזָה אֶל־כֶּ֤תֶף ל֙וּזָה֙ נֶ֔גְבָּה הִ֖יא בֵּֽית־אֵ֑ל וְיָרַ֤ד הַגְּבוּל֙ עַטְר֣וֹת אַדָּ֔ר עַל־הָהָ֕ר אֲשֶׁ֛ר מִנֶּ֥גֶב לְבֵית־חֹר֖וֹן תַּחְתּֽוֹן׃
verses.translit: v'br mshm hgbvl lvzh 'lkhtf lvzh ngbh hy' byt'l vyrd hgbvl 'trvt 'dr 'lhhr 'shr mngb lbytchrvn tchtvn
verses.translation: And the border passed along from thence to Luz, to the side of Luz—the same is Beth-el—southward; and the border went down to Atroth-addar, by the mountain that lieth on the south of Beth-horon the nether.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְתָאַ֣ר הַגְּבוּל֩ וְנָסַ֨ב לִפְאַת־יָ֜ם נֶ֗גְבָּה מִן־הָהָר֙ אֲשֶׁ֨ר עַל־פְּנֵ֥י בֵית־חֹרוֹן֮ נֶ֒גְבָּה֒ (והיה) [וְהָי֣וּ] תֹצְאֹתָ֗יו אֶל־קִרְיַת־בַּ֙עַל֙ הִ֚יא קִרְיַ֣ת יְעָרִ֔ים עִ֖יר בְּנֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֑ה זֹ֖את פְּאַת־יָֽם׃
verses.translit: vt'r hgbvl vnsb lp'tym ngbh mnhhr 'shr 'lpny bytchrvn ngbh (vhyh) [vhyv] tts'tyv 'lqrytb'l hy' qryt y'rym 'yr bny yhvdh z't p'tym
verses.translation: And the border was drawn and turned about on the west side southward, from the mountain that lieth before Beth-horon southward; and the goings out thereof were at Kiriath-baal—the same is Kiriath-jearim—a city of the children of Judah; this was the west side.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּפְאַת־נֶ֕גְבָּה מִקְצֵ֖ה קִרְיַ֣ת יְעָרִ֑ים וְיָצָ֤א הַגְּבוּל֙ יָ֔מָּה וְיָצָ֕א אֶל־מַעְיַ֖ן מֵ֥י נֶפְתּֽוֹחַ׃
verses.translit: vp'tngbh mqtsh qryt y'rym vyts' hgbvl ymh vyts' 'lm'yn my nptvch
verses.translation: And the south side was from the uttermost part of Kiriath-jearim, and the border went out westward, and went out to the fountain of the waters of Nephtoah.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְיָרַ֨ד הַגְּב֜וּל אֶל־קְצֵ֣ה הָהָ֗ר אֲשֶׁר֙ עַל־פְּנֵי֙ גֵּ֣י בֶן־הִנֹּ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֛ר בְּעֵ֥מֶק רְפָאִ֖ים צָפ֑וֹנָה וְיָרַד֩ גֵּ֨י הִנֹּ֜ם אֶל־כֶּ֤תֶף הַיְבוּסִי֙ נֶ֔גְבָּה וְיָרַ֖ד עֵ֥ין רֹגֵֽל׃
verses.translit: vyrd hgbvl 'lqtsh hhr 'shr 'lpny gy bnhnm 'shr b'mq rp'ym tspvnh vyrd gy hnm 'lkhtf hybvsy ngbh vyrd 'yn rgl
verses.translation: And the border went down to the uttermost part of the mountain that lieth before the Valley of the son of Hinnom, which is in the vale of Rephaim northward; and it went down to the Valley of Hinnom, to the side of the Jebusite southward, and went down to En-rogel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְתָאַ֣ר מִצָּפ֗וֹן וְיָצָא֙ עֵ֣ין שֶׁ֔מֶשׁ וְיָצָא֙ אֶל־גְּלִיל֔וֹת אֲשֶׁר־נֹ֖כַח מַעֲלֵ֣ה אֲדֻמִּ֑ים וְיָרַ֕ד אֶ֥בֶן בֹּ֖הַן בֶּן־רְאוּבֵֽן׃
verses.translit: vt'r mtspvn vyts' 'yn shmsh vyts' 'lglylvt 'shrnkhch m'lh 'dmym vyrd 'bn bhn bnr'vbn
verses.translation: And it was drawn on the north, and went out at En-shemesh, and went out to Geliloth, which is over against the ascent of Adummim; and it went down to the Stone of Bohan the son of Reuben.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעָבַ֛ר אֶל־כֶּ֥תֶף מוּל־הָעֲרָבָ֖ה צָפ֑וֹנָה וְיָרַ֖ד הָעֲרָבָֽתָה׃
verses.translit: v'br 'lkhtf mvlh'rbh tspvnh vyrd h'rbth
verses.translation: And it passed along to the side over against the Arabah northward, and went down unto the Arabah.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעָבַ֨ר הַגְּב֜וּל אֶל־כֶּ֣תֶף בֵּית־חׇגְלָה֮ צָפ֒וֹנָה֒ (והיה) [וְהָי֣וּ ] (תצאותיו) [תֹּצְא֣וֹת] הַגְּב֗וּל אֶל־לְשׁ֤וֹן יָם־הַמֶּ֙לַח֙ צָפ֔וֹנָה אֶל־קְצֵ֥ה הַיַּרְדֵּ֖ן נֶ֑גְבָּה זֶ֖ה גְּב֥וּל נֶֽגֶב׃
verses.translit: v'br hgbvl 'lkhtf bytchglh tspvnh (vhyh) [vhyv ] (tts'vtyv) [tts'vt] hgbvl 'llshvn ymhmlch tspvnh 'lqtsh hyrdn ngbh zh gbvl ngb
verses.translation: And the border passed along to the side of Beth-hoglah northward; and the goings out of the border were at the north bay of the Salt Sea, at the south end of the Jordan; this was the south border.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהַיַּרְדֵּ֥ן יִגְבֹּל־אֹת֖וֹ לִפְאַת־קֵ֑דְמָה זֹ֡את נַחֲלַת֩ בְּנֵ֨י בִנְיָמִ֧ן לִגְבֽוּלֹתֶ֛יהָ סָבִ֖יב לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָֽם׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vhyrdn ygbl'tv lp'tqdmh z't nchlt bny bnymn lgbvltyh sbyb lmshpchtm {p}
verses.translation: And the Jordan was to be the border of it on the east side. This was the inheritance of the children of Benjamin, by the borders thereof round about, according to their families.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָי֣וּ הֶֽעָרִ֗ים לְמַטֵּ֛ה בְּנֵ֥י בִנְיָמִ֖ן לְמִשְׁפְּחוֹתֵיהֶ֑ם יְרִיח֥וֹ וּבֵית־חׇגְלָ֖ה וְעֵ֥מֶק קְצִֽיץ׃
verses.translit: vhyv h'rym lmth bny bnymn lmshpchvtyhm yrychv vbytchglh v'mq qtsyts
verses.translation: Now the cities of the tribe of the children of Benjamin according to their families were Jericho, and Beth-hoglah, and Emek-keziz;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבֵ֧ית הָעֲרָבָ֛ה וּצְמָרַ֖יִם וּבֵֽית־אֵֽל׃
verses.translit: vbyt h'rbh vtsmrym vbyt'l
verses.translation: and Beth-arabah, and Zemaraim, and Beth-el;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָעַוִּ֥ים וְהַפָּרָ֖ה וְעׇפְרָֽה׃
verses.translit: vh'vym vhprh v'prh
verses.translation: and Avvim, and Parah, and Ophrah;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּכְפַ֧ר (העמני) [הָעַמֹּנָ֛ה] וְהָעׇפְנִ֖י וָגָ֑בַע עָרִ֥ים שְׁתֵּים־עֶשְׂרֵ֖ה וְחַצְרֵיהֶֽן׃
verses.translit: vkhpr (h'mny) [h'mnh] vh'pny vgb' 'rym shtym'shrh vchtsryhn
verses.translation: and Chephar-ammonah, and Ophni, and Geba; twelve cities with their villages:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: גִּבְע֥וֹן וְהָרָמָ֖ה וּבְאֵרֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: gb'vn vhrmh vb'rvt
verses.translation: Gibeon, and Ramah, and Beeroth;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהַמִּצְפֶּ֥ה וְהַכְּפִירָ֖ה וְהַמֹּצָֽה׃
verses.translit: vhmtsph vhkhpyrh vhmtsh
verses.translation: and Mizpeh, and Chephirah, and Mozah;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְרֶ֥קֶם וְיִרְפְּאֵ֖ל וְתַרְאֲלָֽה׃
verses.translit: vrqm vyrp'l vtr'lh
verses.translation: and Rekem, and Irpeel, and Taralah;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְצֵלַ֡ע הָאֶ֜לֶף וְהַיְבוּסִ֨י הִ֤יא יְרוּשָׁלַ֙͏ִם֙ גִּבְעַ֣ת קִרְיַ֔ת עָרִ֥ים אַרְבַּֽע־עֶשְׂרֵ֖ה וְחַצְרֵיהֶ֑ן זֹ֛את נַחֲלַ֥ת בְּנֵֽי־בִנְיָמִ֖ן לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָֽם׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vtsl' h'lf vhybvsy hy' yrvshl͏m gb't qryt 'rym 'rb''shrh vchtsryhn z't nchlt bnybnymn lmshpchtm {p}
verses.translation: and Zela, Eleph, and the Jebusite—the same is Jerusalem, Gibeath, and Kiriath; fourteen cities with their villages. This is the inheritance of the children of Benjamin according to their families.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֵּצֵ֞א הַגּוֹרָ֤ל הַשֵּׁנִי֙ לְשִׁמְע֔וֹן לְמַטֵּ֥ה בְנֵֽי־שִׁמְע֖וֹן לְמִשְׁפְּחוֹתָ֑ם וַֽיְהִי֙ נַחֲלָתָ֔ם בְּת֖וֹךְ נַחֲלַ֥ת בְּנֵי־יְהוּדָֽה׃
verses.translit: vyts' hgvrl hshny lshm'vn lmth bnyshm'vn lmshpchvtm vyhy nchltm btvkh nchlt bnyyhvdh
verses.translation: And the second lot came out for Simeon, even for the tribe of the children of Simeon according to their families; and their inheritance was in the midst of the inheritance of the children of Judah.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֥י לָהֶ֖ם בְּנַחֲלָתָ֑ם בְּאֵֽר־שֶׁ֥בַע וְשֶׁ֖בַע וּמוֹלָדָֽה׃
verses.translit: vyhy lhm bnchltm b'rshb' vshb' vmvldh
verses.translation: And they had for their inheritance Beer-sheba with Sheba, and Moladah;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַחֲצַ֥ר שׁוּעָ֛ל וּבָלָ֖ה וָעָֽצֶם׃
verses.translit: vchtsr shv'l vblh v'tsm
verses.translation: and Hazarshual, and Balah, and Ezem;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֶלְתּוֹלַ֥ד וּבְת֖וּל וְחׇרְמָֽה׃
verses.translit: v'ltvld vbtvl vchrmh
verses.translation: and Eltolad, and Bethul, and Hormah;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְצִֽקְלַ֥ג וּבֵית־הַמַּרְכָּב֖וֹת וַחֲצַ֥ר סוּסָֽה׃
verses.translit: vtsqlg vbythmrkhbvt vchtsr svsh
verses.translation: and Ziklag, and Beth-marcaboth, and Hazar-susah;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבֵ֥ית לְבָא֖וֹת וְשָׁרוּחֶ֑ן עָרִ֥ים שְׁלֹשׁ־עֶשְׂרֵ֖ה וְחַצְרֵיהֶֽן׃
verses.translit: vbyt lb'vt vshrvchn 'rym shlsh'shrh vchtsryhn
verses.translation: and Beth-lebaoth, and Sharuhen; thirteen cities with their villages:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַ֥יִן ׀ רִמּ֖וֹן וָעֶ֣תֶר וְעָשָׁ֑ן עָרִ֥ים אַרְבַּ֖ע וְחַצְרֵיהֶֽן׃
verses.translit: 'yn  rmvn v'tr v'shn 'rym 'rb' vchtsryhn
verses.translation: Ain, Rimmon, and Ether, and Ashan; four cities with their villages;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְכׇל־הַחֲצֵרִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֤ר סְבִיבוֹת֙ הֶעָרִ֣ים הָאֵ֔לֶּה עַד־בַּ֥עֲלַת בְּאֵ֖ר רָ֣אמַת נֶ֑גֶב זֹ֗את נַחֲלַ֛ת מַטֵּ֥ה בְנֵֽי־שִׁמְע֖וֹן לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָֽם׃
verses.translit: vkhlhchtsrym 'shr sbybvt h'rym h'lh 'db'lt b'r r'mt ngb z't nchlt mth bnyshm'vn lmshpchtm
verses.translation: and all the villages that were round about these cities to Baalath-beer, as far as Ramah of the South. This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Simeon according to their families.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מֵחֶ֙בֶל֙ בְּנֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֔ה נַחֲלַ֖ת בְּנֵ֣י שִׁמְע֑וֹן כִּֽי־הָיָ֞ה חֵ֤לֶק בְּנֵֽי־יְהוּדָה֙ רַ֣ב מֵהֶ֔ם וַיִּנְחֲל֥וּ בְנֵֽי־שִׁמְע֖וֹן בְּת֥וֹךְ נַחֲלָתָֽם׃ {פ}
verses.translit: mchbl bny yhvdh nchlt bny shm'vn khyhyh chlq bnyyhvdh rb mhm vynchlv bnyshm'vn btvkh nchltm {p}
verses.translation: Out of the allotment of the children of Judah was the inheritance of the children of Simeon, for the portion of the children of Judah was too much for them; therefore the children of Simeon had inheritance in the midst of their inheritance.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֙עַל֙ הַגּוֹרָ֣ל הַשְּׁלִישִׁ֔י לִבְנֵ֥י זְבוּלֻ֖ן לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֑ם וַיְהִ֛י גְּב֥וּל נַחֲלָתָ֖ם עַד־שָׂרִֽיד׃
verses.translit: vy'l hgvrl hshlyshy lbny zbvln lmshpchtm vyhy gbvl nchltm 'dshryd
verses.translation: And the third lot came up for the children of Zebulun according to their families; and the border of their inheritance was unto Sarid.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעָלָ֨ה גְבוּלָ֧ם ׀ לַיָּ֛מָּה וּמַרְעֲלָ֖ה וּפָגַ֣ע בְּדַבָּ֑שֶׁת וּפָגַע֙ אֶל־הַנַּ֔חַל אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל־פְּנֵ֥י יׇקְנְעָֽם׃
verses.translit: v'lh gbvlm  lymh vmr'lh vpg' bdbsht vpg' 'lhnchl 'shr 'lpny yqn'm
verses.translation: And their border went up westward, even to Maralah, and reached to Dabbesheth; and it reached to the brook that is before Jokneam.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְשָׁ֣ב מִשָּׂרִ֗יד קֵ֚דְמָה מִזְרַ֣ח הַשֶּׁ֔מֶשׁ עַל־גְּב֥וּל כִּסְלֹ֖ת תָּבֹ֑ר וְיָצָ֥א אֶל־הַדָּבְרַ֖ת וְעָלָ֥ה יָפִֽיעַ׃
verses.translit: vshb mshryd qdmh mzrch hshmsh 'lgbvl khslt tbr vyts' 'lhdbrt v'lh ypy'
verses.translation: And it turned from Sarid eastward toward the sunrising unto the border of Chisloth-tabor; and it went out to Dobrath, and went up to Japhia.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמִשָּׁ֤ם עָבַר֙ קֵ֣דְמָה מִזְרָ֔חָה גִּתָּ֥ה חֵ֖פֶר עִתָּ֣ה קָצִ֑ין וְיָצָ֛א רִמּ֥וֹן הַמְּתֹאָ֖ר הַנֵּעָֽה׃
verses.translit: vmshm 'br qdmh mzrchh gth chpr 'th qtsyn vyts' rmvn hmt'r hn'h
verses.translation: And from thence it passed along eastward to Gath-hepher, to Ethkazin; and it went out at Rimmon-methoar unto Neah.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנָסַ֤ב אֹתוֹ֙ הַגְּב֔וּל מִצְּפ֖וֹן חַנָּתֹ֑ן וְהָיוּ֙ תֹּצְאֹתָ֔יו גֵּ֖י יִפְתַּח־אֵֽל׃
verses.translit: vnsb 'tv hgbvl mtspvn chntn vhyv tts'tyv gy yptch'l
verses.translation: And the border turned about it on the north to Hannathon; and the goings out thereof were at the valley of Iphtahel;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְקַטָּ֤ת וְנַהֲלָל֙ וְשִׁמְר֔וֹן וְיִדְאֲלָ֖ה וּבֵ֣ית לָ֑חֶם עָרִ֥ים שְׁתֵּים־עֶשְׂרֵ֖ה וְחַצְרֵיהֶֽן׃
verses.translit: vqtt vnhll vshmrvn vyd'lh vbyt lchm 'rym shtym'shrh vchtsryhn
verses.translation: and Kattath, and Nahalal, and Shimron, and Idalah, and Beth-lehem; twelve cities with their villages.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: זֹ֛את נַֽחֲלַ֥ת בְּנֵי־זְבוּלֻ֖ן לְמִשְׁפְּחוֹתָ֑ם הֶעָרִ֥ים הָאֵ֖לֶּה וְחַצְרֵיהֶֽן׃ {פ}
verses.translit: z't nchlt bnyzbvln lmshpchvtm h'rym h'lh vchtsryhn {p}
verses.translation: This is the inheritance of the children of Zebulun according to their families, these cities with their villages.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְיִ֨שָּׂשכָ֔ר יָצָ֖א הַגּוֹרָ֣ל הָרְבִיעִ֑י לִבְנֵ֥י יִשָּׂשכָ֖ר לְמִשְׁפְּחוֹתָֽם׃
verses.translit: lyshshkhr yts' hgvrl hrby'y lbny yshshkhr lmshpchvtm
verses.translation: The fourth lot came out for Issachar, even for the children of Issachar according to their families.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֖י גְּבוּלָ֑ם יִזְרְעֶ֥אלָה וְהַכְּסוּלֹ֖ת וְשׁוּנֵֽם׃
verses.translit: vyhy gbvlm yzr''lh vhkhsvlt vshvnm
verses.translation: And their border was Jezreel, and Chesulloth, and Shunem;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַחֲפָרַ֥יִם וְשִׁיאֹ֖ן וַאֲנָחֲרַֽת׃
verses.translit: vchprym vshy'n v'nchrt
verses.translation: and Hapharaim, and Shion, and Anaharath;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָרַבִּ֥ית וְקִשְׁי֖וֹן וָאָֽבֶץ׃
verses.translit: vhrbyt vqshyvn v'bts
verses.translation: and Rabbith, and Kishion, and Ebez;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְרֶ֧מֶת וְעֵין־גַּנִּ֛ים וְעֵ֥ין חַדָּ֖ה וּבֵ֥ית פַּצֵּֽץ׃
verses.translit: vrmt v'yngnym v'yn chdh vbyt ptsts
verses.translation: and Remeth, and En-gannim, and En-haddah, and Beth-pazzez;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּפָגַע֩ הַגְּב֨וּל בְּתָב֤וֹר (ושחצומה) [וְשַׁחֲצִ֙ימָה֙] וּבֵ֣ית שֶׁ֔מֶשׁ וְהָי֛וּ תֹּצְא֥וֹת גְּבוּלָ֖ם הַיַּרְדֵּ֑ן עָרִ֥ים שֵׁשׁ־עֶשְׂרֵ֖ה וְחַצְרֵיהֶֽן׃
verses.translit: vpg' hgbvl btbvr (vshchtsvmh) [vshchtsymh] vbyt shmsh vhyv tts'vt gbvlm hyrdn 'rym shsh'shrh vchtsryhn
verses.translation: and the border reached to Tabor, and Shahazim, and Beth-shemesh; and the goings out of their border were at the Jordan; sixteen cities with their villages.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: זֹ֗את נַחֲלַ֛ת מַטֵּ֥ה בְנֵי־יִשָּׂשכָ֖ר לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֑ם הֶעָרִ֖ים וְחַצְרֵיהֶֽן׃ {פ}
verses.translit: z't nchlt mth bnyyshshkhr lmshpchtm h'rym vchtsryhn {p}
verses.translation: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Issachar according to their families, the cities with their villages.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֵּצֵא֙ הַגּוֹרָ֣ל הַחֲמִישִׁ֔י לְמַטֵּ֥ה בְנֵי־אָשֵׁ֖ר לְמִשְׁפְּחוֹתָֽם׃
verses.translit: vyts' hgvrl hchmyshy lmth bny'shr lmshpchvtm
verses.translation: And the fifth lot came out for the tribe of the children of Asher according to their families.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֖י גְּבוּלָ֑ם חֶלְקַ֥ת וַחֲלִ֖י וָבֶ֥טֶן וְאַכְשָֽׁף׃
verses.translit: vyhy gbvlm chlqt vchly vbtn v'khshf
verses.translation: And their border was Helkath, and Hali, and Beten, and Achshaph;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאַֽלַמֶּ֥לֶךְ וְעַמְעָ֖ד וּמִשְׁאָ֑ל וּפָגַ֤ע בְּכַרְמֶל֙ הַיָּ֔מָּה וּבְשִׁיח֖וֹר לִבְנָֽת׃
verses.translit: v'lmlkh v'm'd vmsh'l vpg' bkhrml hymh vbshychvr lbnt
verses.translation: and Allam-melech, and Amad, and Mishal; and it reached to Carmel westward, and to Shihor-libnath.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְשָׁ֨ב מִזְרַ֣ח הַשֶּׁ֘מֶשׁ֮ בֵּ֣ית דָּגֹן֒ וּפָגַ֣ע בִּ֠זְבֻל֠וּן וּבְגֵ֨י יִפְתַּח־אֵ֥ל צָפ֛וֹנָה בֵּ֥ית הָעֵ֖מֶק וּנְעִיאֵ֑ל וְיָצָ֥א אֶל־כָּב֖וּל מִשְּׂמֹֽאל׃
verses.translit: vshb mzrch hshmsh byt dgn vpg' bzblvn vbgy yptch'l tspvnh byt h'mq vn'y'l vyts' 'lkhbvl mshm'l
verses.translation: And it turned toward the sunrising to Beth-dagon, and reached to Zebulun and to the valley of Iphtahel northward at Beth-emek and Neiel; and it went out to Cabul on the left hand,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעֶבְרֹ֥ן וּרְחֹ֖ב וְחַמּ֣וֹן וְקָנָ֑ה עַ֖ד צִיד֥וֹן רַבָּֽה׃
verses.translit: v'brn vrchb vchmvn vqnh 'd tsydvn rbh
verses.translation: and Ebron, and Rehob, and Hammon, and Kanah, even unto great Zidon.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְשָׁ֤ב הַגְּבוּל֙ הָרָמָ֔ה וְעַד־עִ֖יר מִבְצַר־צֹ֑ר וְשָׁ֤ב הַגְּבוּל֙ חֹסָ֔ה (ויהיו) [וְהָי֧וּ] תֹצְאֹתָ֛יו הַיָּ֖מָּה מֵחֶ֥בֶל אַכְזִֽיבָה׃
verses.translit: vshb hgbvl hrmh v'd'yr mbtsrtsr vshb hgbvl chsh (vyhyv) [vhyv] tts'tyv hymh mchbl 'khzybh
verses.translation: And the border turned to Ramah, and to the fortified city of Tyre; and the border turned to Hosah; and the goings out thereof were at the sea from Hebel to Achzib;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעֻמָ֥ה וַאֲפֵ֖ק וּרְחֹ֑ב עָרִ֛ים עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וּשְׁתַּ֖יִם וְחַצְרֵיהֶֽן׃
verses.translit: v'mh v'pq vrchb 'rym 'shrym vshtym vchtsryhn
verses.translation: Ummah also, and Aphek, and Rehob; twenty and two cities with their villages.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: זֹ֗את נַחֲלַ֛ת מַטֵּ֥ה בְנֵֽי־אָשֵׁ֖ר לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֑ם הֶעָרִ֥ים הָאֵ֖לֶּה וְחַצְרֵיהֶֽן׃ {פ}
verses.translit: z't nchlt mth bny'shr lmshpchtm h'rym h'lh vchtsryhn {p}
verses.translation: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Asher according to their families, these cities with their villages.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לִבְנֵ֣י נַפְתָּלִ֔י יָצָ֖א הַגּוֹרָ֣ל הַשִּׁשִּׁ֑י לִבְנֵ֥י נַפְתָּלִ֖י לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָֽם׃
verses.translit: lbny nptly yts' hgvrl hshshy lbny nptly lmshpchtm
verses.translation: The sixth lot came out for the children of Naphtali, even for the children of Naphtali according to their families.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֣י גְבוּלָ֗ם מֵחֵ֨לֶף מֵאֵל֜וֹן בְּצַעֲנַנִּ֗ים וַאֲדָמִ֥י הַנֶּ֛קֶב וְיַבְנְאֵ֖ל עַד־לַקּ֑וּם וַיְהִ֥י תֹצְאֹתָ֖יו הַיַּרְדֵּֽן׃
verses.translit: vyhy gbvlm mchlf m'lvn bts'nnym v'dmy hnqb vybn'l 'dlqvm vyhy tts'tyv hyrdn
verses.translation: And their border was from Heleph, from Elon-beza-anannim, and Adami-nekeb, and Jabneel, unto Lakkum; and the goings out thereof were at the Jordan.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְשָׁ֨ב הַגְּב֥וּל יָ֙מָּה֙ אַזְנ֣וֹת תָּב֔וֹר וְיָצָ֥א מִשָּׁ֖ם חוּקֹ֑קָה וּפָגַ֨ע בִּזְבֻל֜וּן מִנֶּ֗גֶב וּבְאָשֵׁר֙ פָּגַ֣ע מִיָּ֔ם וּבִ֣יהוּדָ֔ה הַיַּרְדֵּ֖ן מִזְרַ֥ח הַשָּֽׁמֶשׁ׃
verses.translit: vshb hgbvl ymh 'znvt tbvr vyts' mshm chvqqh vpg' bzblvn mngb vb'shr pg' mym vbyhvdh hyrdn mzrch hshmsh
verses.translation: And the border turned westward to Aznoth-tabor, and went out from thence to Hukok; and it reached to Zebulun on the south, and reached to Asher on the west, and to Judah at the Jordan toward the sunrising.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעָרֵ֖י מִבְצָ֑ר הַצִּדִּ֣ים צֵ֔ר וְחַמַּ֖ת רַקַּ֥ת וְכִנָּֽרֶת׃
verses.translit: v'ry mbtsr htsdym tsr vchmt rqt vkhnrt
verses.translation: And the fortified cities were Ziddim-zer, and Hammath, and Rakkath, and Chinnereth;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַאֲדָמָ֥ה וְהָרָמָ֖ה וְחָצֽוֹר׃
verses.translit: v'dmh vhrmh vchtsvr
verses.translation: and Adamah, and Ramah, and Hazor;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְקֶ֥דֶשׁ וְאֶדְרֶ֖עִי וְעֵ֥ין חָצֽוֹר׃
verses.translit: vqdsh v'dr'y v'yn chtsvr
verses.translation: and Kedesh, and Edrei, and En-hazor;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְיִרְאוֹן֙ וּמִגְדַּל־אֵ֔ל חֳרֵ֥ם וּבֵית־עֲנָ֖ת וּבֵ֣ית שָׁ֑מֶשׁ עָרִ֥ים תְּשַֽׁע־עֶשְׂרֵ֖ה וְחַצְרֵיהֶֽן׃
verses.translit: vyr'vn vmgdl'l chrm vbyt'nt vbyt shmsh 'rym tsh''shrh vchtsryhn
verses.translation: and Iron, and Migdal-el, and Horem, and Beth-anath, and Beth-shemesh; nineteen cities with their villages.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: זֹ֗את נַחֲלַ֛ת מַטֵּ֥ה בְנֵֽי־נַפְתָּלִ֖י לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֑ם הֶֽעָרִ֖ים וְחַצְרֵיהֶֽן׃ {פ}
verses.translit: z't nchlt mth bnynptly lmshpchtm h'rym vchtsryhn {p}
verses.translation: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Naphtali according to their families, the cities with their villages.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְמַטֵּ֥ה בְנֵי־דָ֖ן לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֑ם יָצָ֖א הַגּוֹרָ֥ל הַשְּׁבִיעִֽי׃
verses.translit: lmth bnydn lmshpchtm yts' hgvrl hshby'y
verses.translation: The seventh lot came out for the tribe of the children of Dan according to their families.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֖י גְּב֣וּל נַחֲלָתָ֑ם צׇרְעָ֥ה וְאֶשְׁתָּא֖וֹל וְעִ֥יר שָֽׁמֶשׁ׃
verses.translit: vyhy gbvl nchltm tsr'h v'sht'vl v'yr shmsh
verses.translation: And the border of their inheritance was Zorah, and Eshtaol, and Ir-shemesh;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְשַׁעֲלַבִּ֥ין וְאַיָּל֖וֹן וְיִתְלָֽה׃
verses.translit: vsh'lbyn v'ylvn vytlh
verses.translation: and Shaalabbin, and Aijalon, and Ithlah;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֵיל֥וֹן וְתִמְנָ֖תָה וְעֶקְרֽוֹן׃
verses.translit: v'ylvn vtmnth v'qrvn
verses.translation: and Elon, and Timnah, and Ekron;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֶלְתְּקֵ֥ה וְגִבְּת֖וֹן וּבַעֲלָֽת׃
verses.translit: v'ltqh vgbtvn vb'lt
verses.translation: and Eltekeh, and Gibbethon, and Baalath;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וִיהֻ֥ד וּבְנֵֽי־בְרַ֖ק וְגַת־רִמּֽוֹן׃
verses.translit: vyhd vbnybrq vgtrmvn
verses.translation: and Jehud, and Bene-berak, and Gath-rimmon;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמֵ֥י הַיַּרְק֖וֹן וְהָרַקּ֑וֹן עִֽם־הַגְּב֖וּל מ֥וּל יָפֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vmy hyrqvn vhrqvn 'mhgbvl mvl ypv
verses.translation: and Me-jarkon, and Rakkon, with the border over against Joppa.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֵּצֵ֥א גְבוּל־בְּנֵי־דָ֖ן מֵהֶ֑ם וַיַּעֲל֣וּ בְנֵי־דָ֠ן וַיִּלָּחֲמ֨וּ עִם־לֶ֜שֶׁם וַיִּלְכְּד֥וּ אוֹתָ֣הּ  וַיַּכּ֧וּ אוֹתָ֣הּ לְפִי־חֶ֗רֶב וַיִּֽרְשׁ֤וּ אוֹתָהּ֙ וַיֵּ֣שְׁבוּ בָ֔הּ וַיִּקְרְא֤וּ לְלֶ֙שֶׁם֙ דָּ֔ן כְּשֵׁ֖ם דָּ֥ן אֲבִיהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vyts' gbvlbnydn mhm vy'lv bnydn vylchmv 'mlshm vylkhdv 'vth  vykhv 'vth lpychrb vyrshv 'vth vyshbv bh vyqr'v llshm dn khshm dn 'byhm
verses.translation: And the border of the children of Dan was too strait for them; so the children of Dan went up and fought against Leshem, and took it, and smote it with the edge of the sword, and possessed it, and dwelt therein, and called Leshem, Dan, after the name of Dan their father.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: זֹ֗את נַחֲלַ֛ת מַטֵּ֥ה בְנֵי־דָ֖ן לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֑ם הֶעָרִ֥ים הָאֵ֖לֶּה וְחַצְרֵיהֶֽן׃ {ס}
verses.translit: z't nchlt mth bnydn lmshpchtm h'rym h'lh vchtsryhn {s}
verses.translation: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Dan according to their families, these cities with their villages.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְכַלּ֥וּ לִנְחֹל־אֶת־הָאָ֖רֶץ לִגְבוּלֹתֶ֑יהָ וַיִּתְּנ֨וּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֧ל נַחֲלָ֛ה לִיהוֹשֻׁ֥עַ בִּן־נ֖וּן בְּתוֹכָֽם׃
verses.translit: vykhlv lnchl'th'rts lgbvltyh vytnv bnyyshr'l nchlh lyhvsh' bnnvn btvkhm
verses.translation: When they had made an end of distributing the land for inheritance by the borders thereof, the children of Israel gave an inheritance to Joshua the son of Nun in the midst of them;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַל־פִּ֨י יְהֹוָ֜ה נָ֣תְנוּ ל֗וֹ אֶת־הָעִיר֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר שָׁאָ֔ל אֶת־תִּמְנַת־סֶ֖רַח בְּהַ֣ר אֶפְרָ֑יִם וַיִּבְנֶ֥ה אֶת־הָעִ֖יר וַיֵּ֥שֶׁב בָּֽהּ׃
verses.translit: 'lpy yhvh ntnv lv 'th'yr 'shr sh'l 'ttmntsrch bhr 'prym vybnh 'th'yr vyshb bh
verses.translation: according to the commandment of the LORD they gave him the city which he asked, even Timnath-serah in the hill-country of Ephraim; and he built the city, and dwelt therein.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֵ֣לֶּה הַנְּחָלֹ֡ת אֲשֶׁ֣ר נִחֲל֣וּ אֶלְעָזָ֣ר הַכֹּהֵ֣ן ׀ וִיהוֹשֻׁ֪עַ בִּן־נ֟וּן וְרָאשֵׁ֣י הָאָב֣וֹת לְמַטּוֹת֩ בְּנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֨ל ׀ בְּגוֹרָ֤ל ׀ בְּשִׁלֹה֙ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהֹוָ֔ה פֶּ֖תַח אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד וַיְכַלּ֕וּ מֵחַלֵּ֖ק אֶת־הָאָֽרֶץ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: 'lh hnchlt 'shr nchlv 'l'zr hkhhn  vyhvsh' bnnvn vr'shy h'bvt lmtvt bnyyshr'l  bgvrl  bshlh lpny yhvh ptch 'hl mv'd vykhlv mchlq 'th'rts {p}
verses.translation: These are the inheritances, which Eleazar the priest, and Joshua the son of Nun, and the heads of the fathers’houses of the tribes of the children of Israel, distributed for inheritance by lot in Shiloh before the LORD, at the door of the tent of meeting. So they made an end of dividing the land.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֣ר יְהֹוָ֔ה אֶל־יְהוֹשֻׁ֖עַ לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: vydbr yhvh 'lyhvsh' l'mr
verses.translation: And the LORD spoke unto Joshua, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: דַּבֵּ֛ר אֶל־בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לֵאמֹ֑ר תְּנ֤וּ לָכֶם֙ אֶת־עָרֵ֣י הַמִּקְלָ֔ט אֲשֶׁר־דִּבַּ֥רְתִּי אֲלֵיכֶ֖ם בְּיַד־מֹשֶֽׁה׃
verses.translit: dbr 'lbny yshr'l l'mr tnv lkhm 't'ry hmqlt 'shrdbrty 'lykhm bydmshh
verses.translation: ’Speak to the children of Israel, saying: Assign you the cities of refuge, whereof I spoke unto you by the hand of Moses;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לָנ֥וּס שָׁ֙מָּה֙ רוֹצֵ֔חַ מַכֵּה־נֶ֥פֶשׁ בִּשְׁגָגָ֖ה בִּבְלִי־דָ֑עַת וְהָי֤וּ לָכֶם֙ לְמִקְלָ֔ט מִגֹּאֵ֖ל הַדָּֽם׃
verses.translit: lnvs shmh rvtsch mkhhnpsh bshggh bblyd't vhyv lkhm lmqlt mg'l hdm
verses.translation: that the manslayer that killeth any person through error and unawares may flee thither; and they shall be unto you for a refuge from the avenger of blood.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנָ֞ס אֶל־אַחַ֣ת  מֵהֶעָרִ֣ים הָאֵ֗לֶּה וְעָמַד֙ פֶּ֚תַח שַׁ֣עַר הָעִ֔יר וְדִבֶּ֛ר בְּאׇזְנֵ֛י זִקְנֵֽי־הָעִ֥יר הַהִ֖יא אֶת־דְּבָרָ֑יו וְאָֽסְפ֨וּ אֹת֤וֹ הָעִ֙ירָה֙ אֲלֵיהֶ֔ם וְנָתְנוּ־ל֥וֹ מָק֖וֹם וְיָשַׁ֥ב עִמָּֽם׃
verses.translit: vns 'l'cht  mh'rym h'lh v'md ptch sh'r h'yr vdbr b'zny zqnyh'yr hhy' 'tdbryv v'spv 'tv h'yrh 'lyhm vntnvlv mqvm vyshb 'mm
verses.translation: And he shall flee unto one of those cities, and shall stand at the entrance of the gate of the city, and declare his cause in the ears of the elders of that city; and they shall take him into the city unto them, and give him a place, that he may dwell among them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְכִ֨י יִרְדֹּ֜ף גֹּאֵ֤ל הַדָּם֙ אַחֲרָ֔יו וְלֹא־יַסְגִּ֥רוּ אֶת־הָרֹצֵ֖חַ בְּיָד֑וֹ כִּ֤י בִבְלִי־דַ֙עַת֙ הִכָּ֣ה אֶת־רֵעֵ֔הוּ וְלֹא־שֹׂנֵ֥א ה֛וּא ל֖וֹ מִתְּמ֥וֹל שִׁלְשֽׁוֹם׃
verses.translit: vkhy yrdf g'l hdm 'chryv vl'ysgrv 'thrtsch bydv khy bblyd't hkhh 'tr'hv vl'shn' hv' lv mtmvl shlshvm
verses.translation: And if the avenger of blood pursue after him, then they shall not deliver up the manslayer into his hand; because he smote his neighbour unawares, and hated him not beforetime.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְיָשַׁ֣ב  בָּעִ֣יר הַהִ֗יא עַד־עׇמְד֞וֹ לִפְנֵ֤י הָעֵדָה֙ לַמִּשְׁפָּ֔ט עַד־מוֹת֙ הַכֹּהֵ֣ן הַגָּד֔וֹל אֲשֶׁ֥ר יִֽהְיֶ֖ה בַּיָּמִ֣ים הָהֵ֑ם אָ֣ז  יָשׁ֣וּב הָרוֹצֵ֗חַ וּבָ֤א אֶל־עִירוֹ֙ וְאֶל־בֵּית֔וֹ אֶל־הָעִ֖יר אֲשֶׁר־נָ֥ס מִשָּֽׁם׃
verses.translit: vyshb  b'yr hhy' 'd'mdv lpny h'dh lmshpt 'dmvt hkhhn hgdvl 'shr yhyh bymym hhm 'z  yshvb hrvtsch vb' 'l'yrv v'lbytv 'lh'yr 'shrns mshm
verses.translation: And he shall dwell in that city, until he stand before the congregation for judgment, until the death of the high priest that shall be in those days; then may the manslayer return, and come unto his own city, and unto his own house, unto the city from whence he fled.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּקְדִּ֜שׁוּ אֶת־קֶ֤דֶשׁ בַּגָּלִיל֙ בְּהַ֣ר נַפְתָּלִ֔י וְאֶת־שְׁכֶ֖ם בְּהַ֣ר אֶפְרָ֑יִם וְאֶת־קִרְיַ֥ת אַרְבַּ֛ע הִ֥יא חֶבְר֖וֹן בְּהַ֥ר יְהוּדָֽה׃
verses.translit: vyqdshv 'tqdsh bglyl bhr nptly v'tshkhm bhr 'prym v'tqryt 'rb' hy' chbrvn bhr yhvdh
verses.translation: And they set apart Kedesh in Galilee in the hill-country of Naphtali, and Shechem in the hill-country of Ephraim, and Kiriath-arba—the same is Hebron—in the hill-country of Judah.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמֵעֵ֜בֶר לְיַרְדֵּ֤ן יְרִיחוֹ֙ מִזְרָ֔חָה נָתְנ֞וּ אֶת־בֶּ֧צֶר בַּמִּדְבָּ֛ר בַּמִּישֹׁ֖ר מִמַּטֵּ֣ה רְאוּבֵ֑ן וְאֶת־רָאמֹ֤ת בַּגִּלְעָד֙ מִמַּטֵּה־גָ֔ד וְאֶת־[גּוֹלָ֥ן] (גלון) בַּבָּשָׁ֖ן מִמַּטֵּ֥ה מְנַשֶּֽׁה׃
verses.translit: vm'br lyrdn yrychv mzrchh ntnv 'tbtsr bmdbr bmyshr mmth r'vbn v'tr'mt bgl'd mmthgd v't[gvln] (glvn) bbshn mmth mnshh
verses.translation: And beyond the Jordan at Jericho eastward, they assigned Bezer in the wilderness in the table-land out of the tribe of Reuben, and Ramoth in Gilead out of the tribe of Gad, and Golan in Bashan out of the tribe of Manasseh.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֵ֣לֶּה הָיוּ֩ עָרֵ֨י הַמּוּעָדָ֜ה לְכֹ֣ל  בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל וְלַגֵּר֙ הַגָּ֣ר בְּתוֹכָ֔ם לָנ֣וּס שָׁ֔מָּה כׇּל־מַכֵּה־נֶ֖פֶשׁ בִּשְׁגָגָ֑ה וְלֹ֣א יָמ֗וּת בְּיַד֙ גֹּאֵ֣ל הַדָּ֔ם עַד־עׇמְד֖וֹ לִפְנֵ֥י הָעֵדָֽה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: 'lh hyv 'ry hmv'dh lkhl  bny yshr'l vlgr hgr btvkhm lnvs shmh khlmkhhnpsh bshggh vl' ymvt byd g'l hdm 'd'mdv lpny h'dh {p}
verses.translation: These were the appointed cities for all the children of Israel, and for the stranger that sojourneth among them, that whosoever killeth any person through error might flee thither, and not die by the hand of the avenger of blood, until he stood before the congregation.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽיִּגְּשׁ֗וּ רָאשֵׁי֙ אֲב֣וֹת הַלְוִיִּ֔ם אֶל־אֶלְעָזָר֙ הַכֹּהֵ֔ן וְאֶל־יְהוֹשֻׁ֖עַ בִּן־נ֑וּן וְאֶל־רָאשֵׁ֛י אֲב֥וֹת הַמַּטּ֖וֹת לִבְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: vygshv r'shy 'bvt hlvym 'l'l'zr hkhhn v'lyhvsh' bnnvn v'lr'shy 'bvt hmtvt lbny yshr'l
verses.translation: Then came near the heads of fathers’houses of the Levites unto Eleazar the priest, and unto Joshua the son of Nun, and unto the heads of fathers’houses of the tribes of the children of Israel;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְדַבְּר֨וּ אֲלֵיהֶ֜ם בְּשִׁלֹ֗ה בְּאֶ֤רֶץ כְּנַ֙עַן֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר יְהֹוָה֙ צִוָּ֣ה בְיַד־מֹשֶׁ֔ה לָתֶת־לָ֥נוּ עָרִ֖ים לָשָׁ֑בֶת וּמִגְרְשֵׁיהֶ֖ן לִבְהֶמְתֵּֽנוּ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vydbrv 'lyhm bshlh b'rts khn'n l'mr yhvh tsvh bydmshh lttlnv 'rym lshbt vmgrshyhn lbhmtnv {p}
verses.translation: and they spoke unto them at Shiloh in the land of Canaan, saying: ‘The LORD commanded by the hand of Moses to give us cities to dwell in, with the open land thereabout for our cattle.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּתְּנ֨וּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֧ל לַלְוִיִּ֛ם מִנַּחֲלָתָ֖ם אֶל־פִּ֣י יְהֹוָ֑ה אֶת־הֶעָרִ֥ים הָאֵ֖לֶּה וְאֶת־מִגְרְשֵׁיהֶֽן׃
verses.translit: vytnv bnyyshr'l llvym mnchltm 'lpy yhvh 'th'rym h'lh v'tmgrshyhn
verses.translation: And the children of Israel gave unto the Levites out of their inheritance, according to the commandment of the LORD, these cities with the open land about them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֵּצֵ֥א הַגּוֹרָ֖ל לְמִשְׁפְּחֹ֣ת הַקְּהָתִ֑י וַיְהִ֡י לִבְנֵי֩ אַהֲרֹ֨ן הַכֹּהֵ֜ן מִן־הַלְוִיִּ֗ם מִמַּטֵּ֣ה יְ֠הוּדָ֠ה וּמִמַּטֵּ֨ה הַשִּׁמְעֹנִ֜י וּמִמַּטֵּ֤ה בִנְיָמִן֙ בַּגּוֹרָ֔ל עָרִ֖ים שְׁלֹ֥שׁ עֶשְׂרֵֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vyts' hgvrl lmshpcht hqhty vyhy lbny 'hrn hkhhn mnhlvym mmth yhvdh vmmth hshm'ny vmmth bnymn bgvrl 'rym shlsh 'shrh {s}
verses.translation: And the lot came out for the families of the Kohathites; and the children of Aaron the priest, who were of the Levites, had by lot out of the tribe of Judah, and out of the tribe of the Simeonites, and out of the tribe of Benjamin, thirteen cities.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלִבְנֵ֨י קְהָ֜ת הַנּֽוֹתָרִ֗ים מִמִּשְׁפְּחֹ֣ת מַטֵּֽה־אֶ֠פְרַ֠יִם וּֽמִמַּטֵּה־דָ֞ן וּמֵחֲצִ֨י מַטֵּ֧ה מְנַשֶּׁ֛ה בַּגּוֹרָ֖ל עָרִ֥ים עָֽשֶׂר׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vlbny qht hnvtrym mmshpcht mth'prym vmmthdn vmchtsy mth mnshh bgvrl 'rym 'shr {s}
verses.translation: And the rest of the children of Kohath had by lot out of the families of the tribe of Ephraim, and out of the tribe of Dan, and out of the half-tribe of Manasseh, ten cities.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלִבְנֵ֣י גֵרְשׁ֗וֹן מִמִּשְׁפְּח֣וֹת מַטֵּֽה־יִשָּׂשכָ֣ר וּמִמַּטֵּֽה־אָ֠שֵׁ֠ר וּמִמַּטֵּ֨ה נַפְתָּלִ֜י וּ֠מֵחֲצִ֠י מַטֵּ֨ה מְנַשֶּׁ֤ה בַבָּשָׁן֙ בַּגּוֹרָ֔ל עָרִ֖ים שְׁלֹ֥שׁ עֶשְׂרֵֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vlbny grshvn mmshpchvt mthyshshkhr vmmth'shr vmmth nptly vmchtsy mth mnshh bbshn bgvrl 'rym shlsh 'shrh {s}
verses.translation: And the children of Gershon had by lot out of the families of the tribe of Issachar, and out of the tribe of Asher, and out of the tribe of Naphtali, and out of the half-tribe of Manasseh in Bashan, thirteen cities.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לִבְנֵ֨י מְרָרִ֜י לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֗ם מִמַּטֵּ֨ה רְאוּבֵ֤ן וּמִמַּטֵּה־גָד֙ וּמִמַּטֵּ֣ה זְבוּלֻ֔ן עָרִ֖ים שְׁתֵּ֥ים עֶשְׂרֵֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: lbny mrry lmshpchtm mmth r'vbn vmmthgd vmmth zbvln 'rym shtym 'shrh {s}
verses.translation: The children of Merari according to their families had out of the tribe of Reuben, and out of the tribe of Gad, and out of the tribe of Zebulun, twelve cities.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּתְּנ֤וּ בְנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ לַלְוִיִּ֔ם אֶת־הֶעָרִ֥ים הָאֵ֖לֶּה וְאֶת־מִגְרְשֵׁיהֶ֑ן כַּאֲשֶׁ֨ר צִוָּ֧ה יְהֹוָ֛ה בְּיַד־מֹשֶׁ֖ה בַּגּוֹרָֽל׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vytnv bnyyshr'l llvym 'th'rym h'lh v'tmgrshyhn kh'shr tsvh yhvh bydmshh bgvrl {p}
verses.translation: And the children of Israel gave by lot unto the Levites these cities with the open land about them, as the LORD commanded by the hand of Moses.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽיִּתְּנ֗וּ מִמַּטֵּה֙ בְּנֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֔ה וּמִמַּטֵּ֖ה בְּנֵ֣י שִׁמְע֑וֹן אֵ֚ת הֶעָרִ֣ים הָאֵ֔לֶּה אֲשֶׁר־יִקְרָ֥א אֶתְהֶ֖ן בְּשֵֽׁם׃
verses.translit: vytnv mmth bny yhvdh vmmth bny shm'vn 't h'rym h'lh 'shryqr' 'thn bshm
verses.translation: And they gave out of the tribe of the children of Judah, and out of the tribe of the children of Simeon, these cities which are here mentioned by name.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽיְהִי֙ לִבְנֵ֣י אַהֲרֹ֔ן מִמִּשְׁפְּח֥וֹת הַקְּהָתִ֖י מִבְּנֵ֣י לֵוִ֑י כִּ֥י לָהֶ֛ם הָיָ֥ה הַגּוֹרָ֖ל רִאישֹׁנָֽה׃
verses.translit: vyhy lbny 'hrn mmshpchvt hqhty mbny lvy khy lhm hyh hgvrl r'yshnh
verses.translation: And they were for the children of Aaron, of the families of the Kohathites, who were of the children of Levi; for theirs was the first lot. .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּתְּנ֨וּ לָהֶ֜ם אֶת־קִרְיַת֩ אַרְבַּ֨ע אֲבִ֧י הָעֲנ֛וֹק הִ֥יא חֶבְר֖וֹן בְּהַ֣ר יְהוּדָ֑ה וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁ֖הָ סְבִיבֹתֶֽיהָ׃
verses.translit: vytnv lhm 'tqryt 'rb' 'by h'nvq hy' chbrvn bhr yhvdh v'tmgrshh sbybtyh
verses.translation: And they gave them Kiriath-arba, which Arba was the father of Anak—the same is Hebron—in the hill-country of Judah, with the open land round about it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֶת־שְׂדֵ֥ה הָעִ֖יר וְאֶת־חֲצֵרֶ֑יהָ נָ֥תְנ֛וּ לְכָלֵ֥ב בֶּן־יְפֻנֶּ֖ה בַּאֲחֻזָּתֽוֹ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: v'tshdh h'yr v'tchtsryh ntnv lkhlb bnypnh b'chztv {s}
verses.translation: But the fields of the city, and the villages thereof, gave they to Caleb the son of Jephunneh for his possession.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלִבְנֵ֣י  אַֽהֲרֹ֣ן הַכֹּהֵ֗ן נָֽתְנוּ֙ אֶת־עִיר֙ מִקְלַ֣ט הָרֹצֵ֔חַ אֶת־חֶבְר֖וֹן וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁ֑הָ וְאֶת־לִבְנָ֖ה וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶֽׁהָ׃
verses.translit: vlbny  'hrn hkhhn ntnv 't'yr mqlt hrtsch 'tchbrvn v'tmgrshh v'tlbnh v'tmgrshh
verses.translation: And unto the children of Aaron the priest they gave Hebron with the open land about it, the city of refuge for the manslayer, and Libnah with the open land about it;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֶת־יַתִּר֙ וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁ֔הָ וְאֶֽת־אֶשְׁתְּמֹ֖עַ וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶֽׁהָ׃
verses.translit: v'tytr v'tmgrshh v't'shtm' v'tmgrshh
verses.translation: and Jattir with the open land about it, and Eshtemoa with the open land about it;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֶת־חֹלֹן֙ וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁ֔הָ וְאֶת־דְּבִ֖ר וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶֽׁהָ׃
verses.translit: v'tchln v'tmgrshh v'tdbr v'tmgrshh
verses.translation: and Holon with the open land about it, and Debir with the open land about it;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֶת־עַ֣יִן וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁ֗הָ וְאֶת־יֻטָּה֙ וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁ֔הָ אֶת־בֵּ֥ית שֶׁ֖מֶשׁ וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁ֑הָ עָרִ֣ים תֵּ֔שַׁע מֵאֵ֕ת שְׁנֵ֖י הַשְּׁבָטִ֥ים הָאֵֽלֶּה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: v't'yn v'tmgrshh v'tyth v'tmgrshh 'tbyt shmsh v'tmgrshh 'rym tsh' m't shny hshbtym h'lh {s}
verses.translation: and Ain with the open land about it, and Juttah with the open land about it, and Beth-shemesh with the open land about it; nine cities out of those two tribes.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמִמַּטֵּ֣ה בִנְיָמִ֔ין אֶת־גִּבְע֖וֹן וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁ֑הָ אֶת־גֶּ֖בַע וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶֽׁהָ׃
verses.translit: vmmth bnymyn 'tgb'vn v'tmgrshh 'tgb' v'tmgrshh
verses.translation: And out of the tribe of Benjamin, Gibeon with the open land about it, Geba with the open land about it;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֶת־עֲנָתוֹת֙ וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁ֔הָ וְאֶת־עַלְמ֖וֹן וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁ֑הָ עָרִ֖ים אַרְבַּֽע׃
verses.translit: 't'ntvt v'tmgrshh v't'lmvn v'tmgrshh 'rym 'rb'
verses.translation: Anathoth with the open land about it, and Almon with the open land about it; four cities.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כׇּל־עָרֵ֥י בְנֵֽי־אַהֲרֹ֖ן הַכֹּהֲנִ֑ים שְׁלֹשׁ־עֶשְׂרֵ֥ה עָרִ֖ים וּמִגְרְשֵׁיהֶֽן׃ {ס}
verses.translit: khl'ry bny'hrn hkhhnym shlsh'shrh 'rym vmgrshyhn {s}
verses.translation: All the cities of the children of Aaron, the priests, were thirteen cities with the open land about them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּלְמִשְׁפְּח֤וֹת בְּנֵֽי־קְהָת֙ הַלְוִיִּ֔ם הַנּֽוֹתָרִ֖ים מִבְּנֵ֣י קְהָ֑ת וַֽיְהִי֙ עָרֵ֣י גֽוֹרָלָ֔ם מִמַּטֵּ֖ה אֶפְרָֽיִם׃
verses.translit: vlmshpchvt bnyqht hlvym hnvtrym mbny qht vyhy 'ry gvrlm mmth 'prym
verses.translation: And the families of the children of Kohath, the Levites, even the rest of the children of Kohath, they had the cities of their lot out of the tribe of Ephraim.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּתְּנ֨וּ לָהֶ֜ם אֶת־עִ֨יר מִקְלַ֧ט הָרֹצֵ֛חַ אֶת־שְׁכֶ֥ם וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁ֖הָ בְּהַ֣ר אֶפְרָ֑יִם וְאֶת־גֶּ֖זֶר וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶֽׁהָ׃
verses.translit: vytnv lhm 't'yr mqlt hrtsch 'tshkhm v'tmgrshh bhr 'prym v'tgzr v'tmgrshh
verses.translation: And they gave them Shechem with the open land about it in the hill-country of Ephraim, the city of refuge for the manslayer, and Gezer with the open land about it;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֶת־קִבְצַ֙יִם֙ וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁ֔הָ וְאֶת־בֵּ֥ית חוֹרֹ֖ן וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁ֑הָ עָרִ֖ים אַרְבַּֽע׃ {ס}
verses.translit: v'tqbtsym v'tmgrshh v'tbyt chvrn v'tmgrshh 'rym 'rb' {s}
verses.translation: and Kibzaim with the open land about it, and Beth-horon with the open land about it; four cities.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמִ֨מַּטֵּה־דָ֔ן אֶֽת־אֶלְתְּקֵ֖א וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁ֑הָ אֶֽת־גִּבְּת֖וֹן וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶֽׁהָ׃
verses.translit: vmmthdn 't'ltq' v'tmgrshh 'tgbtvn v'tmgrshh
verses.translation: And out of the tribe of Dan, Elteke with the open land about it, Gibbethon with the open land about it;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֶת־אַיָּלוֹן֙ וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁ֔הָ אֶת־גַּת־רִמּ֖וֹן וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁ֑הָ עָרִ֖ים אַרְבַּֽע׃
verses.translit: 't'ylvn v'tmgrshh 'tgtrmvn v'tmgrshh 'rym 'rb'
verses.translation: Aijalon with the open land about it, Gath-rimmon with the open land about it; four cities.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמִֽמַּחֲצִית֙ מַטֵּ֣ה מְנַשֶּׁ֔ה אֶת־תַּעְנַךְ֙ וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁ֔הָ וְאֶת־גַּ֥ת רִמּ֖וֹן וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁ֑הָ עָרִ֖ים שְׁתָּֽיִם׃
verses.translit: vmmchtsyt mth mnshh 'tt'nkh v'tmgrshh v'tgt rmvn v'tmgrshh 'rym shtym
verses.translation: And out of the half-tribe of Manasseh, Taanach with the open land about it, and Gath-rimmon with the open land about it; two cities.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כׇּל־עָרִ֥ים עֶ֖שֶׂר וּמִגְרְשֵׁיהֶ֑ן לְמִשְׁפְּח֥וֹת בְּנֵי־קְהָ֖ת הַנּוֹתָרִֽים׃ {ס}
verses.translit: khl'rym 'shr vmgrshyhn lmshpchvt bnyqht hnvtrym {s}
verses.translation: All the cities of the families of the rest of the children of Kohath were ten with the open land about them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלִבְנֵ֣י גֵֽרְשׁוֹן֮ מִמִּשְׁפְּחֹ֣ת הַלְוִיִּם֒ מֵחֲצִ֞י מַטֵּ֣ה מְנַשֶּׁ֗ה אֶת־עִיר֙ מִקְלַ֣ט הָרֹצֵ֔חַ אֶת־[גּוֹלָ֤ן] (גלון) בַּבָּשָׁן֙ וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁ֔הָ וְאֶת־בְּעֶשְׁתְּרָ֖ה וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁ֑הָ עָרִ֖ים שְׁתָּֽיִם׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vlbny grshvn mmshpcht hlvym mchtsy mth mnshh 't'yr mqlt hrtsch 't[gvln] (glvn) bbshn v'tmgrshh v'tb'shtrh v'tmgrshh 'rym shtym {s}
verses.translation: And unto the children of Gershon, of the families of the Levites, out of the half-tribe of Manasseh they gave Golan in Bashan with the open land about it, the city of refuge for the manslayer; and Beeshterah with the open land about it; two cities.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמִמַּטֵּ֣ה יִשָּׂשכָ֔ר אֶת־קִשְׁי֖וֹן וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁ֑הָ אֶת־דָּבְרַ֖ת וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶֽׁהָ׃
verses.translit: vmmth yshshkhr 'tqshyvn v'tmgrshh 'tdbrt v'tmgrshh
verses.translation: And out of the tribe of Issachar, Kishion with the open land about it, Dobrath with the open land about it;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֶת־יַרְמוּת֙ וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁ֔הָ אֶת־עֵ֥ין גַּנִּ֖ים וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁ֑הָ עָרִ֖ים אַרְבַּֽע׃ {ס}
verses.translit: 'tyrmvt v'tmgrshh 't'yn gnym v'tmgrshh 'rym 'rb' {s}
verses.translation: Jarmuth with the open land about it, En-gannim with the open land about it; four cities.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמִמַּטֵּ֣ה אָשֵׁ֔ר אֶת־מִשְׁאָ֖ל וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁ֑הָ אֶת־עַבְדּ֖וֹן וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶֽׁהָ׃
verses.translit: vmmth 'shr 'tmsh'l v'tmgrshh 't'bdvn v'tmgrshh
verses.translation: And out of the tribe of Asher, Mishal with the open land about it, Abdon with the open land about it;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֶת־חֶלְקָת֙ וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁ֔הָ וְאֶת־רְחֹ֖ב וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁ֑הָ עָרִ֖ים אַרְבַּֽע׃ {ס}
verses.translit: 'tchlqt v'tmgrshh v'trchb v'tmgrshh 'rym 'rb' {s}
verses.translation: Helkath with the open land about it, and Rehob with the open land about it; four cities.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמִמַּטֵּ֨ה נַפְתָּלִ֜י אֶת־עִ֣יר  מִקְלַ֣ט הָרֹצֵ֗חַ אֶת־קֶ֨דֶשׁ בַּגָּלִ֤יל וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁ֙הָ֙ וְאֶת־חַמֹּ֥ת דֹּאר֙ וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁ֔הָ וְאֶת־קַרְתָּ֖ן וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁ֑הָ עָרִ֖ים שָׁלֹֽשׁ׃
verses.translit: vmmth nptly 't'yr  mqlt hrtsch 'tqdsh bglyl v'tmgrshh v'tchmt d'r v'tmgrshh v'tqrtn v'tmgrshh 'rym shlsh
verses.translation: And out of the tribe of Naphtali, Kedesh in Galilee with the open land about it, the city of refuge for the manslayer, and Hammoth-dor with the open land about it, and Kartan with the open land about it; three cities.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כׇּל־עָרֵ֥י הַגֵּרְשֻׁנִּ֖י לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֑ם שְׁלֹשׁ־עֶשְׂרֵ֥ה עִ֖יר וּמִגְרְשֵׁיהֶֽן׃ {ס}
verses.translit: khl'ry hgrshny lmshpchtm shlsh'shrh 'yr vmgrshyhn {s}
verses.translation: All the cities of the Gershonites according to their families were thirteen cities with the open land about them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּלְמִשְׁפְּח֣וֹת בְּנֵי־מְרָרִי֮ הַלְוִיִּ֣ם הַנּוֹתָרִים֒ מֵאֵת֙ מַטֵּ֣ה זְבוּלֻ֔ן אֶֽת־יׇקְנְעָ֖ם וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁ֑הָ אֶת־קַרְתָּ֖ה וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶֽׁהָ׃
verses.translit: vlmshpchvt bnymrry hlvym hnvtrym m't mth zbvln 'tyqn'm v'tmgrshh 'tqrth v'tmgrshh
verses.translation: And unto the families of the children of Merari, the rest of the Levites, out of the tribe of Zebulun, Jokneam with the open land about it, and Kartah with the open land about it;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֶת־דִּמְנָה֙ וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁ֔הָ אֶֽת־נַהֲלָ֖ל וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁ֑הָ עָרִ֖ים אַרְבַּֽע׃ {ס}
verses.translit: 'tdmnh v'tmgrshh 'tnhll v'tmgrshh 'rym 'rb' {s}
verses.translation: Dimnah with the open land about it, Nahalal with the open land about it; four cities.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.translation: [And out of the tribe of Reuben, Bezer with the open land about it, and Jahaz with the open land about it;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.translation: Kedemoth with the open land about it, and Mephaath with the open land about it; four cities.]
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמִמַּטֵּה־גָ֗ד אֶת־עִיר֙ מִקְלַ֣ט הָרֹצֵ֔חַ אֶת־רָמֹ֥ת בַּגִּלְעָ֖ד וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁ֑הָ וְאֶֽת־מַחֲנַ֖יִם וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶֽׁהָ׃
verses.translit: vmmthgd 't'yr mqlt hrtsch 'trmt bgl'd v'tmgrshh v'tmchnym v'tmgrshh
verses.translation: And out of the tribe of Gad, Ramoth in Gilead with the open land about it, the city of refuge for the manslayer, and Mahanaim with the open land about it;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֶת־חֶשְׁבּוֹן֙ וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁ֔הָ אֶת־יַעְזֵ֖ר וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁ֑הָ כׇּל־עָרִ֖ים אַרְבַּֽע׃
verses.translit: 'tchshbvn v'tmgrshh 'ty'zr v'tmgrshh khl'rym 'rb'
verses.translation: Heshbon with the open land about it, Jazer with the open land about it; four cities in all.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כׇּל־הֶ֨עָרִ֜ים לִבְנֵ֤י מְרָרִי֙ לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֔ם הַנּוֹתָרִ֖ים מִמִּשְׁפְּח֣וֹת הַלְוִיִּ֑ם וַֽיְהִי֙ גּוֹרָלָ֔ם עָרִ֖ים שְׁתֵּ֥ים עֶשְׂרֵֽה׃
verses.translit: khlh'rym lbny mrry lmshpchtm hnvtrym mmshpchvt hlvym vyhy gvrlm 'rym shtym 'shrh
verses.translation: All these were the cities of the children of Merari according to their families, even the rest of the families of the Levites; and their lot was twelve cities.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֹּ֚ל עָרֵ֣י הַלְוִיִּ֔ם בְּת֖וֹךְ אֲחֻזַּ֣ת בְּנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל עָרִ֛ים אַרְבָּעִ֥ים וּשְׁמֹנֶ֖ה וּמִגְרְשֵׁיהֶֽן׃
verses.translit: khl 'ry hlvym btvkh 'chzt bnyyshr'l 'rym 'rb'ym vshmnh vmgrshyhn
verses.translation: All the cities of the Levites—forty and eight cities with the open land about them—shall be in the midst of the possession of the children of Israel,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תִּֽהְיֶ֙ינָה֙ הֶעָרִ֣ים הָאֵ֔לֶּה עִ֣יר עִ֔יר וּמִגְרָשֶׁ֖יהָ סְבִיבֹתֶ֑יהָ כֵּ֖ן לְכׇל־הֶעָרִ֥ים הָאֵֽלֶּה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: thyynh h'rym h'lh 'yr 'yr vmgrshyh sbybtyh khn lkhlh'rym h'lh {s}
verses.translation: even these cities, every one with the open land round about it; thus it shall be with all these cities.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּתֵּ֤ן יְהֹוָה֙ לְיִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֶ֨ת־כׇּל־הָאָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֥ר נִשְׁבַּ֖ע לָתֵ֣ת לַאֲבוֹתָ֑ם וַיִּרָשׁ֖וּהָ וַיֵּ֥שְׁבוּ בָֽהּ׃
verses.translit: vytn yhvh lyshr'l 'tkhlh'rts 'shr nshb' ltt l'bvtm vyrshvh vyshbv bh
verses.translation: So the LORD gave unto Israel all the land which He swore to give unto their fathers; and they possessed it, and dwelt therein.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּ֨נַח יְהֹוָ֤ה לָהֶם֙ מִסָּבִ֔יב כְּכֹ֥ל אֲשֶׁר־נִשְׁבַּ֖ע לַאֲבוֹתָ֑ם וְלֹא־עָ֨מַד אִ֤ישׁ בִּפְנֵיהֶם֙ מִכׇּל־אֹ֣יְבֵיהֶ֔ם אֵ֚ת כׇּל־אֹ֣יְבֵיהֶ֔ם נָתַ֥ן יְהֹוָ֖ה בְּיָדָֽם׃
verses.translit: vynch yhvh lhm msbyb khkhl 'shrnshb' l'bvtm vl''md 'ysh bpnyhm mkhl'ybyhm 't khl'ybyhm ntn yhvh bydm
verses.translation: And the LORD gave them rest round about, according to all that He swore unto their fathers; and there stood not a man of all their enemies against them; the LORD delivered all their enemies into their hand.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֹא־נָפַ֣ל דָּבָ֔ר מִכֹּל֙ הַדָּבָ֣ר הַטּ֔וֹב אֲשֶׁר־דִּבֶּ֥ר יְהֹוָ֖ה אֶל־בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל הַכֹּ֖ל בָּֽא׃ {פ}
verses.translit: l'npl dbr mkhl hdbr htvb 'shrdbr yhvh 'lbyt yshr'l hkhl b' {p}
verses.translation: There failed not aught of any good thing which the LORD had spoken unto the house of Israel; all came to pass.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אָ֚ז יִקְרָ֣א יְהוֹשֻׁ֔עַ לָראוּבֵנִ֖י וְלַגָּדִ֑י וְלַחֲצִ֖י מַטֵּ֥ה מְנַשֶּֽׁה׃
verses.translit: 'z yqr' yhvsh' lr'vbny vlgdy vlchtsy mth mnshh
verses.translation: Then Joshua called the Reubenites, and the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֲלֵיהֶ֔ם אַתֶּ֣ם שְׁמַרְתֶּ֔ם אֵ֚ת כׇּל־אֲשֶׁ֣ר צִוָּ֣ה אֶתְכֶ֔ם מֹשֶׁ֖ה עֶ֣בֶד יְהֹוָ֑ה וַתִּשְׁמְע֣וּ בְקוֹלִ֔י לְכֹ֥ל אֲשֶׁר־צִוִּ֖יתִי אֶתְכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lyhm 'tm shmrtm 't khl'shr tsvh 'tkhm mshh 'bd yhvh vtshm'v bqvly lkhl 'shrtsvyty 'tkhm
verses.translation: and said unto them: ‘Ye have kept all that Moses the servant of the LORD commanded you, and have hearkened unto my voice in all that I commanded you;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֹֽא־עֲזַבְתֶּ֣ם אֶת־אֲחֵיכֶ֗ם זֶ֚ה יָמִ֣ים רַבִּ֔ים עַ֖ד הַיּ֣וֹם הַזֶּ֑ה וּשְׁמַרְתֶּ֕ם אֶת־מִשְׁמֶ֕רֶת מִצְוַ֖ת יְהֹוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: l''zbtm 't'chykhm zh ymym rbym 'd hyvm hzh vshmrtm 'tmshmrt mtsvt yhvh 'lhykhm
verses.translation: ye have not left your brethren these many days unto this day, but have kept the charge of the commandment of the LORD your God.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֗ה הֵנִ֨יחַ יְהֹוָ֤ה אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶם֙ לַאֲחֵיכֶ֔ם כַּֽאֲשֶׁ֖ר דִּבֶּ֣ר לָהֶ֑ם וְעַתָּ֡ה פְּנוּ֩ וּלְכ֨וּ לָכֶ֜ם לְאׇהֳלֵיכֶ֗ם אֶל־אֶ֙רֶץ֙ אֲחֻזַּתְכֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֣ר  נָתַ֣ן לָכֶ֗ם מֹשֶׁה֙ עֶ֣בֶד יְהֹוָ֔ה בְּעֵ֖בֶר הַיַּרְדֵּֽן׃
verses.translit: v'th hnych yhvh 'lhykhm l'chykhm kh'shr dbr lhm v'th pnv vlkhv lkhm l'hlykhm 'l'rts 'chztkhm 'shr  ntn lkhm mshh 'bd yhvh b'br hyrdn
verses.translation: And now the LORD your God hath given rest unto your brethren, as He spoke unto them; therefore now turn ye, and get you unto your tents, unto the land of your possession, which Moses the servant of the LORD gave you beyond the Jordan.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: רַ֣ק  שִׁמְר֣וּ מְאֹ֗ד לַעֲשׂ֨וֹת אֶת־הַמִּצְוָ֣ה וְאֶת־הַתּוֹרָה֮ אֲשֶׁ֣ר צִוָּ֣ה אֶתְכֶם֮ מֹשֶׁ֣ה עֶֽבֶד־יְהֹוָה֒ לְ֠אַהֲבָ֠ה אֶת־יְהֹוָ֨ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֜ם וְלָלֶ֧כֶת בְּכׇל־דְּרָכָ֛יו וְלִשְׁמֹ֥ר מִצְוֺתָ֖יו וּלְדׇבְקָה־ב֑וֹ וּלְעׇבְד֕וֹ בְּכׇל־לְבַבְכֶ֖ם וּבְכׇל־נַפְשְׁכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: rq  shmrv m'd l'shvt 'thmtsvh v'thtvrh 'shr tsvh 'tkhm mshh 'bdyhvh l'hbh 'tyhvh 'lhykhm vllkht bkhldrkhyv vlshmr mtsvtyv vldbqhbv vl'bdv bkhllbbkhm vbkhlnpshkhm
verses.translation: Only take diligent heed to do the commandment and the law, which Moses the servant of the LORD commanded you, to love the LORD your God, and to walk in all His ways, and to keep His commandments, and to cleave unto Him, and to serve Him with all your heart and with all your soul.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽיְבָרְכֵ֖ם יְהוֹשֻׁ֑עַ וַֽיְשַׁלְּחֵ֔ם וַיֵּלְכ֖וּ אֶל־אׇהֳלֵיהֶֽם׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vybrkhm yhvsh' vyshlchm vylkhv 'l'hlyhm {p}
verses.translation: So Joshua blessed them, and sent them away; and they went unto their tents.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלַֽחֲצִ֣י  שֵׁ֣בֶט הַֽמְנַשֶּׁ֗ה נָתַ֣ן מֹשֶׁה֮ בַּבָּשָׁן֒ וּלְחֶצְי֗וֹ נָתַ֤ן יְהוֹשֻׁ֙עַ֙ עִם־אֲחֵיהֶ֔ם (מעבר) [בְּעֵ֥בֶר] הַיַּרְדֵּ֖ן יָ֑מָּה וְ֠גַ֠ם כִּֽי־שִׁלְּחָ֧ם יְהוֹשֻׁ֛עַ אֶל־אׇהֳלֵיהֶ֖ם וַֽיְבָרְכֵֽם׃
verses.translit: vlchtsy  shbt hmnshh ntn mshh bbshn vlchtsyv ntn yhvsh' 'm'chyhm (m'br) [b'br] hyrdn ymh vgm khyshlchm yhvsh' 'l'hlyhm vybrkhm
verses.translation: Now to the one half-tribe of Manasseh Moses had given inheritance in Bashan; but unto the other half gave Joshua among their brethren beyond the Jordan westward. Moreover when Joshua sent them away unto their tents, he blessed them,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר אֲלֵיהֶ֜ם לֵאמֹ֗ר בִּנְכָסִ֨ים רַבִּ֜ים שׁ֤וּבוּ אֶל־אׇֽהֳלֵיכֶם֙ וּבְמִקְנֶ֣ה רַב־מְאֹ֔ד בְּכֶ֨סֶף וּבְזָהָ֜ב וּבִנְחֹ֧שֶׁת וּבְבַרְזֶ֛ל וּבִשְׂלָמ֖וֹת הַרְבֵּ֣ה מְאֹ֑ד חִלְק֥וּ שְׁלַל־אֹיְבֵיכֶ֖ם עִם־אֲחֵיכֶֽם׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lyhm l'mr bnkhsym rbym shvbv 'l'hlykhm vbmqnh rbm'd bkhsf vbzhb vbnchsht vbbrzl vbshlmvt hrbh m'd chlqv shll'ybykhm 'm'chykhm {p}
verses.translation: and spoke unto them, saying: ‘Return with much wealth unto your tents, and with very much cattle, with silver, and with gold, and with brass, and with iron, and with very much raiment; divide the spoil of your enemies with your brethren.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּשֻׁ֣בוּ וַיֵּלְכ֡וּ בְּנֵֽי־רְאוּבֵ֨ן וּבְנֵי־גָ֜ד וַחֲצִ֣י  שֵׁ֣בֶט הַֽמְנַשֶּׁ֗ה מֵאֵת֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל מִשִּׁלֹ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּאֶֽרֶץ־כְּנָ֑עַן לָלֶ֜כֶת אֶל־אֶ֣רֶץ הַגִּלְעָ֗ד אֶל־אֶ֤רֶץ אֲחֻזָּתָם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר נֹֽאחֲזוּ־בָ֔הּ עַל־פִּ֥י יְהֹוָ֖ה בְּיַד־מֹשֶֽׁה׃
verses.translit: vyshbv vylkhv bnyr'vbn vbnygd vchtsy  shbt hmnshh m't bny yshr'l mshlh 'shr b'rtskhn'n llkht 'l'rts hgl'd 'l'rts 'chztm 'shr n'chzvbh 'lpy yhvh bydmshh
verses.translation: And the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half-tribe of Manasseh returned, and departed from the children of Israel out of Shiloh, which is in the land of Canaan, to go unto the land of Gilead, to the land of their possession, whereof they were possessed, according to the commandment of the LORD by the hand of Moses.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּבֹ֙אוּ֙ אֶל־גְּלִיל֣וֹת הַיַּרְדֵּ֔ן אֲשֶׁ֖ר בְּאֶ֣רֶץ כְּנָ֑עַן וַיִּבְנ֣וּ בְנֵי־רְאוּבֵ֣ן וּבְנֵי־גָ֡ד וַחֲצִ֣י שֵׁ֩בֶט֩ הַֽמְנַשֶּׁ֨ה שָׁ֤ם מִזְבֵּ֙חַ֙ עַל־הַיַּרְדֵּ֔ן מִזְבֵּ֥חַ גָּד֖וֹל לְמַרְאֶֽה׃
verses.translit: vyb'v 'lglylvt hyrdn 'shr b'rts khn'n vybnv bnyr'vbn vbnygd vchtsy shbt hmnshh shm mzbch 'lhyrdn mzbch gdvl lmr'h
verses.translation: And when they came unto the region about the Jordan, that is in the land of Canaan, the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half-tribe of Manasseh built there an altar by the Jordan, a great altar to look upon.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁמְע֥וּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לֵאמֹ֑ר הִנֵּ֣ה בָנ֣וּ בְנֵי־רְאוּבֵ֣ן וּבְנֵי־גָ֡ד וַחֲצִי֩ שֵׁ֨בֶט הַֽמְנַשֶּׁ֜ה אֶת־הַמִּזְבֵּ֗חַ אֶל־מוּל֙ אֶ֣רֶץ כְּנַ֔עַן אֶל־גְּלִילוֹת֙ הַיַּרְדֵּ֔ן אֶל־עֵ֖בֶר בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: vyshm'v bnyyshr'l l'mr hnh bnv bnyr'vbn vbnygd vchtsy shbt hmnshh 'thmzbch 'lmvl 'rts khn'n 'lglylvt hyrdn 'l'br bny yshr'l
verses.translation: And the children of Israel heard say: ‘Behold, the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half-tribe of Manasseh have built an altar in the forefront of the land of Canaan, in the region about the Jordan, on the side that pertaineth to the children of Israel.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽיִּשְׁמְע֖וּ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיִּקָּ֨הֲל֜וּ כׇּל־עֲדַ֤ת בְּנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ שִׁלֹ֔ה לַעֲל֥וֹת עֲלֵיהֶ֖ם לַצָּבָֽא׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vyshm'v bny yshr'l vyqhlv khl'dt bnyyshr'l shlh l'lvt 'lyhm ltsb' {p}
verses.translation: And when the children of Israel heard of it, the whole congregation of the children of Israel gathered themselves together at Shiloh, to go up against them to war.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁלְח֨וּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל אֶל־בְּנֵי־רְאוּבֵ֧ן וְאֶל־בְּנֵי־גָ֛ד וְאֶל־חֲצִ֥י שֵֽׁבֶט־מְנַשֶּׁ֖ה אֶל־אֶ֣רֶץ הַגִּלְעָ֑ד אֶת־פִּֽינְחָ֖ס בֶּן־אֶלְעָזָ֥ר הַכֹּהֵֽן׃
