verses.translation: And he said unto Jether his first-born: ‘Up, and slay them.’ But the youth drew not his sword; for he feared, because he was yet a youth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֜אמֶר זֶ֣בַח וְצַלְמֻנָּ֗ע ק֤וּם אַתָּה֙ וּפְגַע־בָּ֔נוּ כִּ֥י כָאִ֖ישׁ גְּבוּרָת֑וֹ וַיָּ֣קׇם גִּדְע֗וֹן וַֽיַּהֲרֹג֙ אֶת־זֶ֣בַח וְאֶת־צַלְמֻנָּ֔ע וַיִּקַּח֙ אֶת־הַשַּׂ֣הֲרֹנִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֖ר בְּצַוְּארֵ֥י גְמַלֵּיהֶֽם׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vy'mr zbch vtslmn' qvm 'th vpg'bnv khy kh'ysh gbvrtv vyqm gd'vn vyhrg 'tzbch v'ttslmn' vyqch 'thshhrnym 'shr btsv'ry gmlyhm {p}
verses.translation: Then Zebah and Zalmunna said: ‘Rise thou, and fall upon us; for as the man is, so is his strength.’ And Gideon arose, and slew Zebah and Zalmunna, and took the crescents that were on their camels’necks.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּאמְר֤וּ אִֽישׁ־יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ אֶל־גִּדְע֔וֹן מְשָׁל־בָּ֙נוּ֙ גַּם־אַתָּ֔ה גַּם־בִּנְךָ֖ גַּ֣ם בֶּן־בְּנֶ֑ךָ כִּ֥י הוֹשַׁעְתָּ֖נוּ מִיַּ֥ד מִדְיָֽן׃
verses.translit: vy'mrv 'yshyshr'l 'lgd'vn mshlbnv gm'th gmbnkh gm bnbnkh khy hvsh'tnv myd mdyn
verses.translation: Then the men of Israel said unto Gideon: ‘Rule thou over us, both thou, and thy son, and thy son’s son also; for thou hast saved us out of the hand of Midian.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֲלֵהֶם֙ גִּדְע֔וֹן לֹֽא־אֶמְשֹׁ֤ל אֲנִי֙ בָּכֶ֔ם וְלֹא־יִמְשֹׁ֥ל בְּנִ֖י בָּכֶ֑ם יְהֹוָ֖ה יִמְשֹׁ֥ל בָּכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lhm gd'vn l''mshl 'ny bkhm vl'ymshl bny bkhm yhvh ymshl bkhm
verses.translation: And Gideon said unto them: ‘I will not rule over you, neither shall my son rule over you; the LORD shall rule over you.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר אֲלֵהֶ֜ם גִּדְע֗וֹן אֶשְׁאֲלָ֤ה מִכֶּם֙ שְׁאֵלָ֔ה וּתְנוּ־לִ֕י אִ֖ישׁ נֶ֣זֶם שְׁלָל֑וֹ כִּֽי־נִזְמֵ֤י זָהָב֙ לָהֶ֔ם כִּ֥י יִשְׁמְעֵאלִ֖ים הֵֽם׃
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lhm gd'vn 'sh'lh mkhm sh'lh vtnvly 'ysh nzm shllv khynzmy zhb lhm khy yshm''lym hm
verses.translation: And Gideon said unto them: ‘I would make a request of you, that ye would give me every man the ear-rings of his spoil.’—For they had golden ear-rings, because they were Ishmaelites.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּאמְר֖וּ נָת֣וֹן נִתֵּ֑ן וַֽיִּפְרְשׂוּ֙ אֶת־הַשִּׂמְלָ֔ה וַיַּשְׁלִ֣יכוּ שָׁ֔מָּה אִ֖ישׁ נֶ֥זֶם שְׁלָלֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vy'mrv ntvn ntn vyprshv 'thshmlh vyshlykhv shmh 'ysh nzm shllv
verses.translation: And they answered: ‘We will willingly give them.’ And they spread a garment, and did cast therein every man the ear-rings of his spoil.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֗י מִשְׁקַ֞ל נִזְמֵ֤י הַזָּהָב֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר שָׁאָ֔ל אֶ֥לֶף וּשְׁבַע־מֵא֖וֹת זָהָ֑ב לְ֠בַ֠ד מִן־הַשַּׂהֲרֹנִ֨ים וְהַנְּטִיפ֜וֹת וּבִגְדֵ֣י הָאַרְגָּמָ֗ן שֶׁעַל֙ מַלְכֵ֣י מִדְיָ֔ן וּלְבַד֙ מִן־הָ֣עֲנָק֔וֹת אֲשֶׁ֖ר בְּצַוְּארֵ֥י גְמַלֵּיהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vyhy mshql nzmy hzhb 'shr sh'l 'lf vshb'm'vt zhb lbd mnhshhrnym vhntypvt vbgdy h'rgmn sh'l mlkhy mdyn vlbd mnh'nqvt 'shr btsv'ry gmlyhm
verses.translation: And the weight of the golden ear-rings that he requested was a thousand and seven hundred shekels of gold; beside the crescents, and the pendants, and the purple raiment that was on the kings of Midian, and beside the chains that were about their camels’necks.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֩עַשׂ֩ אוֹת֨וֹ גִדְע֜וֹן לְאֵפ֗וֹד וַיַּצֵּ֨ג אוֹת֤וֹ בְעִירוֹ֙ בְּעׇפְרָ֔ה וַיִּזְנ֧וּ כׇֽל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל אַחֲרָ֖יו שָׁ֑ם וַיְהִ֛י לְגִדְע֥וֹן וּלְבֵית֖וֹ לְמוֹקֵֽשׁ׃
verses.translit: vy'sh 'vtv gd'vn l'pvd vytsg 'vtv b'yrv b'prh vyznv khlyshr'l 'chryv shm vyhy lgd'vn vlbytv lmvqsh
verses.translation: And Gideon made an ephod thereof, and put it in his city, even in Ophrah; and all Israel went astray after it there; and it became a snare unto Gideon, and to his house.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּכָּנַ֣ע מִדְיָ֗ן לִפְנֵי֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְלֹ֥א יָסְפ֖וּ לָשֵׂ֣את רֹאשָׁ֑ם וַתִּשְׁקֹ֥ט הָאָ֛רֶץ אַרְבָּעִ֥ים שָׁנָ֖ה בִּימֵ֥י גִדְעֽוֹן׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vykhn' mdyn lpny bny yshr'l vl' yspv lsh't r'shm vtshqt h'rts 'rb'ym shnh bymy gd'vn {p}
verses.translation: So Midian was subdued before the children of Israel, and they lifted up their heads no more. And the land had rest forty years in the days of Gideon.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֵּ֛לֶךְ יְרֻבַּ֥עַל בֶּן־יוֹאָ֖שׁ וַיֵּ֥שֶׁב בְּבֵיתֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vylkh yrb'l bnyv'sh vyshb bbytv
verses.translation: And Jerubbaal the son of Joash went and dwelt in his own house.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּלְגִדְע֗וֹן הָיוּ֙ שִׁבְעִ֣ים בָּנִ֔ים יֹצְאֵ֖י יְרֵכ֑וֹ כִּֽי־נָשִׁ֥ים רַבּ֖וֹת הָ֥יוּ לֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vlgd'vn hyv shb'ym bnym yts'y yrkhv khynshym rbvt hyv lv
verses.translation: And Gideon had threescore and ten sons of his body begotten; for he had many wives.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּפִֽילַגְשׁוֹ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בִּשְׁכֶ֔ם יָֽלְדָה־לּ֥וֹ גַם־הִ֖יא בֵּ֑ן וַיָּ֥שֶׂם אֶת־שְׁמ֖וֹ אֲבִימֶֽלֶךְ׃
verses.translit: vpylgshv 'shr bshkhm yldhlv gmhy' bn vyshm 'tshmv 'bymlkh
verses.translation: And his concubine that was in Shechem, she also bore him a son, and he called his name Abimelech.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּ֛מׇת גִּדְע֥וֹן בֶּן־יוֹאָ֖שׁ בְּשֵׂיבָ֣ה טוֹבָ֑ה וַיִּקָּבֵ֗ר בְּקֶ֙בֶר֙ יוֹאָ֣שׁ אָבִ֔יו בְּעׇפְרָ֖ה אֲבִ֥י הָעֶזְרִֽי׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vymt gd'vn bnyv'sh bshybh tvbh vyqbr bqbr yv'sh 'byv b'prh 'by h'zry {p}
verses.translation: And Gideon the son of Joash died in a good old age, and was buried in the sepulchre of Joash his father, in Ophrah of the Abiezrites.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֗י כַּֽאֲשֶׁר֙ מֵ֣ת גִּדְע֔וֹן וַיָּשׁ֙וּבוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וַיִּזְנ֖וּ אַחֲרֵ֣י הַבְּעָלִ֑ים וַיָּשִׂ֧ימוּ לָהֶ֛ם בַּ֥עַל בְּרִ֖ית לֵאלֹהִֽים׃
verses.translit: vyhy kh'shr mt gd'vn vyshvbv bny yshr'l vyznv 'chry hb'lym vyshymv lhm b'l bryt l'lhym
verses.translation: And it came to pass, as soon as Gideon was dead, that the children of Israel again went astray after the Baalim, and made Baal-berith their god.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלֹ֤א זָֽכְרוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֶת־יְהֹוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵיהֶ֑ם הַמַּצִּ֥יל אוֹתָ֛ם מִיַּ֥ד כׇּל־אֹיְבֵיהֶ֖ם מִסָּבִֽיב׃
verses.translit: vl' zkhrv bny yshr'l 'tyhvh 'lhyhm hmtsyl 'vtm myd khl'ybyhm msbyb
verses.translation: And the children of Israel remembered not the LORD their God, who had delivered them out of the hand of all their enemies on every side;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלֹא־עָשׂ֣וּ חֶ֔סֶד עִם־בֵּ֥ית יְרֻבַּ֖עַל גִּדְע֑וֹן כְּכׇ֨ל־הַטּוֹבָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשָׂ֖ה עִם־יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vl''shv chsd 'mbyt yrb'l gd'vn khkhlhtvbh 'shr 'shh 'myshr'l {p}
verses.translation: neither showed they kindness to the house of Jerubbaal, namely Gideon, according to all the goodness which he had shown unto Israel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֵּ֨לֶךְ אֲבִימֶ֤לֶךְ בֶּן־יְרֻבַּ֙עַל֙ שְׁכֶ֔מָה אֶל־אֲחֵ֖י אִמּ֑וֹ וַיְדַבֵּ֣ר אֲלֵיהֶ֔ם וְאֶל־כׇּל־מִשְׁפַּ֛חַת בֵּית־אֲבִ֥י אִמּ֖וֹ לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: vylkh 'bymlkh bnyrb'l shkhmh 'l'chy 'mv vydbr 'lyhm v'lkhlmshpcht byt'by 'mv l'mr
verses.translation: And Abimelech the son of Jerubbaal went to Shechem unto his mother’s brethren, and spoke with them, and with all the family of the house of his mother’s father, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: דַּבְּרוּ־נָ֞א בְּאׇזְנֵ֨י כׇל־בַּעֲלֵ֣י שְׁכֶם֮ מַה־טּ֣וֹב לָכֶם֒ הַמְשֹׁ֨ל בָּכֶ֜ם שִׁבְעִ֣ים אִ֗ישׁ כֹּ֚ל בְּנֵ֣י יְרֻבַּ֔עַל אִם־מְשֹׁ֥ל בָּכֶ֖ם אִ֣ישׁ אֶחָ֑ד וּזְכַרְתֶּ֕ם כִּֽי־עַצְמְכֶ֥ם וּבְשַׂרְכֶ֖ם אָֽנִי׃
verses.translit: dbrvn' b'zny khlb'ly shkhm mhtvb lkhm hmshl bkhm shb'ym 'ysh khl bny yrb'l 'mmshl bkhm 'ysh 'chd vzkhrtm khy'tsmkhm vbshrkhm 'ny
verses.translation: ’Speak, I pray you, in the ears of all the men of Shechem: Which is better for you, that all the sons of Jerubbaal, who are threescore and ten persons, rule over you, or that one rule over you? remember also that I am your bone and your flesh.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְדַבְּר֨וּ אֲחֵי־אִמּ֜וֹ עָלָ֗יו בְּאׇזְנֵי֙ כׇּל־בַּעֲלֵ֣י שְׁכֶ֔ם אֵ֥ת כׇּל־הַדְּבָרִ֖ים הָאֵ֑לֶּה וַיֵּ֤ט לִבָּם֙ אַחֲרֵ֣י אֲבִימֶ֔לֶךְ כִּ֥י אָמְר֖וּ אָחִ֥ינוּ הֽוּא׃
verses.translit: vydbrv 'chy'mv 'lyv b'zny khlb'ly shkhm 't khlhdbrym h'lh vyt lbm 'chry 'bymlkh khy 'mrv 'chynv hv'
verses.translation: And his mother’s brethren spoke of him in the ears of all the men of Shechem all these words; and their hearts inclined to follow Abimelech; for they said: ‘He is our brother.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּתְּנוּ־לוֹ֙ שִׁבְעִ֣ים כֶּ֔סֶף מִבֵּ֖ית בַּ֣עַל בְּרִ֑ית וַיִּשְׂכֹּ֨ר בָּהֶ֜ם אֲבִימֶ֗לֶךְ אֲנָשִׁ֤ים רֵיקִים֙ וּפֹ֣חֲזִ֔ים וַיֵּלְכ֖וּ אַחֲרָֽיו׃
verses.translit: vytnvlv shb'ym khsf mbyt b'l bryt vyshkhr bhm 'bymlkh 'nshym ryqym vpchzym vylkhv 'chryv
verses.translation: And they gave him threescore and ten pieces of silver out of the house of Baal-berith, wherewith Abimelech hired vain and light fellows, who followed him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּבֹ֤א בֵית־אָבִיו֙ עׇפְרָ֔תָה וַֽיַּהֲרֹ֞ג אֶת־אֶחָ֧יו בְּנֵי־יְרֻבַּ֛עַל שִׁבְעִ֥ים אִ֖ישׁ עַל־אֶ֣בֶן אֶחָ֑ת וַיִּוָּתֵ֞ר יוֹתָ֧ם בֶּן־יְרֻבַּ֛עַל הַקָּטֹ֖ן כִּ֥י נֶחְבָּֽא׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vyb' byt'byv 'prth vyhrg 't'chyv bnyyrb'l shb'ym 'ysh 'l'bn 'cht vyvtr yvtm bnyrb'l hqtn khy nchb' {s}
verses.translation: And he went unto his father’s house at Ophrah, and slew his brethren the sons of Jerubbaal, being threescore and ten persons, upon one stone; but Jotham the youngest son of Jerubbaal was left; for he hid himself.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֵּאָ֨סְפ֜וּ כׇּל־בַּעֲלֵ֤י שְׁכֶם֙ וְכׇל־בֵּ֣ית מִלּ֔וֹא וַיֵּ֣לְכ֔וּ וַיַּמְלִ֥יכוּ אֶת־אֲבִימֶ֖לֶךְ לְמֶ֑לֶךְ עִם־אֵל֥וֹן מֻצָּ֖ב אֲשֶׁ֥ר בִּשְׁכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vy'spv khlb'ly shkhm vkhlbyt mlv' vylkhv vymlykhv 't'bymlkh lmlkh 'm'lvn mtsb 'shr bshkhm
verses.translation: And all the men of Shechem assembled themselves together, and all Beth-millo, and went and made Abimelech king, by the terebinth of the pillar that was in Shechem.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּגִּ֣דוּ לְיוֹתָ֗ם וַיֵּ֙לֶךְ֙ וַֽיַּעֲמֹד֙ בְּרֹ֣אשׁ הַר־גְּרִזִ֔ים וַיִּשָּׂ֥א קוֹל֖וֹ וַיִּקְרָ֑א וַיֹּ֣אמֶר לָהֶ֗ם שִׁמְע֤וּ אֵלַי֙ בַּעֲלֵ֣י שְׁכֶ֔ם וְיִשְׁמַ֥ע אֲלֵיכֶ֖ם אֱלֹהִֽים׃
verses.translit: vygdv lyvtm vylkh vy'md br'sh hrgrzym vysh' qvlv vyqr' vy'mr lhm shm'v 'ly b'ly shkhm vyshm' 'lykhm 'lhym
verses.translation: And when they told it to Jotham, he went and stood in the top of mount Gerizim, and lifted up his voice, and cried, and said unto them: ‘Hearken unto me, ye men of Shechem, that God may hearken unto you.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הָל֤וֹךְ הָֽלְכוּ֙ הָעֵצִ֔ים לִמְשֹׁ֥חַ עֲלֵיהֶ֖ם מֶ֑לֶךְ וַיֹּאמְר֥וּ לַזַּ֖יִת (מלוכה) [מׇלְכָ֥ה] עָלֵֽינוּ׃
verses.translit: hlvkh hlkhv h'tsym lmshch 'lyhm mlkh vy'mrv lzyt (mlvkhh) [mlkhh] 'lynv
verses.translation: The trees went forth on a time to anoint a king over them; and they said unto the olive-tree: Reign thou over us.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר לָהֶם֙ הַזַּ֔יִת הֶחֳדַ֙לְתִּי֙ אֶת־דִּשְׁנִ֔י אֲשֶׁר־בִּ֛י יְכַבְּד֥וּ אֱלֹהִ֖ים וַאֲנָשִׁ֑ים וְהָ֣לַכְתִּ֔י לָנ֖וּעַ עַל־הָעֵצִֽים׃
verses.translit: vy'mr lhm hzyt hchdlty 'tdshny 'shrby ykhbdv 'lhym v'nshym vhlkhty lnv' 'lh'tsym
verses.translation: But the olive-tree said unto them: Should I leave my fatness, seeing that by me they honour God and man, and go to hold sway over the trees?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּאמְר֥וּ הָעֵצִ֖ים לַתְּאֵנָ֑ה לְכִי־אַ֖תְּ מׇלְכִ֥י עָלֵֽינוּ׃
verses.translit: vy'mrv h'tsym lt'nh lkhy't mlkhy 'lynv
verses.translation: And the trees said to the fig-tree: Come thou, and reign over us.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתֹּ֤אמֶר לָהֶם֙ הַתְּאֵנָ֔ה הֶחֳדַ֙לְתִּי֙ אֶת־מׇתְקִ֔י וְאֶת־תְּנוּבָתִ֖י הַטּוֹבָ֑ה וְהָ֣לַכְתִּ֔י לָנ֖וּעַ עַל־הָעֵצִֽים׃
verses.translit: vt'mr lhm ht'nh hchdlty 'tmtqy v'ttnvbty htvbh vhlkhty lnv' 'lh'tsym
verses.translation: But the fig-tree said unto them: Should I leave my sweetness, and my good fruitage, and go to hold sway over the trees?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּאמְר֥וּ הָעֵצִ֖ים לַגָּ֑פֶן לְכִי־אַ֖תְּ (מלוכי) [מׇלְכִ֥י] עָלֵֽינוּ׃
verses.translit: vy'mrv h'tsym lgpn lkhy't (mlvkhy) [mlkhy] 'lynv
verses.translation: And the trees said unto the vine: Come thou, and reign over us.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתֹּ֤אמֶר לָהֶם֙ הַגֶּ֔פֶן הֶחֳדַ֙לְתִּי֙ אֶת־תִּ֣ירוֹשִׁ֔י הַֽמְשַׂמֵּ֥חַ אֱלֹהִ֖ים וַאֲנָשִׁ֑ים וְהָ֣לַכְתִּ֔י לָנ֖וּעַ עַל־הָעֵצִֽים׃
verses.translit: vt'mr lhm hgpn hchdlty 'ttyrvshy hmshmch 'lhym v'nshym vhlkhty lnv' 'lh'tsym
verses.translation: And the vine said unto them: Should I leave my wine, which cheereth God and man, and go to hold sway over the trees?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּאמְר֥וּ כׇל־הָעֵצִ֖ים אֶל־הָאָטָ֑ד לֵ֥ךְ אַתָּ֖ה מְלׇךְ־עָלֵֽינוּ׃
verses.translit: vy'mrv khlh'tsym 'lh'td lkh 'th mlkh'lynv
verses.translation: Then said all the trees unto the bramble: Come thou, and reign over us.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר הָאָטָד֮ אֶל־הָעֵצִים֒ אִ֡ם בֶּאֱמֶ֣ת אַתֶּם֩ מֹשְׁחִ֨ים אֹתִ֤י לְמֶ֙לֶךְ֙ עֲלֵיכֶ֔ם בֹּ֖אוּ חֲס֣וּ בְצִלִּ֑י וְאִם־אַ֕יִן תֵּ֤צֵא אֵשׁ֙ מִן־הָ֣אָטָ֔ד וְתֹאכַ֖ל אֶת־אַרְזֵ֥י הַלְּבָנֽוֹן׃
verses.translit: vy'mr h'td 'lh'tsym 'm b'mt 'tm mshchym 'ty lmlkh 'lykhm b'v chsv btsly v'm'yn tts' 'sh mnh'td vt'khl 't'rzy hlbnvn
verses.translation: And the bramble said unto the trees: If in truth ye anoint me king over you, then come and take refuge in my shadow; and if not, let fire come out of the bramble, and devour the cedars of Lebanon.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֗ה אִם־בֶּאֱמֶ֤ת וּבְתָמִים֙ עֲשִׂיתֶ֔ם וַתַּמְלִ֖יכוּ אֶת־אֲבִימֶ֑לֶךְ וְאִם־טוֹבָ֤ה עֲשִׂיתֶם֙ עִם־יְרֻבַּ֣עַל וְעִם־בֵּית֔וֹ וְאִם־כִּגְמ֥וּל יָדָ֖יו עֲשִׂ֥יתֶם לֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: v'th 'mb'mt vbtmym 'shytm vtmlykhv 't'bymlkh v'mtvbh 'shytm 'myrb'l v'mbytv v'mkhgmvl ydyv 'shytm lv
verses.translation: Now therefore, if ye have dealt truly and uprightly, in that ye have made Abimelech king, and if ye have dealt well with Jerubbaal and his house, and have done unto him according to the deserving of his hands—
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲשֶׁר־נִלְחַ֥ם אָבִ֖י עֲלֵיכֶ֑ם וַיַּשְׁלֵ֤ךְ אֶת־נַפְשׁוֹ֙ מִנֶּ֔גֶד וַיַּצֵּ֥ל אֶתְכֶ֖ם מִיַּ֥ד מִדְיָֽן׃
verses.translit: 'shrnlchm 'by 'lykhm vyshlkh 'tnpshv mngd vytsl 'tkhm myd mdyn
verses.translation: for my father fought for you, and adventured his life, and delivered you out of the hand of Midian;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאַתֶּ֞ם קַמְתֶּ֨ם עַל־בֵּ֤ית אָבִי֙ הַיּ֔וֹם וַתַּהַרְג֧וּ אֶת־בָּנָ֛יו שִׁבְעִ֥ים אִ֖ישׁ עַל־אֶ֣בֶן אֶחָ֑ת וַתַּמְלִ֜יכוּ אֶת־אֲבִימֶ֤לֶךְ בֶּן־אֲמָתוֹ֙ עַל־בַּעֲלֵ֣י שְׁכֶ֔ם כִּ֥י אֲחִיכֶ֖ם הֽוּא׃
verses.translit: v'tm qmtm 'lbyt 'by hyvm vthrgv 'tbnyv shb'ym 'ysh 'l'bn 'cht vtmlykhv 't'bymlkh bn'mtv 'lb'ly shkhm khy 'chykhm hv'
verses.translation: and ye are risen up against my father’s house this day, and have slain his sons, threescore and ten persons, upon one stone, and have made Abimelech, the son of his maid-servant, king over the men of Shechem, because he is your brother—
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאִם־בֶּאֱמֶ֨ת וּבְתָמִ֧ים עֲשִׂיתֶ֛ם עִם־יְרֻבַּ֥עַל וְעִם־בֵּית֖וֹ הַיּ֣וֹם הַזֶּ֑ה שִׂמְחוּ֙ בַּאֲבִימֶ֔לֶךְ וְיִשְׂמַ֥ח גַּם־ה֖וּא בָּכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: v'mb'mt vbtmym 'shytm 'myrb'l v'mbytv hyvm hzh shmchv b'bymlkh vyshmch gmhv' bkhm
verses.translation: if ye then have dealt truly and uprightly with Jerubbaal and with his house this day, then rejoice ye in Abimelech, and let him also rejoice in you.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאִם־אַ֕יִן תֵּ֤צֵא אֵשׁ֙ מֵאֲבִימֶ֔לֶךְ וְתֹאכַ֛ל אֶת־בַּעֲלֵ֥י שְׁכֶ֖ם וְאֶת־בֵּ֣ית מִלּ֑וֹא וְתֵצֵ֨א אֵ֜שׁ מִבַּעֲלֵ֤י שְׁכֶם֙ וּמִבֵּ֣ית מִלּ֔וֹא וְתֹאכַ֖ל אֶת־אֲבִימֶֽלֶךְ׃
verses.translit: v'm'yn tts' 'sh m'bymlkh vt'khl 'tb'ly shkhm v'tbyt mlv' vtts' 'sh mb'ly shkhm vmbyt mlv' vt'khl 't'bymlkh
verses.translation: But if not, let fire come out from Abimelech, and devour the men of Shechem, and Beth-millo; and let fire come out from the men of Shechem, and from Beth-millo, and devour Abimelech.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּ֣נׇס יוֹתָ֔ם וַיִּבְרַ֖ח וַיֵּ֣לֶךְ בְּאֵ֑רָה וַיֵּ֣שֶׁב שָׁ֔ם מִפְּנֵ֖י אֲבִימֶ֥לֶךְ אָחִֽיו׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vyns yvtm vybrch vylkh b'rh vyshb shm mpny 'bymlkh 'chyv {p}
verses.translation: And Jotham ran away, and fled, and went to Beer, and dwelt there, for fear of Abimelech his brother.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּ֧שַׂר אֲבִימֶ֛לֶךְ עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל שָׁלֹ֥שׁ שָׁנִֽים׃
verses.translit: vyshr 'bymlkh 'lyshr'l shlsh shnym
verses.translation: And Abimelech was prince over Israel three years.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁלַ֤ח אֱלֹהִים֙ ר֣וּחַ רָעָ֔ה בֵּ֣ין אֲבִימֶ֔לֶךְ וּבֵ֖ין בַּעֲלֵ֣י שְׁכֶ֑ם וַיִּבְגְּד֥וּ בַעֲלֵֽי־שְׁכֶ֖ם בַּאֲבִימֶֽלֶךְ׃
verses.translit: vyshlch 'lhym rvch r'h byn 'bymlkh vbyn b'ly shkhm vybgdv b'lyshkhm b'bymlkh
verses.translation: And God sent an evil spirit between Abimelech and the men of Shechem; and the men of Shechem dealt treacherously with Abimelech;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לָב֕וֹא חֲמַ֖ס שִׁבְעִ֣ים בְּנֵֽי־יְרֻבָּ֑עַל וְדָמָ֗ם לָשׂ֞וּם עַל־אֲבִימֶ֤לֶךְ אֲחִיהֶם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הָרַ֣ג אוֹתָ֔ם וְעַל֙ בַּעֲלֵ֣י שְׁכֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁר־חִזְּק֥וּ אֶת־יָדָ֖יו לַהֲרֹ֥ג אֶת־אֶחָֽיו׃
verses.translit: lbv' chms shb'ym bnyyrb'l vdmm lshvm 'l'bymlkh 'chyhm 'shr hrg 'vtm v'l b'ly shkhm 'shrchzqv 'tydyv lhrg 't'chyv
verses.translation: that the violence done to the threescore and ten sons of Jerubbaal might come, and that their blood might be laid upon Abimelech their brother, who slew them, and upon the men of Shechem, who strengthened his hands to slay his brethren.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּשִׂ֣ימוּ לוֹ֩ בַעֲלֵ֨י שְׁכֶ֜ם מְאָֽרְבִ֗ים עַ֚ל רָאשֵׁ֣י הֶהָרִ֔ים וַֽיִּגְזְל֔וּ אֵ֛ת כׇּל־אֲשֶׁר־יַעֲבֹ֥ר עֲלֵיהֶ֖ם בַּדָּ֑רֶךְ וַיֻּגַּ֖ד לַאֲבִימֶֽלֶךְ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vyshymv lv b'ly shkhm m'rbym 'l r'shy hhrym vygzlv 't khl'shry'br 'lyhm bdrkh vygd l'bymlkh {p}
verses.translation: And the men of Shechem set liers-in-wait for him on the tops of the mountains, and they robbed all that came along that way by them; and it was told Abimelech.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּבֹ֞א גַּ֤עַל בֶּן־עֶ֙בֶד֙ וְאֶחָ֔יו וַיַּעַבְר֖וּ בִּשְׁכֶ֑ם וַיִּבְטְחוּ־ב֖וֹ בַּעֲלֵ֥י שְׁכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vyb' g'l bn'bd v'chyv vy'brv bshkhm vybtchvbv b'ly shkhm
verses.translation: And Gaal the son of Ebed came with his brethren, and went on to Shechem; and the men of Shechem put their trust in him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֵּצְא֨וּ הַשָּׂדֶ֜ה וַֽיִּבְצְר֤וּ אֶת־כַּרְמֵיהֶם֙ וַֽיִּדְרְכ֔וּ וַֽיַּעֲשׂ֖וּ הִלּוּלִ֑ים וַיָּבֹ֙אוּ֙ בֵּ֣ית אֱֽלֹהֵיהֶ֔ם וַיֹּֽאכְלוּ֙ וַיִּשְׁתּ֔וּ וַֽיְקַלְל֖וּ אֶת־אֲבִימֶֽלֶךְ׃
verses.translit: vyts'v hshdh vybtsrv 'tkhrmyhm vydrkhv vy'shv hlvlym vyb'v byt 'lhyhm vy'khlv vyshtv vyqllv 't'bymlkh
verses.translation: And they went out into the field, and gathered their vineyards, and trod the grapes, and held festival, and went into the house of their god, and did eat and drink, and cursed Abimelech.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר  גַּ֣עַל בֶּן־עֶ֗בֶד מִֽי־אֲבִימֶ֤לֶךְ וּמִֽי־שְׁכֶם֙ כִּ֣י נַעַבְדֶ֔נּוּ הֲלֹ֥א בֶן־יְרֻבַּ֖עַל וּזְבֻ֣ל פְּקִיד֑וֹ עִבְד֗וּ אֶת־אַנְשֵׁ֤י חֲמוֹר֙ אֲבִ֣י שְׁכֶ֔ם וּמַדּ֖וּעַ נַעַבְדֶ֥נּוּ אֲנָֽחְנוּ׃
verses.translit: vy'mr  g'l bn'bd my'bymlkh vmyshkhm khy n'bdnv hl' bnyrb'l vzbl pqydv 'bdv 't'nshy chmvr 'by shkhm vmdv' n'bdnv 'nchnv
verses.translation: And Gaal the son of Ebed said: ‘Who is Abimelech, and who is Shechem, that we should serve him? is not he the son of Jerubbaal? and Zebul his officer? serve ye the men of Hamor the father of Shechem; but why should we serve him?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמִ֨י יִתֵּ֜ן אֶת־הָעָ֤ם הַזֶּה֙ בְּיָדִ֔י וְאָסִ֖ירָה אֶת־אֲבִימֶ֑לֶךְ וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ לַאֲבִימֶ֔לֶךְ רַבֶּ֥ה צְבָאֲךָ֖ וָצֵֽאָה׃
verses.translit: vmy ytn 'th'm hzh bydy v'syrh 't'bymlkh vy'mr l'bymlkh rbh tsb'kh vts'h
verses.translation: And would that this people were under my hand! then would I remove Abimelech.’ And he said to Abimelech: ‘Increase thine army, and come out.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁמַ֗ע זְבֻל֙ שַׂר־הָעִ֔יר אֶת־דִּבְרֵ֖י גַּ֣עַל בֶּן־עָ֑בֶד וַיִּ֖חַר אַפּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vyshm' zbl shrh'yr 'tdbry g'l bn'bd vychr 'pv
verses.translation: And when Zebul the ruler of the city heard the words of Gaal the son of Ebed, his anger was kindled.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁלַ֧ח מַלְאָכִ֛ים אֶל־אֲבִימֶ֖לֶךְ בְּתׇרְמָ֣ה לֵאמֹ֑ר הִנֵּה֩ גַ֨עַל בֶּן־עֶ֤בֶד וְאֶחָיו֙ בָּאִ֣ים שְׁכֶ֔מָה וְהִנָּ֛ם צָרִ֥ים אֶת־הָעִ֖יר עָלֶֽיךָ׃
verses.translit: vyshlch ml'khym 'l'bymlkh btrmh l'mr hnh g'l bn'bd v'chyv b'ym shkhmh vhnm tsrym 'th'yr 'lykh
verses.translation: And he sent messengers unto Abimelech in Tormah, saying: ‘Behold, Gaal the son of Ebed and his brethren are come to Shechem; and, behold, they will incite the city against thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַתָּה֙ ק֣וּם לַ֔יְלָה אַתָּ֖ה וְהָעָ֣ם אֲשֶׁר־אִתָּ֑ךְ וֶאֱרֹ֖ב בַּשָּׂדֶֽה׃
verses.translit: v'th qvm lylh 'th vh'm 'shr'tkh v'rb bshdh
verses.translation: Now therefore, up by night, thou and the people that are with thee, and lie in wait in the field.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָיָ֤ה בַבֹּ֙קֶר֙ כִּזְרֹ֣חַ הַשֶּׁ֔מֶשׁ תַּשְׁכִּ֖ים וּפָשַׁטְתָּ֣ עַל־הָעִ֑יר וְהִנֵּה־ה֞וּא וְהָעָ֤ם אֲשֶׁר־אִתּוֹ֙ יֹצְאִ֣ים אֵלֶ֔יךָ וְעָשִׂ֣יתָ לּ֔וֹ כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר תִּמְצָ֥א יָדֶֽךָ׃
verses.translit: vhyh bbqr khzrch hshmsh tshkhym vpshtt 'lh'yr vhnhhv' vh'm 'shr'tv yts'ym 'lykh v'shyt lv kh'shr tmts' ydkh
verses.translation: And it shall be, that in the morning, as soon as the sun is up, thou shalt rise early, and set upon the city; and, behold, when he and the people that are with him come out against thee, then mayest thou do to them as thou shalt be able.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּ֧קׇם אֲבִימֶ֛לֶךְ וְכׇל־הָעָ֥ם אֲשֶׁר־עִמּ֖וֹ לָ֑יְלָה וַיֶּאֶרְב֣וּ עַל־שְׁכֶ֔ם אַרְבָּעָ֖ה רָאשִֽׁים׃
verses.translit: vyqm 'bymlkh vkhlh'm 'shr'mv lylh vy'rbv 'lshkhm 'rb'h r'shym
verses.translation: And Abimelech rose up, and all the people that were with him, by night, and they lay in wait against Shechem in four companies.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֵּצֵא֙ גַּ֣עַל בֶּן־עֶ֔בֶד וַיַּעֲמֹ֕ד פֶּ֖תַח שַׁ֣עַר הָעִ֑יר וַיָּ֧קׇם אֲבִימֶ֛לֶךְ וְהָעָ֥ם אֲשֶׁר־אִתּ֖וֹ מִן־הַמַּאְרָֽב׃
verses.translit: vyts' g'l bn'bd vy'md ptch sh'r h'yr vyqm 'bymlkh vh'm 'shr'tv mnhm'rb
verses.translation: And Gaal the son of Ebed went out, and stood in the entrance of the gate of the city; and Abimelech rose up, and the people that were with him, from the ambushment.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּרְא־גַּ֘עַל֮ אֶת־הָעָם֒ וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֶל־זְבֻ֔ל הִנֵּה־עָ֣ם יוֹרֵ֔ד מֵרָאשֵׁ֖י הֶהָרִ֑ים וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֵלָיו֙ זְבֻ֔ל אֵ֣ת צֵ֧ל הֶהָרִ֛ים אַתָּ֥ה רֹאֶ֖ה כָּאֲנָשִֽׁים׃
verses.translit: vyr'g'l 'th'm vy'mr 'lzbl hnh'm yvrd mr'shy hhrym vy'mr 'lyv zbl 't tsl hhrym 'th r'h kh'nshym
verses.translation: And when Gaal saw the people, he said to Zebul: ‘Behold, there come people down from the tops of the mountains.’ And Zebul said unto him: ‘Thou seest the shadow of the mountains as if they were men.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨סֶף ע֣וֹד גַּ֘עַל֮ לְדַבֵּר֒ וַיֹּ֕אמֶר הִנֵּה־עָם֙ יֽוֹרְדִ֔ים מֵעִ֖ם טַבּ֣וּר הָאָ֑רֶץ וְרֹאשׁ־אֶחָ֣ד בָּ֔א מִדֶּ֖רֶךְ אֵל֥וֹן מְעוֹנְנִֽים׃
verses.translit: vysf 'vd g'l ldbr vy'mr hnh'm yvrdym m'm tbvr h'rts vr'sh'chd b' mdrkh 'lvn m'vnnym
verses.translation: And Gaal spoke again and said: ‘See, there come people down by the middle of the land, and one company cometh by the way of Elon-meonenim.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר אֵלָ֜יו זְבֻ֗ל אַיֵּ֨ה אֵפ֥וֹא פִ֙יךָ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תֹּאמַ֔ר מִ֥י אֲבִימֶ֖לֶךְ כִּ֣י נַעַבְדֶ֑נּוּ הֲלֹ֨א זֶ֤ה הָעָם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר מָאַ֣סְתָּה בּ֔וֹ צֵא־נָ֥א עַתָּ֖ה וְהִלָּ֥חֶם בּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lyv zbl 'yh 'pv' pykh 'shr t'mr my 'bymlkh khy n'bdnv hl' zh h'm 'shr m'sth bv ts'n' 'th vhlchm bv
verses.translation: Then said Zebul unto him: ‘Where is now thy mouth, that thou saidst: Who is Abimelech, that we should serve him? is not this the people that thou hast despised? go out now, I pray, and fight with them.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֵּ֣צֵא גַ֔עַל לִפְנֵ֖י בַּעֲלֵ֣י שְׁכֶ֑ם וַיִּלָּ֖חֶם בַּאֲבִימֶֽלֶךְ׃
verses.translit: vyts' g'l lpny b'ly shkhm vylchm b'bymlkh
verses.translation: And Gaal went out before the men of Shechem, and fought with Abimelech.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּרְדְּפֵ֣הוּ אֲבִימֶ֔לֶךְ וַיָּ֖נׇס מִפָּנָ֑יו וַֽיִּפְּל֛וּ חֲלָלִ֥ים רַבִּ֖ים עַד־פֶּ֥תַח הַשָּֽׁעַר׃
verses.translit: vyrdphv 'bymlkh vyns mpnyv vyplv chllym rbym 'dptch hsh'r
verses.translation: And Abimelech chased him, and he fled before him, and there fell many wounded, even unto the entrance of the gate.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֵּ֥שֶׁב אֲבִימֶ֖לֶךְ בָּֽארוּמָ֑ה וַיְגָ֧רֶשׁ זְבֻ֛ל אֶת־גַּ֥עַל וְאֶת־אֶחָ֖יו מִשֶּׁ֥בֶת בִּשְׁכֶֽם׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vyshb 'bymlkh b'rvmh vygrsh zbl 'tg'l v't'chyv mshbt bshkhm {s}
verses.translation: And Abimelech dwelt at Arumah; and Zebul drove out Gaal and his brethren, that they should not dwell in Shechem.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽיְהִי֙ מִֽמׇּחֳרָ֔ת וַיֵּצֵ֥א הָעָ֖ם הַשָּׂדֶ֑ה וַיַּגִּ֖דוּ לַאֲבִימֶֽלֶךְ׃
verses.translit: vyhy mmchrt vyts' h'm hshdh vygdv l'bymlkh
verses.translation: And it came to pass on the morrow, that the people went out into the field; and it was told Abimelech.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּקַּ֣ח אֶת־הָעָ֗ם וַיֶּֽחֱצֵם֙ לִשְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה רָאשִׁ֔ים וַיֶּאֱרֹ֖ב בַּשָּׂדֶ֑ה וַיַּ֗רְא וְהִנֵּ֤ה הָעָם֙ יֹצֵ֣א מִן־הָעִ֔יר וַיָּ֥קׇם עֲלֵיהֶ֖ם וַיַּכֵּֽם׃
verses.translit: vyqch 'th'm vychtsm lshlshh r'shym vy'rb bshdh vyr' vhnh h'm yts' mnh'yr vyqm 'lyhm vykhm
verses.translation: And he took the people, and divided them into three companies, and lay in wait in the field; and he looked, and, behold, the people were coming forth out of the city; and he rose up against them, and smote them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַאֲבִימֶ֗לֶךְ וְהָֽרָאשִׁים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עִמּ֔וֹ פָּשְׁט֕וּ וַיַּ֣עַמְד֔וּ פֶּ֖תַח שַׁ֣עַר הָעִ֑יר וּשְׁנֵ֣י הָרָאשִׁ֗ים פָּ֥שְׁט֛וּ עַֽל־כׇּל־אֲשֶׁ֥ר בַּשָּׂדֶ֖ה וַיַּכּֽוּם׃
verses.translit: v'bymlkh vhr'shym 'shr 'mv pshtv vy'mdv ptch sh'r h'yr vshny hr'shym pshtv 'lkhl'shr bshdh vykhvm
verses.translation: And Abimelech, and the companies that were with him, rushed forward, and stood in the entrance of the gate of the city; and the two companies rushed upon all that were in the field, and smote them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַאֲבִימֶ֜לֶךְ נִלְחָ֣ם בָּעִ֗יר כֹּ֚ל הַיּ֣וֹם הַה֔וּא וַיִּלְכֹּד֙ אֶת־הָעִ֔יר וְאֶת־הָעָ֥ם אֲשֶׁר־בָּ֖הּ הָרָ֑ג וַיִּתֹּץ֙ אֶת־הָעִ֔יר וַיִּזְרָעֶ֖הָ מֶֽלַח׃ {פ}
verses.translit: v'bymlkh nlchm b'yr khl hyvm hhv' vylkhd 'th'yr v'th'm 'shrbh hrg vytts 'th'yr vyzr'h mlch {p}
verses.translation: And Abimelech fought against the city all that day; and he took the city, and slew the people that were therein; and he beat down the city, and sowed it with salt.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽיִּשְׁמְע֔וּ כׇּֽל־בַּעֲלֵ֖י מִֽגְדַּל־שְׁכֶ֑ם וַיָּבֹ֣אוּ אֶל־צְרִ֔יחַ בֵּ֖ית אֵ֥ל בְּרִֽית׃
verses.translit: vyshm'v khlb'ly mgdlshkhm vyb'v 'ltsrych byt 'l bryt
verses.translation: And when all the men of the tower of Shechem heard thereof, they entered into the hold of the house of El-berith.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֻּגַּ֖ד לַאֲבִימֶ֑לֶךְ כִּ֣י הִֽתְקַבְּצ֔וּ כׇּֽל־בַּעֲלֵ֖י מִֽגְדַּל־שְׁכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vygd l'bymlkh khy htqbtsv khlb'ly mgdlshkhm
verses.translation: And it was told Abimelech that all the men of the tower of Shechem were gathered together.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֨עַל אֲבִימֶ֜לֶךְ הַר־צַלְמ֗וֹן הוּא֮ וְכׇל־הָעָ֣ם אֲשֶׁר־אִתּוֹ֒ וַיִּקַּח֩ אֲבִימֶ֨לֶךְ אֶת־הַקַּרְדֻּמּ֜וֹת בְּיָד֗וֹ וַיִּכְרֹת֙ שׂוֹכַ֣ת עֵצִ֔ים וַיִּ֨שָּׂאֶ֔הָ וַיָּ֖שֶׂם עַל־שִׁכְמ֑וֹ וַיֹּ֜אמֶר אֶל־הָעָ֣ם אֲשֶׁר־עִמּ֗וֹ מָ֤ה רְאִיתֶם֙ עָשִׂ֔יתִי מַהֲר֖וּ עֲשׂ֥וּ כָמֽוֹנִי׃
verses.translit: vy'l 'bymlkh hrtslmvn hv' vkhlh'm 'shr'tv vyqch 'bymlkh 'thqrdmvt bydv vykhrt shvkht 'tsym vysh'h vyshm 'lshkhmv vy'mr 'lh'm 'shr'mv mh r'ytm 'shyty mhrv 'shv khmvny
verses.translation: And Abimelech got him up to mount Zalmon, he and all the people that were with him; and Abimelech took an axe in his hand, and cut down a bough from the trees, and took it up, and laid it on his shoulder; and he said unto the people that were with him: ‘What ye have seen me do, make haste, and do as I have done.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּכְרְת֨וּ גַם־כׇּל־הָעָ֜ם אִ֣ישׁ שׂוֹכֹ֗ה וַיֵּ֨לְכ֜וּ אַחֲרֵ֤י אֲבִימֶ֙לֶךְ֙ וַיָּשִׂ֣ימוּ עַֽל־הַצְּרִ֔יחַ וַיַּצִּ֧יתוּ עֲלֵיהֶ֛ם אֶֽת־הַצְּרִ֖יחַ בָּאֵ֑שׁ וַיָּמֻ֜תוּ גַּ֣ם כׇּל־אַנְשֵׁ֧י מִֽגְדַּל־שְׁכֶ֛ם כְּאֶ֖לֶף אִ֥ישׁ וְאִשָּֽׁה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vykhrtv gmkhlh'm 'ysh shvkhh vylkhv 'chry 'bymlkh vyshymv 'lhtsrych vytsytv 'lyhm 'thtsrych b'sh vymtv gm khl'nshy mgdlshkhm kh'lf 'ysh v'shh {p}
verses.translation: And all the people likewise cut down every man his bough, and followed Abimelech, and put them to the hold, and set the hold on fire upon them; so that all the men of the tower of Shechem died also, about a thousand men and women.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֵּ֥לֶךְ אֲבִימֶ֖לֶךְ אֶל־תֵּבֵ֑ץ וַיִּ֥חַן בְּתֵבֵ֖ץ וַֽיִּלְכְּדָֽהּ׃
verses.translit: vylkh 'bymlkh 'ltbts vychn btbts vylkhdh
verses.translation: Then went Abimelech to Thebez, and encamped against Thebez, and took it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמִגְדַּל־עֹז֮ הָיָ֣ה בְתוֹךְ־הָעִיר֒ וַיָּנֻ֨סוּ שָׁ֜מָּה כׇּל־הָאֲנָשִׁ֣ים וְהַנָּשִׁ֗ים וְכֹל֙ בַּעֲלֵ֣י הָעִ֔יר וַֽיִּסְגְּר֖וּ בַּעֲדָ֑ם וַֽיַּעֲל֖וּ עַל־גַּ֥ג הַמִּגְדָּֽל׃
verses.translit: vmgdl'z hyh btvkhh'yr vynsv shmh khlh'nshym vhnshym vkhl b'ly h'yr vysgrv b'dm vy'lv 'lgg hmgdl
verses.translation: But there was a strong tower within the city, and thither fled all the men and women, even all they of the city, and shut themselves in, and got them up to the roof of the tower.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּבֹ֤א אֲבִימֶ֙לֶךְ֙ עַד־הַמִּגְדָּ֔ל וַיִּלָּ֖חֶם בּ֑וֹ וַיִּגַּ֛שׁ עַד־פֶּ֥תַח הַמִּגְדָּ֖ל לְשׇׂרְפ֥וֹ בָאֵֽשׁ׃
verses.translit: vyb' 'bymlkh 'dhmgdl vylchm bv vygsh 'dptch hmgdl lshrpv b'sh
verses.translation: And Abimelech came unto the tower, and fought against it, and went close unto the door of the tower to burn it with fire.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתַּשְׁלֵ֞ךְ אִשָּׁ֥ה אַחַ֛ת פֶּ֥לַח רֶ֖כֶב עַל־רֹ֣אשׁ אֲבִימֶ֑לֶךְ וַתָּ֖רִץ אֶת־גֻּלְגׇּלְתּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vtshlkh 'shh 'cht plch rkhb 'lr'sh 'bymlkh vtrts 'tglgltv
verses.translation: And a certain woman cast an upper millstone upon Abimelech’s head, and broke his skull.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּקְרָ֨א מְהֵרָ֜ה אֶל־הַנַּ֣עַר  נֹשֵׂ֣א כֵלָ֗יו וַיֹּ֤אמֶר לוֹ֙ שְׁלֹ֤ף חַרְבְּךָ֙ וּמ֣וֹתְתֵ֔נִי פֶּן־יֹ֥אמְרוּ לִ֖י אִשָּׁ֣ה הֲרָגָ֑תְהוּ וַיִּדְקְרֵ֥הוּ נַעֲר֖וֹ וַיָּמֹֽת׃
verses.translit: vyqr' mhrh 'lhn'r  nsh' khlyv vy'mr lv shlf chrbkh vmvttny pny'mrv ly 'shh hrgthv vydqrhv n'rv vymt
verses.translation: Then he called hastily unto the young man his armour-bearer, and said unto him: ‘Draw thy sword, and kill me, that men say not of me: A woman slew him.’ And his young man thrust him through, and he died.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּרְא֥וּ אִֽישׁ־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל כִּ֣י מֵ֣ת אֲבִימֶ֑לֶךְ וַיֵּלְכ֖וּ אִ֥ישׁ לִמְקֹמֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vyr'v 'yshyshr'l khy mt 'bymlkh vylkhv 'ysh lmqmv
verses.translation: And when the men of Israel saw that Abimelech was dead, they departed every man unto his place.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּ֣שֶׁב אֱלֹהִ֔ים אֵ֖ת רָעַ֣ת אֲבִימֶ֑לֶךְ אֲשֶׁ֤ר עָשָׂה֙ לְאָבִ֔יו לַהֲרֹ֖ג אֶת־שִׁבְעִ֥ים אֶחָֽיו׃
verses.translit: vyshb 'lhym 't r't 'bymlkh 'shr 'shh l'byv lhrg 'tshb'ym 'chyv
verses.translation: Thus God requited the wickedness of Abimelech, which he did unto his father, in slaying his seventy brethren;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֵ֗ת כׇּל־רָעַת֙ אַנְשֵׁ֣י שְׁכֶ֔ם הֵשִׁ֥יב אֱלֹהִ֖ים בְּרֹאשָׁ֑ם וַתָּבֹ֣א אֲלֵיהֶ֔ם קִֽלְלַ֖ת יוֹתָ֥ם בֶּן־יְרֻבָּֽעַל׃ {פ}
verses.translit: v't khlr't 'nshy shkhm hshyb 'lhym br'shm vtb' 'lyhm qllt yvtm bnyrb'l {p}
verses.translation: and all the wickedness of the men of Shechem did God requite upon their heads; and upon them came the curse of Jotham the son of Jerubbaal.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּ֩קׇם֩ אַחֲרֵ֨י אֲבִימֶ֜לֶךְ לְהוֹשִׁ֣יעַ אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל תּוֹלָ֧ע בֶּן־פּוּאָ֛ה בֶּן־דּוֹד֖וֹ אִ֣ישׁ יִשָּׂשכָ֑ר וְהוּא־יֹשֵׁ֥ב בְּשָׁמִ֖יר בְּהַ֥ר אֶפְרָֽיִם׃
verses.translit: vyqm 'chry 'bymlkh lhvshy' 'tyshr'l tvl' bnpv'h bndvdv 'ysh yshshkhr vhv'yshb bshmyr bhr 'prym
verses.translation: And after Abimelech there arose to save Israel Tola the son of Puah, the son of Dodo, a man of Issachar; and he dwelt in Shamir in the hill-country of Ephraim.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁפֹּט֙ אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וְשָׁלֹ֖שׁ שָׁנָ֑ה וַיָּ֖מׇת וַיִּקָּבֵ֥ר בְּשָׁמִֽיר׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vyshpt 'tyshr'l 'shrym vshlsh shnh vymt vyqbr bshmyr {p}
verses.translation: And he judged Israel twenty and three years, and died, and was buried in Shamir.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּ֣קׇם אַחֲרָ֔יו יָאִ֖יר הַגִּלְעָדִ֑י וַיִּשְׁפֹּט֙ אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וּשְׁתַּ֖יִם שָׁנָֽה׃
verses.translit: vyqm 'chryv y'yr hgl'dy vyshpt 'tyshr'l 'shrym vshtym shnh
verses.translation: And after him arose Jair, the Gileadite; and he judged Israel twenty and two years.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽיְהִי־ל֞וֹ שְׁלֹשִׁ֣ים בָּנִ֗ים רֹֽכְבִים֙ עַל־שְׁלֹשִׁ֣ים עֲיָרִ֔ים וּשְׁלֹשִׁ֥ים עֲיָרִ֖ים לָהֶ֑ם לָהֶ֞ם יִקְרְא֣וּ  חַוֺּ֣ת יָאִ֗יר עַ֚ד הַיּ֣וֹם הַזֶּ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֖ר בְּאֶ֥רֶץ הַגִּלְעָֽד׃
verses.translit: vyhylv shlshym bnym rkhbym 'lshlshym 'yrym vshlshym 'yrym lhm lhm yqr'v  chvt y'yr 'd hyvm hzh 'shr b'rts hgl'd
verses.translation: And he had thirty sons that rode on thirty ass colts, and they had thirty cities, which are called Havvoth-jair unto this day, which are in the land of Gilead.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּ֣מׇת יָאִ֔יר וַיִּקָּבֵ֖ר בְּקָמֽוֹן׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vymt y'yr vyqbr bqmvn {p}
verses.translation: And Jair died, and was buried in Kamon.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּסִ֣יפוּ  בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל לַעֲשׂ֣וֹת הָרַע֮ בְּעֵינֵ֣י יְהֹוָה֒ וַיַּעַבְד֣וּ אֶת־הַבְּעָלִ֣ים וְאֶת־הָעַשְׁתָּר֡וֹת וְאֶת־אֱלֹהֵ֣י אֲרָם֩ וְאֶת־אֱלֹהֵ֨י צִיד֜וֹן וְאֵ֣ת  אֱלֹהֵ֣י מוֹאָ֗ב וְאֵת֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י בְנֵֽי־עַמּ֔וֹן וְאֵ֖ת אֱלֹהֵ֣י פְלִשְׁתִּ֑ים וַיַּעַזְב֥וּ אֶת־יְהֹוָ֖ה וְלֹ֥א עֲבָדֽוּהוּ׃
verses.translit: vysypv  bny yshr'l l'shvt hr' b'yny yhvh vy'bdv 'thb'lym v'th'shtrvt v't'lhy 'rm v't'lhy tsydvn v't  'lhy mv'b v't 'lhy bny'mvn v't 'lhy plshtym vy'zbv 'tyhvh vl' 'bdvhv
verses.translation: And the children of Israel again did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD, and served the Baalim, and the Ashtaroth, and the gods of Aram, and the gods of Zidon, and the gods of Moab, and the gods of the children of Ammon, and the gods of the Philistines; and they forsook the LORD, and served Him not.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּֽחַר־אַ֥ף יְהֹוָ֖ה בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַֽיִּמְכְּרֵם֙ בְּיַד־פְּלִשְׁתִּ֔ים וּבְיַ֖ד בְּנֵ֥י עַמּֽוֹן׃
verses.translit: vychr'f yhvh byshr'l vymkhrm bydplshtym vbyd bny 'mvn
verses.translation: And the anger of the LORD was kindled against Israel, and He gave them over into the hand of the Philistines, and into the hand of the children of Ammon.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽיִּרְעֲצ֤וּ וַיְרֹֽצְצוּ֙ אֶת־בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל בַּשָּׁנָ֖ה הַהִ֑יא שְׁמֹנֶ֨ה עֶשְׂרֵ֜ה שָׁנָ֗ה אֶֽת־כׇּל־בְּנֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ אֲשֶׁר֙ בְּעֵ֣בֶר הַיַּרְדֵּ֔ן בְּאֶ֥רֶץ הָאֱמֹרִ֖י אֲשֶׁ֥ר בַּגִּלְעָֽד׃
verses.translit: vyr'tsv vyrtstsv 'tbny yshr'l bshnh hhy' shmnh 'shrh shnh 'tkhlbny yshr'l 'shr b'br hyrdn b'rts h'mry 'shr bgl'd
verses.translation: And they oppressed and crushed the children of Israel that year; eighteen years [oppressed they] all the children of Israel that were beyond the Jordan in the land of the Amorites, which is in Gilead.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּעַבְר֤וּ בְנֵֽי־עַמּוֹן֙ אֶת־הַיַּרְדֵּ֔ן לְהִלָּחֵ֛ם גַּם־בִּיהוּדָ֥ה וּבְבִנְיָמִ֖ין וּבְבֵ֣ית אֶפְרָ֑יִם וַתֵּ֥צֶר לְיִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל מְאֹֽד׃
verses.translit: vy'brv bny'mvn 'thyrdn lhlchm gmbyhvdh vbbnymyn vbbyt 'prym vttsr lyshr'l m'd
verses.translation: And the children of Ammon passed over the Jordan to fight also against Judah, and against Benjamin, and against the house of Ephraim, so that Israel was sore distressed.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽיִּזְעֲקוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֶל־יְהֹוָ֖ה לֵאמֹ֑ר חָטָ֣אנוּ לָ֔ךְ וְכִ֤י עָזַ֙בְנוּ֙ אֶת־אֱלֹהֵ֔ינוּ וַֽנַּעֲבֹ֖ד אֶת־הַבְּעָלִֽים׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vyz'qv bny yshr'l 'lyhvh l'mr cht'nv lkh vkhy 'zbnv 't'lhynv vn'bd 'thb'lym {p}
verses.translation: And the children of Israel cried unto the LORD, saying: ‘We have sinned against Thee, in that we have forsaken our God, and have served the Baalim.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר יְהֹוָ֖ה אֶל־בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל הֲלֹ֤א מִמִּצְרַ֙יִם֙ וּמִן־הָ֣אֱמֹרִ֔י וּמִן־בְּנֵ֥י עַמּ֖וֹן וּמִן־פְּלִשְׁתִּֽים׃
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'lbny yshr'l hl' mmtsrym vmnh'mry vmnbny 'mvn vmnplshtym
verses.translation: And the LORD said unto the children of Israel: ‘Did not I save you from the Egyptians, and from the Amorites, from the children of Ammon, and from the Philistines?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְצִידוֹנִ֤ים וַֽעֲמָלֵק֙ וּמָע֔וֹן לָחֲצ֖וּ אֶתְכֶ֑ם וַתִּצְעֲק֣וּ אֵלַ֔י וָאוֹשִׁ֥יעָה אֶתְכֶ֖ם מִיָּדָֽם׃
verses.translit: vtsydvnym v'mlq vm'vn lchtsv 'tkhm vtts'qv 'ly v'vshy'h 'tkhm mydm
verses.translation: The Zidonians also, and the Amalekites, and the Maonites, did oppress you; and ye cried unto Me, and I saved you out of their hand.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאַתֶּם֙ עֲזַבְתֶּ֣ם אוֹתִ֔י וַתַּעַבְד֖וּ אֱלֹהִ֣ים אֲחֵרִ֑ים לָכֵ֥ן לֹֽא־אוֹסִ֖יף לְהוֹשִׁ֥יעַ אֶתְכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: v'tm 'zbtm 'vty vt'bdv 'lhym 'chrym lkhn l''vsyf lhvshy' 'tkhm
verses.translation: Yet ye have forsaken Me, and served other gods; wherefore I will save you no more.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְכ֗וּ וְזַֽעֲקוּ֙ אֶל־הָ֣אֱלֹהִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר בְּחַרְתֶּ֖ם בָּ֑ם הֵ֛מָּה יוֹשִׁ֥יעוּ לָכֶ֖ם בְּעֵ֥ת צָרַתְכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: lkhv vz'qv 'lh'lhym 'shr bchrtm bm hmh yvshy'v lkhm b't tsrtkhm
verses.translation: Go and cry unto the gods which ye have chosen; let them save you in the time of your distress.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּאמְר֨וּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֤ל אֶל־יְהֹוָה֙ חָטָ֔אנוּ עֲשֵֽׂה־אַתָּ֣ה לָ֔נוּ כְּכׇל־הַטּ֖וֹב בְּעֵינֶ֑יךָ אַ֛ךְ הַצִּילֵ֥נוּ נָ֖א הַיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃
verses.translit: vy'mrv bnyyshr'l 'lyhvh cht'nv 'shh'th lnv khkhlhtvb b'ynykh 'kh htsylnv n' hyvm hzh
verses.translation: And the children of Israel said unto the LORD: ‘We have sinned; do Thou unto us whatsoever seemeth good unto Thee; only deliver us, we pray Thee, this day.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּסִ֜ירוּ אֶת־אֱלֹהֵ֤י הַנֵּכָר֙ מִקִּרְבָּ֔ם וַיַּעַבְד֖וּ אֶת־יְהֹוָ֑ה וַתִּקְצַ֥ר נַפְשׁ֖וֹ בַּעֲמַ֥ל יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vysyrv 't'lhy hnkhr mqrbm vy'bdv 'tyhvh vtqtsr npshv b'ml yshr'l {p}
verses.translation: And they put away the strange gods from among them, and served the LORD; and His soul was grieved for the misery of Israel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּצָּֽעֲקוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י עַמּ֔וֹן וַֽיַּחֲנ֖וּ בַּגִּלְעָ֑ד וַיֵּאָֽסְפוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וַֽיַּחֲנ֖וּ בַּמִּצְפָּֽה׃
verses.translit: vyts'qv bny 'mvn vychnv bgl'd vy'spv bny yshr'l vychnv bmtsph
verses.translation: Then the children of Ammon were gathered together, and encamped in Gilead. And the children of Israel assembled themselves together, and encamped in Mizpah.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּאמְר֨וּ הָעָ֜ם שָׂרֵ֤י גִלְעָד֙ אִ֣ישׁ אֶל־רֵעֵ֔הוּ מִ֣י הָאִ֔ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יָחֵ֔ל לְהִלָּחֵ֖ם בִּבְנֵ֣י עַמּ֑וֹן יִֽהְיֶ֣ה לְרֹ֔אשׁ לְכֹ֖ל יֹשְׁבֵ֥י גִלְעָֽד׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vy'mrv h'm shry gl'd 'ysh 'lr'hv my h'ysh 'shr ychl lhlchm bbny 'mvn yhyh lr'sh lkhl yshby gl'd {p}
verses.translation: And the people, the princes of Gilead, said one to another: ‘What man is he that will begin to fight against the children of Ammon? he shall be head over all the inhabitants of Gilead.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְיִפְתָּ֣ח הַגִּלְעָדִ֗י הָיָה֙ גִּבּ֣וֹר חַ֔יִל וְה֖וּא בֶּן־אִשָּׁ֣ה זוֹנָ֑ה וַיּ֥וֹלֶד גִּלְעָ֖ד אֶת־יִפְתָּֽח׃
verses.translit: vyptch hgl'dy hyh gbvr chyl vhv' bn'shh zvnh vyvld gl'd 'typtch
verses.translation: Now Jephthah the Gileadite was a mighty man of valour, and he was the son of a harlot; and Gilead begot Jephthah.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתֵּ֧לֶד אֵֽשֶׁת־גִּלְעָ֛ד ל֖וֹ בָּנִ֑ים וַיִּגְדְּל֨וּ בְֽנֵי־הָאִשָּׁ֜ה וַיְגָרְשׁ֣וּ אֶת־יִפְתָּ֗ח וַיֹּ֤אמְרוּ לוֹ֙ לֹא־תִנְחַ֣ל בְּבֵית־אָבִ֔ינוּ כִּ֛י בֶּן־אִשָּׁ֥ה אַחֶ֖רֶת אָֽתָּה׃
verses.translit: vtld 'shtgl'd lv bnym vygdlv bnyh'shh vygrshv 'typtch vy'mrv lv l'tnchl bbyt'bynv khy bn'shh 'chrt 'th
verses.translation: And Gilead’s wife bore him sons; and when his wife’s sons grew up, they drove out Jephthah, and said unto him: ‘Thou shalt not inherit in our father’s house; for thou art the son of another woman.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּבְרַ֤ח יִפְתָּח֙ מִפְּנֵ֣י אֶחָ֔יו וַיֵּ֖שֶׁב בְּאֶ֣רֶץ ט֑וֹב וַיִּֽתְלַקְּט֤וּ אֶל־יִפְתָּח֙ אֲנָשִׁ֣ים רֵיקִ֔ים וַיֵּצְא֖וּ עִמּֽוֹ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vybrch yptch mpny 'chyv vyshb b'rts tvb vytlqtv 'lyptch 'nshym ryqym vyts'v 'mv {p}
verses.translation: Then Jephthah fled from his brethren, and dwelt in the land of Tob; and there were gathered vain fellows to Jephthah, and they went out with him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֖י מִיָּמִ֑ים וַיִּלָּחֲמ֥וּ בְנֵֽי־עַמּ֖וֹן עִם־יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: vyhy mymym vylchmv bny'mvn 'myshr'l
verses.translation: And it came to pass after a while, that the children of Ammon made war against Israel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֕י כַּאֲשֶׁר־נִלְחֲמ֥וּ בְנֵֽי־עַמּ֖וֹן עִם־יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיֵּֽלְכוּ֙ זִקְנֵ֣י גִלְעָ֔ד לָקַ֥חַת אֶת־יִפְתָּ֖ח מֵאֶ֥רֶץ טֽוֹב׃
verses.translit: vyhy kh'shrnlchmv bny'mvn 'myshr'l vylkhv zqny gl'd lqcht 'typtch m'rts tvb
verses.translation: And it was so, that when the children of Ammon made war against Israel, the elders of Gilead went to fetch Jephthah out of the land of Tob.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּאמְר֣וּ לְיִפְתָּ֔ח לְכָ֕ה וְהָיִ֥יתָה לָּ֖נוּ לְקָצִ֑ין וְנִֽלָּחֲמָ֖ה בִּבְנֵ֥י עַמּֽוֹן׃
verses.translit: vy'mrv lyptch lkhh vhyyth lnv lqtsyn vnlchmh bbny 'mvn
verses.translation: And they said unto Jephthah: ‘Come and be our chief, that we may fight with the children of Ammon.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יִפְתָּח֙ לְזִקְנֵ֣י גִלְעָ֔ד הֲלֹ֤א אַתֶּם֙ שְׂנֵאתֶ֣ם אוֹתִ֔י וַתְּגָרְשׁ֖וּנִי מִבֵּ֣ית אָבִ֑י וּמַדּ֜וּעַ בָּאתֶ֤ם אֵלַי֙ עַ֔תָּה כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר צַ֥ר לָכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vy'mr yptch lzqny gl'd hl' 'tm shn'tm 'vty vtgrshvny mbyt 'by vmdv' b'tm 'ly 'th kh'shr tsr lkhm
verses.translation: And Jephthah said unto the elders of Gilead: ‘Did not ye hate me, and drive me out of my father’s house? and why are ye come unto me now when ye are in distress?’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּאמְרוּ֩ זִקְנֵ֨י גִלְעָ֜ד אֶל־יִפְתָּ֗ח לָכֵן֙ עַתָּה֙ שַׁ֣בְנוּ אֵלֶ֔יךָ וְהָלַכְתָּ֣ עִמָּ֔נוּ וְנִלְחַמְתָּ֖ בִּבְנֵ֣י עַמּ֑וֹן וְהָיִ֤יתָ לָּ֙נוּ֙ לְרֹ֔אשׁ לְכֹ֖ל יֹשְׁבֵ֥י גִלְעָֽד׃
verses.translit: vy'mrv zqny gl'd 'lyptch lkhn 'th shbnv 'lykh vhlkht 'mnv vnlchmt bbny 'mvn vhyyt lnv lr'sh lkhl yshby gl'd
verses.translation: And the elders of Gilead said unto Jephthah: ‘Therefore are we returned to thee now, that thou mayest go with us, and fight with the children of Ammon, and thou shalt be our head over all the inhabitants of Gilead.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יִפְתָּ֜ח אֶל־זִקְנֵ֣י גִלְעָ֗ד אִם־מְשִׁיבִ֨ים אַתֶּ֤ם אוֹתִי֙ לְהִלָּחֵם֙ בִּבְנֵ֣י עַמּ֔וֹן וְנָתַ֧ן יְהֹוָ֛ה אוֹתָ֖ם לְפָנָ֑י אָנֹכִ֕י אֶהְיֶ֥ה לָכֶ֖ם לְרֹֽאשׁ׃
verses.translit: vy'mr yptch 'lzqny gl'd 'mmshybym 'tm 'vty lhlchm bbny 'mvn vntn yhvh 'vtm lpny 'nkhy 'hyh lkhm lr'sh
verses.translation: And Jephthah said unto the elders of Gilead: ‘If ye bring me back home to fight with the children of Ammon, and the LORD deliver them before me, I will be your head.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּאמְר֥וּ זִקְנֵֽי־גִלְעָ֖ד אֶל־יִפְתָּ֑ח יְהֹוָ֗ה יִֽהְיֶ֤ה שֹׁמֵ֙עַ֙ בֵּינוֹתֵ֔ינוּ אִם־לֹ֥א כִדְבָרְךָ֖ כֵּ֥ן נַעֲשֶֽׂה׃
verses.translit: vy'mrv zqnygl'd 'lyptch yhvh yhyh shm' bynvtynv 'ml' khdbrkh khn n'shh
verses.translation: And the elders of Gilead said unto Jephthah: ‘The LORD shall be witness between us; surely according to thy word so will we do.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֵּ֤לֶךְ יִפְתָּח֙ עִם־זִקְנֵ֣י גִלְעָ֔ד וַיָּשִׂ֨ימוּ הָעָ֥ם אוֹת֛וֹ עֲלֵיהֶ֖ם לְרֹ֣אשׁ וּלְקָצִ֑ין וַיְדַבֵּ֨ר יִפְתָּ֧ח אֶת־כׇּל־דְּבָרָ֛יו לִפְנֵ֥י יְהֹוָ֖ה בַּמִּצְפָּֽה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vylkh yptch 'mzqny gl'd vyshymv h'm 'vtv 'lyhm lr'sh vlqtsyn vydbr yptch 'tkhldbryv lpny yhvh bmtsph {p}
verses.translation: Then Jephthah went with the elders of Gilead, and the people made him head and chief over them; and Jephthah spoke all his words before the LORD in Mizpah.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁלַ֤ח יִפְתָּח֙ מַלְאָכִ֔ים אֶל־מֶ֥לֶךְ בְּנֵֽי־עַמּ֖וֹן לֵאמֹ֑ר מַה־לִּ֣י וָלָ֔ךְ כִּֽי־בָ֥אתָ אֵלַ֖י לְהִלָּחֵ֥ם בְּאַרְצִֽי׃
verses.translit: vyshlch yptch ml'khym 'lmlkh bny'mvn l'mr mhly vlkh khyb't 'ly lhlchm b'rtsy
verses.translation: And Jephthah sent messengers unto the king of the children of Ammon, saying: ‘What hast thou to do with me, that thou art come unto me to fight against my land?’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֩אמֶר֩ מֶ֨לֶךְ בְּנֵֽי־עַמּ֜וֹן אֶל־מַלְאֲכֵ֣י יִפְתָּ֗ח כִּֽי־לָקַ֨ח יִשְׂרָאֵ֤ל אֶת־אַרְצִי֙ בַּעֲלוֹת֣וֹ מִמִּצְרַ֔יִם מֵאַרְנ֥וֹן וְעַד־הַיַּבֹּ֖ק וְעַד־הַיַּרְדֵּ֑ן וְעַתָּ֕ה הָשִׁ֥יבָה אֶתְהֶ֖ן בְּשָׁלֽוֹם׃
verses.translit: vy'mr mlkh bny'mvn 'lml'khy yptch khylqch yshr'l 't'rtsy b'lvtv mmtsrym m'rnvn v'dhybq v'dhyrdn v'th hshybh 'thn bshlvm
verses.translation: And the king of the children of Ammon answered unto the messengers of Jephthah: ‘Because Israel took away my land, when he came up out of Egypt, from the Arnon even unto the Jabbok, and unto the Jordan; now therefore restore those cities peaceably.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיּ֥וֹסֶף ע֖וֹד יִפְתָּ֑ח וַיִּשְׁלַח֙ מַלְאָכִ֔ים אֶל־מֶ֖לֶךְ בְּנֵ֥י עַמּֽוֹן׃
verses.translit: vyvsf 'vd yptch vyshlch ml'khym 'lmlkh bny 'mvn
verses.translation: And Jephthah sent messengers again unto the king of the children of Ammon;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר ל֔וֹ כֹּ֖ה אָמַ֣ר יִפְתָּ֑ח לֹֽא־לָקַ֤ח יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ אֶת־אֶ֣רֶץ מוֹאָ֔ב וְאֶת־אֶ֖רֶץ בְּנֵ֥י עַמּֽוֹן׃
verses.translit: vy'mr lv khh 'mr yptch l'lqch yshr'l 't'rts mv'b v't'rts bny 'mvn
verses.translation: and he said unto him: ‘Thus saith Jephthah: Israel took not away the land of Moab, nor the land of the children of Ammon.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֖י בַּעֲלוֹתָ֣ם מִמִּצְרָ֑יִם וַיֵּ֨לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֤ל בַּמִּדְבָּר֙ עַד־יַם־ס֔וּף וַיָּבֹ֖א קָדֵֽשָׁה׃
verses.translit: khy b'lvtm mmtsrym vylkh yshr'l bmdbr 'dymsvf vyb' qdshh
verses.translation: But when they came up from Egypt, and Israel walked through the wilderness unto the Red Sea, and came to Kadesh;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁלַ֣ח יִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל מַלְאָכִ֣ים ׀ אֶל־מֶ֩לֶךְ֩ אֱד֨וֹם ׀ לֵאמֹ֜ר אֶעְבְּרָה־נָּ֣א בְאַרְצֶ֗ךָ וְלֹ֤א שָׁמַע֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ אֱד֔וֹם וְגַ֨ם אֶל־מֶ֧לֶךְ מוֹאָ֛ב שָׁלַ֖ח וְלֹ֣א אָבָ֑ה וַיֵּ֥שֶׁב יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בְּקָדֵֽשׁ׃
verses.translit: vyshlch yshr'l ml'khym  'lmlkh 'dvm  l'mr ''brhn' b'rtskh vl' shm' mlkh 'dvm vgm 'lmlkh mv'b shlch vl' 'bh vyshb yshr'l bqdsh
verses.translation: then Israel sent messengers unto the king of Edom, saying: Let me, I pray thee, pass through thy land; but the king of Edom hearkened not. And in like manner he sent unto the king of Moab; but he would not; and Israel abode in Kadesh.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֵּ֣לֶךְ בַּמִּדְבָּ֗ר וַיָּ֜סׇב אֶת־אֶ֤רֶץ אֱדוֹם֙ וְאֶת־אֶ֣רֶץ מוֹאָ֔ב וַיָּבֹ֤א מִמִּזְרַח־שֶׁ֙מֶשׁ֙ לְאֶ֣רֶץ מוֹאָ֔ב וַֽיַּחֲנ֖וּן בְּעֵ֣בֶר אַרְנ֑וֹן וְלֹֽא־בָ֙אוּ֙ בִּגְב֣וּל מוֹאָ֔ב כִּ֥י אַרְנ֖וֹן גְּב֥וּל מוֹאָֽב׃
verses.translit: vylkh bmdbr vysb 't'rts 'dvm v't'rts mv'b vyb' mmzrchshmsh l'rts mv'b vychnvn b'br 'rnvn vl'b'v bgbvl mv'b khy 'rnvn gbvl mv'b
verses.translation: Then he walked through the wilderness, and compassed the land of Edom, and the land of Moab, and came by the east side of the land of Moab, and they pitched on the other side of the Arnon; but they came not within the border of Moab, for the Arnon was the border of Moab.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁלַ֤ח יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ מַלְאָכִ֔ים אֶל־סִיח֥וֹן מֶלֶךְ־הָאֱמֹרִ֖י מֶ֣לֶךְ חֶשְׁבּ֑וֹן וַיֹּ֤אמֶר לוֹ֙ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל נַעְבְּרָה־נָּ֥א בְאַרְצְךָ֖ עַד־מְקוֹמִֽי׃
verses.translit: vyshlch yshr'l ml'khym 'lsychvn mlkhh'mry mlkh chshbvn vy'mr lv yshr'l n'brhn' b'rtskh 'dmqvmy
verses.translation: And Israel sent messengers unto Sihon king of the Amorites, the king of Heshbon; and Israel said unto him: Let us pass, we pray thee, through thy land unto my place.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלֹא־הֶאֱמִ֨ין סִיח֤וֹן אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ עֲבֹ֣ר בִּגְבֻל֔וֹ וַיֶּאֱסֹ֤ף סִיחוֹן֙ אֶת־כׇּל־עַמּ֔וֹ וַֽיַּחֲנ֖וּ בְּיָ֑הְצָה וַיִּלָּ֖חֶם עִם־יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: vl'h'myn sychvn 'tyshr'l 'br bgblv vy'sf sychvn 'tkhl'mv vychnv byhtsh vylchm 'myshr'l
verses.translation: But Sihon trusted not Israel to pass through his border; but Sihon gathered all his people together, and pitched in Jahaz, and fought against Israel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַ֠יִּתֵּ֠ן יְהֹוָ֨ה אֱלֹהֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל אֶת־סִיח֧וֹן וְאֶת־כׇּל־עַמּ֛וֹ בְּיַ֥ד יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל וַיַּכּ֑וּם וַיִּירַשׁ֙ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֵ֚ת כׇּל־אֶ֣רֶץ הָאֱמֹרִ֔י יוֹשֵׁ֖ב הָאָ֥רֶץ הַהִֽיא׃
verses.translit: vytn yhvh 'lhyyshr'l 'tsychvn v'tkhl'mv byd yshr'l vykhvm vyyrsh yshr'l 't khl'rts h'mry yvshb h'rts hhy'
verses.translation: And the LORD, the God of Israel, delivered Sihon and all his people into the hand of Israel, and they smote them; so Israel possessed all the land of the Amorites, the inhabitants of that country.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּ֣ירְשׁ֔וּ אֵ֖ת כׇּל־גְּב֣וּל הָאֱמֹרִ֑י מֵֽאַרְנוֹן֙ וְעַד־הַיַּבֹּ֔ק וּמִן־הַמִּדְבָּ֖ר וְעַד־הַיַּרְדֵּֽן׃
verses.translit: vyyrshv 't khlgbvl h'mry m'rnvn v'dhybq vmnhmdbr v'dhyrdn
verses.translation: And they possessed all the border of the Amorites, from the Arnon even unto the Jabbok, and from the wilderness even unto the Jordan.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֞ה יְהֹוָ֣ה  אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל הוֹרִישׁ֙ אֶת־הָ֣אֱמֹרִ֔י מִפְּנֵ֖י עַמּ֣וֹ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְאַתָּ֖ה תִּירָשֶֽׁנּוּ׃
verses.translit: v'th yhvh  'lhy yshr'l hvrysh 'th'mry mpny 'mv yshr'l v'th tyrshnv
verses.translation: So now the LORD, the God of Israel, hath dispossessed the Amorites from before His people Israel, and shouldest thou possess them?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֲלֹ֞א אֵ֣ת אֲשֶׁ֧ר יוֹרִֽישְׁךָ֛ כְּמ֥וֹשׁ אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ אוֹת֣וֹ תִירָ֑שׁ וְאֵת֩ כׇּל־אֲשֶׁ֨ר הוֹרִ֜ישׁ יְהֹוָ֧ה אֱלֹהֵ֛ינוּ מִפָּנֵ֖ינוּ אוֹת֥וֹ נִירָֽשׁ׃
verses.translit: hl' 't 'shr yvryshkh khmvsh 'lhykh 'vtv tyrsh v't khl'shr hvrysh yhvh 'lhynv mpnynv 'vtv nyrsh
verses.translation: Wilt not thou possess that which Chemosh thy god giveth thee to possess? So whomsoever the LORD our God hath dispossessed from before us, them will we possess.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֗ה הֲט֥וֹב טוֹב֙ אַתָּ֔ה מִבָּלָ֥ק בֶּן־צִפּ֖וֹר מֶ֣לֶךְ מוֹאָ֑ב הֲר֥וֹב רָב֙ עִם־יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אִם־נִלְחֹ֥ם נִלְחַ֖ם בָּֽם׃
verses.translit: v'th htvb tvb 'th mblq bntspvr mlkh mv'b hrvb rb 'myshr'l 'mnlchm nlchm bm
verses.translation: And now art thou any thing better than Balak the son of Zippor, king of Moab? did he ever strive against Israel, or did he ever fight against them?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּשֶׁ֣בֶת יִ֠שְׂרָאֵ֠ל בְּחֶשְׁבּ֨וֹן וּבִבְנוֹתֶ֜יהָ וּבְעַרְע֣וֹר וּבִבְנוֹתֶ֗יהָ וּבְכׇל־הֶֽעָרִים֙ אֲשֶׁר֙ עַל־יְדֵ֣י אַרְנ֔וֹן שְׁלֹ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת שָׁנָ֑ה וּמַדּ֥וּעַ לֹֽא־הִצַּלְתֶּ֖ם בָּעֵ֥ת הַהִֽיא׃
verses.translit: bshbt yshr'l bchshbvn vbbnvtyh vb'r'vr vbbnvtyh vbkhlh'rym 'shr 'lydy 'rnvn shlsh m'vt shnh vmdv' l'htsltm b't hhy'
verses.translation: While Israel dwelt in Heshbon and its towns, and in Aroer and its towns, and in all the cities that are along by the side of the Arnon, three hundred years; wherefore did ye not recover them within that time?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאָֽנֹכִי֙ לֹא־חָטָ֣אתִי לָ֔ךְ וְאַתָּ֞ה עֹשֶׂ֥ה אִתִּ֛י רָעָ֖ה לְהִלָּ֣חֶם בִּ֑י יִשְׁפֹּ֨ט יְהֹוָ֤ה הַשֹּׁפֵט֙ הַיּ֔וֹם בֵּ֚ין בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וּבֵ֖ין בְּנֵ֥י עַמּֽוֹן׃
verses.translit: v'nkhy l'cht'ty lkh v'th 'shh 'ty r'h lhlchm by yshpt yhvh hshpt hyvm byn bny yshr'l vbyn bny 'mvn
verses.translation: I therefore have not sinned against thee, but thou doest me wrong to war against me; the LORD, the Judge, be judge this day between the children of Israel and the children of Ammon.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלֹ֣א שָׁמַ֔ע מֶ֖לֶךְ בְּנֵ֣י עַמּ֑וֹן אֶל־דִּבְרֵ֣י יִפְתָּ֔ח אֲשֶׁ֥ר שָׁלַ֖ח אֵלָֽיו׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vl' shm' mlkh bny 'mvn 'ldbry yptch 'shr shlch 'lyv {p}
verses.translation: Howbeit the king of the children of Ammon hearkened not unto the words of Jephthah which he sent him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתְּהִ֤י עַל־יִפְתָּח֙ ר֣וּחַ יְהֹוָ֔ה וַיַּעֲבֹ֥ר אֶת־הַגִּלְעָ֖ד וְאֶת־מְנַשֶּׁ֑ה וַֽיַּעֲבֹר֙ אֶת־מִצְפֵּ֣ה גִלְעָ֔ד וּמִמִּצְפֵּ֣ה גִלְעָ֔ד עָבַ֖ר בְּנֵ֥י עַמּֽוֹן׃
verses.translit: vthy 'lyptch rvch yhvh vy'br 'thgl'd v'tmnshh vy'br 'tmtsph gl'd vmmtsph gl'd 'br bny 'mvn
verses.translation: Then the spirit of the LORD came upon Jephthah, and he passed over Gilead and Manasseh, and passed over Mizpeh of Gilead, and from Mizpeh of Gilead he passed over unto the children of Ammon.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּדַּ֨ר יִפְתָּ֥ח נֶ֛דֶר לַיהֹוָ֖ה וַיֹּאמַ֑ר אִם־נָת֥וֹן תִּתֵּ֛ן אֶת־בְּנֵ֥י עַמּ֖וֹן בְּיָדִֽי׃
verses.translit: vydr yptch ndr lyhvh vy'mr 'mntvn ttn 'tbny 'mvn bydy
verses.translation: And Jephthah vowed a vow unto the LORD, and said: ‘If Thou wilt indeed deliver the children of Ammon into my hand,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָיָ֣ה הַיּוֹצֵ֗א אֲשֶׁ֨ר יֵצֵ֜א מִדַּלְתֵ֤י בֵיתִי֙ לִקְרָאתִ֔י בְּשׁוּבִ֥י בְשָׁל֖וֹם מִבְּנֵ֣י עַמּ֑וֹן וְהָיָה֙ לַיהֹוָ֔ה וְהַעֲלִיתִ֖יהוּ עֹלָֽה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vhyh hyvts' 'shr yts' mdlty byty lqr'ty bshvby bshlvm mbny 'mvn vhyh lyhvh vh'lytyhv 'lh {p}
verses.translation: then it shall be, that whatsoever cometh forth of the doors of my house to meet me, when I return in peace from the children of Ammon, it shall be the LORD’S, and I will offer it up for a burnt-offering.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּעֲבֹ֥ר יִפְתָּ֛ח אֶל־בְּנֵ֥י עַמּ֖וֹן לְהִלָּ֣חֶם בָּ֑ם וַיִּתְּנֵ֥ם יְהֹוָ֖ה בְּיָדֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vy'br yptch 'lbny 'mvn lhlchm bm vytnm yhvh bydv
verses.translation: So Jephthah passed over unto the children of Ammon to fight against them; and the LORD delivered them into his hand.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּכֵּ֡ם מֵעֲרוֹעֵר֩ וְעַד־בֹּאֲךָ֨ מִנִּ֜ית עֶשְׂרִ֣ים עִ֗יר וְעַד֙ אָבֵ֣ל כְּרָמִ֔ים מַכָּ֖ה גְּדוֹלָ֣ה מְאֹ֑ד וַיִּכָּֽנְעוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י עַמּ֔וֹן מִפְּנֵ֖י בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vykhm m'rv'r v'db'kh mnyt 'shrym 'yr v'd 'bl khrmym mkhh gdvlh m'd vykhn'v bny 'mvn mpny bny yshr'l {p}
verses.translation: And he smote them from Aroer until thou come to Minnith, even twenty cities, and unto Abel-cheramim, with a very great slaughter. So the children of Ammon were subdued before the children of Israel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּבֹ֨א יִפְתָּ֣ח הַמִּצְפָּה֮ אֶל־בֵּיתוֹ֒ וְהִנֵּ֤ה בִתּוֹ֙ יֹצֵ֣את לִקְרָאת֔וֹ בְּתֻפִּ֖ים וּבִמְחֹל֑וֹת וְרַק֙ הִ֣יא יְחִידָ֔ה אֵֽין־ל֥וֹ מִמֶּ֛נּוּ בֵּ֖ן אוֹ־בַֽת׃
verses.translit: vyb' yptch hmtsph 'lbytv vhnh btv yts't lqr'tv btpym vbmchlvt vrq hy' ychydh 'ynlv mmnv bn 'vbt
verses.translation: And Jephthah came to Mizpah unto his house, and, behold, his daughter came out to meet him with timbrels and with dances; and she was his only child; beside her he had neither son nor daughter.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִי֩ כִרְאוֹת֨וֹ אוֹתָ֜הּ וַיִּקְרַ֣ע אֶת־בְּגָדָ֗יו וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ אֲהָ֤הּ בִּתִּי֙ הַכְרֵ֣עַ הִכְרַעְתִּ֔נִי וְאַ֖תְּ הָיִ֣ית בְּעֹֽכְרָ֑י וְאָנֹכִ֗י פָּצִ֤יתִי פִי֙ אֶל־יְהֹוָ֔ה וְלֹ֥א אוּכַ֖ל לָשֽׁוּב׃
verses.translit: vyhy khr'vtv 'vth vyqr' 'tbgdyv vy'mr 'hh bty hkhr' hkhr'tny v't hyyt b'khry v'nkhy ptsyty py 'lyhvh vl' 'vkhl lshvb
verses.translation: And it came to pass, when he saw her, that he rent his clothes, and said: ‘Alas, my daughter! thou hast brought me very low, and thou art become my troubler; for I have opened my mouth unto the LORD, and I cannot go back.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלָ֗יו אָבִי֙ פָּצִ֤יתָה אֶת־פִּ֙יךָ֙ אֶל־יְהֹוָ֔ה עֲשֵׂ֣ה לִ֔י כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר יָצָ֣א מִפִּ֑יךָ אַחֲרֵ֡י אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂה֩ לְךָ֨ יְהֹוָ֧ה נְקָמ֛וֹת מֵאֹיְבֶ֖יךָ מִבְּנֵ֥י עַמּֽוֹן׃
verses.translit: vt'mr 'lyv 'by ptsyth 'tpykh 'lyhvh 'shh ly kh'shr yts' mpykh 'chry 'shr 'shh lkh yhvh nqmvt m'ybykh mbny 'mvn
verses.translation: And she said unto him: ‘My father, thou hast opened thy mouth unto the LORD; do unto me according to that which hath proceeded out of thy mouth; forasmuch as the LORD hath taken vengeance for thee of thine enemies, even of the children of Ammon.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתֹּ֙אמֶר֙ אֶל־אָבִ֔יהָ יֵעָ֥שֶׂה לִּ֖י הַדָּבָ֣ר הַזֶּ֑ה הַרְפֵּ֨ה מִמֶּ֜נִּי שְׁנַ֣יִם חֳדָשִׁ֗ים וְאֵֽלְכָה֙ וְיָרַדְתִּ֣י עַל־הֶהָרִ֔ים וְאֶבְכֶּה֙ עַל־בְּתוּלַ֔י אָנֹכִ֖י (ורעיתי) [וְרֵֽעוֹתָֽי]׃
verses.translit: vt'mr 'l'byh y'shh ly hdbr hzh hrph mmny shnym chdshym v'lkhh vyrdty 'lhhrym v'bkhh 'lbtvly 'nkhy (vr'yty) [vr'vty]
verses.translation: And she said unto her father: ‘Let this thing be done for me: let me alone two months, that I may depart and go down upon the mountains, and bewail my virginity, I and my companions.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר לֵ֔כִי וַיִּשְׁלַ֥ח אוֹתָ֖הּ שְׁנֵ֣י חֳדָשִׁ֑ים וַתֵּ֤לֶךְ הִיא֙ וְרֵ֣עוֹתֶ֔יהָ וַתֵּ֥בְךְּ עַל־בְּתוּלֶ֖יהָ עַל־הֶהָרִֽים׃
verses.translit: vy'mr lkhy vyshlch 'vth shny chdshym vtlkh hy' vr'vtyh vtbkh 'lbtvlyh 'lhhrym
verses.translation: And he said: ‘Go.’ And he sent her away for two months; and she departed, she and her companions, and bewailed her virginity upon the mountains.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֞י מִקֵּ֣ץ  שְׁנַ֣יִם חֳדָשִׁ֗ים וַתָּ֙שׇׁב֙ אֶל־אָבִ֔יהָ וַיַּ֣עַשׂ לָ֔הּ אֶת־נִדְר֖וֹ אֲשֶׁ֣ר נָדָ֑ר וְהִיא֙ לֹא־יָדְעָ֣ה אִ֔ישׁ וַתְּהִי־חֹ֖ק בְּיִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: vyhy mqts  shnym chdshym vtshb 'l'byh vy'sh lh 'tndrv 'shr ndr vhy' l'yd'h 'ysh vthychq byshr'l
verses.translation: And it came to pass at the end of two months, that she returned unto her father, who did with her according to his vow which he had vowed; and she had not known man. And it was a custom in Israel,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִיָּמִ֣ים  יָמִ֗ימָה תֵּלַ֙כְנָה֙ בְּנ֣וֹת יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לְתַנּ֕וֹת לְבַת־יִפְתָּ֖ח הַגִּלְעָדִ֑י אַרְבַּ֥עַת יָמִ֖ים בַּשָּׁנָֽה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: mymym  ymymh tlkhnh bnvt yshr'l ltnvt lbtyptch hgl'dy 'rb't ymym bshnh {p}
verses.translation: that the daughters of Israel went yearly to lament the daughter of Jephthah the Gileadite four days in a year.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּצָּעֵק֙ אִ֣ישׁ אֶפְרַ֔יִם וַֽיַּעֲבֹ֖ר צָפ֑וֹנָה וַיֹּאמְר֨וּ לְיִפְתָּ֜ח מַדּ֣וּעַ  עָבַ֣רְתָּ  לְהִלָּחֵ֣ם בִּבְנֵי־עַמּ֗וֹן וְלָ֙נוּ֙ לֹ֤א קָרָ֙אתָ֙ לָלֶ֣כֶת עִמָּ֔ךְ בֵּיתְךָ֕ נִשְׂרֹ֥ף עָלֶ֖יךָ בָּאֵֽשׁ׃
verses.translit: vyts'q 'ysh 'prym vy'br tspvnh vy'mrv lyptch mdv'  'brt  lhlchm bbny'mvn vlnv l' qr't llkht 'mkh bytkh nshrf 'lykh b'sh
verses.translation: And the men of Ephraim were gathered together, and passed to Zaphon; and they said unto Jephthah: ‘Wherefore didst thou pass over to fight against the children of Ammon, and didst not call us to go with thee? we will burn thy house upon thee with fire.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יִפְתָּח֙ אֲלֵיהֶ֔ם אִ֣ישׁ רִ֗יב הָיִ֛יתִי אֲנִ֛י וְעַמִּ֥י וּבְנֵֽי־עַמּ֖וֹן מְאֹ֑ד וָאֶזְעַ֣ק אֶתְכֶ֔ם וְלֹא־הוֹשַׁעְתֶּ֥ם אוֹתִ֖י מִיָּדָֽם׃
verses.translit: vy'mr yptch 'lyhm 'ysh ryb hyyty 'ny v'my vbny'mvn m'd v'z'q 'tkhm vl'hvsh'tm 'vty mydm
verses.translation: And Jephthah said unto them: ‘I and my people were at great strife with the children of Ammon; and when I called you, ye saved me not out of their hand.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וָאֶרְאֶ֞ה כִּֽי־אֵינְךָ֣ מוֹשִׁ֗יעַ וָאָשִׂ֨ימָה נַפְשִׁ֤י בְכַפִּי֙ וָֽאֶעְבְּרָה֙ אֶל־בְּנֵ֣י עַמּ֔וֹן וַיִּתְּנֵ֥ם יְהֹוָ֖ה בְּיָדִ֑י וְלָמָ֞ה עֲלִיתֶ֥ם אֵלַ֛י הַיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּ֖ה לְהִלָּ֥חֶם בִּֽי׃
verses.translit: v'r'h khy'ynkh mvshy' v'shymh npshy bkhpy v''brh 'lbny 'mvn vytnm yhvh bydy vlmh 'lytm 'ly hyvm hzh lhlchm by
verses.translation: And when I saw that ye saved me not, I put my life in my hand, and passed over against the children of Ammon, and the LORD delivered them into my hand; wherefore then are ye come up unto me this day, to fight against me?’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּקְבֹּ֤ץ יִפְתָּח֙ אֶת־כׇּל־אַנְשֵׁ֣י גִלְעָ֔ד וַיִּלָּ֖חֶם אֶת־אֶפְרָ֑יִם וַיַּכּוּ֩ אַנְשֵׁ֨י גִלְעָ֜ד אֶת־אֶפְרַ֗יִם כִּ֤י אָֽמְרוּ֙ פְּלִיטֵ֤י אֶפְרַ֙יִם֙ אַתֶּ֔ם גִּלְעָ֕ד בְּת֥וֹךְ אֶפְרַ֖יִם בְּת֥וֹךְ מְנַשֶּֽׁה׃
verses.translit: vyqbts yptch 'tkhl'nshy gl'd vylchm 't'prym vykhv 'nshy gl'd 't'prym khy 'mrv plyty 'prym 'tm gl'd btvkh 'prym btvkh mnshh
verses.translation: Then Jephthah gathered together all the men of Gilead, and fought with Ephraim; and the men of Gilead smote Ephraim, because they said: ‘Ye are fugitives of Ephraim, ye Gileadites, in the midst of Ephraim, and in the midst of Manasseh.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּלְכֹּ֥ד גִּלְעָ֛ד אֶֽת־מַעְבְּר֥וֹת הַיַּרְדֵּ֖ן לְאֶפְרָ֑יִם וְֽ֠הָיָ֠ה כִּ֣י יֹאמְר֞וּ פְּלִיטֵ֤י אֶפְרַ֙יִם֙ אֶֽעֱבֹ֔רָה וַיֹּ֨אמְרוּ ל֧וֹ אַנְשֵֽׁי־גִלְעָ֛ד הַאֶפְרָתִ֥י אַ֖תָּה וַיֹּ֥אמֶֽר ׀ לֹֽא׃
verses.translit: vylkhd gl'd 'tm'brvt hyrdn l'prym vhyh khy y'mrv plyty 'prym ''brh vy'mrv lv 'nshygl'd h'prty 'th vy'mr  l'
verses.translation: And the Gileadites took the fords of the Jordan against the Ephraimites; and it was so, that when any of the fugitives of Ephraim said: 'Let me go over,' the men of Gilead said unto him: ‘Art thou an Ephraimite?’ If he said: ‘Nay’;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמְרוּ לוֹ֩ אֱמׇר־נָ֨א שִׁבֹּ֜לֶת וַיֹּ֣אמֶר סִבֹּ֗לֶת וְלֹ֤א יָכִין֙ לְדַבֵּ֣ר כֵּ֔ן וַיֹּאחֲז֣וּ אוֹת֔וֹ וַיִּשְׁחָט֖וּהוּ אֶל־מַעְבְּר֣וֹת הַיַּרְדֵּ֑ן וַיִּפֹּ֞ל בָּעֵ֤ת הַהִיא֙ מֵֽאֶפְרַ֔יִם אַרְבָּעִ֥ים וּשְׁנַ֖יִם אָֽלֶף׃
verses.translit: vy'mrv lv 'mrn' shblt vy'mr sblt vl' ykhyn ldbr khn vy'chzv 'vtv vyshchtvhv 'lm'brvt hyrdn vypl b't hhy' m'prym 'rb'ym vshnym 'lf
verses.translation: then said they unto him: ‘Say now Shibboleth’; and he said ‘Sibboleth’; for he could not frame to pronounce it right; then they laid hold on him, and slew him at the fords of the Jordan; and there fell at that time of Ephraim forty and two thousand.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁפֹּ֥ט יִפְתָּ֛ח אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל שֵׁ֣שׁ שָׁנִ֑ים וַיָּ֗מׇת יִפְתָּח֙ הַגִּלְעָדִ֔י וַיִּקָּבֵ֖ר בְּעָרֵ֥י גִלְעָֽד׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vyshpt yptch 'tyshr'l shsh shnym vymt yptch hgl'dy vyqbr b'ry gl'd {p}
verses.translation: And Jephthah judged Israel six years. Then died Jephthah the Gileadite, and was buried in one of the cities of Gilead.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁפֹּ֤ט אַֽחֲרָיו֙ אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אִבְצָ֖ן מִבֵּ֥ית לָֽחֶם׃
verses.translit: vyshpt 'chryv 'tyshr'l 'btsn mbyt lchm
verses.translation: And after him Ibzan of Beth-lehem judged Israel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽיְהִי־ל֞וֹ שְׁלֹשִׁ֣ים בָּנִ֗ים וּשְׁלֹשִׁ֤ים בָּנוֹת֙ שִׁלַּ֣ח הַח֔וּצָה וּשְׁלֹשִׁ֣ים בָּנ֔וֹת הֵבִ֥יא לְבָנָ֖יו מִן־הַח֑וּץ וַיִּשְׁפֹּ֥ט אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל שֶׁ֥בַע שָׁנִֽים׃
verses.translit: vyhylv shlshym bnym vshlshym bnvt shlch hchvtsh vshlshym bnvt hby' lbnyv mnhchvts vyshpt 'tyshr'l shb' shnym
verses.translation: And he had thirty sons, and thirty daughters he sent abroad, and thirty daughters he brought in from abroad for his sons. And he judged Israel seven years.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּ֣מׇת אִבְצָ֔ן וַיִּקָּבֵ֖ר בְּבֵ֥ית לָֽחֶם׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vymt 'btsn vyqbr bbyt lchm {p}
verses.translation: and Ibzan died, and was buried at Beth-lehem. .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁפֹּ֤ט אַֽחֲרָיו֙ אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֵיל֖וֹן הַזְּבוּלֹנִ֑י וַיִּשְׁפֹּ֥ט אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל עֶ֥שֶׂר שָׁנִֽים׃
verses.translit: vyshpt 'chryv 'tyshr'l 'ylvn hzbvlny vyshpt 'tyshr'l 'shr shnym
verses.translation: And after him Elon the Zebulunite judged Israel; and he judged Israel ten years.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּ֖מׇת אֵיל֣וֹן הַזְּבוּלֹנִ֑י וַיִּקָּבֵ֥ר בְּאַיָּל֖וֹן בְּאֶ֥רֶץ זְבוּלֻֽן׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vymt 'ylvn hzbvlny vyqbr b'ylvn b'rts zbvln {p}
verses.translation: And Elon the Zebulunite died, and was buried in Aijalon in the land of Zebulun.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁפֹּ֥ט אַחֲרָ֖יו אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל עַבְדּ֥וֹן בֶּן־הִלֵּ֖ל הַפִּרְעָתוֹנִֽי׃
verses.translit: vyshpt 'chryv 'tyshr'l 'bdvn bnhll hpr'tvny
verses.translation: And after him Abdon the son of Hillel the Pirathonite judged Israel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽיְהִי־ל֞וֹ אַרְבָּעִ֣ים בָּנִ֗ים וּשְׁלֹשִׁים֙ בְּנֵ֣י בָנִ֔ים רֹכְבִ֖ים עַל־שִׁבְעִ֣ים עֲיָרִ֑ם וַיִּשְׁפֹּ֥ט אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל שְׁמֹנֶ֥ה שָׁנִֽים׃
verses.translit: vyhylv 'rb'ym bnym vshlshym bny bnym rkhbym 'lshb'ym 'yrm vyshpt 'tyshr'l shmnh shnym
verses.translation: And he had forty sons and thirty sons’sons, that rode on threescore and ten ass colts; and he judged Israel eight years.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּ֛מׇת עַבְדּ֥וֹן בֶּן־הִלֵּ֖ל הַפִּרְעָתוֹנִ֑י וַיִּקָּבֵ֤ר בְּפִרְעָתוֹן֙ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ אֶפְרַ֔יִם בְּהַ֖ר הָעֲמָלֵקִֽי׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vymt 'bdvn bnhll hpr'tvny vyqbr bpr'tvn b'rts 'prym bhr h'mlqy {p}
verses.translation: And Abdon the son of Hillel the Pirathonite died, and was buried in Pirathon in the land of Ephraim, in the hill-country of the Amalekites.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּסִ֙יפוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לַעֲשׂ֥וֹת הָרַ֖ע בְּעֵינֵ֣י יְהֹוָ֑ה וַיִּתְּנֵ֧ם יְהֹוָ֛ה בְּיַד־פְּלִשְׁתִּ֖ים אַרְבָּעִ֥ים שָׁנָֽה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vysypv bny yshr'l l'shvt hr' b'yny yhvh vytnm yhvh bydplshtym 'rb'ym shnh {p}
verses.translation: And the children of Israel again did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD; and the LORD delivered them into the hand of the Philistines forty years.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִי֩ אִ֨ישׁ אֶחָ֧ד מִצׇּרְעָ֛ה מִמִּשְׁפַּ֥חַת הַדָּנִ֖י וּשְׁמ֣וֹ מָנ֑וֹחַ וְאִשְׁתּ֥וֹ עֲקָרָ֖ה וְלֹ֥א יָלָֽדָה׃
verses.translit: vyhy 'ysh 'chd mtsr'h mmshpcht hdny vshmv mnvch v'shtv 'qrh vl' yldh
verses.translation: And there was a certain man of Zorah, of the family of the Danites, whose name was Manoah; and his wife was barren, and bore not.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֵּרָ֥א מַלְאַךְ־יְהֹוָ֖ה אֶל־הָאִשָּׁ֑ה וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלֶ֗יהָ הִנֵּה־נָ֤א אַתְּ־עֲקָרָה֙ וְלֹ֣א יָלַ֔דְתְּ וְהָרִ֖ית וְיָלַ֥דְתְּ בֵּֽן׃
verses.translit: vyr' ml'khyhvh 'lh'shh vy'mr 'lyh hnhn' 't'qrh vl' yldt vhryt vyldt bn
verses.translation: And the angel of the LORD appeared unto the woman, and said unto her: ‘Behold now, thou art barren, and hast not borne; but thou shalt conceive, and bear a son.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַתָּה֙ הִשָּׁ֣מְרִי נָ֔א וְאַל־תִּשְׁתִּ֖י יַ֣יִן וְשֵׁכָ֑ר וְאַל־תֹּאכְלִ֖י כׇּל־טָמֵֽא׃
verses.translit: v'th hshmry n' v'ltshty yyn vshkhr v'lt'khly khltm'
verses.translation: Now therefore beware, I pray thee, and drink no wine nor strong drink, and eat not any unclean thing.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּי֩ הִנָּ֨ךְ הָרָ֜ה וְיֹלַ֣דְתְּ בֵּ֗ן וּמוֹרָה֙ לֹא־יַעֲלֶ֣ה עַל־רֹאשׁ֔וֹ כִּֽי־נְזִ֧יר אֱלֹהִ֛ים יִֽהְיֶ֥ה הַנַּ֖עַר מִן־הַבָּ֑טֶן וְה֗וּא יָחֵ֛ל לְהוֹשִׁ֥יעַ אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל מִיַּ֥ד פְּלִשְׁתִּֽים׃
verses.translit: khy hnkh hrh vyldt bn vmvrh l'y'lh 'lr'shv khynzyr 'lhym yhyh hn'r mnhbtn vhv' ychl lhvshy' 'tyshr'l myd plshtym
verses.translation: For, lo, thou shalt conceive, and bear a son; and no razor shall come upon his head; for the child shall be a Nazirite unto God from the womb; and he shall begin to save Israel out of the hand of the Philistines.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתָּבֹ֣א הָאִשָּׁ֗ה וַתֹּ֣אמֶר לְאִישָׁהּ֮ לֵאמֹר֒ אִ֤ישׁ הָֽאֱלֹהִים֙ בָּ֣א אֵלַ֔י וּמַרְאֵ֕הוּ כְּמַרְאֵ֛ה מַלְאַ֥ךְ הָאֱלֹהִ֖ים נוֹרָ֣א מְאֹ֑ד וְלֹ֤א שְׁאִלְתִּ֙יהוּ֙ אֵֽי־מִזֶּ֣ה ה֔וּא וְאֶת־שְׁמ֖וֹ לֹא־הִגִּ֥יד לִֽי׃
verses.translit: vtb' h'shh vt'mr l'yshh l'mr 'ysh h'lhym b' 'ly vmr'hv khmr'h ml'kh h'lhym nvr' m'd vl' sh'ltyhv 'ymzh hv' v'tshmv l'hgyd ly
verses.translation: Then the woman came and told her husband, saying: ‘A man of God came unto me, and his countenance was like the countenance of the angel of God, very terrible; and I asked him not whence he was, neither told he me his name;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר לִ֔י הִנָּ֥ךְ הָרָ֖ה וְיֹלַ֣דְתְּ בֵּ֑ן וְעַתָּ֞ה אַל־תִּשְׁתִּ֣י  יַ֣יִן וְשֵׁכָ֗ר וְאַל־תֹּֽאכְלִי֙ כׇּל־טֻמְאָ֔ה כִּֽי־נְזִ֤יר אֱלֹהִים֙ יִֽהְיֶ֣ה הַנַּ֔עַר מִן־הַבֶּ֖טֶן עַד־י֥וֹם מוֹתֽוֹ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vy'mr ly hnkh hrh vyldt bn v'th 'ltshty  yyn vshkhr v'lt'khly khltm'h khynzyr 'lhym yhyh hn'r mnhbtn 'dyvm mvtv {p}
verses.translation: but he said unto me: Behold, thou shalt conceive, and bear a son; and now drink no wine nor strong drink, and eat not any unclean thing; for the child shall be a Nazirite unto God from the womb to the day of his death.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֶּעְתַּ֥ר מָנ֛וֹחַ אֶל־יְהֹוָ֖ה וַיֹּאמַ֑ר בִּ֣י אֲדוֹנָ֔י אִ֣ישׁ הָאֱלֹהִ֞ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר שָׁלַ֗חְתָּ יָבוֹא־נָ֥א עוֹד֙ אֵלֵ֔ינוּ וְיוֹרֵ֕נוּ מַֽה־נַּעֲשֶׂ֖ה לַנַּ֥עַר הַיּוּלָּֽד׃
verses.translit: vy'tr mnvch 'lyhvh vy'mr by 'dvny 'ysh h'lhym 'shr shlcht ybv'n' 'vd 'lynv vyvrnv mhn'shh ln'r hyvld
verses.translation: Then Manoah entreated the LORD, and said: ‘Oh, LORD, I pray Thee, let the man of God whom Thou didst send come again unto us, and teach us what we shall do unto the child that shall be born.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁמַ֥ע הָאֱלֹהִ֖ים בְּק֣וֹל מָנ֑וֹחַ וַיָּבֹ֣א מַלְאַךְ֩ הָאֱלֹהִ֨ים ע֜וֹד אֶל־הָאִשָּׁ֗ה וְהִיא֙ יוֹשֶׁ֣בֶת בַּשָּׂדֶ֔ה וּמָנ֥וֹחַ אִישָׁ֖הּ אֵ֥ין עִמָּֽהּ׃
verses.translit: vyshm' h'lhym bqvl mnvch vyb' ml'kh h'lhym 'vd 'lh'shh vhy' yvshbt bshdh vmnvch 'yshh 'yn 'mh
verses.translation: And God hearkened to the voice of Manoah; and the angel of God came again unto the woman as she sat in the field; but Manoah her husband was not with her.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתְּמַהֵר֙ הָֽאִשָּׁ֔ה וַתָּ֖רׇץ וַתַּגֵּ֣ד לְאִישָׁ֑הּ וַתֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלָ֔יו הִנֵּ֨ה נִרְאָ֤ה אֵלַי֙ הָאִ֔ישׁ אֲשֶׁר־בָּ֥א בַיּ֖וֹם אֵלָֽי׃
verses.translit: vtmhr h'shh vtrts vtgd l'yshh vt'mr 'lyv hnh nr'h 'ly h'ysh 'shrb' byvm 'ly
verses.translation: And the woman made haste, and ran, and told her husband, and said unto him: ‘Behold, the man hath appeared unto me, that came unto me that day.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּ֛קׇם וַיֵּ֥לֶךְ מָנ֖וֹחַ אַחֲרֵ֣י אִשְׁתּ֑וֹ וַיָּבֹא֙ אֶל־הָאִ֔ישׁ וַיֹּ֣אמֶר ל֗וֹ הַאַתָּ֥ה הָאִ֛ישׁ אֲשֶׁר־דִּבַּ֥רְתָּ אֶל־הָאִשָּׁ֖ה וַיֹּ֥אמֶר אָֽנִי׃
verses.translit: vyqm vylkh mnvch 'chry 'shtv vyb' 'lh'ysh vy'mr lv h'th h'ysh 'shrdbrt 'lh'shh vy'mr 'ny
verses.translation: And Manoah arose, and went after his wife, and came to the man, and said unto him: ‘Art thou the man that spokest unto the woman?’ And he said: ‘I am.’
