verses.translit: vy'mr 'lyv 'brym 'nchnv mbytlchm yhvdh 'dyrkhty hr'prym mshm 'nkhy v'lkh 'dbyt lchm yhvdh v'tbyt yhvh 'ny hlkh v'yn 'ysh m'sf 'vty hbyth
verses.translation: And he said unto him: ‘We are passing from Beth-lehem in Judah unto the farther side of the hill-country of Ephraim; from thence am I, and I went to Beth-lehem in Judah, and I am now going to the house of the LORD; and there is no man that taketh me into his house.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְגַם־תֶּ֤בֶן גַּם־מִסְפּוֹא֙ יֵ֣שׁ לַחֲמוֹרֵ֔ינוּ וְ֠גַ֠ם לֶ֣חֶם וָיַ֤יִן יֶשׁ־לִי֙ וְלַֽאֲמָתֶ֔ךָ וְלַנַּ֖עַר עִם־עֲבָדֶ֑יךָ אֵ֥ין מַחְס֖וֹר כׇּל־דָּבָֽר׃
verses.translit: vgmtbn gmmspv' ysh lchmvrynv vgm lchm vyyn yshly vl'mtkh vln'r 'm'bdykh 'yn mchsvr khldbr
verses.translation: Yet there is both straw and provender for our asses; and there is bread and wine also for me, and for thy handmaid, and for the young man that is with thy servants; there is no want of any thing.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר הָאִ֤ישׁ הַזָּקֵן֙ שָׁל֣וֹם לָ֔ךְ רַ֥ק כׇּל־מַחְסוֹרְךָ֖ עָלָ֑י רַ֥ק בָּרְח֖וֹב אַל־תָּלַֽן׃
verses.translit: vy'mr h'ysh hzqn shlvm lkh rq khlmchsvrkh 'ly rq brchvb 'ltln
verses.translation: And the old man said: ‘Peace be unto thee; howsoever let all thy wants lie upon me; only lodge not in the broad place.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְבִיאֵ֣הוּ לְבֵית֔וֹ (ויבול) [וַיָּ֖בׇל] לַחֲמוֹרִ֑ים וַֽיִּרְחֲצוּ֙ רַגְלֵיהֶ֔ם וַיֹּאכְל֖וּ וַיִּשְׁתּֽוּ׃
verses.translit: vyby'hv lbytv (vybvl) [vybl] lchmvrym vyrchtsv rglyhm vy'khlv vyshtv
verses.translation: So he brought him into his house, and gave the asses fodder; and they washed their feet, and did eat and drink.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֵ֘מָּה֮ מֵיטִיבִ֣ים אֶת־לִבָּם֒ וְהִנֵּה֩ אַנְשֵׁ֨י הָעִ֜יר אַנְשֵׁ֣י בְנֵי־בְלִיַּ֗עַל נָסַ֙בּוּ֙ אֶת־הַבַּ֔יִת מִֽתְדַּפְּקִ֖ים עַל־הַדָּ֑לֶת וַיֹּאמְר֗וּ אֶל־הָ֠אִ֠ישׁ בַּ֣עַל הַבַּ֤יִת הַזָּקֵן֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר הוֹצֵ֗א אֶת־הָאִ֛ישׁ אֲשֶׁר־בָּ֥א אֶל־בֵּיתְךָ֖ וְנֵדָעֶֽנּוּ׃
verses.translit: hmh mytybym 'tlbm vhnh 'nshy h'yr 'nshy bnybly'l nsbv 'thbyt mtdpqym 'lhdlt vy'mrv 'lh'ysh b'l hbyt hzqn l'mr hvts' 'th'ysh 'shrb' 'lbytkh vnd'nv
verses.translation: As they were making their hearts merry, behold, the men of the city, certain base fellows, beset the house round about, beating at the door; and they spoke to the master of the house, the old man, saying: ‘Bring forth the man that came into thy house, that we may know him.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֵּצֵ֣א אֲלֵיהֶ֗ם הָאִישׁ֙ בַּ֣עַל הַבַּ֔יִת וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֲלֵהֶ֔ם אַל־אַחַ֖י אַל־תָּרֵ֣עוּ נָ֑א אַ֠חֲרֵי אֲשֶׁר־בָּ֞א הָאִ֤ישׁ הַזֶּה֙ אֶל־בֵּיתִ֔י אַֽל־תַּעֲשׂ֖וּ אֶת־הַנְּבָלָ֥ה הַזֹּֽאת׃
verses.translit: vyts' 'lyhm h'ysh b'l hbyt vy'mr 'lhm 'l'chy 'ltr'v n' 'chry 'shrb' h'ysh hzh 'lbyty 'lt'shv 'thnblh hz't
verses.translation: And the man, the master of the house, went out unto them, and said unto them: ‘Nay, my brethren, I pray you, do not so wickedly; seeing that this man is come into my house, do not this wanton deed.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִנֵּה֩ בִתִּ֨י הַבְּתוּלָ֜ה וּפִילַגְשֵׁ֗הוּ אֽוֹצִיאָה־נָּ֤א אוֹתָם֙ וְעַנּ֣וּ אוֹתָ֔ם וַעֲשׂ֣וּ לָהֶ֔ם הַטּ֖וֹב בְּעֵינֵיכֶ֑ם וְלָאִ֤ישׁ הַזֶּה֙ לֹ֣א תַֽעֲשׂ֔וּ דְּבַ֖ר הַנְּבָלָ֥ה הַזֹּֽאת׃
verses.translit: hnh bty hbtvlh vpylgshhv 'vtsy'hn' 'vtm v'nv 'vtm v'shv lhm htvb b'ynykhm vl'ysh hzh l' t'shv dbr hnblh hz't
verses.translation: Behold, here is my daughter a virgin, and his concubine; I will bring them out now, and humble ye them, and do with them what seemeth good unto you; but unto this man do not so wanton a thing.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלֹֽא־אָב֤וּ הָֽאֲנָשִׁים֙ לִשְׁמֹ֣עַֽ ל֔וֹ וַיַּחֲזֵ֤ק הָאִישׁ֙ בְּפִ֣ילַגְשׁ֔וֹ וַיֹּצֵ֥א אֲלֵיהֶ֖ם הַח֑וּץ וַיֵּדְע֣וּ א֠וֹתָ֠הּ וַיִּֽתְעַלְּלוּ־בָ֤הּ כׇּל־הַלַּ֙יְלָה֙ עַד־הַבֹּ֔קֶר וַֽיְשַׁלְּח֖וּהָ (בעלות) [כַּעֲל֥וֹת] הַשָּֽׁחַר׃
verses.translit: vl''bv h'nshym lshm' lv vychzq h'ysh bpylgshv vyts' 'lyhm hchvts vyd'v 'vth vyt'llvbh khlhlylh 'dhbqr vyshlchvh (b'lvt) [kh'lvt] hshchr
verses.translation: But the men would not hearken to him; so the man laid hold on his concubine, and brought her forth unto them; and they knew her, and abused her all the night until the morning; and when the day began to spring, they let her go.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתָּבֹ֥א הָאִשָּׁ֖ה לִפְנ֣וֹת הַבֹּ֑קֶר וַתִּפֹּ֞ל פֶּ֧תַח בֵּית־הָאִ֛ישׁ אֲשֶׁר־אֲדוֹנֶ֥יהָ שָּׁ֖ם עַד־הָאֽוֹר׃
verses.translit: vtb' h'shh lpnvt hbqr vtpl ptch byth'ysh 'shr'dvnyh shm 'dh'vr
verses.translation: Then came the woman in the dawning of the day, and fell down at the door of the man’s house where her lord was, till it was light.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּ֨קׇם אֲדֹנֶ֜יהָ בַּבֹּ֗קֶר וַיִּפְתַּח֙ דַּלְת֣וֹת הַבַּ֔יִת וַיֵּצֵ֖א לָלֶ֣כֶת לְדַרְכּ֑וֹ וְהִנֵּ֧ה הָאִשָּׁ֣ה פִֽילַגְשׁ֗וֹ נֹפֶ֙לֶת֙ פֶּ֣תַח הַבַּ֔יִת וְיָדֶ֖יהָ עַל־הַסַּֽף׃
verses.translit: vyqm 'dnyh bbqr vyptch dltvt hbyt vyts' llkht ldrkhv vhnh h'shh pylgshv nplt ptch hbyt vydyh 'lhsf
verses.translation: And her lord rose up in the morning, and opened the doors of the house, and went out to go his way; and, behold, the woman his concubine was fallen down at the door of the house, with her hands upon the threshold.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֧אמֶר אֵלֶ֛יהָ ק֥וּמִי וְנֵלֵ֖כָה וְאֵ֣ין עֹנֶ֑ה וַיִּקָּחֶ֙הָ֙ עַֽל־הַחֲמ֔וֹר וַיָּ֣קׇם הָאִ֔ישׁ וַיֵּ֖לֶךְ לִמְקֹמֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lyh qvmy vnlkhh v'yn 'nh vyqchh 'lhchmvr vyqm h'ysh vylkh lmqmv
verses.translation: And he said unto her. 'Up, and let us be going'; but none answered; then he took her up upon the ass; and the man rose up, and got him unto his place.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּבֹ֣א אֶל־בֵּית֗וֹ וַיִּקַּ֤ח אֶת־הַֽמַּאֲכֶ֙לֶת֙ וַיַּחֲזֵ֣ק בְּפִֽילַגְשׁ֔וֹ וַֽיְנַתְּחֶ֙הָ֙ לַעֲצָמֶ֔יהָ לִשְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָׂ֖ר נְתָחִ֑ים וַֽיְשַׁלְּחֶ֔הָ בְּכֹ֖ל גְּב֥וּל יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: vyb' 'lbytv vyqch 'thm'khlt vychzq bpylgshv vyntchh l'tsmyh lshnym 'shr ntchym vyshlchh bkhl gbvl yshr'l
verses.translation: And when he was come into his house, he took a knife, and laid hold on his concubine, and divided her, limb by limb, into twelve pieces, and sent her throughout all the borders of Israel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָיָ֣ה כׇל־הָרֹאֶ֗ה וְאָמַר֙ לֹֽא־נִהְיְתָ֤ה וְלֹֽא־נִרְאֲתָה֙ כָּזֹ֔את לְמִיּ֞וֹם עֲל֤וֹת בְּנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם עַ֖ד הַיּ֣וֹם הַזֶּ֑ה שִׂימוּ־לָכֶ֥ם עָלֶ֖יהָ עֻ֥צוּ וְדַבֵּֽרוּ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vhyh khlhr'h v'mr l'nhyth vl'nr'th khz't lmyvm 'lvt bnyyshr'l m'rts mtsrym 'd hyvm hzh shymvlkhm 'lyh 'tsv vdbrv {p}
verses.translation: And it was so, that all that saw it said: ‘Such a thing hath not happened nor been seen from the day that the children of Israel came up out of the land of Egypt unto this day; consider it, take counsel, and speak.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֵּצְאוּ֮ כׇּל־בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵל֒ וַתִּקָּהֵ֨ל הָעֵדָ֜ה כְּאִ֣ישׁ אֶחָ֗ד לְמִדָּן֙ וְעַד־בְּאֵ֣ר שֶׁ֔בַע וְאֶ֖רֶץ הַגִּלְעָ֑ד אֶל־יְהֹוָ֖ה הַמִּצְפָּֽה׃
verses.translit: vyts'v khlbny yshr'l vtqhl h'dh kh'ysh 'chd lmdn v'db'r shb' v'rts hgl'd 'lyhvh hmtsph
verses.translation: Then all the children of Israel went out, and the congregation was assembled as one man, from Dan even to Beer-sheba, with the land of Gilead, unto the LORD at Mizpah.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּֽתְיַצְּב֞וּ פִּנּ֣וֹת כׇּל־הָעָ֗ם כֹּ֚ל שִׁבְטֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל בִּקְהַ֖ל עַ֣ם הָאֱלֹהִ֑ים אַרְבַּ֨ע מֵא֥וֹת אֶ֛לֶף אִ֥ישׁ רַגְלִ֖י שֹׁ֥לֵֽף־חָֽרֶב׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vytytsbv pnvt khlh'm khl shbty yshr'l bqhl 'm h'lhym 'rb' m'vt 'lf 'ysh rgly shlfchrb {p}
verses.translation: And the chiefs of all the people, even of all the tribes of Israel, presented themselves in the assembly of the people of God, four hundred thousand footmen that drew sword.—
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽיִּשְׁמְעוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י בִנְיָמִ֔ן כִּֽי־עָל֥וּ בְנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל הַמִּצְפָּ֑ה וַיֹּֽאמְרוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל דַּבְּר֕וּ אֵיכָ֥ה נִהְיְתָ֖ה הָרָעָ֥ה הַזֹּֽאת׃
verses.translit: vyshm'v bny bnymn khy'lv bnyyshr'l hmtsph vy'mrv bny yshr'l dbrv 'ykhh nhyth hr'h hz't
verses.translation: Now the children of Benjamin heard that the children of Israel were gone up to Mizpah.—And the children of Israel said: ‘Tell us, how was this wickedness brought to pass?’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֜עַן הָאִ֣ישׁ הַלֵּוִ֗י אִ֛ישׁ הָאִשָּׁ֥ה הַנִּרְצָחָ֖ה וַיֹּאמַ֑ר הַגִּבְעָ֙תָה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לְבִנְיָמִ֔ן בָּ֛אתִי אֲנִ֥י וּפִילַגְשִׁ֖י לָלֽוּן׃
verses.translit: vy'n h'ysh hlvy 'ysh h'shh hnrtschh vy'mr hgb'th 'shr lbnymn b'ty 'ny vpylgshy llvn
verses.translation: And the Levite, the husband of the woman that was murdered, answered and said: ‘I came into Gibeah that belongeth to Benjamin, I and my concubine, to lodge.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּקֻ֤מוּ עָלַי֙ בַּעֲלֵ֣י הַגִּבְעָ֔ה וַיָּסֹ֧בּוּ עָלַ֛י אֶת־הַבַּ֖יִת לָ֑יְלָה אוֹתִי֙ דִּמּ֣וּ לַהֲרֹ֔ג וְאֶת־פִּילַגְשִׁ֥י עִנּ֖וּ וַתָּמֹֽת׃
verses.translit: vyqmv 'ly b'ly hgb'h vysbv 'ly 'thbyt lylh 'vty dmv lhrg v'tpylgshy 'nv vtmt
verses.translation: And the men of Gibeah rose against me, and beset the house round about upon me by night; me they thought to have slain, and my concubine they forced, and she is dead.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וָאֹחֵ֤ז בְּפִֽילַגְשִׁי֙ וָֽאֲנַתְּחֶ֔הָ וָֽאֲשַׁלְּחֶ֔הָ בְּכׇל־שְׂדֵ֖ה נַחֲלַ֣ת יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל כִּ֥י עָשׂ֛וּ זִמָּ֥ה וּנְבָלָ֖ה בְּיִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: v'chz bpylgshy v'ntchh v'shlchh bkhlshdh nchlt yshr'l khy 'shv zmh vnblh byshr'l
verses.translation: And I took my concubine, and cut her in pieces, and sent her throughout all the country of the inheritance of Israel; for they have committed lewdness and wantonness in Israel
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִנֵּ֥ה כֻלְּכֶ֖ם בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל הָב֥וּ לָכֶ֛ם דָּבָ֥ר וְעֵצָ֖ה הֲלֹֽם׃
verses.translit: hnh khlkhm bny yshr'l hbv lkhm dbr v'tsh hlm
verses.translation: Behold, ye are all here, children of Israel, give here your advice and council.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּ֙קׇם֙ כׇּל־הָעָ֔ם כְּאִ֥ישׁ אֶחָ֖ד לֵאמֹ֑ר לֹ֤א נֵלֵךְ֙ אִ֣ישׁ לְאׇהֳל֔וֹ וְלֹ֥א נָס֖וּר אִ֥ישׁ לְבֵיתֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vyqm khlh'm kh'ysh 'chd l'mr l' nlkh 'ysh l'hlv vl' nsvr 'ysh lbytv
verses.translation: And all the people arose as one man, saying: ‘We will not any of us go to his tent, neither will we any of us turn unto his house.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֕ה זֶ֣ה הַדָּבָ֔ר אֲשֶׁ֥ר נַעֲשֶׂ֖ה לַגִּבְעָ֑ה עָלֶ֖יהָ בְּגוֹרָֽל׃
verses.translit: v'th zh hdbr 'shr n'shh lgb'h 'lyh bgvrl
verses.translation: But now this is the thing which we will do to Gibeah: we will go up against it by lot;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלָקַ֣חְנוּ עֲשָׂרָה֩ אֲנָשִׁ֨ים לַמֵּאָ֜ה לְכֹ֣ל  שִׁבְטֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל וּמֵאָ֤ה לָאֶ֙לֶף֙ וְאֶ֣לֶף לָֽרְבָבָ֔ה לָקַ֥חַת צֵדָ֖ה לָעָ֑ם לַעֲשׂ֗וֹת לְבוֹאָם֙ לְגֶ֣בַע בִּנְיָמִ֔ן כְּכׇ֨ל־הַנְּבָלָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשָׂ֖ה בְּיִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: vlqchnv 'shrh 'nshym lm'h lkhl  shbty yshr'l vm'h l'lf v'lf lrbbh lqcht tsdh l'm l'shvt lbv'm lgb' bnymn khkhlhnblh 'shr 'shh byshr'l
verses.translation: and we will take ten men of a hundred throughout all the tribes of Israel, and a hundred of a thousand, and a thousand out of ten thousand, to fetch victuals for the people, that they may do, when they come to Gibeah of Benjamin, according to all the wantonness that they have wrought in Israel.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֵּאָסֵ֞ף כׇּל־אִ֤ישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ אֶל־הָעִ֔יר כְּאִ֥ישׁ אֶחָ֖ד חֲבֵרִֽים׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vy'sf khl'ysh yshr'l 'lh'yr kh'ysh 'chd chbrym {p}
verses.translation: So all the men of Israel were gathered against the city, knit together as one man.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽיִּשְׁלְח֞וּ שִׁבְטֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ אֲנָשִׁ֔ים בְּכׇל־שִׁבְטֵ֥י בִנְיָמִ֖ן לֵאמֹ֑ר מָ֚ה הָרָעָ֣ה הַזֹּ֔את אֲשֶׁ֥ר נִהְיְתָ֖ה בָּכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vyshlchv shbty yshr'l 'nshym bkhlshbty bnymn l'mr mh hr'h hz't 'shr nhyth bkhm
verses.translation: And the tribes of Israel sent men through all the tribe of Benjamin, saying: ‘What wickedness is this that is come to pass among you?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֡ה תְּנוּ֩ אֶת־הָאֲנָשִׁ֨ים בְּנֵי־בְלִיַּ֜עַל אֲשֶׁ֤ר בַּגִּבְעָה֙ וּנְמִיתֵ֔ם וּנְבַעֲרָ֥ה רָעָ֖ה מִיִּשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְלֹ֤א אָבוּ֙ [בְּנֵ֣י] בִנְיָמִ֔ן לִשְׁמֹ֕עַ בְּק֖וֹל אֲחֵיהֶ֥ם בְּנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: v'th tnv 'th'nshym bnybly'l 'shr bgb'h vnmytm vnb'rh r'h myshr'l vl' 'bv [bny] bnymn lshm' bqvl 'chyhm bnyyshr'l
verses.translation: Now therefore deliver up the men, the base fellows that are in Gibeah, that we may put them to death, and put away evil from Israel.’ But the children of Benjamin would not hearken to the voice of their brethren the children of Israel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֵּאָסְפ֧וּ בְנֵֽי־בִנְיָמִ֛ן מִן־הֶעָרִ֖ים הַגִּבְעָ֑תָה לָצֵ֥את לַמִּלְחָמָ֖ה עִם־בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: vy'spv bnybnymn mnh'rym hgb'th lts't lmlchmh 'mbny yshr'l
verses.translation: And the children of Benjamin gathered themselves together out of their cities unto Gibeah, to go out to battle against the children of Israel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּתְפָּֽקְדוּ֩ בְנֵ֨י בִנְיָמִ֜ן בַּיּ֤וֹם הַהוּא֙ מֵהֶ֣עָרִ֔ים עֶשְׂרִ֨ים וְשִׁשָּׁ֥ה אֶ֛לֶף אִ֖ישׁ שֹׁ֣לֵֽף חָ֑רֶב לְ֠בַ֠ד מִיֹּשְׁבֵ֤י הַגִּבְעָה֙ הִתְפָּ֣קְד֔וּ שְׁבַ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת אִ֥ישׁ בָּחֽוּר׃
verses.translit: vytpqdv bny bnymn byvm hhv' mh'rym 'shrym vshshh 'lf 'ysh shlf chrb lbd myshby hgb'h htpqdv shb' m'vt 'ysh bchvr
verses.translation: And the children of Benjamin numbered on that day out of the cities twenty and six thousand men that drew sword, besides the inhabitants of Gibeah, who numbered seven hundred chosen men.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִכֹּ֣ל  הָעָ֣ם הַזֶּ֗ה שְׁבַ֤ע מֵאוֹת֙ אִ֣ישׁ בָּח֔וּר אִטֵּ֖ר יַד־יְמִינ֑וֹ כׇּל־זֶ֗ה קֹלֵ֧עַ בָּאֶ֛בֶן אֶל־הַֽשַּׂעֲרָ֖ה וְלֹ֥א יַחֲטִֽא׃ {פ}
verses.translit: mkhl  h'm hzh shb' m'vt 'ysh bchvr 'tr ydymynv khlzh ql' b'bn 'lhsh'rh vl' ycht' {p}
verses.translation: All this people, even seven hundred chosen men, were left-handed; every one could sling stones at a hair-breadth, and not miss.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאִ֨ישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל הִתְפָּֽקְד֗וּ לְבַד֙ מִבִּנְיָמִ֔ן אַרְבַּ֨ע מֵא֥וֹת אֶ֛לֶף אִ֖ישׁ שֹׁ֣לֵֽף חָ֑רֶב כׇּל־זֶ֖ה אִ֥ישׁ מִלְחָמָֽה׃
verses.translit: v'ysh yshr'l htpqdv lbd mbnymn 'rb' m'vt 'lf 'ysh shlf chrb khlzh 'ysh mlchmh
verses.translation: And the men of Israel, beside Benjamin, numbered four hundred thousand men that drew sword; all these were men of war.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּקֻ֜מוּ וַיַּעֲל֣וּ בֵֽית־אֵל֮ וַיִּשְׁאֲל֣וּ בֵאלֹהִים֒ וַיֹּֽאמְרוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל מִ֚י יַעֲלֶה־לָּ֣נוּ בַתְּחִלָּ֔ה לַמִּלְחָמָ֖ה עִם־בְּנֵ֣י בִנְיָמִ֑ן וַיֹּ֥אמֶר יְהֹוָ֖ה יְהוּדָ֥ה בַתְּחִלָּֽה׃
verses.translit: vyqmv vy'lv byt'l vysh'lv b'lhym vy'mrv bny yshr'l my y'lhlnv btchlh lmlchmh 'mbny bnymn vy'mr yhvh yhvdh btchlh
verses.translation: And the children of Israel arose, and went up to Beth-el, and asked counsel of God; and they said: ‘Who shall go up for us first to battle against the children of Benjamin?’ And the LORD said: ‘Judah first.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּק֥וּמוּ בְנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בַּבֹּ֑קֶר וַֽיַּחֲנ֖וּ עַל־הַגִּבְעָֽה׃
verses.translit: vyqvmv bnyyshr'l bbqr vychnv 'lhgb'h
verses.translation: And the children of Israel rose up in the morning, and encamped against Gibeah.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֵּצֵא֙ אִ֣ישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לַמִּלְחָמָ֖ה עִם־בִּנְיָמִ֑ן וַיַּעַרְכ֨וּ אִתָּ֧ם אִֽישׁ־יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל מִלְחָמָ֖ה אֶל־הַגִּבְעָֽה׃
verses.translit: vyts' 'ysh yshr'l lmlchmh 'mbnymn vy'rkhv 'tm 'yshyshr'l mlchmh 'lhgb'h
verses.translation: And the men of Israel went out to battle against Benjamin; and the men of Israel set the battle in array against them at Gibeah.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֵּצְא֥וּ בְנֵי־בִנְיָמִ֖ן מִן־הַגִּבְעָ֑ה וַיַּשְׁחִ֨יתוּ בְיִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֗וּא שְׁנַ֨יִם וְעֶשְׂרִ֥ים אֶ֛לֶף אִ֖ישׁ אָֽרְצָה׃
verses.translit: vyts'v bnybnymn mnhgb'h vyshchytv byshr'l byvm hhv' shnym v'shrym 'lf 'ysh 'rtsh
verses.translation: And the children of Benjamin came forth out of Gibeah, and destroyed down to the ground of the Israelites on that day twenty and two thousand men.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּתְחַזֵּ֥ק הָעָ֖ם אִ֣ישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיֹּסִ֙פוּ֙ לַעֲרֹ֣ךְ מִלְחָמָ֔ה בַּמָּק֕וֹם אֲשֶׁר־עָ֥רְכוּ שָׁ֖ם בַּיּ֥וֹם הָרִאשֽׁוֹן׃
verses.translit: vytchzq h'm 'ysh yshr'l vyspv l'rkh mlchmh bmqvm 'shr'rkhv shm byvm hr'shvn
verses.translation: And the people, the men of Israel, encouraged themselves, and set the battle again in array in the place where they set themselves in array the first day.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּעֲל֣וּ בְנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל וַיִּבְכּ֣וּ לִפְנֵי־יְהֹוָה֮ עַד־הָעֶ֒רֶב֒ וַיִּשְׁאֲל֤וּ בַֽיהֹוָה֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר הַאוֹסִ֗יף לָגֶ֙שֶׁת֙ לַמִּלְחָמָ֔ה עִם־בְּנֵ֥י בִנְיָמִ֖ן אָחִ֑י וַיֹּ֥אמֶר יְהֹוָ֖ה עֲל֥וּ אֵלָֽיו׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vy'lv bnyyshr'l vybkhv lpnyyhvh 'dh'rb vysh'lv byhvh l'mr h'vsyf lgsht lmlchmh 'mbny bnymn 'chy vy'mr yhvh 'lv 'lyv {p}
verses.translation: And the children of Israel went up and wept before the LORD until even; and they asked of the LORD, saying: ‘Shall I again draw nigh to battle against the children of Benjamin my brother?’ And the LORD said: ‘Go up against him.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּקְרְב֧וּ בְנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל אֶל־בְּנֵ֥י בִנְיָמִ֖ן בַּיּ֥וֹם הַשֵּׁנִֽי׃
verses.translit: vyqrbv bnyyshr'l 'lbny bnymn byvm hshny
verses.translation: And the children of Israel came near against the children of Benjamin the second day.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֵּצֵא֩ בִנְיָמִ֨ן ׀ לִקְרָאתָ֥ם ׀ מִֽן־הַגִּבְעָה֮ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַשֵּׁנִי֒ וַיַּשְׁחִ֩יתוּ֩ בִבְנֵ֨י יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל ע֗וֹד שְׁמֹנַ֨ת עָשָׂ֥ר אֶ֛לֶף אִ֖ישׁ אָ֑רְצָה כׇּל־אֵ֖לֶּה שֹׁ֥לְפֵי חָֽרֶב׃
verses.translit: vyts' bnymn  lqr'tm  mnhgb'h byvm hshny vyshchytv bbny yshr'l 'vd shmnt 'shr 'lf 'ysh 'rtsh khl'lh shlpy chrb
verses.translation: And Benjamin went forth against them out of Gibeah the second day, and destroyed down to the ground of the children of Israel again eighteen thousand men; all these drew the sword.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּעֲל֣וּ כׇל־בְּנֵי֩ יִשְׂרָאֵ֨ל וְכׇל־הָעָ֜ם וַיָּבֹ֣אוּ בֵֽית־אֵ֗ל וַיִּבְכּוּ֙ וַיֵּ֤שְׁבוּ שָׁם֙ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהֹוָ֔ה וַיָּצ֥וּמוּ בַיּוֹם־הַה֖וּא עַד־הָעָ֑רֶב וַֽיַּעֲל֛וּ עֹל֥וֹת וּשְׁלָמִ֖ים לִפְנֵ֥י יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: vy'lv khlbny yshr'l vkhlh'm vyb'v byt'l vybkhv vyshbv shm lpny yhvh vytsvmv byvmhhv' 'dh'rb vy'lv 'lvt vshlmym lpny yhvh
verses.translation: Then all the children of Israel, and all the people, went up, and came unto Beth-el, and wept, and sat there before the LORD, and fasted that day until even; and they offered burnt-offerings and peace-offerings before the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁאֲל֥וּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בַּיהֹוָ֑ה וְשָׁ֗ם אֲרוֹן֙ בְּרִ֣ית הָאֱלֹהִ֔ים בַּיָּמִ֖ים הָהֵֽם׃
verses.translit: vysh'lv bnyyshr'l byhvh vshm 'rvn bryt h'lhym bymym hhm
verses.translation: And the children of Israel asked of the LORD—for the ark of the covenant of God was there in those days,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּ֠פִֽינְחָ֠ס בֶּן־אֶלְעָזָ֨ר בֶּֽן־אַהֲרֹ֜ן עֹמֵ֣ד  לְפָנָ֗יו בַּיָּמִ֣ים הָהֵם֮ לֵאמֹר֒ הַאוֹסִ֨ף ע֜וֹד לָצֵ֧את לַמִּלְחָמָ֛ה עִם־בְּנֵֽי־בִנְיָמִ֥ן אָחִ֖י אִם־אֶחְדָּ֑ל וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהֹוָה֙ עֲל֔וּ כִּ֥י מָחָ֖ר אֶתְּנֶ֥נּוּ בְיָדֶֽךָ׃
verses.translit: vpynchs bn'l'zr bn'hrn 'md  lpnyv bymym hhm l'mr h'vsf 'vd lts't lmlchmh 'mbnybnymn 'chy 'm'chdl vy'mr yhvh 'lv khy mchr 'tnnv bydkh
verses.translation: and Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron, stood before it in those days—saying: ‘Shall I yet again go out to battle against the children of Benjamin my brother, or shall I cease?’ And the LORD said: ‘Go up; for to-morrow I will deliver him into thy hand.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּ֤שֶׂם יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ אֹֽרְבִ֔ים אֶל־הַגִּבְעָ֖ה סָבִֽיב׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vyshm yshr'l 'rbym 'lhgb'h sbyb {p}
verses.translation: And Israel set liers-in-wait against Gibeah round about.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּעֲל֧וּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל אֶל־בְּנֵ֥י בִנְיָמִ֖ן בַּיּ֣וֹם הַשְּׁלִישִׁ֑י וַיַּעַרְכ֥וּ אֶל־הַגִּבְעָ֖ה כְּפַ֥עַם בְּפָֽעַם׃
verses.translit: vy'lv bnyyshr'l 'lbny bnymn byvm hshlyshy vy'rkhv 'lhgb'h khp'm bp'm
verses.translation: And the children of Israel went up against the children of Benjamin on the third day, and set themselves in array against Gibeah, as at other times.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֵּצְא֤וּ בְנֵֽי־בִנְיָמִן֙ לִקְרַ֣את הָעָ֔ם הׇנְתְּק֖וּ מִן־הָעִ֑יר וַיָּחֵ֡לּוּ לְהַכּוֹת֩ מֵהָעָ֨ם חֲלָלִ֜ים כְּפַ֣עַם  בְּפַ֗עַם בַּֽמְסִלּוֹת֙ אֲשֶׁ֨ר אַחַ֜ת עֹלָ֣ה בֵֽית־אֵ֗ל וְאַחַ֤ת גִּבְעָ֙תָה֙ בַּשָּׂדֶ֔ה כִּשְׁלֹשִׁ֥ים אִ֖ישׁ בְּיִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: vyts'v bnybnymn lqr't h'm hntqv mnh'yr vychlv lhkhvt mh'm chllym khp'm  bp'm bmslvt 'shr 'cht 'lh byt'l v'cht gb'th bshdh khshlshym 'ysh byshr'l
verses.translation: And the children of Benjamin went out against the people, and were drawn away from the city; and they began to smite and kill of the people, as at other times, in the field, in the highways, of which one goeth up to Beth-el, and the other to Gibeah, about thirty men of Israel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּֽאמְרוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י בִנְיָמִ֔ן נִגָּפִ֥ים הֵ֛ם לְפָנֵ֖ינוּ כְּבָרִֽאשֹׁנָ֑ה וּבְנֵ֧י יִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל אָמְר֗וּ נָנ֙וּסָה֙ וּֽנְתַקְּנ֔וּהוּ מִן־הָעִ֖יר אֶל־הַֽמְסִלּֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: vy'mrv bny bnymn ngpym hm lpnynv khbr'shnh vbny yshr'l 'mrv nnvsh vntqnvhv mnh'yr 'lhmslvt
verses.translation: And the children of Benjamin said: ‘They are smitten down before us, as at the first.’ But the children of Israel said: ‘Let us flee, and draw them away from the city unto the highways.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְכֹ֣ל  אִ֣ישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל קָ֚מוּ מִמְּקוֹמ֔וֹ וַיַּעַרְכ֖וּ בְּבַ֣עַל תָּמָ֑ר וְאֹרֵ֧ב יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל מֵגִ֥יחַ מִמְּקֹמ֖וֹ מִמַּ֥עֲרֵה גָֽבַע׃
verses.translit: vkhl  'ysh yshr'l qmv mmqvmv vy'rkhv bb'l tmr v'rb yshr'l mgych mmqmv mm'rh gb'
verses.translation: And all the men of Israel rose up out of their place, and set themselves in array at Baal-tamar; and the liers-in-wait of Israel broke forth out of their place, even out of Maareh-geba.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּבֹ֩אוּ֩ מִנֶּ֨גֶד לַגִּבְעָ֜ה עֲשֶׂ֩רֶת֩ אֲלָפִ֨ים אִ֤ישׁ בָּחוּר֙ מִכׇּל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְהַמִּלְחָמָ֖ה כָּבֵ֑דָה וְהֵם֙ לֹ֣א יָדְע֔וּ כִּי־נֹגַ֥עַת עֲלֵיהֶ֖ם הָרָעָֽה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vyb'v mngd lgb'h 'shrt 'lpym 'ysh bchvr mkhlyshr'l vhmlchmh khbdh vhm l' yd'v khyng't 'lyhm hr'h {p}
verses.translation: And there came over against Gibeah ten thousand chosen men out of all Israel, and the battle was sore; but they knew not that evil was close upon them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּגֹּ֨ף יְהֹוָ֥ה ׀ אֶֽת־בִּנְיָמִן֮ לִפְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵל֒ וַיַּשְׁחִ֩יתוּ֩ בְנֵ֨י יִשְׂרָאֵ֤ל בְּבִנְיָמִן֙ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֔וּא עֶשְׂרִ֨ים וַחֲמִשָּׁ֥ה אֶ֛לֶף וּמֵאָ֖ה אִ֑ישׁ כׇּל־אֵ֖לֶּה שֹׁ֥לֵֽף־חָֽרֶב׃
verses.translit: vygf yhvh  'tbnymn lpny yshr'l vyshchytv bny yshr'l bbnymn byvm hhv' 'shrym vchmshh 'lf vm'h 'ysh khl'lh shlfchrb
verses.translation: And the LORD smote Benjamin before Israel; and the children of Israel destroyed of Benjamin that day twenty and five thousand and a hundred men; all these drew the sword.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּרְא֥וּ בְנֵֽי־בִנְיָמִ֖ן כִּ֣י נִגָּ֑פוּ וַיִּתְּנ֨וּ אִֽישׁ־יִשְׂרָאֵ֤ל מָקוֹם֙ לְבִנְיָמִ֔ן כִּ֤י בָֽטְחוּ֙ אֶל־הָ֣אֹרֵ֔ב אֲשֶׁר־שָׂ֖מוּ אֶל־הַגִּבְעָֽה׃
verses.translit: vyr'v bnybnymn khy ngpv vytnv 'yshyshr'l mqvm lbnymn khy btchv 'lh'rb 'shrshmv 'lhgb'h
verses.translation: So the children of Benjamin saw that they were smitten. And the men of Israel gave place to Benjamin, because they trusted unto the liers-in-wait whom they had set against Gibeah.—
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָאֹרֵ֣ב הֵחִ֔ישׁוּ וַֽיִּפְשְׁט֖וּ אֶל־הַגִּבְעָ֑ה וַיִּמְשֹׁךְ֙ הָאֹרֵ֔ב וַיַּ֥ךְ אֶת־כׇּל־הָעִ֖יר לְפִי־חָֽרֶב׃
verses.translit: vh'rb hchyshv vypshtv 'lhgb'h vymshkh h'rb vykh 'tkhlh'yr lpychrb
verses.translation: And the liers-in-wait hastened, and rushed upon Gibeah; and the liers-in-wait drew forth, and smote all the city with the edge of the sword.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהַמּוֹעֵ֗ד הָיָ֛ה לְאִ֥ישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל עִם־הָאֹרֵ֑ב הֶ֕רֶב לְהַעֲלוֹתָ֛ם מַשְׂאַ֥ת הֶעָשָׁ֖ן מִן־הָעִֽיר׃
verses.translit: vhmv'd hyh l'ysh yshr'l 'mh'rb hrb lh'lvtm msh't h'shn mnh'yr
verses.translation: Now there was an appointed sign between the men of Israel and the liers-in-wait, that they should make a great beacon of smoke rise up out of the city.—
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּהֲפֹ֥ךְ אִֽישׁ־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בַּמִּלְחָמָ֑ה וּבִנְיָמִ֡ן הֵחֵל֩ לְהַכּ֨וֹת חֲלָלִ֤ים בְּאִֽישׁ־יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ כִּשְׁלֹשִׁ֣ים אִ֔ישׁ כִּ֣י אָֽמְר֔וּ אַךְ֩ נִגּ֨וֹף נִגָּ֥ף הוּא֙ לְפָנֵ֔ינוּ כַּמִּלְחָמָ֖ה הָרִאשֹׁנָֽה׃
verses.translit: vyhpkh 'yshyshr'l bmlchmh vbnymn hchl lhkhvt chllym b'yshyshr'l khshlshym 'ysh khy 'mrv 'kh ngvf ngf hv' lpnynv khmlchmh hr'shnh
verses.translation: And the men of Israel turned in the battle, and Benjamin began to smite and kill of the men of Israel about thirty persons; for they said: ‘Surely they are smitten down before us, as in the first battle.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהַמַּשְׂאֵ֗ת הֵחֵ֛לָּה לַעֲל֥וֹת מִן־הָעִ֖יר עַמּ֣וּד עָשָׁ֑ן וַיִּ֤פֶן בִּנְיָמִן֙ אַחֲרָ֔יו וְהִנֵּ֛ה עָלָ֥ה כְלִיל־הָעִ֖יר הַשָּׁמָֽיְמָה׃
verses.translit: vhmsh't hchlh l'lvt mnh'yr 'mvd 'shn vypn bnymn 'chryv vhnh 'lh khlylh'yr hshmymh
verses.translation: But when the beacon began to arise up out of the city in a pillar of smoke, the Benjamites looked behind them, and, behold, the whole of the city went up in smoke to heaven.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאִ֤ישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ הָפַ֔ךְ וַיִּבָּהֵ֖ל אִ֣ישׁ בִּנְיָמִ֑ן כִּ֣י רָאָ֔ה כִּֽי־נָגְעָ֥ה עָלָ֖יו הָרָעָֽה׃
verses.translit: v'ysh yshr'l hpkh vybhl 'ysh bnymn khy r'h khyng'h 'lyv hr'h
verses.translation: And the men of Israel turned, and the men of Benjamin were amazed; for they saw that evil was come upon them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּפְנ֞וּ לִפְנֵ֨י אִ֤ישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ אֶל־דֶּ֣רֶךְ הַמִּדְבָּ֔ר וְהַמִּלְחָמָ֖ה הִדְבִּיקָ֑תְהוּ וַֽאֲשֶׁר֙ מֵהֶ֣עָרִ֔ים מַשְׁחִיתִ֥ים אוֹת֖וֹ בְּתוֹכֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vypnv lpny 'ysh yshr'l 'ldrkh hmdbr vhmlchmh hdbyqthv v'shr mh'rym mshchytym 'vtv btvkhv
verses.translation: Therefore they turned their backs before the men of Israel unto the way of the wilderness; but the battle followed hard after them; and they that came out of the city destroyed them in the midst of the men of Israel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּתְּר֤וּ אֶת־בִּנְיָמִן֙ הִרְדִיפֻ֔הוּ מְנוּחָ֖ה הִדְרִיכֻ֑הוּ עַ֛ד נֹ֥כַח הַגִּבְעָ֖ה מִמִּזְרַח־שָֽׁמֶשׁ׃
verses.translit: khtrv 'tbnymn hrdyphv mnvchh hdrykhhv 'd nkhch hgb'h mmzrchshmsh
verses.translation: They inclosed the Benjamites round about, and chased them, and overtook them at their resting-place, as far as over against Gibeah toward the sunrising.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽיִּפְּלוּ֙ מִבִּנְיָמִ֔ן שְׁמֹנָֽה־עָשָׂ֥ר אֶ֖לֶף אִ֑ישׁ אֶת־כׇּל־אֵ֖לֶּה אַנְשֵׁי־חָֽיִל׃
verses.translit: vyplv mbnymn shmnh'shr 'lf 'ysh 'tkhl'lh 'nshychyl
verses.translation: And there fell of Benjamin eighteen thousand men; all these were men of valour.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּפְנ֞וּ וַיָּנֻ֤סוּ הַמִּדְבָּ֙רָה֙ אֶל־סֶ֣לַע הָרִמּ֔וֹן וַיְעֹלְלֻ֙הוּ֙ בַּֽמְסִלּ֔וֹת חֲמֵ֥שֶׁת אֲלָפִ֖ים אִ֑ישׁ וַיַּדְבִּ֤יקוּ אַֽחֲרָיו֙ עַד־גִּדְעֹ֔ם וַיַּכּ֥וּ מִמֶּ֖נּוּ אַלְפַּ֥יִם אִֽישׁ׃
verses.translit: vypnv vynsv hmdbrh 'lsl' hrmvn vy'llhv bmslvt chmsht 'lpym 'ysh vydbyqv 'chryv 'dgd'm vykhv mmnv 'lpym 'ysh
verses.translation: And they turned and fled toward the wilderness unto the rock of Rimmon; and they gleaned of them in the highways five thousand men; and followed hard after them unto Gidom, and smote of them two thousand men.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִי֩ כׇל־הַנֹּ֨פְלִ֜ים מִבִּנְיָמִ֗ן עֶשְׂרִים֩ וַחֲמִשָּׁ֨ה אֶ֥לֶף אִ֛ישׁ שֹׁ֥לֵֽף חֶ֖רֶב בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֑וּא אֶת־כׇּל־אֵ֖לֶּה אַנְשֵׁי־חָֽיִל׃
verses.translit: vyhy khlhnplym mbnymn 'shrym vchmshh 'lf 'ysh shlf chrb byvm hhv' 'tkhl'lh 'nshychyl
verses.translation: So that all who fell that day of Benjamin were twenty and five thousand men that drew the sword; all these were men of valour.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּפְנ֞וּ וַיָּנֻ֤סוּ הַמִּדְבָּ֙רָה֙ אֶל־סֶ֣לַע הָרִמּ֔וֹן שֵׁ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת אִ֑ישׁ וַיֵּֽשְׁבוּ֙ בְּסֶ֣לַע רִמּ֔וֹן אַרְבָּעָ֖ה חֳדָשִֽׁים׃
verses.translit: vypnv vynsv hmdbrh 'lsl' hrmvn shsh m'vt 'ysh vyshbv bsl' rmvn 'rb'h chdshym
verses.translation: But six hundred men turned and fled toward the wilderness unto the rock of Rimmon, and abode in the rock of Rimmon four months.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאִ֨ישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל שָׁ֣בוּ אֶל־בְּנֵ֤י בִנְיָמִן֙ וַיַּכּ֣וּם לְפִי־חֶ֔רֶב מֵעִ֤יר מְתֹם֙ עַד־בְּהֵמָ֔ה עַ֖ד כׇּל־הַנִּמְצָ֑א גַּ֛ם כׇּל־הֶעָרִ֥ים הַנִּמְצָא֖וֹת שִׁלְּח֥וּ בָאֵֽשׁ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: v'ysh yshr'l shbv 'lbny bnymn vykhvm lpychrb m'yr mtm 'dbhmh 'd khlhnmts' gm khlh'rym hnmts'vt shlchv b'sh {p}
verses.translation: And the men of Israel turned back upon the children of Benjamin, and smote them with the edge of the sword, both the entire city, and the cattle, and all that they found; moreover all the cities which they found they set on fire.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאִ֣ישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל נִשְׁבַּ֥ע בַּמִּצְפָּ֖ה לֵאמֹ֑ר אִ֣ישׁ מִמֶּ֔נּוּ לֹא־יִתֵּ֥ן בִּתּ֛וֹ לְבִנְיָמִ֖ן לְאִשָּֽׁה׃
verses.translit: v'ysh yshr'l nshb' bmtsph l'mr 'ysh mmnv l'ytn btv lbnymn l'shh
verses.translation: Now the men of Israel had sworn in Mizpah, saying: ‘There shall not any of us give his daughter unto Benjamin to wife.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּבֹ֤א הָעָם֙ בֵּֽית־אֵ֔ל וַיֵּ֤שְׁבוּ שָׁם֙ עַד־הָעֶ֔רֶב לִפְנֵ֖י הָאֱלֹהִ֑ים וַיִּשְׂא֣וּ קוֹלָ֔ם וַיִּבְכּ֖וּ בְּכִ֥י גָדֽוֹל׃
verses.translit: vyb' h'm byt'l vyshbv shm 'dh'rb lpny h'lhym vysh'v qvlm vybkhv bkhy gdvl
verses.translation: And the people came to Beth-el, and sat there till even before God, and lifted up their voices, and wept sore.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמְר֔וּ לָמָ֗ה יְהֹוָה֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל הָ֥יְתָה זֹּ֖את בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל לְהִפָּקֵ֥ד הַיּ֛וֹם מִיִּשְׂרָאֵ֖ל שֵׁ֥בֶט אֶחָֽד׃
verses.translit: vy'mrv lmh yhvh 'lhy yshr'l hyth z't byshr'l lhpqd hyvm myshr'l shbt 'chd
verses.translation: And they said: ‘O LORD, the God of Israel, why is this come to pass in Israel, that there should be to-day one tribe lacking in Israel?’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽיְהִי֙ מִֽמׇּחֳרָ֔ת וַיַּשְׁכִּ֣ימוּ הָעָ֔ם וַיִּבְנוּ־שָׁ֖ם מִזְבֵּ֑חַ וַיַּעֲל֥וּ עֹל֖וֹת וּשְׁלָמִֽים׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vyhy mmchrt vyshkhymv h'm vybnvshm mzbch vy'lv 'lvt vshlmym {p}
verses.translation: And it came to pass on the morrow that the people rose early, and built there an altar, and offered burnt-offerings and peace-offerings.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּֽאמְרוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל מִ֠י אֲשֶׁ֨ר לֹא־עָלָ֧ה בַקָּהָ֛ל מִכׇּל־שִׁבְטֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל אֶל־יְהֹוָ֑ה כִּי֩ הַשְּׁבוּעָ֨ה הַגְּדוֹלָ֜ה הָיְתָ֗ה לַ֠אֲשֶׁ֠ר לֹא־עָלָ֨ה אֶל־יְהֹוָ֧ה הַמִּצְפָּ֛ה לֵאמֹ֖ר מ֥וֹת יוּמָֽת׃
verses.translit: vy'mrv bny yshr'l my 'shr l''lh bqhl mkhlshbty yshr'l 'lyhvh khy hshbv'h hgdvlh hyth l'shr l''lh 'lyhvh hmtsph l'mr mvt yvmt
verses.translation: And the children of Israel said: ‘Who is there among all the tribes of Israel that came not up in the assembly unto the LORD?’ For they had made a great oath concerning him that came not up unto the LORD to Mizpah, saying: ‘He shall surely be put to death.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּנָּֽחֲמוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֶל־בִּנְיָמִ֖ן אָחִ֑יו וַיֹּ֣אמְר֔וּ נִגְדַּ֥ע הַיּ֛וֹם שֵׁ֥בֶט אֶחָ֖ד מִיִּשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: vynchmv bny yshr'l 'lbnymn 'chyv vy'mrv ngd' hyvm shbt 'chd myshr'l
verses.translation: And the children of Israel repented them for Benjamin their brother, and said: ‘There is one tribe cut off from Israel this day.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מַה־נַּעֲשֶׂ֥ה לָהֶ֛ם לַנּוֹתָרִ֖ים לְנָשִׁ֑ים וַאֲנַ֙חְנוּ֙ נִשְׁבַּ֣עְנוּ בַֽיהֹוָ֔ה לְבִלְתִּ֛י תֵּת־לָהֶ֥ם מִבְּנוֹתֵ֖ינוּ לְנָשִֽׁים׃
verses.translit: mhn'shh lhm lnvtrym lnshym v'nchnv nshb'nv byhvh lblty ttlhm mbnvtynv lnshym
verses.translation: How shall we do for wives for them that remain, seeing we have sworn by the LORD that we will not give them of our daughters to wives?’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמְר֔וּ מִ֗י אֶחָד֙ מִשִּׁבְטֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֲשֶׁ֛ר לֹא־עָלָ֥ה אֶל־יְהֹוָ֖ה הַמִּצְפָּ֑ה וְ֠הִנֵּ֠ה לֹ֣א בָא־אִ֧ישׁ אֶל־הַֽמַּחֲנֶ֛ה מִיָּבֵ֥ישׁ גִּלְעָ֖ד אֶל־הַקָּהָֽל׃
verses.translit: vy'mrv my 'chd mshbty yshr'l 'shr l''lh 'lyhvh hmtsph vhnh l' b''ysh 'lhmchnh mybysh gl'd 'lhqhl
verses.translation: And they said: ‘What one is there of the tribes of Israel that came not up unto the LORD to Mizpah?’ And, behold, there came none to the camp from Jabesh-gilead to the assembly.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּתְפָּקֵ֖ד הָעָ֑ם וְהִנֵּ֤ה אֵֽין־שָׁם֙ אִ֔ישׁ מִיּוֹשְׁבֵ֖י יָבֵ֥שׁ גִּלְעָֽד׃
verses.translit: vytpqd h'm vhnh 'ynshm 'ysh myvshby ybsh gl'd
verses.translation: For when the people were numbered, behold, there were none of the inhabitants of Jabesh-gilead there.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁלְחוּ־שָׁ֣ם הָעֵדָ֗ה שְׁנֵים־עָשָׂ֥ר אֶ֛לֶף אִ֖ישׁ מִבְּנֵ֣י הֶחָ֑יִל וַיְצַוּ֨וּ אוֹתָ֜ם לֵאמֹ֗ר לְ֠כ֠וּ וְהִכִּיתֶ֞ם אֶת־יוֹשְׁבֵ֨י יָבֵ֤שׁ גִּלְעָד֙ לְפִי־חֶ֔רֶב וְהַנָּשִׁ֖ים וְהַטָּֽף׃
verses.translit: vyshlchvshm h'dh shnym'shr 'lf 'ysh mbny hchyl vytsvv 'vtm l'mr lkhv vhkhytm 'tyvshby ybsh gl'd lpychrb vhnshym vhtf
verses.translation: And the congregation sent thither twelve thousand men of the valiantest, and commanded them, saying: ‘Go and smite the inhabitants of Jabesh-gilead with the edge of the sword, with the women and the little ones.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְזֶ֥ה הַדָּבָ֖ר אֲשֶׁ֣ר תַּעֲשׂ֑וּ כׇּל־זָכָ֗ר וְכׇל־אִשָּׁ֛ה יֹדַ֥עַת מִשְׁכַּב־זָכָ֖ר תַּחֲרִֽימוּ׃
verses.translit: vzh hdbr 'shr t'shv khlzkhr vkhl'shh yd't mshkhbzkhr tchrymv
verses.translation: And this is the thing that ye shall do: ye shall utterly destroy every male, and every woman that hath lain by man.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽיִּמְצְא֞וּ מִיּוֹשְׁבֵ֣י  יָבֵ֣ישׁ גִּלְעָ֗ד אַרְבַּ֤ע מֵאוֹת֙ נַעֲרָ֣ה בְתוּלָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֧ר לֹא־יָדְעָ֛ה אִ֖ישׁ לְמִשְׁכַּ֣ב זָכָ֑ר וַיָּבִ֨אוּ אוֹתָ֤ם אֶל־הַֽמַּחֲנֶה֙ שִׁלֹ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֖ר בְּאֶ֥רֶץ כְּנָֽעַן׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vymts'v myvshby  ybysh gl'd 'rb' m'vt n'rh btvlh 'shr l'yd'h 'ysh lmshkhb zkhr vyb'v 'vtm 'lhmchnh shlh 'shr b'rts khn'n {p}
verses.translation: And they found among the inhabitants of Jabesh-gilead four hundred young virgins, that had not known man by lying with him; and they brought them unto the camp to Shiloh, which is in the land of Canaan.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽיִּשְׁלְחוּ֙ כׇּל־הָ֣עֵדָ֔ה וַֽיְדַבְּרוּ֙ אֶל־בְּנֵ֣י בִנְיָמִ֔ן אֲשֶׁ֖ר בְּסֶ֣לַע רִמּ֑וֹן וַיִּקְרְא֥וּ לָהֶ֖ם שָׁלֽוֹם׃
verses.translit: vyshlchv khlh'dh vydbrv 'lbny bnymn 'shr bsl' rmvn vyqr'v lhm shlvm
verses.translation: And the whole congregation sent and spoke to the children of Benjamin that were in the rock of Rimmon, and proclaimed peace unto them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּ֤שׇׁב בִּנְיָמִן֙ בָּעֵ֣ת הַהִ֔יא וַיִּתְּנ֤וּ לָהֶם֙ הַנָּשִׁ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר חִיּ֔וּ מִנְּשֵׁ֖י יָבֵ֣שׁ גִּלְעָ֑ד וְלֹא־מָצְא֥וּ לָהֶ֖ם כֵּֽן׃
verses.translit: vyshb bnymn b't hhy' vytnv lhm hnshym 'shr chyv mnshy ybsh gl'd vl'mts'v lhm khn
verses.translation: And Benjamin returned at that time; and they gave them the women whom they had saved alive of the women of Jabesh-gilead; and yet so they sufficed them not.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָעָ֥ם נִחָ֖ם לְבִנְיָמִ֑ן כִּֽי־עָשָׂ֧ה יְהֹוָ֛ה פֶּ֖רֶץ בְּשִׁבְטֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: vh'm nchm lbnymn khy'shh yhvh prts bshbty yshr'l
verses.translation: And the people repented them for Benjamin, because that the LORD had made a breach in the tribes of Israel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּֽאמְרוּ֙ זִקְנֵ֣י הָֽעֵדָ֔ה מַה־נַּעֲשֶׂ֥ה לַנּוֹתָרִ֖ים לְנָשִׁ֑ים כִּֽי־נִשְׁמְדָ֥ה מִבִּנְיָמִ֖ן אִשָּֽׁה׃
verses.translit: vy'mrv zqny h'dh mhn'shh lnvtrym lnshym khynshmdh mbnymn 'shh
verses.translation: Then the elders of the congregation said: ‘How shall we do for wives for them that remain, seeing the women are destroyed out of Benjamin?’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמְר֔וּ יְרֻשַּׁ֥ת פְּלֵיטָ֖ה לְבִנְיָמִ֑ן וְלֹא־יִמָּחֶ֥ה שֵׁ֖בֶט מִיִּשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: vy'mrv yrsht plyth lbnymn vl'ymchh shbt myshr'l
verses.translation: And they said: ‘They that are escaped must be as an inheritance for Benjamin, that a tribe be not blotted out from Israel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַאֲנַ֗חְנוּ לֹ֥א נוּכַ֛ל לָתֵת־לָהֶ֥ם נָשִׁ֖ים מִבְּנוֹתֵ֑ינוּ כִּֽי־נִשְׁבְּע֤וּ בְנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר אָר֕וּר נֹתֵ֥ן אִשָּׁ֖ה לְבִנְיָמִֽן׃ {ס}
verses.translit: v'nchnv l' nvkhl lttlhm nshym mbnvtynv khynshb'v bnyyshr'l l'mr 'rvr ntn 'shh lbnymn {s}
verses.translation: Howbeit we may not give them wives of our daughters.’ For the children of Israel had sworn, saying: ‘Cursed be he that giveth a wife to Benjamin.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּאמְר֡וּ הִנֵּה֩ חַג־יְהֹוָ֨ה בְּשִׁל֜וֹ מִיָּמִ֣ים  יָמִ֗ימָה אֲשֶׁ֞ר מִצְּפ֤וֹנָה לְבֵֽית־אֵל֙ מִזְרְחָ֣ה הַשֶּׁ֔מֶשׁ לִ֨מְסִלָּ֔ה הָעֹלָ֥ה מִבֵּֽית־אֵ֖ל שְׁכֶ֑מָה וּמִנֶּ֖גֶב לִלְבוֹנָֽה׃
verses.translit: vy'mrv hnh chgyhvh bshlv mymym  ymymh 'shr mtspvnh lbyt'l mzrchh hshmsh lmslh h'lh mbyt'l shkhmh vmngb llbvnh
verses.translation: And they said: ‘Behold, there is the feast of the LORD from year to year in Shiloh, which is on the north of Beth-el, on the east side of the highway that goeth up from Beth-el to Shechem, and on the south of Lebonah.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: (ויצו) [וַיְצַוּ֕וּ] אֶת־בְּנֵ֥י בִנְיָמִ֖ן לֵאמֹ֑ר לְכ֖וּ וַאֲרַבְתֶּ֥ם בַּכְּרָמִֽים׃
verses.translit: (vytsv) [vytsvv] 'tbny bnymn l'mr lkhv v'rbtm bkhrmym
verses.translation: And they commanded the children of Benjamin, saying: ‘Go and lie in wait in the vineyards;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּרְאִיתֶ֗ם וְ֠הִנֵּ֠ה אִם־יֵ֨צְא֥וּ בְנוֹת־שִׁילוֹ֮ לָח֣וּל בַּמְּחֹלוֹת֒ וִֽיצָאתֶם֙ מִן־הַכְּרָמִ֔ים וַחֲטַפְתֶּ֥ם לָכֶ֛ם אִ֥ישׁ אִשְׁתּ֖וֹ מִבְּנ֣וֹת שִׁיל֑וֹ וַהֲלַכְתֶּ֖ם אֶ֥רֶץ בִּנְיָמִֽן׃
verses.translit: vr'ytm vhnh 'myts'v bnvtshylv lchvl bmchlvt vyts'tm mnhkhrmym vchtptm lkhm 'ysh 'shtv mbnvt shylv vhlkhtm 'rts bnymn
verses.translation: and see, and, behold, if the daughters of Shiloh come out to dance in the dances, then come ye out of the vineyards, and catch you every man his wife of the daughters of Shiloh, and go to the land of Benjamin.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָיָ֡ה כִּֽי־יָבֹ֣אוּ אֲבוֹתָם֩ א֨וֹ אֲחֵיהֶ֜ם (לרוב) [לָרִ֣יב ] אֵלֵ֗ינוּ וְאָמַ֤רְנוּ אֲלֵיהֶם֙ חׇנּ֣וּנוּ אוֹתָ֔ם כִּ֣י לֹ֥א לָקַ֛חְנוּ אִ֥ישׁ אִשְׁתּ֖וֹ בַּמִּלְחָמָ֑ה כִּ֣י לֹ֥א אַתֶּ֛ם נְתַתֶּ֥ם לָהֶ֖ם כָּעֵ֥ת תֶּאְשָֽׁמוּ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vhyh khyyb'v 'bvtm 'v 'chyhm (lrvb) [lryb ] 'lynv v'mrnv 'lyhm chnvnv 'vtm khy l' lqchnv 'ysh 'shtv bmlchmh khy l' 'tm nttm lhm kh't t'shmv {s}
verses.translation: And it shall be, when their fathers or their brethren come to strive with us, that we will say unto them: Grant them graciously unto us; because we took not for each man of them his wife in battle; neither did ye give them unto them, that ye should now be guilty.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּֽעֲשׂוּ־כֵן֙ בְּנֵ֣י בִנְיָמִ֔ן וַיִּשְׂא֤וּ נָשִׁים֙ לְמִסְפָּרָ֔ם מִן־הַמְּחֹלְל֖וֹת אֲשֶׁ֣ר גָּזָ֑לוּ וַיֵּלְכ֗וּ וַיָּשׁ֙וּבוּ֙ אֶל־נַ֣חֲלָתָ֔ם וַיִּבְנוּ֙ אֶת־הֶ֣עָרִ֔ים וַיֵּשְׁב֖וּ בָּהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vy'shvkhn bny bnymn vysh'v nshym lmsprm mnhmchllvt 'shr gzlv vylkhv vyshvbv 'lnchltm vybnv 'th'rym vyshbv bhm
verses.translation: And the children of Benjamin did so, and took them wives, according to their number, of them that danced, whom they carried off; and they went and returned unto their inheritance, and built the cities, and dwelt in them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּתְהַלְּכ֨וּ מִשָּׁ֤ם בְּנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ בָּעֵ֣ת הַהִ֔יא אִ֥ישׁ לְשִׁבְט֖וֹ וּלְמִשְׁפַּחְתּ֑וֹ וַיֵּצְא֣וּ מִשָּׁ֔ם אִ֖ישׁ לְנַחֲלָתֽוֹ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vythlkhv mshm bnyyshr'l b't hhy' 'ysh lshbtv vlmshpchtv vyts'v mshm 'ysh lnchltv {p}
verses.translation: And the children of Israel departed thence at that time, every man to his tribe and to his family, and they went out from thence every man to his inheritance.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בַּיָּמִ֣ים הָהֵ֔ם אֵ֥ין מֶ֖לֶךְ בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל אִ֛ישׁ הַיָּשָׁ֥ר בְּעֵינָ֖יו יַעֲשֶֽׂה׃
verses.translit: bymym hhm 'yn mlkh byshr'l 'ysh hyshr b'ynyv y'shh
verses.translation: In those days there was no king in Israel; every man did that which was right in his own eyes.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִי֩ אִ֨ישׁ אֶחָ֜ד מִן־הָרָמָתַ֛יִם צוֹפִ֖ים מֵהַ֣ר אֶפְרָ֑יִם וּשְׁמ֡וֹ אֶ֠לְקָנָ֠ה בֶּן־יְרֹחָ֧ם בֶּן־אֱלִיה֛וּא בֶּן־תֹּ֥חוּ בֶן־צ֖וּף אֶפְרָתִֽי׃
verses.translit: vyhy 'ysh 'chd mnhrmtym tsvpym mhr 'prym vshmv 'lqnh bnyrchm bn'lyhv' bntchv bntsvf 'prty
verses.translation: Now there was a certain man of Ramathaim-zophim, of the hill-country of Ephraim, and his name was Elkanah, the son of Jeroham, the son of Elihu, the son of Tohu, the son of Zuph, an Ephraimite.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלוֹ֙ שְׁתֵּ֣י נָשִׁ֔ים שֵׁ֤ם אַחַת֙ חַנָּ֔ה וְשֵׁ֥ם הַשֵּׁנִ֖ית פְּנִנָּ֑ה וַיְהִ֤י לִפְנִנָּה֙ יְלָדִ֔ים וּלְחַנָּ֖ה אֵ֥ין יְלָדִֽים׃
verses.translit: vlv shty nshym shm 'cht chnh vshm hshnyt pnnh vyhy lpnnh yldym vlchnh 'yn yldym
verses.translation: And he had two wives: the name of the one was Hannah, and the name of the other Peninnah; and Peninnah had children, but Hannah had no children.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעָלָה֩ הָאִ֨ישׁ הַה֤וּא מֵֽעִירוֹ֙ מִיָּמִ֣ים ׀ יָמִ֔ימָה לְהִֽשְׁתַּחֲוֺ֧ת וְלִזְבֹּ֛חַ לַיהֹוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת בְּשִׁלֹ֑ה וְשָׁ֞ם שְׁנֵ֣י בְנֵֽי־עֵלִ֗י חׇפְנִי֙ וּפִ֣נְחָ֔ס כֹּהֲנִ֖ים לַיהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: v'lh h'ysh hhv' m'yrv mymym  ymymh lhshtchvt vlzbch lyhvh tsb'vt bshlh vshm shny bny'ly chpny vpnchs khhnym lyhvh
verses.translation: And this man went up out of his city from year to year to worship and to sacrifice unto the LORD of hosts in Shiloh. And the two sons of Eli, Hophni and Phinehas, were there priests unto the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֣י הַיּ֔וֹם וַיִּזְבַּ֖ח אֶלְקָנָ֑ה וְנָתַ֞ן לִפְנִנָּ֣ה אִשְׁתּ֗וֹ וּֽלְכׇל־בָּנֶ֛יהָ וּבְנוֹתֶ֖יהָ מָנֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: vyhy hyvm vyzbch 'lqnh vntn lpnnh 'shtv vlkhlbnyh vbnvtyh mnvt
verses.translation: And it came to pass upon a day, when Elkanah sacrificed, that he gave to Peninnah his wife, and to all her sons and her daughters, portions;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּלְחַנָּ֕ה יִתֵּ֛ן מָנָ֥ה אַחַ֖ת אַפָּ֑יִם כִּ֤י אֶת־חַנָּה֙ אָהֵ֔ב וַיהֹוָ֖ה סָגַ֥ר רַחְמָֽהּ׃
verses.translit: vlchnh ytn mnh 'cht 'pym khy 'tchnh 'hb vyhvh sgr rchmh
verses.translation: but unto Hannah he gave a double portion; for he loved Hannah, but the LORD had shut up her womb.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְכִעֲסַ֤תָּה צָרָתָהּ֙ גַּם־כַּ֔עַס בַּעֲב֖וּר הַרְּעִמָ֑הּ כִּֽי־סָגַ֥ר יְהֹוָ֖ה בְּעַ֥ד רַחְמָֽהּ׃
verses.translit: vkh'sth tsrth gmkh's b'bvr hr'mh khysgr yhvh b'd rchmh
verses.translation: And her rival vexed her sore, to make her fret, because the LORD had shut up her womb.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְכֵ֨ן יַעֲשֶׂ֜ה שָׁנָ֣ה בְשָׁנָ֗ה מִדֵּ֤י עֲלֹתָהּ֙ בְּבֵ֣ית יְהֹוָ֔ה כֵּ֖ן תַּכְעִסֶ֑נָּה וַתִּבְכֶּ֖ה וְלֹ֥א תֹאכַֽל׃
verses.translit: vkhn y'shh shnh bshnh mdy 'lth bbyt yhvh khn tkh'snh vtbkhh vl' t'khl
verses.translation: And as he did so year by year, when she went up to the house of the LORD, so she vexed her; therefore she wept, and would not eat.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר לָ֜הּ אֶלְקָנָ֣ה אִישָׁ֗הּ חַנָּה֙ לָ֣מֶה תִבְכִּ֗י וְלָ֙מֶה֙ לֹ֣א תֹֽאכְלִ֔י וְלָ֖מֶה יֵרַ֣ע לְבָבֵ֑ךְ הֲל֤וֹא אָֽנֹכִי֙ ט֣וֹב לָ֔ךְ מֵעֲשָׂרָ֖ה בָּנִֽים׃
verses.translit: vy'mr lh 'lqnh 'yshh chnh lmh tbkhy vlmh l' t'khly vlmh yr' lbbkh hlv' 'nkhy tvb lkh m'shrh bnym
verses.translation: And Elkanah her husband said unto her: ‘Hannah, why weepest thou? and why eatest thou not? and why is thy heart grieved? am not I better to thee than ten sons?’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתָּ֣קׇם חַנָּ֔ה אַחֲרֵ֛י אׇכְלָ֥הֿ בְשִׁלֹ֖ה וְאַחֲרֵ֣י שָׁתֹ֑ה וְעֵלִ֣י הַכֹּהֵ֗ן יֹשֵׁב֙ עַל־הַכִּסֵּ֔א עַל־מְזוּזַ֖ת הֵיכַ֥ל יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: vtqm chnh 'chry 'khlh bshlh v'chry shth v'ly hkhhn yshb 'lhkhs' 'lmzvzt hykhl yhvh
verses.translation: So Hannah rose up after they had eaten in Shiloh, and after they had drunk—now Eli the priest sat upon his seat by the door-post of the temple of the LORD;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהִ֖יא מָ֣רַת נָ֑פֶשׁ וַתִּתְפַּלֵּ֥ל עַל־יְהֹוָ֖ה וּבָכֹ֥ה תִבְכֶּֽה׃
verses.translit: vhy' mrt npsh vttpll 'lyhvh vbkhh tbkhh
verses.translation: and she was in bitterness of soul—and prayed unto the LORD, and wept sore.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתִּדֹּ֨ר נֶ֜דֶר וַתֹּאמַ֗ר יְהֹוָ֨ה צְבָא֜וֹת אִם־רָאֹ֥ה תִרְאֶ֣ה  בׇּעֳנִ֣י אֲמָתֶ֗ךָ וּזְכַרְתַּ֙נִי֙ וְלֹא־תִשְׁכַּ֣ח אֶת־אֲמָתֶ֔ךָ וְנָתַתָּ֥ה לַאֲמָתְךָ֖ זֶ֣רַע אֲנָשִׁ֑ים וּנְתַתִּ֤יו לַֽיהֹוָה֙ כׇּל־יְמֵ֣י חַיָּ֔יו וּמוֹרָ֖ה לֹא־יַעֲלֶ֥ה עַל־רֹאשֽׁוֹ׃
verses.translit: vtdr ndr vt'mr yhvh tsb'vt 'mr'h tr'h  b'ny 'mtkh vzkhrtny vl'tshkhch 't'mtkh vntth l'mtkh zr' 'nshym vnttyv lyhvh khlymy chyyv vmvrh l'y'lh 'lr'shv
verses.translation: And she vowed a vow, and said: ‘O LORD of hosts, if Thou wilt indeed look on the affliction of Thy handmaid, and remember me, and not forget Thy handmaid, but wilt give unto Thy handmaid a man-child, then I will give him unto the LORD all the days of his life, and there shall no razor come upon his head.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָיָה֙ כִּ֣י הִרְבְּתָ֔ה לְהִתְפַּלֵּ֖ל לִפְנֵ֣י יְהֹוָ֑ה וְעֵלִ֖י שֹׁמֵ֥ר אֶת־פִּֽיהָ׃
verses.translit: vhyh khy hrbth lhtpll lpny yhvh v'ly shmr 'tpyh
verses.translation: And it came to pass, as she prayed long before the LORD, that Eli watched her mouth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְחַנָּ֗ה הִ֚יא מְדַבֶּ֣רֶת עַל־לִבָּ֔הּ רַ֚ק שְׂפָתֶ֣יהָ נָּע֔וֹת וְקוֹלָ֖הּ לֹ֣א יִשָּׁמֵ֑עַ וַיַּחְשְׁבֶ֥הָ עֵלִ֖י לְשִׁכֹּרָֽה׃
verses.translit: vchnh hy' mdbrt 'llbh rq shptyh n'vt vqvlh l' yshm' vychshbh 'ly lshkhrh
verses.translation: Now Hannah, she spoke in her heart; only her lips moved, but her voice could not be heard; therefore, Eli thought she had been drunken.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֵלֶ֙יהָ֙ עֵלִ֔י עַד־מָתַ֖י תִּשְׁתַּכָּרִ֑ין הָסִ֥ירִי אֶת־יֵינֵ֖ךְ מֵעָלָֽיִךְ׃
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lyh 'ly 'dmty tshtkhryn hsyry 'tyynkh m'lykh
verses.translation: And Eli said unto her: ‘How long wilt thou be drunken? put away thy wine from thee.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתַּ֨עַן חַנָּ֤ה וַתֹּ֙אמֶר֙ לֹ֣א אֲדֹנִ֔י אִשָּׁ֤ה קְשַׁת־ר֙וּחַ֙ אָנֹ֔כִי וְיַ֥יִן וְשֵׁכָ֖ר לֹ֣א שָׁתִ֑יתִי וָאֶשְׁפֹּ֥ךְ אֶת־נַפְשִׁ֖י לִפְנֵ֥י יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: vt'n chnh vt'mr l' 'dny 'shh qshtrvch 'nkhy vyyn vshkhr l' shtyty v'shpkh 'tnpshy lpny yhvh
verses.translation: And Hannah answered and said: ‘No, my lord, I am a woman of a sorrowful spirit; I have drunk neither wine nor strong drink, but I poured out my soul before the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַל־תִּתֵּן֙ אֶת־אֲמָ֣תְךָ֔ לִפְנֵ֖י בַּת־בְּלִיָּ֑עַל כִּֽי־מֵרֹ֥ב שִׂיחִ֛י וְכַעְסִ֖י דִּבַּ֥רְתִּי עַד־הֵֽנָּה׃
verses.translit: 'lttn 't'mtkh lpny btbly'l khymrb shychy vkh'sy dbrty 'dhnh
verses.translation: Count not thy handmaid for a wicked woman: for out of the abundance of my complaint and my vexation have I spoken hitherto.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֧עַן עֵלִ֛י וַיֹּ֖אמֶר לְכִ֣י לְשָׁל֑וֹם וֵאלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל יִתֵּן֙ אֶת־שֵׁ֣לָתֵ֔ךְ אֲשֶׁ֥ר שָׁאַ֖לְתְּ מֵעִמּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vy'n 'ly vy'mr lkhy lshlvm v'lhy yshr'l ytn 'tshltkh 'shr sh'lt m'mv
verses.translation: Then Eli answered and said: ‘Go in peace, and the God of Israel grant thy petition that thou hast asked of Him.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתֹּ֕אמֶר תִּמְצָ֧א שִׁפְחָתְךָ֛ חֵ֖ן בְּעֵינֶ֑יךָ וַתֵּ֨לֶךְ הָאִשָּׁ֤ה לְדַרְכָּהּ֙ וַתֹּאכַ֔ל וּפָנֶ֥יהָ לֹא־הָֽיוּ־לָ֖הּ עֽוֹד׃
verses.translit: vt'mr tmts' shpchtkh chn b'ynykh vtlkh h'shh ldrkhh vt'khl vpnyh l'hyvlh 'vd
verses.translation: And she said: ‘Let thy servant find favour in thy sight.’ So the woman went her way, and did eat, and her countenance was no more sad.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּשְׁכִּ֣מוּ בַבֹּ֗קֶר וַיִּֽשְׁתַּחֲווּ֙ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהֹוָ֔ה וַיָּשֻׁ֛בוּ וַיָּבֹ֥אוּ אֶל־בֵּיתָ֖ם הָרָמָ֑תָה וַיֵּ֤דַע אֶלְקָנָה֙ אֶת־חַנָּ֣ה אִשְׁתּ֔וֹ וַֽיִּזְכְּרֶ֖הָ יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: vyshkhmv bbqr vyshtchvv lpny yhvh vyshbv vyb'v 'lbytm hrmth vyd' 'lqnh 'tchnh 'shtv vyzkhrh yhvh
verses.translation: And they rose up in the morning early, and worshipped before the LORD, and returned, and came to their house to Ramah; and Elkanah knew Hannah his wife; and the LORD remembered her.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽיְהִי֙ לִתְקֻפ֣וֹת הַיָּמִ֔ים וַתַּ֥הַר חַנָּ֖ה וַתֵּ֣לֶד בֵּ֑ן וַתִּקְרָ֤א אֶת־שְׁמוֹ֙ שְׁמוּאֵ֔ל כִּ֥י מֵיְהֹוָ֖ה שְׁאִלְתִּֽיו׃
verses.translit: vyhy ltqpvt hymym vthr chnh vtld bn vtqr' 'tshmv shmv'l khy myhvh sh'ltyv
verses.translation: And it came to pass, when the time was come about, that Hannah conceived, and bore a son; and she called his name Samuel: ‘because I have asked him of the LORD.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֛עַל הָאִ֥ישׁ אֶלְקָנָ֖ה וְכׇל־בֵּית֑וֹ לִזְבֹּ֧חַ לַיהֹוָ֛ה אֶת־זֶ֥בַח הַיָּמִ֖ים וְאֶת־נִדְרֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vy'l h'ysh 'lqnh vkhlbytv lzbch lyhvh 'tzbch hymym v'tndrv
verses.translation: And the man Elkanah, and all his house, went up to offer unto the LORD the yearly sacrifice, and his vow.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְחַנָּ֖ה לֹ֣א עָלָ֑תָה כִּֽי־אָמְרָ֣ה לְאִישָׁ֗הּ עַ֣ד יִגָּמֵ֤ל הַנַּ֙עַר֙ וַהֲבִאֹתִ֗יו וְנִרְאָה֙ אֶת־פְּנֵ֣י יְהֹוָ֔ה וְיָ֥שַׁב שָׁ֖ם עַד־עוֹלָֽם׃
verses.translit: vchnh l' 'lth khy'mrh l'yshh 'd ygml hn'r vhb'tyv vnr'h 'tpny yhvh vyshb shm 'd'vlm
verses.translation: But Hannah went not up; for she said unto her husband: ‘Until the child be weaned, when I will bring him, that he may appear before the LORD, and there abide for ever.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר לָהּ֩ אֶלְקָנָ֨ה אִישָׁ֜הּ עֲשִׂ֧י הַטּ֣וֹב בְּעֵינַ֗יִךְ שְׁבִי֙ עַד־גׇּמְלֵ֣ךְ אֹת֔וֹ אַ֛ךְ יָקֵ֥ם יְהֹוָ֖ה אֶת־דְּבָר֑וֹ וַתֵּ֤שֶׁב הָֽאִשָּׁה֙ וַתֵּ֣ינֶק אֶת־בְּנָ֔הּ עַד־גׇּמְלָ֖הּ אֹתֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vy'mr lh 'lqnh 'yshh 'shy htvb b'ynykh shby 'dgmlkh 'tv 'kh yqm yhvh 'tdbrv vtshb h'shh vtynq 'tbnh 'dgmlh 'tv
verses.translation: And Elkanah her husband said unto her: ‘Do what seemeth thee good; tarry until thou have weaned him; only the LORD establish His word.’ So the woman tarried and gave her son suck, until she weaned him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתַּעֲלֵ֨הוּ עִמָּ֜הּ כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר גְּמָלַ֗תּוּ בְּפָרִ֤ים שְׁלֹשָׁה֙ וְאֵיפָ֨ה אַחַ֥ת קֶ֙מַח֙ וְנֵ֣בֶל יַ֔יִן וַתְּבִאֵ֥הוּ בֵית־יְהֹוָ֖ה שִׁל֑וֹ וְהַנַּ֖עַר נָֽעַר׃
verses.translit: vt'lhv 'mh kh'shr gmltv bprym shlshh v'yph 'cht qmch vnbl yyn vtb'hv bytyhvh shlv vhn'r n'r
verses.translation: And when she had weaned him, she took him up with her, with three bullocks, and one ephah of meal, and a bottle of wine, and brought him unto the house of the LORD in Shiloh; and the child was young.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽיִּשְׁחֲט֖וּ אֶת־הַפָּ֑ר וַיָּבִ֥אוּ אֶת־הַנַּ֖עַר אֶל־עֵלִֽי׃
verses.translit: vyshchtv 'thpr vyb'v 'thn'r 'l'ly
verses.translation: And when the bullock was slain, the child was brought to Eli.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתֹּ֙אמֶר֙ בִּ֣י אֲדֹנִ֔י חֵ֥י נַפְשְׁךָ֖ אֲדֹנִ֑י אֲנִ֣י הָאִשָּׁ֗ה הַנִּצֶּ֤בֶת עִמְּכָה֙ בָּזֶ֔ה לְהִתְפַּלֵּ֖ל אֶל־יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: vt'mr by 'dny chy npshkh 'dny 'ny h'shh hntsbt 'mkhh bzh lhtpll 'lyhvh
verses.translation: And she said: ‘Oh, my lord, as thy soul liveth, my lord, I am the woman that stood by thee here, praying unto the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֶל־הַנַּ֥עַר הַזֶּ֖ה הִתְפַּלָּ֑לְתִּי וַיִּתֵּ֨ן יְהֹוָ֥ה לִי֙ אֶת־שְׁאֵ֣לָתִ֔י אֲשֶׁ֥ר שָׁאַ֖לְתִּי מֵעִמּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: 'lhn'r hzh htpllty vytn yhvh ly 'tsh'lty 'shr sh'lty m'mv
verses.translation: For this child I prayed; and the LORD hath granted me my petition which I asked of Him;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְגַ֣ם אָנֹכִ֗י הִשְׁאִלְתִּ֙הוּ֙ לַֽיהֹוָ֔ה כׇּל־הַיָּמִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הָיָ֔ה ה֥וּא שָׁא֖וּל לַיהֹוָ֑ה וַיִּשְׁתַּ֥חוּ שָׁ֖ם לַֽיהֹוָֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vgm 'nkhy hsh'lthv lyhvh khlhymym 'shr hyh hv' sh'vl lyhvh vyshtchv shm lyhvh {s}
verses.translation: therefore I also have lent him to the LORD; as long as he liveth he is lent to the LORD.’ And he worshipped the LORD there.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתִּתְפַּלֵּ֤ל חַנָּה֙ וַתֹּאמַ֔ר עָלַ֤ץ לִבִּי֙ בַּֽיהֹוָ֔ה רָ֥מָה קַרְנִ֖י בַּֽיהֹוָ֑ה רָ֤חַב פִּי֙ עַל־א֣וֹיְבַ֔י כִּ֥י שָׂמַ֖חְתִּי בִּישׁוּעָתֶֽךָ׃
verses.translit: vttpll chnh vt'mr 'lts lby byhvh rmh qrny byhvh rchb py 'l'vyby khy shmchty byshv'tkh
verses.translation: And Hannah prayed, and said: My heart exulteth in the LORD, My horn is exalted in the LORD; My mouth is enlarged over mine enemies; Because I rejoice in Thy salvation.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֵין־קָד֥וֹשׁ כַּיהֹוָ֖ה כִּ֣י אֵ֣ין בִּלְתֶּ֑ךָ וְאֵ֥ין צ֖וּר כֵּאלֹהֵֽינוּ׃
verses.translit: 'ynqdvsh khyhvh khy 'yn bltkh v'yn tsvr kh'lhynv
verses.translation: There is none holy as the LORD, For there is none beside Thee; Neither is there any rock like our God.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַל־תַּרְבּ֤וּ תְדַבְּרוּ֙ גְּבֹהָ֣ה גְבֹהָ֔ה יֵצֵ֥א עָתָ֖ק מִפִּיכֶ֑ם כִּ֣י אֵ֤ל דֵּעוֹת֙ יְהֹוָ֔ה (ולא) [וְל֥וֹ] נִתְכְּנ֖וּ עֲלִלֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: 'ltrbv tdbrv gbhh gbhh yts' 'tq mpykhm khy 'l d'vt yhvh (vl') [vlv] ntkhnv 'llvt
verses.translation: Multiply not exceeding proud talk; Let not arrogancy come out of your mouth; For the LORD is a God of knowledge, And by Him actions are weighed.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: קֶ֥שֶׁת גִּבֹּרִ֖ים חַתִּ֑ים וְנִכְשָׁלִ֖ים אָ֥זְרוּ חָֽיִל׃
verses.translit: qsht gbrym chtym vnkhshlym 'zrv chyl
verses.translation: The bows of the mighty men are broken, And they that stumbled are girded with strength.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שְׂבֵעִ֤ים בַּלֶּ֙חֶם֙ נִשְׂכָּ֔רוּ וּרְעֵבִ֖ים חָדֵ֑לּוּ עַד־עֲקָרָה֙ יָלְדָ֣ה שִׁבְעָ֔ה וְרַבַּ֥ת בָּנִ֖ים אֻמְלָֽלָה׃
verses.translit: shb'ym blchm nshkhrv vr'bym chdlv 'd'qrh yldh shb'h vrbt bnym 'mllh
verses.translation: They that were full have hired out themselves for bread; And they that were hungry have ceased; While the barren hath borne seven, She that had many children hath languished.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְהֹוָ֖ה מֵמִ֣ית וּמְחַיֶּ֑ה מוֹרִ֥יד שְׁא֖וֹל וַיָּֽעַל׃
verses.translit: yhvh mmyt vmchyh mvryd sh'vl vy'l
verses.translation: The LORD killeth, and maketh alive; He bringeth down to the grave, and bringeth up.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְהֹוָ֖ה מוֹרִ֣ישׁ וּמַעֲשִׁ֑יר מַשְׁפִּ֖יל אַף־מְרוֹמֵֽם׃
verses.translit: yhvh mvrysh vm'shyr mshpyl 'fmrvmm
verses.translation: The LORD maketh poor, and maketh rich; He bringeth low, He also lifteth up. .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מֵקִ֨ים מֵעָפָ֜ר דָּ֗ל מֵֽאַשְׁפֹּת֙ יָרִ֣ים אֶבְי֔וֹן לְהוֹשִׁיב֙ עִם־נְדִיבִ֔ים וְכִסֵּ֥א כָב֖וֹד יַנְחִלֵ֑ם כִּ֤י לַֽיהֹוָה֙ מְצֻ֣קֵי אֶ֔רֶץ וַיָּ֥שֶׁת עֲלֵיהֶ֖ם תֵּבֵֽל׃
verses.translit: mqym m'pr dl m'shpt yrym 'byvn lhvshyb 'mndybym vkhs' khbvd ynchlm khy lyhvh mtsqy 'rts vysht 'lyhm tbl
verses.translation: He raiseth up the poor out of the dust, He lifteth up the needy from the dung-hill, To make them sit with princes, And inherit the throne of glory; For the pillars of the earth are the LORD’S, And He hath set the world upon them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: רַגְלֵ֤י חֲסִידָו֙ יִשְׁמֹ֔ר וּרְשָׁעִ֖ים בַּחֹ֣שֶׁךְ יִדָּ֑מּוּ כִּי־לֹ֥א בְכֹ֖חַ יִגְבַּר־אִֽישׁ׃
verses.translit: rgly chsydv yshmr vrsh'ym bchshkh ydmv khyl' bkhch ygbr'ysh
verses.translation: He will keep the feet of His holy ones, But the wicked shall be put to silence in darkness; For not by strength shall man prevail.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְהֹוָ֞ה יֵחַ֣תּוּ מְרִיבָ֗ו עָלָו֙ בַּשָּׁמַ֣יִם יַרְעֵ֔ם יְהֹוָ֖ה יָדִ֣ין אַפְסֵי־אָ֑רֶץ וְיִתֶּן־עֹ֣ז לְמַלְכּ֔וֹ וְיָרֵ֖ם קֶ֥רֶן מְשִׁיחֽוֹ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: yhvh ychtv mrybv 'lv bshmym yr'm yhvh ydyn 'psy'rts vytn'z lmlkhv vyrm qrn mshychv {p}
verses.translation: They that strive with the LORD shall be broken to pieces; Against them will He thunder in heaven; The LORD will judge the ends of the earth; And He will give strength unto His king, And exalt the horn of His anointed.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֵּ֧לֶךְ אֶלְקָנָ֛ה הָרָמָ֖תָה עַל־בֵּית֑וֹ וְהַנַּ֗עַר הָיָ֤ה מְשָׁרֵת֙ אֶת־יְהֹוָ֔ה אֶת־פְּנֵ֖י עֵלִ֥י הַכֹּהֵֽן׃
verses.translit: vylkh 'lqnh hrmth 'lbytv vhn'r hyh mshrt 'tyhvh 'tpny 'ly hkhhn
verses.translation: And Elkanah went to Ramah to his house. And the child did minister unto the LORD before Eli the priest.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבְנֵ֥י עֵלִ֖י בְּנֵ֣י בְלִיָּ֑עַל לֹ֥א יָדְע֖וּ אֶת־יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: vbny 'ly bny bly'l l' yd'v 'tyhvh
verses.translation: Now the sons of Eli were base men; they knew not the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמִשְׁפַּ֥ט הַכֹּהֲנִ֖ים אֶת־הָעָ֑ם כׇּל־אִ֞ישׁ זֹבֵ֣חַ זֶ֗בַח וּבָ֨א נַ֤עַר הַכֹּהֵן֙ כְּבַשֵּׁ֣ל הַבָּשָׂ֔ר וְהַמַּזְלֵ֛ג שְׁלֹ֥שׁ הַשִּׁנַּ֖יִם בְּיָדֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vmshpt hkhhnym 'th'm khl'ysh zbch zbch vb' n'r hkhhn khbshl hbshr vhmzlg shlsh hshnym bydv
verses.translation: And the custom of the priests with the people was, that, when any man offered sacrifice, the priest’s servant came, while the flesh was in seething, with a flesh-hook of three teeth in his band;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהִכָּ֨ה בַכִּיּ֜וֹר א֣וֹ בַדּ֗וּד א֤וֹ בַקַּלַּ֙חַת֙ א֣וֹ בַפָּר֔וּר כֹּ֚ל אֲשֶׁ֣ר יַעֲלֶ֣ה הַמַּזְלֵ֔ג יִקַּ֥ח הַכֹּהֵ֖ן בּ֑וֹ כָּ֚כָה יַעֲשׂ֣וּ לְכׇל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל הַבָּאִ֥ים שָׁ֖ם בְּשִׁלֹֽה׃
verses.translit: vhkhh bkhyvr 'v bdvd 'v bqlcht 'v bprvr khl 'shr y'lh hmzlg yqch hkhhn bv khkhh y'shv lkhlyshr'l hb'ym shm bshlh
verses.translation: and he struck it into the pan, or kettle, or caldron, or pot; all that the flesh-hook brought up the priest took therewith. So they did unto all the Israelites that came thither in Shiloh.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: גַּם֮ בְּטֶ֘רֶם֮ יַקְטִר֣וּן אֶת־הַחֵ֒לֶב֒ וּבָ֣א  נַ֣עַר הַכֹּהֵ֗ן וְאָמַר֙ לָאִ֣ישׁ הַזֹּבֵ֔חַ תְּנָ֣ה בָשָׂ֔ר לִצְל֖וֹת לַכֹּהֵ֑ן וְלֹא־יִקַּ֧ח מִמְּךָ֛ בָּשָׂ֥ר מְבֻשָּׁ֖ל כִּ֥י אִם־חָֽי׃
verses.translit: gm btrm yqtrvn 'thchlb vb'  n'r hkhhn v'mr l'ysh hzbch tnh bshr ltslvt lkhhn vl'yqch mmkh bshr mbshl khy 'mchy
verses.translation: Yea, before the fat was made to smoke, the priest’s servant came, and said to the man that sacrificed: ‘Give flesh to roast for the priest; for he will not have sodden flesh of thee, but raw.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר אֵלָ֜יו הָאִ֗ישׁ קַטֵּ֨ר יַקְטִיר֤וּן כַּיּוֹם֙ הַחֵ֔לֶב וְקַ֨ח־לְךָ֔ כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר תְּאַוֶּ֖ה נַפְשֶׁ֑ךָ וְאָמַ֥ר ׀ [לֹא֙] (לו) כִּ֚י עַתָּ֣ה תִתֵּ֔ן וְאִם־לֹ֖א לָקַ֥חְתִּי בְחׇזְקָֽה׃
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lyv h'ysh qtr yqtyrvn khyvm hchlb vqchlkh kh'shr t'vh npshkh v'mr  [l'] (lv) khy 'th ttn v'ml' lqchty bchzqh
verses.translation: And if the man said unto him: ‘Let the fat be made to smoke first of all, and then take as much as thy soul desireth’; then he would say: ‘Nay, but thou shalt give it me now; and if not, I will take it by force.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתְּהִ֨י חַטַּ֧את הַנְּעָרִ֛ים גְּדוֹלָ֥ה מְאֹ֖ד אֶת־פְּנֵ֣י יְהֹוָ֑ה כִּ֤י נִֽאֲצוּ֙ הָאֲנָשִׁ֔ים אֵ֖ת מִנְחַ֥ת יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: vthy cht't hn'rym gdvlh m'd 'tpny yhvh khy n'tsv h'nshym 't mncht yhvh
verses.translation: And the sin of the young men was very great before the LORD; for the men dealt contemptuously with the offering of the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּשְׁמוּאֵ֕ל מְשָׁרֵ֖ת אֶת־פְּנֵ֣י יְהֹוָ֑ה נַ֕עַר חָג֖וּר אֵפ֥וֹד בָּֽד׃
verses.translit: vshmv'l mshrt 'tpny yhvh n'r chgvr 'pvd bd
verses.translation: But Samuel ministered before the LORD, being a child, girded with a linen ephod.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמְעִ֤יל קָטֹן֙ תַּעֲשֶׂה־לּ֣וֹ אִמּ֔וֹ וְהַעַלְתָ֥ה ל֖וֹ מִיָּמִ֣ים ׀ יָמִ֑ימָה בַּֽעֲלוֹתָהּ֙ אֶת־אִישָׁ֔הּ לִזְבֹּ֖חַ אֶת־זֶ֥בַח הַיָּמִֽים׃
verses.translit: vm'yl qtn t'shhlv 'mv vh'lth lv mymym  ymymh b'lvth 't'yshh lzbch 'tzbch hymym
verses.translation: Moreover his mother made him a little robe, and brought it to him from year to year, when she came up with her husband to offer the yearly sacrifice.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבֵרַ֨ךְ עֵלִ֜י אֶת־אֶלְקָנָ֣ה וְאֶת־אִשְׁתּ֗וֹ וְאָמַר֙ יָשֵׂם֩ יְהֹוָ֨ה לְךָ֥ זֶ֙רַע֙ מִן־הָאִשָּׁ֣ה הַזֹּ֔את תַּ֚חַת הַשְּׁאֵלָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר שָׁאַ֖ל לַֽיהֹוָ֑ה וְהָלְכ֖וּ לִמְקוֹמֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vbrkh 'ly 't'lqnh v't'shtv v'mr yshm yhvh lkh zr' mnh'shh hz't tcht hsh'lh 'shr sh'l lyhvh vhlkhv lmqvmv
verses.translation: And Eli would bless Elkanah and his wife, and say: ‘The LORD give thee seed of this woman for the loan which was lent to the LORD.’ And they would go unto their own home.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־פָקַ֤ד יְהֹוָה֙ אֶת־חַנָּ֔ה וַתַּ֛הַר וַתֵּ֥לֶד שְׁלֹשָֽׁה־בָנִ֖ים וּשְׁתֵּ֣י בָנ֑וֹת וַיִּגְדַּ֛ל הַנַּ֥עַר שְׁמוּאֵ֖ל עִם־יְהֹוָֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: khypqd yhvh 'tchnh vthr vtld shlshhbnym vshty bnvt vygdl hn'r shmv'l 'myhvh {s}
verses.translation: So the LORD remembered Hannah, and she conceived, and bore three sons and two daughters. And the child Samuel grew before the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעֵלִ֖י זָקֵ֣ן מְאֹ֑ד וְשָׁמַ֗ע אֵת֩ כׇּל־אֲשֶׁ֨ר יַעֲשׂ֤וּן בָּנָיו֙ לְכׇל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְאֵ֤ת אֲשֶֽׁר־יִשְׁכְּבוּן֙ אֶת־הַנָּשִׁ֔ים הַצֹּ֣בְא֔וֹת פֶּ֖תַח אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד׃
verses.translit: v'ly zqn m'd vshm' 't khl'shr y'shvn bnyv lkhlyshr'l v't 'shryshkhbvn 'thnshym htsb'vt ptch 'hl mv'd
verses.translation: Now Eli was very old; and he heard all that his sons did unto all Israel, and how that they lay with the women that did service at the door of the tent of meeting.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר לָהֶ֔ם לָ֥מָּה תַעֲשׂ֖וּן כַּדְּבָרִ֣ים הָאֵ֑לֶּה אֲשֶׁ֨ר אָנֹכִ֤י שֹׁמֵ֙עַ֙ אֶת־דִּבְרֵיכֶ֣ם רָעִ֔ים מֵאֵ֖ת כׇּל־הָעָ֥ם אֵֽלֶּה׃
verses.translit: vy'mr lhm lmh t'shvn khdbrym h'lh 'shr 'nkhy shm' 'tdbrykhm r'ym m't khlh'm 'lh
verses.translation: And he said unto them: ‘Why do ye such things? for I hear evil reports concerning you from all this people.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַ֖ל בָּנָ֑י כִּ֠י לֽוֹא־טוֹבָ֤ה הַשְּׁמֻעָה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אָנֹכִ֣י שֹׁמֵ֔עַ מַעֲבִרִ֖ים עַם־יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: 'l bny khy lv'tvbh hshm'h 'shr 'nkhy shm' m'brym 'myhvh
verses.translation: Nay, my sons; for it is no good report which I hear the LORD’S people do spread abroad.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִם־יֶחֱטָ֨א אִ֤ישׁ לְאִישׁ֙ וּפִֽלְל֣וֹ אֱלֹהִ֔ים וְאִ֤ם לַֽיהֹוָה֙ יֶחֱטָא־אִ֔ישׁ מִ֖י יִתְפַּלֶּל־ל֑וֹ וְלֹ֤א יִשְׁמְעוּ֙ לְק֣וֹל אֲבִיהֶ֔ם כִּֽי־חָפֵ֥ץ יְהֹוָ֖ה לַהֲמִיתָֽם׃
verses.translit: 'mycht' 'ysh l'ysh vpllv 'lhym v'm lyhvh ycht''ysh my ytplllv vl' yshm'v lqvl 'byhm khychpts yhvh lhmytm
verses.translation: If one man sin against another, God shall judge him; but if a man sin against the LORD, who shall entreat for him?’ But they hearkened not unto the voice of their father, because the LORD would slay them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהַנַּ֣עַר שְׁמוּאֵ֔ל הֹלֵ֥ךְ וְגָדֵ֖ל וָט֑וֹב גַּ֚ם עִם־יְהֹוָ֔ה וְגַ֖ם עִם־אֲנָשִֽׁים׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vhn'r shmv'l hlkh vgdl vtvb gm 'myhvh vgm 'm'nshym {p}
verses.translation: And the child Samuel grew on, and increased in favour both with the LORD, and also with men.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּבֹ֥א אִישׁ־אֱלֹהִ֖ים אֶל־עֵלִ֑י וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלָ֗יו כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהֹוָ֔ה הֲנִגְלֹ֤ה נִגְלֵ֙יתִי֙ אֶל־בֵּ֣ית אָבִ֔יךָ בִּֽהְיוֹתָ֥ם בְּמִצְרַ֖יִם לְבֵ֥ית פַּרְעֹֽה׃
verses.translit: vyb' 'ysh'lhym 'l'ly vy'mr 'lyv khh 'mr yhvh hnglh nglyty 'lbyt 'bykh bhyvtm bmtsrym lbyt pr'h
verses.translation: And there came a man of God unto Eli, and said unto him: ‘Thus saith the LORD: Did I reveal Myself unto the house of thy father, when they were in Egypt in bondage to Pharaoh’s house?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבָחֹ֣ר אֹ֠ת֠וֹ מִכׇּל־שִׁבְטֵ֨י יִשְׂרָאֵ֥ל לִי֙ לְכֹהֵ֔ן לַעֲל֣וֹת עַֽל־מִזְבְּחִ֗י לְהַקְטִ֥יר קְטֹ֛רֶת לָשֵׂ֥את אֵפ֖וֹד לְפָנָ֑י וָֽאֶתְּנָה֙ לְבֵ֣ית אָבִ֔יךָ אֶת־כׇּל־אִשֵּׁ֖י בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: vbchr 'tv mkhlshbty yshr'l ly lkhhn l'lvt 'lmzbchy lhqtyr qtrt lsh't 'pvd lpny v'tnh lbyt 'bykh 'tkhl'shy bny yshr'l
verses.translation: And did I choose him out of all the tribes of Israel to be My priest, to go up unto Mine altar, to burn incense, to wear an ephod before Me? and did I give unto the house of thy father all the offerings of the children of Israel made by fire?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לָ֣מָּה תִבְעֲט֗וּ בְּזִבְחִי֙ וּבְמִנְחָתִ֔י אֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוִּ֖יתִי מָע֑וֹן וַתְּכַבֵּ֤ד אֶת־בָּנֶ֙יךָ֙ מִמֶּ֔נִּי לְהַבְרִיאֲכֶ֗ם מֵרֵאשִׁ֛ית כׇּל־מִנְחַ֥ת יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לְעַמִּֽי׃
verses.translit: lmh tb'tv bzbchy vbmnchty 'shr tsvyty m'vn vtkhbd 'tbnykh mmny lhbry'khm mr'shyt khlmncht yshr'l l'my
verses.translation: Wherefore kick ye at My sacrifice and at Mine offering, which I have commanded in My habitation; and honourest thy sons above Me, to make yourselves fat with the chiefest of all the offerings of Israel My people?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לָכֵ֗ן נְאֻם־יְהֹוָה֮ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵל֒ אָמ֣וֹר אָמַ֔רְתִּי בֵּֽיתְךָ֙ וּבֵ֣ית אָבִ֔יךָ יִתְהַלְּכ֥וּ לְפָנַ֖י עַד־עוֹלָ֑ם וְעַתָּ֤ה נְאֻם־יְהֹוָה֙ חָלִ֣ילָה לִּ֔י כִּֽי־מְכַבְּדַ֥י אֲכַבֵּ֖ד וּבֹזַ֥י יֵקָֽלּוּ׃
verses.translit: lkhn n'myhvh 'lhy yshr'l 'mvr 'mrty bytkh vbyt 'bykh ythlkhv lpny 'd'vlm v'th n'myhvh chlylh ly khymkhbdy 'khbd vbzy yqlv
verses.translation: Therefore the LORD, the God of Israel, saith: I said indeed that thy house, and the house of thy father, should walk before Me for ever; but now the LORD saith: Be it far from Me: for them that honour Me I will honour, and they that despise Me shall be lightly esteemed.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִנֵּה֙ יָמִ֣ים בָּאִ֔ים וְגָֽדַעְתִּי֙ אֶת־זְרֹ֣עֲךָ֔ וְאֶת־זְרֹ֖עַ בֵּ֣ית אָבִ֑יךָ מִֽהְי֥וֹת זָקֵ֖ן בְּבֵיתֶֽךָ׃
verses.translit: hnh ymym b'ym vgd'ty 'tzr'kh v'tzr' byt 'bykh mhyvt zqn bbytkh
verses.translation: Behold, the days come, that I will cut off thine arm, and the arm of thy father’s house, that there shall not be an old man in thy house.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהִבַּטְתָּ֙ צַ֣ר מָע֔וֹן בְּכֹ֥ל אֲשֶׁר־יֵיטִ֖יב אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְלֹא־יִֽהְיֶ֥ה זָקֵ֛ן בְּבֵיתְךָ֖ כׇּל־הַיָּמִֽים׃
verses.translit: vhbtt tsr m'vn bkhl 'shryytyb 'tyshr'l vl'yhyh zqn bbytkh khlhymym
verses.translation: And thou shalt behold a rival in My habitation, in all the good which shall be done to Israel; and there shall not be an old man in thy house for ever.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאִ֗ישׁ לֹֽא־אַכְרִ֤ית לְךָ֙ מֵעִ֣ם מִזְבְּחִ֔י לְכַלּ֥וֹת אֶת־עֵינֶ֖יךָ וְלַאֲדִ֣יב אֶת־נַפְשֶׁ֑ךָ וְכׇל־מַרְבִּ֥ית בֵּיתְךָ֖ יָמ֥וּתוּ אֲנָשִֽׁים׃
verses.translit: v'ysh l''khryt lkh m'm mzbchy lkhlvt 't'ynykh vl'dyb 'tnpshkh vkhlmrbyt bytkh ymvtv 'nshym
verses.translation: Yet will I not cut off every man of thine from Mine altar, to make thine eyes to fail, and thy heart to languish; and all the increase of thy house shall die young men.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְזֶה־לְּךָ֣ הָא֗וֹת אֲשֶׁ֤ר יָבֹא֙ אֶל־שְׁנֵ֣י בָנֶ֔יךָ אֶל־חׇפְנִ֖י וּפִֽינְחָ֑ס בְּי֥וֹם אֶחָ֖ד יָמ֥וּתוּ שְׁנֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vzhlkh h'vt 'shr yb' 'lshny bnykh 'lchpny vpynchs byvm 'chd ymvtv shnyhm
verses.translation: And this shall be the sign unto thee, that which shall come upon thy two sons, on Hophni and Phinehas: in one day they shall die both of them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַהֲקִימֹתִ֥י לִי֙ כֹּהֵ֣ן נֶאֱמָ֔ן כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר בִּלְבָבִ֥י וּבְנַפְשִׁ֖י יַעֲשֶׂ֑ה וּבָנִ֤יתִי לוֹ֙ בַּ֣יִת נֶאֱמָ֔ן וְהִתְהַלֵּ֥ךְ לִפְנֵֽי־מְשִׁיחִ֖י כׇּל־הַיָּמִֽים׃
verses.translit: vhqymty ly khhn n'mn kh'shr blbby vbnpshy y'shh vbnyty lv byt n'mn vhthlkh lpnymshychy khlhymym
verses.translation: And I will raise Me up a faithful priest, that shall do according to that which is in My heart and in My mind; and I will build him a sure house; and he shall walk before Mine anointed for ever.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָיָ֗ה כׇּל־הַנּוֹתָר֙ בְּבֵ֣יתְךָ֔ יָבוֹא֙ לְהִשְׁתַּחֲוֺ֣ת ל֔וֹ לַאֲג֥וֹרַת כֶּ֖סֶף וְכִכַּר־לָ֑חֶם וְאָמַ֗ר סְפָחֵ֥נִי נָ֛א אֶל־אַחַ֥ת הַכְּהֻנּ֖וֹת לֶאֱכֹ֥ל פַּת־לָֽחֶם׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vhyh khlhnvtr bbytkh ybv' lhshtchvt lv l'gvrt khsf vkhkhrlchm v'mr spchny n' 'l'cht hkhhnvt l'khl ptlchm {p}
verses.translation: And it shall come to pass, that every one that is left in thy house shall come and bow down to him for a piece of silver and a loaf of bread, and shall say: Put me, I pray thee, into one of the priests’offices, that I may eat a morsel of bread.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהַנַּ֧עַר שְׁמוּאֵ֛ל מְשָׁרֵ֥ת אֶת־יְהֹוָ֖ה לִפְנֵ֣י עֵלִ֑י וּדְבַר־יְהֹוָ֗ה הָיָ֤ה יָקָר֙ בַּיָּמִ֣ים הָהֵ֔ם אֵ֥ין חָז֖וֹן נִפְרָֽץ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vhn'r shmv'l mshrt 'tyhvh lpny 'ly vdbryhvh hyh yqr bymym hhm 'yn chzvn nprts {s}
verses.translation: And the child Samuel ministered unto the LORD before Eli. And the word of the LORD was precious in those days; there was no frequent vision.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽיְהִי֙ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֔וּא וְעֵלִ֖י שֹׁכֵ֣ב בִּמְקוֹמ֑וֹ וְעֵינָו֙ הֵחֵ֣לּוּ כֵה֔וֹת לֹ֥א יוּכַ֖ל לִרְאֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: vyhy byvm hhv' v'ly shkhb bmqvmv v'ynv hchlv khhvt l' yvkhl lr'vt
verses.translation: And it came to pass at that time, when Eli was laid down in his place—now his eyes had begun to wax dim, that he could not see—
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנֵ֤ר אֱלֹהִים֙ טֶ֣רֶם יִכְבֶּ֔ה וּשְׁמוּאֵ֖ל שֹׁכֵ֑ב בְּהֵיכַ֣ל יְהֹוָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־שָׁ֖ם אֲר֥וֹן אֱלֹהִֽים׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vnr 'lhym trm ykhbh vshmv'l shkhb bhykhl yhvh 'shrshm 'rvn 'lhym {p}
verses.translation: and the lamp of God was not yet gone out, and Samuel was laid down to sleep in the temple of the LORD, where the ark of God was,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּקְרָ֧א יְהֹוָ֛ה אֶל־שְׁמוּאֵ֖ל וַיֹּ֥אמֶר הִנֵּֽנִי׃
verses.translit: vyqr' yhvh 'lshmv'l vy'mr hnny
verses.translation: that the LORD called Samuel; and he said: ‘Here am I.’ .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּ֣רׇץ אֶל־עֵלִ֗י וַיֹּ֤אמֶר הִנְנִי֙ כִּֽי־קָרָ֣אתָ לִּ֔י וַיֹּ֥אמֶר לֹֽא־קָרָ֖אתִי שׁ֣וּב שְׁכָ֑ב וַיֵּ֖לֶךְ וַיִּשְׁכָּֽב׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vyrts 'l'ly vy'mr hnny khyqr't ly vy'mr l'qr'ty shvb shkhb vylkh vyshkhb {s}
verses.translation: And he ran unto Eli, and said: ‘Here am I; for thou didst call me.’ And he said: ‘I called not; lie down again.’ And he went and lay down.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣סֶף יְהֹוָ֗ה קְרֹ֣א עוֹד֮ שְׁמוּאֵל֒ וַיָּ֤קׇם שְׁמוּאֵל֙ וַיֵּ֣לֶךְ אֶל־עֵלִ֔י וַיֹּ֣אמֶר הִנְנִ֔י כִּ֥י קָרָ֖אתָ לִ֑י וַיֹּ֛אמֶר לֹא־קָרָ֥אתִֽי בְנִ֖י שׁ֥וּב שְׁכָֽב׃
verses.translit: vysf yhvh qr' 'vd shmv'l vyqm shmv'l vylkh 'l'ly vy'mr hnny khy qr't ly vy'mr l'qr'ty bny shvb shkhb
verses.translation: And the LORD called yet again Samuel. And Samuel arose and went to Eli, and said: ‘Here am I; for thou didst call me.’ And he answered: ‘I called not, my son; lie down again.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּשְׁמוּאֵ֕ל טֶ֖רֶם יָדַ֣ע אֶת־יְהֹוָ֑ה וְטֶ֛רֶם יִגָּלֶ֥ה אֵלָ֖יו דְּבַר־יְהֹוָֽה׃
